local local_class = newclass('CivilWarFakeNewsSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = CivilWarFakeNews @
		Comment = 가짜 뉴스 TV 부수기 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 진행도
	self.section_state = {
		default_start = 1,
		tv_break = 2,
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.default_start

	-- npc
	self.get_civilian = function(number)
		return get_character('fake_news_npc_' .. number)
	end

	-- field object
	self.get_tv = controller.get_tv
	self.get_broken_tv = controller.get_broken_tv

	-- fx
	self.get_fx_obj_smoke = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_obj_smoke')
	end

	-- zone event
	self.tv_zone_name = 'fake_news_tv_zone'
	self.tv_strings = nil
	self.req_cnt = 1
	self.tv_routine = false
	self.zone_check = false

	--sfx
	self.sfx_tv_loop = nil
	self.sfx_npc_clap = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_fx_obj_smoke()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/CivilWar/Common/Util')

	self.tv_strings = {
		'cw_fake_news_s1_4',
		'cw_fake_news_s1_5',
		'cw_fake_news_s1_6',
		'cw_fake_news_s1_7',
		'cw_fake_news_s1_8',
		'cw_fake_news_s1_9'
	}

	self.get_broken_tv().ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	self.util = nil
	self.tv_strings = nil
	self.req_cnt = -1
	self.tv_routine = false
	self.zone_check = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.default_start and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.tv_zone_name) then
		self.zone_check = true

		if not self.tv_routine then
			self.tv_routine = true
			start_coroutine(self.tv_talk, self)
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.default_start and
			type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), self.tv_zone_name) then
		self.req_cnt = self.req_cnt + 1
		self.zone_check = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.default_start then
		return false
	end

	-- 폭탄 대미지를 받았을 때
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.get_tv(), e.Info.target) then
		if e.Info.type == CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap | CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.tv_break
			start_coroutine(self.tv_break_event, self)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
	self.req_cnt = -1
	self.tv_routine = false
	self.zone_check = false
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_tv())

	if self.sfx_tv_loop ~= nil then
		self.sfx_tv_loop:Stop()
		self.sfx_tv_loop = nil
	end

	if self.sfx_npc_clap ~= nil then
		self.sfx_npc_clap:Stop()
		self.sfx_npc_clap = nil
	end
	return true
end
--endregion

-- 티비 대사 출력
function local_class:tv_talk()
	self.req_cnt = self.req_cnt + 1
	local cur_req_cnt = self.req_cnt
	local tv = self.get_tv()

	self.sfx_tv_loop = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_02', parent = self.get_tv(), loop = true,
			  type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	while cur_req_cnt == self.req_cnt do
		for i = 1, #self.tv_strings do
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tv,
					{ key = self.tv_strings[i], skip = false })

			if not self.tv_routine then
				break
			end
		end

		-- 마지막 대사 후 3초 대기
		local time_passed = 0
		local delay_time = 3

		while self.tv_routine and time_passed < delay_time do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		-- 3초 후에 존 안에 있을 경우 다시 루틴
		if self.zone_check then
			cur_req_cnt = self.req_cnt
		end
	end

	self.tv_routine = false
end

function local_class:tv_break_event()
	local broken_tv = self.get_broken_tv()
	local tv = self.get_tv()
	local civilian_1 = self.get_civilian(1)
	local civilian_2 = self.get_civilian(2)
	local civilian_3 = self.get_civilian(3)
	local civilian_4 = self.get_civilian(4)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_broadcast_01')

	self.tv_routine = false
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(tv)
	tv.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	broken_tv.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

	self.get_fx_obj_smoke():Instantiate(broken_tv.Position)

	--1)(2)(up,embarrassed)상태로 1칸 아래로 이동하면서 대사
	--(3)(left,scared,embarrassed) 상태로 1칸 오른쪽으로 이동
	character_util.set_locked_dir(civilian_1, 'up')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(civilian_2, 'up')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(civilian_3, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(civilian_3, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_group_anim({ civilian_1, civilian_2, civilian_3 }, self, 'embarrassed')
	wp_util.move(civilian_1, civilian_1.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), 4)
	wp_util.move(civilian_2, civilian_2.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), 4)

	--(1): 아이고야!
	--(2): 뭐, 뭐야?!
	--(3): 으아아악!!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(civilian_1, { key = 'cw_fake_news_s1_10', skip = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(civilian_2, { key = 'cw_fake_news_s1_11', skip = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(civilian_3, { key = 'cw_fake_news_s1_12', skip = false })

	--(4)(left,smile,success) 1초
	scene_util.set_emotion(civilian_4, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(civilian_4, self, 'success')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--(4)속도 1로 (left) 1칸 이동 후
	character_util.remove_anim(civilian_4)
	wp_util.move_async(civilian_4, civilian_4.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 1)

	--(4)(left,smile,clap)
	scene_util.set_anim(civilian_4, self, { name = 'clap', one_shot_sfx = false })

	self.sfx_npc_clap = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '01_clap_loop_01', parent = civilian_4, loop = true,
			  type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', max_distance = 2 })

	character_util.remove_group_anim({ civilian_1, civilian_2 })
	scene_util.set_anim(civilian_3, self, 'cast')
	civilian_1.Interactable.Talk = 'cw_fake_news_s1_13'
	civilian_2.Interactable.Talk = 'cw_fake_news_s1_14'
	civilian_3.Interactable.Talk = 'cw_fake_news_s1_15'
	civilian_4.Interactable.Talk = 'cw_fake_news_s1_16'

	-- 쥐폭탄 조작 후 대기 상태에 퀘스트 클리어 진입
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

return local_class

	self.custom_state_key = 'fake_id_current_state'
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:load_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/CivilWar/Common/Util')

	self:npc_setting()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent), 'on_battle_start_event')
	message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), 'on_battle_end_event')
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_worker(), self.controller)

	self.util = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.default_start and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'show_worker_talk_zone') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.show_worker_talk
		start_coroutine(self.show_worker_event, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.show_worker_talk and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_fake_id_box()) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.get_fake_id
		self.util:start_scene(self.interact_fake_id_box, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.get_fake_id and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_worker()) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.give_fake_id
		self.util:start_scene(self.give_fake_id_event, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 전투중에 인터렉트 불가능
function local_class:on_battle_start_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.show_worker_talk then
		self.get_fake_id_box().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 전투중이 아니면 인터렉트 가능
function local_class:on_battle_end_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.show_worker_talk then
		self.get_fake_id_box().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

--- npc 세팅
function local_class:npc_setting()
	local state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.custom_state_key)

	if state ~= -1 then
		self.current_section_state = state
	end

	local worker = self.get_worker()
	character_util.set_position(worker, self.get_fake_id_npc_pos(1))
	character_util.set_direction(worker, 'right')

	--노동자 npc 이펙트 생성
	self.fx_star_piece = self.fx:star_piece():Instantiate(worker.Position)

	--이벤트 첫 시작일 경우
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.default_start then
		--노동자 세팅
		scene_util.set_emotion(worker, self, 'scared')
		scene_util.set_anim(worker, self, 'cast')

		--브로커 세팅
		local black_marker_1 = self.get_black_market(1)
		character_util.set_position(black_marker_1, self.get_fake_id_npc_pos(2))
		character_util.set_direction(black_marker_1, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(black_marker_1, self, 'doyagao')
		scene_util.set_anim(black_marker_1, self, 'idle')

		local black_marker_2 = self.get_black_market(2)
		character_util.set_position(black_marker_2, self.get_fake_id_npc_pos(3))
		character_util.set_direction(black_marker_2, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(black_marker_2, self, 'doyagao')
		scene_util.set_anim(black_marker_2, self, 'bow_idle')

		--브로커가 들고있는 아이템
		local offset = vector(-0.3, 0, 0.2)
		self.broker_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = black_marker_2.Position + offset,
			itemid = self.item_id,
			sprscale = 0.5,
			notforinven = true,
			showoncharacter = true,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
		})
		self.broker_item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	else
		--노동자 세팅
		scene_util.set_emotion(worker, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(worker, self, 'seat')

		-- 박스 인터렉트 가능
		self.get_fake_id_box().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		--원라인 대사
		--(1)(right,tired,idle):  진작에 신분증 재발급 신청을 했어야 하는데…
		worker.Interactable.Talk = 'cw_give_fakeid_s1_5'
	end

	--책상 위에 있는 아이템
	local item_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_fake_id_table_pos')
	self.table_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = item_pos,
		itemid = self.item_id,
		sprscale = 0.5,
		notforinven = true,
		showoncharacter = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
	})
	self.table_item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

--- 일꾼과 암거래 상인 대화
function local_class:show_worker_event()
	local worker = self.get_worker()
	local black_marker_1 = self.get_black_market(1)
	local black_marker_2 = self.get_black_market(2)

	--현재 스테이트 저장
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.custom_state_key, self.section_state.show_worker_talk)

	--(1)(right,scared,release): 아니 또 거기서 3배를 더 달라고요?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_02', parent = worker, loop = false,
			  type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(worker, self, nil,
			'release',
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_give_fakeid_s1_1', skip = false })

	--(1)(right,scared,cast): 이미 제 돈으로 신분증도 완성해놨잖아요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(worker, self, nil,
			'cast',
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_give_fakeid_s1_2', skip = false })

	--(2)(left,doyagao,bomb_idle): 이봐, 그건 제작비지 제공비가 아니라고.
	music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', parent = black_marker_1, loop = false,
			  type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(black_marker_1, self, nil,
			'bomb_idle',
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_give_fakeid_s1_3', skip = false })

	self.broker_item:ConsumeComplete()
	self.broker_item = nil

	--(3)(left,doyagao,nod2회): 뭐, 아쉬운 건 우리가 아니니까.
	music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '01_male_laugh_at_03', parent = black_marker_2, loop = false,
			  type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(black_marker_2, self, nil,
			'nod',
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_give_fakeid_s1_4', skip = false })

	--이 후 (1)(right,tired,seat) 상태 (2),(3)은 오른쪽으로 이동 그리드 넘어가면 제거
	scene_util.set_emotion(worker, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(worker, self, 'seat')

	local move_key = 'black_marker_move_wp'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(black_marker_1, black_marker_1.Position + vector(8, 0, 0),
			nil, 2, self, move_key)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(black_marker_2, black_marker_2.Position + vector(8, 0, 0),
			nil, 2, self, move_key)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(black_marker_1, 0, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(black_marker_2, 0, 0.5)
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	character_util.set_position(black_marker_1, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_position(black_marker_2, vector(999, 0, 999))

	-- 박스 인터렉트 가능
	self.get_fake_id_box().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	--원라인 대사
	--(1)(right,tired,idle):  진작에 신분증 재발급 신청을 했어야 하는데…
	worker.Interactable.Talk = 'cw_give_fakeid_s1_5'
end

function local_class:interact_fake_id_box()
	local box = self.get_fake_id_box()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local worker = self.get_worker()

	party_util.align_party(box.Position, 'down', 1, 'linear')

	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'eat')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--아이템 shake async
	do
		local shake_key = 'fake_id'
		local duration = 0.5
		drop_item_util.shake(self.table_item, shake_key, 0.03, duration)
		wait_for_sec(duration)

		drop_item_util.cancel_shake(self.table_item, shake_key)
	end

	--아이템 획득
	self.table_item.ConsumeTarget = leader
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	equipping_sfx:Stop()
	equipping_sfx = nil

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.get_fake_id_box().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	character_util.add_listener(worker, self.controller)
end

--- 일꾼에게 위조 신분증 전달
function local_class:give_fake_id_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local worker = self.get_worker()
	local align_pos = worker.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)

	party_util.align_party(align_pos, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	--가디언(left,idle,throw)로 해당 스프라이트를 (1) 0.5칸 우측에 던진다.
	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = leader.Position,
											  target = worker.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
											  itemid = self.item_id,
											  sprscale = 0.5,
											  notforinven = true,
											  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })

	--이 후 (1)에게 해당 아이템이 습득된다.
	item.ConsumeTarget = worker
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--(1)(right,surprise,idle)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(worker, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(worker, self, 'idle')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(worker, '01_player_jump_01')

	--(1)(right,surprise,release): 이… 이걸 어떻게?!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(worker, self, nil,
			'release',
			nil,
			'cw_give_fakeid_s1_6')

	--선택지
	--난 마계 별의 결사단이니까! (노랑)
	--알면 다쳐. (빨강)
	--다 돕고 사는 거 아니겠어? (초록)
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'cw_give_fakeid_s1_7', 'intellect' },
		{ 'cw_give_fakeid_s1_8', 'brutal' },
		{ 'cw_give_fakeid_s1_9', 'mercy' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--가디언(left,smile,victory_get)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'victory_get', sfx_name = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01' })

		--동시에(1)(right,smile,idle)
		scene_util.set_emotion(worker, self, 'smile')
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		--가디언(left,eyelight,idle)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'eyelight')

		--동시에(1)(right,scread,idle)(jump1회)
		scene_util.set_emotion(worker, self, 'scared')
		character_util.normal_jump(worker, '01_jump_01')
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
	elseif choose_result == 3 then
		--가디언(left,sleep_deep,nod2회)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'sleep_deep')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'nod')

		--동시에(1)(right,smile,sing)
		scene_util.set_emotion(worker, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(worker, self, 'sing')
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	--(1)(right,smile,idle)(jump1회): 도와줘서 정말 고마워! 보답으로 이걸 줄게!
	scene_util.set_emotion(worker, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(worker, self, 'clap')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(worker, 'cw_give_fakeid_s1_10')

	--(1)(get)자세로 스타피스를 한칸 앞에 떨군다.
	scene_util.set_anim(worker, self, 'get')

	self.fx_star_piece:Dispose()
	self.fx_star_piece = nil

	local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)

	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, worker.Position, worker.Position + vector(1, 0, 0))
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--(1)(right,smile,release): 이 은혜는 평생 기억할게!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(worker, self, nil,
			'release',
			nil,
			'cw_give_fakeid_s1_11')

	worker.Interactable.Talk = 'cw_give_fakeid_s1_11'

	-- 퀘스트 클리어
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

return local_class

	character_util.add_color(demon_powergirl, demon_powergirl.Name, unity_color({ 0.6, 0.6, 0.6, 1 }), 1, 0.3)
end

-- 파이몬 숙주 대사 끝
function local_class:talk_end_demon_powergirl_host(fo)
	local demon_powergirl = fo
	character_util.remove_color(demon_powergirl, demon_powergirl.Name, 0.3)
end

--해당 녹색존 진입시 이벤트
--해당 이벤트는 섹션 7까지 유지된다.
function local_class:block_event()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	self.jump_king_gimmick:jump_end_wait(function()
		self.is_in_block_zone = false
	end)

	if not self.is_in_block_zone then
		field_ui_manager:Show()
		party_util.reset_controllers()

		return
	end

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local hela = self.get_hela()
	scene_util.set_emotion(hela, self, 'scared')

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--친구(scared)표정 (release): 그쪽으로 가면 붙잡힐 거야!
	character_util.look_at(hela, leader)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hela, self, nil,
			{ name = 'release' },
			{ name = 'scared' },
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_jump_block_1', skip = true })

	local return_pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter('jump_block_zone', leader, 'left', 1)
	wp_util.move_async(leader, return_pos, 4, nil, { run = false })
	self.is_in_block_zone = false

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
	
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

function local_class:demon_powergirl_rush_routine_start(opening_scene)
	self.is_rush_routine = true
	start_coroutine(self.demon_powergirl_rush_routine, self, opening_scene)
end

function local_class:demon_powergirl_rush_routine_end()
	self.is_rush_routine = false
end

--파이몬이 달릴 때 부딪히는 오브젝트 파괴 하는 루틴
function local_class:demon_powergirl_rush_routine(fo, opening_scene)
	local demon_powergirl = fo
	local bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(demon_powergirl.Bounds.center, demon_powergirl.Bounds.size * 1.1)

	while self.is_rush_routine do
		local dir = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(demon_powergirl))
		bounds.center = demon_powergirl.Bounds.center
		local correction_value = 0.3
		local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(bounds, dir * correction_value)

		for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
			local obj = obj_list[i]
			if lua_helper.type_compare(obj.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.RockDamagedBehaviour) then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee | CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
				damage_info.sender = demon_powergirl
				damage_info.target = obj
				damage_info.damage = 9999999

				--파이몬과 부딪힌 오브젝트는 fx_obj_smoke 출력과 함께 사라짐
				self.fx:obj_smoke():Instantiate(obj.Position)

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

				if opening_scene then
					--부술때 화면 shake 0.05 /0.5초	
					camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.5)
				end
				--오브젝트 사라질때 화면 shake0.1 / 0.5초 재생
				camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)
			end
		end

		obj_list:Dispose()

		if not self.is_rush_routine then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:get_inner_progress()
	if self.quest_progress == nil then
		return 0
	end

	if self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		return #self.sections
	end

	return self.quest_progress.InnerProgress
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('CivilWarJumpKingPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = CivilWarJumpKing @
		Comment = 2스테이지에서 점프킹 스테이지 오픈 이벤트 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.available_stage_name = 'civilwar_2'

	-- 섹션 내 스테이트 Enum
	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		after_police_zone_enter = 2,
		police_event = 3,
		interact_tiara_event = 4,
	}
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	-- 파이몬
	self.get_demon_powergirl = function()
		return get_character('sub_jump_king_demon_powergirl')
	end

	-- 헬라
	self.get_hela = function()
		return get_character('sub_jump_king_hela')
	end

	-- 경찰들
	self.get_police = function(idx)
		return get_character('sub_jump_king_police_' .. idx)
	end

	-- 티아라 올려진 오브젝트
	self.get_tiara_box = function()
		return get_field_object('sub_jump_king_tiara_interact')
	end

	-- 아이템 id
	self.donut_id = 21091
	self.tiara_id = 21094

	self.fx = {
		flame_rush_loop = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_flame_rush_loop')
		end,
		flame_rush_end = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_flame_rush_end')
		end,
		flame_area = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_flame_area')
		end,
		dead = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
		end,
		obj_smoke = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_obj_smoke')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	---@type CivilWarUtil
	self.cw_util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/CivilWar/Common/Util')

	self.fx:load_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	self:progress_check()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.after_police_zone_enter
			and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'sub_jump_king_open_event_1') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.police_event
		self.cw_util:start_scene(self.police_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local tiara_box = self.get_tiara_box()

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.police_event and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, tiara_box) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.interact_tiara_event
		self.cw_util:start_scene(self.tiara_interact_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 's12_start' then
		self:pre_setting()
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:progress_check()
	local main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(357)
	local main_quest_inner_progress = main_quest_progress.InnerProgress

	if main_quest_inner_progress > 10 then
		self:pre_setting()
	else
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	end
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_police_zone_enter

	self.police = {
		self.get_police(1),
		self.get_police(2),
		self.get_police(3),
	}

	self.group_action = function(table, func)
		for i = 1, #table do
			func(table[i], i)
		end
	end

	self.group_action(self.police, function(target, idx)
		character_util.set_active_state(target, 'enabled')
		target.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_jump_king_police_pos_1') + vector(0, 0, -(idx - 1))
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(target, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })
	end)

	local hela = self.get_hela()
	character_util.set_active_state(hela, 'enabled')
	--character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(hela, 0, 0)
	--hela.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_jump_king_hela_pos_1')
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(hela, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	hela.Position = vector(8.3, 1, 26)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(hela, { dir = 'down', sfx = false })

	local demon_powergirl = self.get_demon_powergirl()
	character_util.set_active_state(demon_powergirl, 'enabled')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(demon_powergirl, 0, 0)
	demon_powergirl.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_jump_king_reine_pos_1') + vector(0, 0, 2)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(demon_powergirl, { dir = 'down', sfx = false })

	local tiara_box = self.get_tiara_box()
	self.tiara = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = tiara_box.Position + vector(0.5, 2, 0.3),
		itemid = self.tiara_id,
		notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
	})
end

function local_class:police_event()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	local hela = self.get_hela()
	--(1)(2)(3)(left,idle,idle)상태 (1)에게 카메라가 따라간다.
	local camera_pos = self.police[1].Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0.5)

	--(1)(2)(3)속도 2로 좌측으로 한칸 이동
	local wp_key = 'wp_key'

	self.group_action(self.police, function(target)
		local speed = 2
		local wp = target.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(target,
				wp, speed, nil, self, wp_key,
				{ run = false })
	end)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	--(1)(left,smile,eat)1초 해당 NPC로 부터 포물선으로 좌측 1칸에 해당 스프라이트가 떨어진다.
	local item_target_pos = self.police[1].Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	local donut = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = self.police[1].Position,
		target = item_target_pos,
		itemid = self.donut_id,
		notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		skip_text = true
	})

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--(1)(left,smile,success): 드디어 아껴뒀던 간식을 먹을 수 있겠다.
	--이때 (2)(3) (up)방향 전환
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(self.police[2], { dir = 'up', sfx = false })
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(self.police[3], { dir = 'up', sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.police[1], self, 'left',
			{ name = 'success' },
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_pre_1', skip = true })

	--(2): 그래 이제 마신도 지원왔고 그 정도 시간은 있겠지.
	--이때 (1)(down,smile,idle)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(self.police[1], { dir = 'down', sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.police[2], 'cw_jump_king_pre_2', true)

	--(3): 천천히 먹어… 마지막일수도 있잖아.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.police[3], 'cw_jump_king_pre_3', true)

	--이때 상단 오브젝트에서 레이네의 친구가 jump높이로 뛰어 1초동안 해당 스프라이트 좌측 0.5칸으로 이동
	--이때 (1)(2)(3)(left,surprise,idle)(jump1회)
	self.group_action(self.police, function(target)
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(target, { dir = 'left', sfx = '01_swing_01' })
		scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, 'surprise')
		character_util.normal_jump(target, true)
	end)

	do
		local hela_jump_target_pos = item_target_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(hela, 1, 0)
		scene_util.set_anim(hela, self, { name = 'get' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

		local height = 0.5
		local duration = 0.5
		character_util.jump(hela, height, duration)
		wp_util.move_async(hela, hela_jump_target_pos, nil, duration, { run = false, locked_dir = 'right' })
	end

	--친구(right,idle,eat)0.5초
	local eat_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
		parent = hela,
		loop = true,
		type_priority = 'loop',
		player_priority = 'npc'
	})
	scene_util.set_anim(hela, self, { name = 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--이때 도넛 스프라이트 친구에게 획득됨
	donut.ConsumeTarget = hela
	donut:Fly()
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(hela)
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_loop_sfx)

	--이 후 친구(left)방향으로 6속도로 달려서 그리드밖에서 사라짐
	local wp_key = 'wp_key'
	local speed = 6

	local hela_wp = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', hela.Position, -1.5)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hela,
			hela_wp, speed, nil, self, wp_key,
			{ run = true, end_callback = function()
				hela.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				character_util.set_active_state(hela, 'disabled')
			end })

	--친구 뛰기시작하고 0.5초 후 (1)(2)(3)도 (scared)표정으로 6 속도로 (left)방향 달려서 그리드밖에서 사라짐
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	self.group_action(self.police, function(target)
		scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, 'scared')
		local wp = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', target.Position, -1.5)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(target,
				wp, speed, nil, self, wp_key,
				{ run = true, end_callback = function()
					target.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
					character_util.set_active_state(target, 'disabled')
				end })
	end)

	--이때 대사 (1): 거기 서!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.police[1],
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_pre_4', skip = false })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.police[1])

	--카메라 기사에게 복귀 컨트롤 풀림
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	--서브퀘스트 마커 해당 지점에 생김
	local tiara_box = self.get_tiara_box()
	quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_key, tiara_box, true)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:tiara_interact_event()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local tiara_box = self.get_tiara_box()
	local demon_powergirl = self.get_demon_powergirl()
	scene_util.hide_weapon(demon_powergirl)
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_key)

	-- 기존 메인 파이몬 숨김
	character_util.set_position(get_character('demon_powergirl'), vector(999, 0, 999))

	--가디언 해당 오브젝트 하단에 정렬 (up,idle,idle)
	local wp = tiara_box.Position + vector(0.5, 0, -1)
	wp_util.move_async(leader, wp, 3, nil, { run = false, last_direction = 'up' })

	--선택지
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--힘껏 점프한다. (초록)
		{ 'cw_jump_king_pre_choose_1', 'mercy' },
		--저 물건은 분명히 신맛이 날거야. (노랑)
		{ 'cw_jump_king_pre_choose_2', 'intellect' },
		--때린다. (빨강)
		{ 'cw_jump_king_pre_choose_3', 'brutal' },
	})

	--힘껏 점프한다. (초록)
	if choose_result == 1 then
		--(up,idle,cast2)(jump2회)
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'cast2' })
		character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, true)
		character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, true)

		--(up,idle,idle)(annoyed)이모티콘 버블
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'annoyed')

		--저 물건은 분명히 신맛이 날거야. (노랑)
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
		--(left,sleep_deep,question)(silence) 이모티콘 버블
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self,
				{ 'left', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'question' },
				{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
				'silence')

		--(left,idle,nod2회)
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

		--때린다. (빨강)
	elseif choose_result == 3 then
		--(up,idle,attack)

		--앞에 오브젝트 (shake0.03/0.2초)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
		field_object_util.shake(tiara_box, 0.03, 0.2)
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

		--(left,tired,bomb_idle)(annoyed)이모티콘 버블
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self,
				{ 'left', sfx = false },
				{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
				{ name = 'tired' },
				'annoyed')
	end

	--공통진행
	--화면 shake0.1 /0.5초
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)

	--동시에 가디언(left,scared,cliff)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(leader, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'cliff' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--가디언(left,damaged,prostrate 0.5속도) 1.5칸 좌측으로 이동 (이동 시간 0.5초)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'prostrate', scale = 0.5 })

	local wp = leader.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0)
	local duration = 0.5
	wp_util.move(leader, wp, nil, duration, { run = false })

	--동시에 상단으로 부터 파이몬이 fx_flame_rush 와 경로에 fx_flame_area 사용
	self.controller:demon_powergirl_rush_routine_start(demon_powergirl, false)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(demon_powergirl, 1, 0)
	self:change_damage_behaviour()

	--이동속도 8로 내려온다. 부딪치는 오브젝트는 fx_obj_smoke와 함께 사라진다.
	local flame_rush = self.fx:flame_rush_loop()

function local_class:open_substage_scene()
	--파이몬이 달려가는 방향을 보자 새로운 길이 생겨나는 걸 발견했다!

	screen_util.quest_accept_event(false, false)

	quest_util.activate_quest(self.controller)
end

function local_class:item_move_curve(item, target_pos, height, duration, rotation_num)
	local start_pos = item.Position

	coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(duration, start_pos, target_pos, function(progress, cur_value)
		local h = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
		local lerp_pos = cur_value + vector(0, h, 0)

		item.Position = lerp_pos

		local rotate_progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(1, progress)
		local cur_rotation = rotate_progress * 360 * rotation_num

		item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.back)
		item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.back)
	end)
end

function local_class:change_damage_behaviour()
	local target_zone = field_util.get_zone('sub_jump_king_get_object_zone')
	local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(target_zone.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
		local obj = obj_list[i]
		obj.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.RockDamagedBehaviour()
	end
end

return local_class

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(soldiers[2], self, 'down',

			{ name = 'scared' },
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s1_19', skip = true })
	
	--레이네(up,idle,idle):$all_pymon_host$괴, 괴물이라뇨! 전 엄연히 소녀라고요!
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(demon_powergirl)
	self.controller:talk_demon_powergirl_host(demon_powergirl)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(demon_powergirl, 'cw_jump_king_s1_20', true)

	self.controller:talk_end_demon_powergirl_host(demon_powergirl)

	--(6)(right,attack,release): 다들 맞서 싸워!!!
	--이때 1~10 NPC들 표정 (attack) 변경 파이몬은 (left,idle,idle)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	character_util.set_group_emotion(soldiers, { name = 'attack' })
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(demon_powergirl, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(soldiers[6], self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release' },
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s1_21', skip = true })

	--파이몬(left,smile,victory_get): 하하하! 몸풀기엔 딱이겠군!

	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_powergirl, self, 'left',

			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s1_22', skip = true })

	--일반전투 진행

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_key)
	--일반전투 끝난 후 페이드 아웃 페이드 인
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

	character_util.set_death_type(npc, 'airspin')

local local_class = newclass('CivilWarJumpKingSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = CivilWarJumpKing @
		Comment = 사울 병사에게 추격 당하다 헬라를 만남 @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.available_stage_name = 'civilwar_substage_pymon'

	-- 섹션 내 스테이트 Enum
	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		radio_scene = 2,
		soldier_chase_event = 3,
		wait_6_sec = 4,
		hela_hide_event = 5,
		done = 6
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	-- 파이몬
	self.get_demon_powergirl = function()
		return get_character('demon_powergirl')
	end

	-- 레이네
	self.get_reine = function()
		return get_character('reine')
	end

	-- 헬라
	self.get_hela = function()
		return get_character('hela')
	end

	-- 추격 하는 병사
	self.get_chase_soldier = function()
		return get_character('chase_soldier')
	end

	-- 길막는 병사
	self.get_blocking_soldier = function(idx)
		return get_character('blocking_soldier_' .. idx)
	end

	--가드 타워
	self.get_guard_tower = function()
		return get_field_object('s2_guardtower')
	end

	-- 문
	self.get_door = function(idx)
		return get_field_object('door_' .. idx)
	end

	self.fx = {
		dead = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}

	-- 티아라 아이템 아이디
	self.tiara_id = 21094
	-- 라디오 아이템 아이디
	self.radio_item_id = 21050

	-- 문이 열렸는지
	self.is_door_opened = false

	self.chase_soldier_state = {
		none = 1,
		chase = 2,
		stop = 3,
		caught = 4,
	}

	self.current_chase_soldier_state = self.chase_soldier_state.none
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:load_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent), 'on_door_opened_event')

	self:pre_setting()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.radio_scene

	self.is_prev_section = self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 1

	if self.is_prev_section then
		start_coroutine(self.s2_radio_scene, self, self.is_prev_section)
	else
		sp_util.start_scene(self.s2_radio_scene, self, self.is_prev_section)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local reine = self.get_reine()
	local chase_soldier = self.get_chase_soldier()

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.soldier_chase_event
			and self.current_chase_soldier_state == self.chase_soldier_state.stop
			and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, reine, 'soldier_chase_area') then
		self.current_chase_soldier_state = self.chase_soldier_state.chase
		-- 추격 범위에 다시 들어오면 추격 모드로 변경
		self:convert_to_chasing_state(chase_soldier)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.soldier_chase_event
			and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, reine, 's2_hela_hide_event') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.wait_6_sec
		start_coroutine(self.wait_6_sec_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	-- 잡혔을 때
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.soldier_chase_event
			and self.current_chase_soldier_state == self.chase_soldier_state.chase
			and e:GetParamAt(0) == 'caught_target' then
		self.current_chase_soldier_state = self.chase_soldier_state.caught
		sp_util.start_scene(self.caught_reaction, self)

		-- 지정된 존을 벗어났을 때
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.soldier_chase_event
			and self.current_chase_soldier_state == self.chase_soldier_state.chase
			and e:GetParamAt(0) == 'return_to_base_pos' then
		self.current_chase_soldier_state = self.chase_soldier_state.stop

		start_coroutine(self.chase_soldier_return, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_door_opened_event(e)
	if e.DoorHandleName == 'door_2' or e.DoorHandleName == 'door_3' then
		self.is_door_opened = true
	elseif e.DoorHandleName == 'door_1' then
		self.is_door_opened = true
	end
end

function local_class:wait_6_sec_event()
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_key)

	--플레이어가 2층에서 해당 플로어로 내려온 후 6초가 경과하면 이벤트 재생
	wait_for_sec(6)

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.hela_hide_event
	sp_util.start_scene(self.hela_hide_event, self)
end

function local_class:hela_hide_event()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	local reine = self.get_reine()
	local hela = self.get_hela()
	local chase_soldier = self.get_chase_soldier()

	character_util.convert_to_npc(chase_soldier)
	character_util.stop(chase_soldier)
	character_util.set_active_state(chase_soldier, 'disabled')

	--레이네가 해당 장소까지 속도(8)로 정렬

	wp_util.move_async(reine, reine_wp, 8, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'left' })

			{ name = 'cast' },
			{ name = 'scared' },
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s2_13', skip = true })

	--레이네(right,scared,embarrassed): 귀… 귀신이!

			{ name = 'embarrassed' },
			{ name = 'scared' },
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s2_16', skip = true })

function local_class:jump_move_async(fo, height, target_pos, speed, move_data)

	local duration = distance / speed

	character_util.jump(fo, height, duration)
	wp_util.move_async(fo, target_pos, nil, duration, move_data)
end

-- 아이템이 fade 하면서 회전하면서 드랍 하는 함수
function local_class:item_move_curve_and_fade(item, target_pos, height, duration, rotation_num)
	local start_pos = item.Position
	local item_sprite = item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local shadow_sprite = item.ShadowTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local item_start_color = item_sprite.TintColor
	local shadow_start_color = shadow_sprite.TintColor

	coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(duration, start_pos, target_pos, function(progress, cur_value)
		local h = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
		local lerp_pos = cur_value + vector(0, h, 0)

		item.Position = lerp_pos

		local rotate_progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(1, progress)
		local cur_rotation = rotate_progress * 360 * rotation_num

		item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.back)
		item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.back)

		item_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 1 }) * unity_class.mathf.Lerp(item_start_color.a, 1, progress)
		shadow_sprite.Alpha = 0.38 * unity_class.mathf.Lerp(shadow_start_color.a, 1, progress)
		item_sprite:Rebuild()
		shadow_sprite:Rebuild()
	end)
end

-- 캐릭터 스케일을 lerp 하게 조절
function local_class:set_scale_lerp(target, scale_duration, start_scale, end_scale)
	coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(scale_duration, start_scale, end_scale, function(progress, cur_value)
		character_util.set_scale_factor(target, target.Name, cur_value)
	end)

	target.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
	local origin_hit_box = target.Hitbox
	target.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(1, 0.75, 2))

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(chase_soldier, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })

local local_class = newclass('CivilWarJumpKingSection3')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = CivilWarJumpKing @
		Comment = 사울 병사를 피하며 처음으로 점프로 벽을 건넘 @

		NextSections = 3 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.available_stage_name = 'civilwar_substage_pymon'

	-- 섹션 내 스테이트 Enum
	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		hela_follow_start_event = 2,
		hela_follow_event = 3,
		interact_hela_scene = 4,
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	-- 레이네
	self.get_reine = function()
		return get_character('reine')
	end

	-- 헬라
	self.get_hela = function()
		return get_character('hela')
	end

	-- 병사들
	self.get_soldier = function(idx)
		return get_character('blocking_soldier_' .. idx)
	end

	self.fx = {
		flame_rush_loop = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_flame_rush_loop')
		end,
		smokescreen = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_smokescreen')
		end,
		custom_sprite = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite')
		end,
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}

	self.is_in_block_zone = false
	self.hela_move_end = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:load_all()
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	-- 총알 프리로드
	do
		local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
		local custom_atlas
		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
				res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
					custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
					custom_atlas:Initialize()
				end)

		self.pooled_bullet = self.fx:custom_sprite():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)
		local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

		bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
		bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
		bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
		bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
		bullet_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas

		bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'bullet_dark.png'
		bullet_sprite:Rebuild()
	end

end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	self:pre_setting()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.hela_follow_start_event

	start_coroutine(self.hela_follow_start_event, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	if self.pooled_bullet ~= nil then
		self.pooled_bullet:Dispose()
		self.pooled_bullet = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local reine = self.get_reine()

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.hela_follow_start_event
			and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, reine, 's3_follow_event_zone') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.hela_follow_event

		start_coroutine(self.hela_follow_event, self)

		return true
	elseif not self.is_in_block_zone
			and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, reine, 's3_block_zone') then
		self.is_in_block_zone = true
		sp_util.start_scene(self.block_zone_enter_event, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local hela = self.get_hela()

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.hela_follow_event and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, hela) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.interact_hela_scene
		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_hela_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:block_zone_enter_event()

		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			--이때 레이네(down,surprise,idle)(jump1회)
			scene_util.set_emotion(reine, self, 'surprise')
			character_util.normal_jump_async(reine, true)
		end)
	})

	--(tired)표정으로 (down)바라본 채 뒷걸음질로 위쪽으로 0.5칸 이동

function local_class:hela_follow_start_event()

		field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_hela_pos_1'),

function local_class:hela_follow_event()
	while not self.hela_move_end do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	local hela = self.get_hela()

	local hela_wp = {}
	local hela_wp_num = 8
	for idx = 2, hela_wp_num do
		local wp = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_hela_pos_' .. idx)
		table.insert(hela_wp, wp)
	end

	--이때 마커가 그 다음방 표시한 곳에 찍히게 된다
	local quest_marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_hela_pos_8') + vector(0, 0, 0.8)
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.controller.quest_marker_key, self.controller.quest_id, true, quest_marker_pos)

	local speed = 6.5
	--플레이어가 해당 공간에 들어오면 친구는 또 경로따라 다음방까지 이동한다.
	wp_util.move(hela, hela_wp, speed, nil,
			{ run = true, last_direction = 'down', callback = function(wp_index)
				if wp_index == 3 then
					local distance = vector_util.distance(hela_wp[3], hela_wp[4])
					local duration = distance / speed
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
					character_util.jump(hela, 1.5, duration)
				elseif wp_index == 6 then
					character_util.set_active_state(hela, 'enabled')
					character_util.add_listener(hela, self.controller)
				end
			end })

function local_class:dodge_bullet_scene()
	local hela = self.get_hela()
	local reine = self.get_reine()

	--슬로우 모션 시작
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_01')
	local slow_key = 'dodge_bullet_slow'
	time_util.mod(slow_key, 0.5)

	start_coroutine(function()
		--이와 동시에 하단 그리드 밖에서 부터 화살표 선으로 bullet_dark 프로젝타일이 16의 속도로 날아온다.
		local shoot_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_bullet_pos_1')
		local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_bullet_pos_2') + vector(0, 0.3, 8)
		local speed = 16

		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.MoveTo, self.pooled_bullet.transform,
				shoot_pos, target_pos, -1, nil, speed, false)
		if self.pooled_bullet ~= nil then
			self.pooled_bullet:Dispose()
			self.pooled_bullet = nil
		end
	end)

	start_coroutine(function()
		--레이네와 친구가 이동 시작 후 0.75초 (슬로우모션 적용 안된 시간 기준) 후 슬로우모션이 풀린다.
		wait_for_sec(0.75)
		time_util.unmod(slow_key)
	end)

	--친구(right,damaged,prostrate)레이네(right,damaged,prostrate) 상태로 전환 애니메이션 속도는 0.25로 jump높이로 떠오른다.
	--동시에 친구는 1초에 걸쳐 우측으로 1.5칸 레이네는 2칸 이동한다.
	do
		local duration = 1
		local height = 0.5
		local wp_key = 'wp_key'
		local jump_target_pos = {
			reine.Position + vector(2, 0, 0),
			hela.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0),
		}
		scene_util.set_anim(hela, self, { name = 'prostrate', scale = 0.25 })
		scene_util.set_emotion(hela, self, 'damaged')

		character_util.jump(hela, height, duration)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hela,
				jump_target_pos[2], nil, duration, self, wp_key, { run = false })

		--레이네는 친구보다 0.2초 늦게 전환
		--레이네 전환될 때 레이네에게 fx_hit +빨간틴트+눌림
		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		scene_util.set_anim(reine, self, { name = 'prostrate', scale = 0.25 })
		scene_util.set_emotion(reine, self, 'damaged')

		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(reine)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(reine)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
		self.fx.hit():Instantiate(reine.Bounds.center + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

		character_util.jump(reine, height, duration)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(reine,
				jump_target_pos[1], nil, duration, self, wp_key, { run = false })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end
end

--이동 중 타겟을 홀드업 하고 쭉 이동하는 연출
function local_class:custom_holdup_and_move(fo, target, data)
	local start_pos = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'from')
	local duration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'duration')
	local height = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'height', 1)

	local time_passed = 0
	while not self.move_and do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local lerp_pos_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_pos.y, height, progress)
		local cur_pos

		-- 홀드업할 타겟의 x 좌표가 같아질때까지 들어 올리고 이후엔 앞으로 전진함
		if target.Position.x > fo.Position.x then
			cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position, lerp_pos_y)
		else
			cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position, lerp_pos_y)
		end

		if progress < 1 then
			character_util.set_position(target, cur_pos, true)
		else
			cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position, height)
			character_util.set_position(target, cur_pos, true)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local reine = self.get_reine()

	if self.current_section_state < self.section_state.jump_king_tutorial
			and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, reine, 's4_jump_king_tutorial') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.jump_king_tutorial
		start_coroutine(self.jump_king_tutorial_scene, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state < self.section_state.reine_rest_event
			and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, reine, 's4_jump_king_tutorial_check_zone') then
		local marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_quest_marker_pos_2')
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.controller.quest_marker_key, self.controller.quest_id, true, marker_pos)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state < self.section_state.reine_rest_event
			and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, reine, 's4_reine_rest_event') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.reine_rest_event

		start_coroutine(self.reine_rest_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)

		self.qte_tap = true
		self.jump = false

		return true
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action3TouchUp then
		self.jump = true
	end

	if CS.Oak.InputManager.IsPC and self.is_tutorial and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		self.qte_tap = true
		self.jump = false

		return true
	end

	if CS.Oak.InputManager.IsPC and self.is_tutorial and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchUp then
		self.jump = true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:tutorial_jump_charge()
	self.jump_charge_time_passed = 0
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	while self.jump_charging do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		self.jump_charge_time_passed = self.jump_charge_time_passed + dt
		self.jump_charge_time = {
			ready = self.jump_charge_time_passed < 0.5,
			level_1 = self.jump_charge_time_passed > 0.5 and self.jump_charge_time_passed <= 1.25,
			level_2 = self.jump_charge_time_passed > 1.25 and self.jump_charge_time_passed <= 2,
			level_3 = self.jump_charge_time_passed > 2 and self.jump_charge_time_passed <= 4,
			over = self.jump_charge_time_passed > 4
		}

		if self.jump_charge_time.ready then
			if self.current_charge_state == self.jump_charge_state.ready then
				self.current_charge_state = self.jump_charge_state.level_1
				self:tutorial_jump_charge_action(leader, self.jump_charge_state.ready)
			end
		elseif self.jump_charge_time.level_1 then
			if self.current_charge_state == self.jump_charge_state.level_1 then
				self.current_charge_state = self.jump_charge_state.level_2
				self:tutorial_holdup(leader)
				self:tutorial_jump_charge_action(leader, self.jump_charge_state.level_1)
			end
		elseif self.jump_charge_time.level_2 then
			if self.current_charge_state == self.jump_charge_state.level_2 then
				self.current_charge_state = self.jump_charge_state.level_3
				self:tutorial_holdup(leader)
				self:tutorial_jump_charge_action(leader, self.jump_charge_state.level_2)
			end
		elseif self.jump_charge_time.level_3 then
			if self.current_charge_state == self.jump_charge_state.level_3 then
				self.current_charge_state = self.jump_charge_state.over
				self:tutorial_holdup(leader)
				self:tutorial_jump_charge_action(leader, self.jump_charge_state.level_3)
			end
		elseif self.jump_charge_time.over then
			if self.current_charge_state == self.jump_charge_state.over then
				self.current_charge_state = self.jump_charge_state.done

				self:tutorial_throw(leader, unity_class.vector3.right)

				if self.fx_buff_loop_pool ~= nil then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_light_turn_off_01')
					local buff_end = self.fx:jump_king_buff_end()
										 :Instantiate(leader.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, leader.Transform)
					buff_end.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7
					self.fx_buff_loop_pool:Dispose()
					self.fx_buff_loop_pool = nil
				end

				self:tutorial_jump_charge_action(leader, self.jump_charge_state.over)

				self.jump_charging = false

				return
			end
		end

		if self.jump then
			if self.is_tutorial then
				if self.current_charge_state == self.jump_charge_state.level_1
						or self.current_charge_state == self.jump_charge_state.done then
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

					self:jump_king_tutorial_fail()
				else
					self.jump_charging = false
					self:tutorial_jump(leader)
				end

				return
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:tutorial_jump_charge_action(fo, level)
	if self.jump_charge_state.ready == level then
		--0초~0.5초 미만
		--캐릭터의 표정이 (attack) 액션이 (boong_attack_ready_loop)상태가 된다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(fo,
				{ name = 'boong_attack_ready_loop', loop = true }, { name = 'attack' })
	elseif self.jump_charge_state.level_1 == level then
		--0.5초~1.25초 미만 (1단계)
		--캐릭터의 표정 (damaged)로 변경 액션은 유지 상태로 (shake0.03/0.3초) 적용
		--fx_lasthit 재생
		self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(fo.Position)

		character_util.set_emotion(fo, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.shake(fo, 0.03, 0.3)

	elseif self.jump_charge_state.level_2 == level then
		--1.25초~2초 미만 (2단계)
		--캐릭터의 표정 (attack)으로 변경 나머지 액션과 이펙트는 유지 (shake0.03/0.3초) 적용
		character_util.set_emotion(fo, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.stop_shake(fo)
		character_util.shake(fo, 0.03, 0.3)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_catch_fire_01')
		self.fx:jump_king_cast():Instantiate(fo.Position)

	elseif self.jump_charge_state.level_3 == level then
		--2초 미만~ 4초 (3단계)
		--나머지는 유지 상태로 표정 (mad)로 변경 (shake0.03)과 동시에 fx_m_plitvice_buff가 활성화 된다.
		--취소되거나 점프를 뛰면 해당 이펙트는 fx_m_plitvice_buff_end 재생되며 사라진다.
		local side_dir = direction_util.is_side_ver2(fo.Direction)
		local fx_offset = unity_class.vector3.zero

		if side_dir then
			local dir = direction_util.to_vector3(direction_util.get_opposite_ver2(fo.Direction))
			fx_offset = dir * 0.1
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_demonpowergirl_cwp_03')
		self.fx_buff_loop_pool = self.fx:jump_king_buff():Instantiate(fo.Position + fx_offset)
		self.fx_buff_loop_pool.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7

		character_util.set_emotion(fo, { name = 'mad' })
		character_util.stop_shake(fo)
		character_util.shake(fo, 0.03, 9999)

	elseif self.jump_charge_state.over == level then
		--5초 초과 (타임 오버)
		--캐릭터 보던 방향으로 (confused,dead)재생 쓰러지고 1초 후 마리오점프하면서 기상하고 원래 상태로 복귀한다.
		--쓰러질때 팔로워 캐릭터는 (surprise)표정 (jump1회) 재생 원래상태로 복귀될때까지 (tired)표정 상태가 된다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')

		character_util.stop_shake(fo)

		local anim_dur = spine_util.get_animation_duration(fo, 'dead')

		local trip_sound_sec = 1.2
		wait_for_sec(anim_dur - trip_sound_sec)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')

		wait_for_sec(trip_sound_sec)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		local look_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(fo)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
		character_util.mario_jump_new(fo, look_dir)
		character_util.remove_emotion(fo)
		self:jump_king_tutorial_fail()
	end
end

function local_class:jump_king_tutorial_fail()
	local hela = self.get_hela()
	--성공할때까지 기믹 버튼 튜토리얼 UI반복
	--music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	local reaction = function(idx)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hela, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
				{ name = 'attack' },
				{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s4_' .. idx, skip = true })

		self.current_charge_state = self.jump_charge_state.ready
		self:jump_king_tutorial()
	end

	if self.current_charge_state == self.jump_charge_state.level_1 then
		--너무 빨리 버튼을 떼서 점프에 실패했을 때
		--친구(left,attack,release회): 조, 조금만 더 힘에 집중해봐!
		reaction(6)
	elseif self.current_charge_state == self.jump_charge_state.done then
		--과 충전 (5초 이상) 했을 시
		--친구(left,tired,release2회): 조, 조금만 긴장을 풀어 봐!
		reaction(7)
	else
		self.is_tutorial = false
	end

	self.jump = false
end

function local_class:tutorial_jump(fo)
	local hela = self.get_hela()

	character_util.stop_shake(fo)
	character_util.set_emotion(hela, { name = 'damaged' })

	if self.fx_buff_loop_pool ~= nil then
		local buff_end = self.fx:jump_king_buff_end()

		buff_end.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7
		self.fx_buff_loop_pool:Dispose()
		self.fx_buff_loop_pool = nil
	end

	self.fx:jump_king_cast():Instantiate(fo.Position)
	self.fx:jump_king_jump():Instantiate(fo.Position)

	local jump_sound

	if self.current_charge_state == self.jump_charge_state.level_2 then

	elseif self.current_charge_state == self.jump_charge_state.level_3 then

	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(jump_sound)

	self:tutorial_jump_logic(fo, 5, 7, 3)

	self.fx:jump_king_smash():Instantiate(fo.Position)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_demonpowergirl_throw_03')

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(fo, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })
	self:tutorial_throw(fo, unity_class.vector3.right)

	self:jump_success()
end

function local_class:tutorial_jump_logic(target, distance, speed, height)
	local time_passed = 0

	-- 바라 보는 방향으로 점프
	local dir = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(target))
	local start_pos = target.Position
	local end_pos = start_pos + distance * dir
	local duration = distance / speed

	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local lerp_pos = vector_util.lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		local cur_y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height + lerp_pos.y
		local cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(lerp_pos, cur_y)

		target.Position = cur_pos

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	target.Position = end_pos
end

function local_class:jump_success()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local hela = self.get_hela()
	local reine = self.get_reine()

	--점프 뛰어서 넘어갔을 시 좌우 위치 상관없이 이벤트 재생
	--친구 레이네 오른쪽에 정렬
	local wp = reine.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)
	wp_util.move_async(hela, wp, 2, nil, { run = false })

	--레이네(right,surprise,idle) 친구(left,smile,idle)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(reine, { dir = 'right', sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(reine, self, 'surprise')

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(hela, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })
	scene_util.set_emotion(hela, self, 'smile')

	--레이네(right,smile,cast): 서, 성공했어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reine, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'cast', keep = true },
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s4_8', skip = true })

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			--상단 [shout] 긴급 상황 발생!! 마신으로 추정되는 꼬마가 도망쳤다!
			--화면 shake0.1 / 0.5초
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)
			local bubble_data = { bubble_direction = 'none', viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.8) }
			scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(reine, 'cw_jump_king_s4_9', true, bubble_data)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			--레이네 / 친구 (up,idle,idle)(jump1회)
			scene_util.set_direction_by_args(reine, { dir = 'up', sfx = false })
			scene_util.set_direction_by_args(hela, { dir = 'up', sfx = '01_swing_01' })

			character_util.normal_jump(reine, true)
			character_util.normal_jump_async(hela, true)

			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end)
	})

	--친구(left,tired,release): 빠, 빨리 움직이자!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hela, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release' },
			{ name = 'tired' },
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s4_10', skip = true })

	--친구(left,attack,cast): 저 앞을 넘으려면 좀 더 힘을 줘서 뛰어야 할 것 같아!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hela, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'cast' },
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s4_10_1', skip = true })

	--만약에 해당 그리드에서 장애물에 부딪혀 게임오버 되면 해당 위치에서 “ 빠, 빨리 움직이자! “ 이벤트부터 재생 된다.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(reine)

	--이후 서브 마커 위치 변경
	local marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_long_jump_marker_pos')
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.controller.quest_marker_key, self.controller.quest_id, true, marker_pos)

	--컨트롤 풀림

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Show()
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

function local_class:reine_rest_event()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	self.jump_king_gimmick:jump_end_wait(function()
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.jump_king_tutorial
	end)

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.jump_king_tutorial then
		return
	end

	local hela = self.get_hela()
	local reine = self.get_reine()

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_key)

	--레이네의 표정이 (damaged)로 전환되고 이동속도 2로 1번까지 정렬 이 후 이동속도 1로 경로따라 2번까지 정렬된다.
	scene_util.set_emotion(reine, self, 'damaged')

	--따라오던 팔로워 친구는 (3)위치에 정렬되어 (left,tired,idle)
	do
		local wp = {
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_reine_rest_event_pos_1'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_reine_rest_event_pos_1') + vector(0, 0, 0.8),
		}

function local_class:tutorial_holdup(fo)
	local hela = self.get_hela()
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(fo.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(hela,
				{ name = 'seat', loop = true }, { name = 'attack' })
		command_util.publish_holdup(fo, hela, fo.Position, nil, true)
	end
end

function local_class:tutorial_throw(fo, dir)
	local hela = self.get_hela()
	character_util.convert_to_npc(hela, user_party, true)

	local current_state = fo.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local hold_target = current_state.HoldTarget
		if hold_target ~= nil then

			command_util.publish_throw(fo, hold_target, dir,
					fo.Position, 4, true)
		end
		if self.current_charge_state == self.jump_charge_state.done then
			character_util.set_emotion(fo, { name = 'confused' })
			character_util.set_side_direction(fo)
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(fo,
					{ name = 'dead', loop = false }, { name = 'confused' })
		else
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)
		end
	end
	coroutine.yield()

	while lua_helper.type_compare(hela.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hela)
	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(hela, user_party, true)
end

		quest_marker_event_2 = 3,

	self.get_reine = function()

	end

	-- 헬라
	self.get_hela = function()
		return get_character('hela')
	end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	if self.jump_king_gimmick == nil then
		self.jump_king_gimmick = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/CivilWar/JumpKing/Gimmick/JumpKingGimmickController')
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	return true
end

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.quest_marker_event_1

	local marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('game_over_reset_pos_5')
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.controller.quest_marker_key, self.controller.quest_id, true, marker_pos)

	start_coroutine(function()
		self.jump_king_gimmick:load_async()
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

	return false
end
