	self.soldiers = {
		self.get_soldier(1),
		self.get_soldier(2),
		self.get_soldier(3),
		self.get_soldier(4),
	}

	self.group_action(self.soldiers, function(target, idx)
		character_util.set_active_state(target, 'enabled')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)
		target.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_soldier_' .. idx .. '_pos_1')
		scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = 'rifle_reload', loop = false })
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(target, { dir = 'down', sfx = false })
	end)

	--무기
	--long_barrel_rifle
	self.group_action(self.soldiers, function(target)
		self.shoot_helpers[target] = self:create_shoot_helper(target, 'projectile_civilwar_sniper_bullet')
		character_util.spine_set_attachment(target, '[base]weapon1', 'long_barrel_rifle')
		target.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'rifle_idle'
		target.CustomWalkAnimationName = 'rifle_walk'
		target.CustomRunAnimationName = 'rifle_run'
	end)

	--친구 레이네 속도 4로 해당 지점 까지 (run)모션으로 이동
	local wp = {
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_reine_escape_pos_1'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_reine_escape_pos_1') + vector(-1, 0, 0),
	}

	local wp_key = 'wp_key'
	local speed = 4
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(reine,
			wp[1], speed, nil, self, wp_key,
			{ run = false })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hela,
			wp[2], speed, nil, self, wp_key,
			{ run = false })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	--이 후 어택 7명의 적군 NPC가 플레이어 바라보면서 (rifle_reload모션끝에 정지) 상태 레이네와 친구를 향해 어택레인지를 보인다.
	--애니메이션 해당 이벤트 실행 전에 재생시켜놓고 rifle_reload 끝모션에 정지된 상태가 되도록
	--어택레인지 보인후 친구(left,surprise,idle)(jump1회) 레이네 (right,surprise,idle)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(reine, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_emotion(hela, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(hela, true)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(reine, true)

	--카메라 사이즈 5로 줄어들면서 카메라 위로 2.5칸 이동
	local camera_pos = reine.Position + vector(0, 0, 3.5)
	camera_util.move(camera_pos, 0.5)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(5, 0.5)

	self.vfo.Position = reine.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)

	local attack_ranges = {}

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_reload_01')

	self.group_action(self.soldiers, function(target)
		local soldier_attack_range = attack_range_util.create_rect(unity_class.vector3.zero,
				unity_class.vector2(16, 0.4), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		attack_range_util.show(soldier_attack_range)
		attack_ranges[target] = soldier_attack_range
		local target_pos = reine.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
		local shoot_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - target.Position).normalized

		attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(soldier_attack_range, target.Position, shoot_dir, 0)
	end)

	local darken_key = 'qte'
	field:Darken(darken_key, 0.5, 0.3)

	--QTE(right)발생 실패X
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	qte_util.swipe('right', nil, 0.1)

	field:Undarken(darken_key, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')

	self.group_action(self.soldiers, function(target)
		attack_range_util.hide(attack_ranges[target])
	end)

	local shoot_offset = vector(0.2, 0, 0.5)
	local shoot_cycle = 0.05

	start_coroutine(function()
		self.group_action(self.soldiers, function(target)
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(target, 'rifle_shoot')
		end)

		for _ = 1, 5 do
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_minigun_shoot_01')
			self.group_action(self.soldiers, function(target)
				self.shoot_helpers[target]:ShootTargetPosition(self.vfo.Position, shoot_offset, 0)
			end)

			wait_for_sec(shoot_cycle)
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_minigun_shoot_01')

		self.group_action(self.soldiers, function(target)
			character_util.remove_anim(target)
		end)
	end)

	wait_for_sec(0.05)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })

	--입력시
	--슬로우모션 1초간 적용
	local slow_key = 'dodge_bullet_slow'
	time_util.mod(slow_key, 0.5)
	local duration = 1

	--카메라 레이네에게 복귀하면서 사이즈도 4로 복귀
	camera_util.resize_to_default(duration)
	local camera_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_reine_escape_pos_2')
	camera_util.move(camera_pos, duration, { end_target = reine })

	--친구랑 레이네 jump+(right,damaged,prostrate 0.25속도) 으로 오른쪽 지정된 위치까지 이동
	self.party = {
		reine,
		hela
	}

	local jump_target_pos = {
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_reine_escape_pos_2'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_reine_escape_pos_2') + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	}

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')

	self:custom_prostrate_jump_move(self.party, jump_target_pos)

	--동시에 bullet_dark이 경로대로 빠르게 날아온다.
	time_util.unmod(slow_key)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_run', state = 'event' })

	--헬레(right,scared,prostrate): 이, 이게 무슨일이야…?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
	scene_util.set_emotion(hela, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hela, 'cw_jump_king_s6_12_1', true)

	--좌측[shout]: 망할 꼬맹이들 이리로 올줄 알았지!
	--이때 화면 shake0.1/ 0.5초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)
	local bubble_data = { bubble_direction = 'none', viewport_pos = vector(0.25, 0.55) }
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(reine, 'cw_jump_king_s6_13', true, bubble_data)
end

function local_class:run_event()
	local hela = self.get_hela()
	local reine = self.get_reine()

	--친구 레이네 마리오 점프 기상
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_new(hela, 'right')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(reine, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(hela, self, 'damaged')

	character_util.remove_anim(hela)
	character_util.remove_anim(reine)

	--적군 NPC들 속도 8로 각자 하단 위치 로 이동
	--도착한 NPC들은 (right,attack,rifle_reload 막모션에 정지) 재생

	self.group_action(self.soldiers, function(target)
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(target, 'rifle_shoot')
	end)

	do
		--친구 레이네는 기상 직후 (damaged)표정으로 (run) 속도 6으로 우측으로 이동 시작
		local reine_wp = {
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_reine_escape_pos_3'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_reine_escape_pos_4'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_reine_escape_pos_5'),
		}

		local hela_wp = {
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_reine_escape_pos_3'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_reine_escape_pos_4'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_reine_escape_pos_5') + vector(-1, 0, 0),
		}

		local run_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_dash_01',
			parent = reine,
			loop = true,
			type_priority = 'loop',
			player_priority = 'npc'
		})
		-- 상단 경로따라 이동
		--친구 레이네 (1)번 위치까지 쭉 이동
		local wp_key = 'wp_key'
		local speed = 6
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(reine,
				reine_wp, speed, nil, self, wp_key,
				{ run = true })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hela,
				hela_wp, speed, nil, self, wp_key,
				{ run = true })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(run_loop_sfx)
	end

	--도착하면 QTE(down)사용 실패X
	local darken_key = 'qte'
	field:Darken(darken_key, 0.5, 0.3)

	--QTE(right)발생 실패X
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	qte_util.swipe('down', nil, 0.1)

	field:Undarken(darken_key, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')

	--입력시 친구 레이네 jump+ (right,damaged,prostrate0.25속도) 사용하여 2번 위치까지 이동

	--이때 bullet_dark 3발이 상단으로 빠르게 날아감.
	local out_side_pos = vector(-80, 0, 76)
	local bullet_start_pos = {
		out_side_pos + vector(0, 1.5, 0.5),
		out_side_pos + vector(-1, 1.5, -0.5),
		out_side_pos + vector(-2, 1.5, 0.5),
	}

	local shoot_dir = unity_class.vector3.right

	start_coroutine(function()
		for idx = 1, #bullet_start_pos do
			self.soldiers[idx].Position = bullet_start_pos[idx]
			self.shoot_helpers[self.soldiers[idx]]:ShootDirectionAtPosition(bullet_start_pos[idx], shoot_dir, 1)
		end
	end)

	local jump_target_pos = {
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_reine_escape_pos_6'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_reine_escape_pos_6') + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	}
	local eat_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_01',
		parent = reine,
		loop = false,
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'npc'
	})
	--music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_01')

	self:custom_prostrate_jump_move(self.party, jump_target_pos)

	--친구 레이네(right,damaged,prostrate)(shake0.03 / 0.5초)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(reine, 0.03, 0.5)
	character_util.shake(hela, 0.03, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--둘다 마리오 점프로 기상 표정 (scared)
	scene_util.set_emotion(reine, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_emotion(hela, self, 'scared')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_new(hela, 'right')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(reine, 'right')

	--3번 위치로 애니메이션 (run) 사용해 이동속도 8로 정렬
	do
		--친구 레이네는 기상 직후 (damaged)표정으로 (run) 속도 6으로 우측으로 이동 시작
		local wp = {
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_reine_escape_pos_7'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_reine_escape_pos_7') + vector(-1, 0, 0)
		}
		local run_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_dash_01',
			parent = reine,
			loop = true,
			type_priority = 'loop',
			player_priority = 'npc'
		})
		-- 상단 경로따라 이동
		--친구 레이네 (1)번 위치까지 쭉 이동
		local wp_key = 'wp_key'
		local speed = 6
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(reine,
				wp[1], speed, nil, self, wp_key,
				{ run = true })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hela,
				wp[2], speed, nil, self, wp_key,
				{ run = false })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(run_loop_sfx)
	end

	--친구(right,attack,release2회): 레이네 빨리! 여기만 넘으면 돼!
	--이때 레이네(left,tired,cast)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(reine, { dir = 'left', sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(reine, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(reine, self, { name = 'cast' })

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hela, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s6_14', skip = true })

	--레이네(left,attack,nod2회): 응!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reine, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s6_15', skip = true })

	--레이네 (right,damaged,idle)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(reine, { dir = 'right', sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(reine, self, 'damaged')

	--기믹 버튼에 튜토리얼 UI 사용
	--기믹 버튼 누르고 뗏을때 이벤트 재생
	qte_util.tap(1)

	--이때 좌측 NPC들 해당 열로 정렬
	self.group_action(self.soldiers, function(target, idx)
		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_soldier_' .. idx .. '_pos_3')
		character_util.set_position(target, pos)
	end)

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			--레이네 fx_hit 재생과 동시에 빨간틴트+눌림 효과 (right,damaged,damaged)상태로
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(reine)
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(reine)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
			self.fx.hit():Instantiate(reine.Bounds.center + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
			scene_util.set_emotion(reine, self, 'damaged')
			scene_util.set_anim(reine, self, 'damaged')

			--속도 3 spin1회로 우측 1.5칸 이동 후 (right,damaged,prostrate)
			local speed = 3
			local distance = 1.5
			local duration = distance / speed
			character_util.spine_rotate(reine, -360, duration)
			local wp = reine.Position + vector(distance, 0, 0)
			wp_util.move_async(reine, wp, speed, nil, { run = false, end_callback = function()
				scene_util.set_anim(reine, self, { name = 'prostrate' })
			end })
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			--레이네 fx_hit재생할때 친구 (right,surprise,idle)(jump1회): 레이네…!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			character_util.normal_jump(hela, true)
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hela, self, 'right',
					nil,
					{ name = 'surprise' },
					{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s6_16', skip = true })
		end)
	})

	character_util.spine_rotate(reine, 0, 0)

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			--레이네(right,damaged,prostrate): 다리에… 힘이…
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(reine, self, 'right',
					nil,
					{ name = 'damaged', keep = true },
					{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s6_17', skip = true })
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			--이때 친구 (right,attack,run)으로 속도 8로 우측2칸 이동 이동끝나면 바로 (right,attack,eat)
			local wp = hela.Position + vector(2, 0, 0)
			wp_util.move_async(hela, wp, 8, nil, { run = true, end_callback = function()
				scene_util.set_emotion(hela, self, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim(hela, self, { name = 'eat' })
				self.eat_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
					sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
					parent = reine,
					loop = true,
					type_priority = 'loop',
					player_priority = 'npc'
				})
			end })
		end)
	})

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--친구 우측 0.5칸 이동하면서 holdable로 레이네를 집어든다.

	--이때 레이네 (right,damaged,seat)
	scene_util.set_emotion(reine, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(reine, self, { name = 'seat' })
	scene_util.set_anim(hela, self, { name = 'hold', next_anim = 'hold_loop', upper = true })
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.eat_loop_sfx)

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local wp_key = 'wp_key'

			local reine_to_pos = reine.Position + vector(0, 0.7, 0)
			local speed = 5
			local duration = 0.2
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(reine,
					reine_to_pos, nil, duration, self, wp_key,
					{ run = false, y_mode = 'flying' })

			local hela_to_pos = hela.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hela,
					hela_to_pos, speed, nil, self, wp_key,
					{ run = false })

			wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			--대사: 레이네…! 일어나! 도망쳐!!
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hela, 'cw_jump_king_s6_18', true)
		end)
	})

	--친구(shake0.03/0.5초)
	character_util.shake(hela, 0.03, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--친구 (jump)높이로 떠오름 동시에 레이네 (right,damaged,damaged)로 2층 위로 올라가며
	character_util.spine_deviate_local_angle(hela, -30, 0.3, 0.3)
	do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		local wp = {
			reine.Position + vector(0, 1.2, 0),
			hela.Position + vector(0, 1.2, 0),
		}

		local wp_key = 'wp_key'
		local duration = 0.3
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(reine,
				wp[1], nil, duration, self, wp_key,
				{ run = false, y_mode = 'flying' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hela,
				wp[2], nil, duration, self, wp_key,
				{ run = false, y_mode = 'flying' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	do
		local wp = {
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_reine_escape_pos_9'),
			hela.Position + vector(0, -1.2, 0),
		}
		local wp_key = 'wp_key'
		local duration = 0.3

		--spin 2회 속도6로 우측 4칸 이동한다.
		local speed = 6
		local distance = 4
		local spin_duration = distance / speed
		character_util.spine_rotate(reine, -360 * 2, spin_duration)
		scene_util.set_anim(reine, self, { name = 'damaged' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(reine,
				wp[1], speed, nil, self, wp_key,
				{ run = false, y_mode = 'flying', end_callback = function()
					character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(reine)
					character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(reine)
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
					self.fx.hit():Instantiate(reine.Bounds.center + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
					scene_util.set_anim(reine, self, { name = 'prostrate' })
					music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 4 })
					self.blizzard_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
						sfx_name = '01_blizzard_04',
						parent = reine,
						loop = true,
						type_priority = 'loop',
						player_priority = 'npc',
						fade_in_time = 4
					})
				end })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hela,
				wp[2], nil, duration, self, wp_key,
				{ run = false, y_mode = 'flying' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--친구(left,scared,idle)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(hela, { dir = 'left', sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(hela, self, 'scared')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(hela, true)

	--친구(left,scared,cast)(shake0.03)
	character_util.shake(hela, 0.03, 99999)
	character_util.remove_anim(hela, true)
	scene_util.set_anim(hela, self, { name = 'cast' })

	--적군 NPC들 해당 경로대로 친구앞까지 이동하기 시작
	local wp_key = 'wp_key'
	local speed = 6
	self.group_action(self.soldiers, function(target)
		local pos = {
			target.Position + vector(2, 0, 0),
			target.Position + vector(2, 0, 2),
			target.Position + vector(7, 0, 2),
			target.Position + vector(7, 0, 0),
			target.Position + vector(14, 0, 0),
			target.Position + vector(14, 0, 1),
		}
		scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = 'rifle_run' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(target,
				pos, speed, nil, self, wp_key,
				{ run = true, last_direction = 'right', end_callback = function()
					scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
				end })
	end)

	local bubble_scale = 0.8
	--레이네(right,damaged,prostrate)(shake0.03/0.5초) : 헬라…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(reine, 0.03, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(reine, 'cw_jump_king_s6_19', true, { scale = bubble_scale })

	--레이네(left,damaged,walk4legs) 이동속도 0.5로 좌측 1칸 이동 후 (left,damaged,prostrate): 끌어 올려줘야… 하는데…
	scene_util.set_anim(reine, self, { name = 'walk4legs' })
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(hela, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })

	wp_util.move_async(reine, wp, 0.5, nil, { run = false })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(reine, self, { name = 'prostrate' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(reine, 'cw_jump_king_s6_20', true, { scale = bubble_scale })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	--병사들 도착한 후 앞에 병사 (1): 다른 꼬맹이는 어디간거지?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.soldiers[1], 'cw_jump_king_s6_21', true)

	--레이네(left,damaged,walk4legs) 이동속도 0.5로 좌측 1칸 이동 후
	--(left,damaged,prostrate): 괘, 괜히 되도않는 걱정이나 해서…
	scene_util.set_anim(reine, self, { name = 'walk4legs' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	local wp = reine.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	wp_util.move_async(reine, wp, 0.5, nil, { run = false })

	scene_util.set_anim(reine, self, { name = 'prostrate' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(reine, 'cw_jump_king_s6_22', true, { scale = bubble_scale })

	--병사 (2): 어차피 멀리가지 못했을 거야.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.soldiers[4], 'cw_jump_king_s6_23', true)

	--레이네(left,damaged,walk4legs 0.25속도)0.2초 후 (shake0.03)+모션 0.5초
	scene_util.set_anim(reine, self, { name = 'walk4legs', mix_duration = 0.25, scale = 0.25 })
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	character_util.set_anim_time_scale(reine, 0)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(reine, 0.03, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--레이네(left,damaged,prostrate)(shake정지)+빨간틴트+눌림효과
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
	self.fx.hit():Instantiate(reine.Bounds.center + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
	character_util.set_anim_time_scale(reine, 1)
	scene_util.set_anim(reine, self, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(reine)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(reine)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--레이네(left,tired,prostrate): 전부 내탓인건데… 바보같이 친구나 위기에 빠뜨리고…
	scene_util.set_emotion(reine, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(reine, 'cw_jump_king_s6_24', true, { scale = bubble_scale })

	--선택지
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--멍청이 (빨강)
		{ 'cw_jump_king_s6_choose_4', 'brutal' }
	})
	--레이네(left,damaged,prostrate)(shake0.03/0.5초): 레이네 이 멍청아…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(reine, self, 'damaged')
	character_util.shake(reine, 0.03, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(reine, 'cw_jump_king_s6_25', true, { scale = bubble_scale })

	--레이네(left,damaged,prostrate): 조금만… 제발 조금만 움직이면 되는데…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(reine, 'cw_jump_king_s6_26', true, { scale = bubble_scale })

	--병사 (1)(rifle_reload 모션끝에 정지): 일단 이 꼬마애부터 처리하자고
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_reload_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(self.soldiers[1], self, { name = 'rifle_reload', loop = false })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.soldiers[1], 'cw_jump_king_s6_27', true)

	--선택지
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--움직여… 멍청아!!! (빨강)
		{ 'cw_jump_king_s6_choose_5', 'brutal' }
	})

	--레이네(left,attack,prostrate)(shake0.03/0.5초): 움직이라고…
	scene_util.set_emotion(reine, self, 'attack')
	character_util.shake(reine, 0.03, 0.5)

	--레이네 카메라 0프레임으로 3으로 변경
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 0)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(reine, 'cw_jump_king_s6_28', true,
			{ scale = bubble_scale, ignore_orthographic_size = true })

	--레이네(left,mad,idle 0.05배속): 이 멍청아!!
	--대사 출력과 동시에 카메라 줌 2로 줄어들면서 화면 shake0.2/ 화이트 페이드 아웃
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_demonpowergirl_cwp_02')
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local duration = 1
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2, duration)
			camera_util.shake(0.2, duration)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')
			music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.blizzard_loop_sfx, 2)
			screen_util.fade_out_async(duration, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			scene_util.set_emotion(reine, self, 'mad')
			scene_util.set_anim(reine, self, { name = 'idle', mix_duration = 0.5, scale = 0.1 })
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(reine, 'cw_jump_king_s6_29', true,
					{ ignore_orthographic_size = true })
		end)
	})
end

function local_class:demon_powergirl_event()
	local demon_powergirl = self.get_demon_powergirl()
	local reine = self.get_reine()
	local hela = self.get_hela()

	--카메라 2로 줌된 상태로 레이나 위치에 레이나 제거 후 파이몬 (demon_powergirl_3)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(reine)
	demon_powergirl.Position = reine.Position
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(demon_powergirl, 1, 0)
	scene_util.hide_weapon(demon_powergirl)

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	param.MoveCamera = false
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(demon_powergirl, param, true)

	camera_util.move_async(demon_powergirl.Position, 0, { end_target = demon_powergirl })
	reine.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	--화이트 페이드 인 되면서 파이몬 jump 해서 해당 위치로 1초간 이동
	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	--이동간 jingak 애니메이션 사용 loop X
	--착지하면 파이몬 위치에 fx_demonpowergirl_basic_3rd 사용
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_powergirl, self, { name = 'jingak', loop = false, scale = 0.7 })

	local wp_key = 'wp_key'
	local duration = 1
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_clara_boss_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(demon_powergirl, 3, duration)
	local wp = hela.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(demon_powergirl, wp, nil, duration, self, wp_key,
			{ run = false, end_callback = function()
				--카메라 4로 복귀됨
				camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
				--화면 shake0.1/ 0.5초
				camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_demonpowergirl_throw_03')
				self.fx.jump_king_smash():Instantiate(demon_powergirl.Position)
			end })

	--해당 1 초 이동간에 4명의 사울 병사들 (right,damaged,embarrassed)상태로 (left)로 1칸 뒷걸음질쳐서 이동한다.
	--(3): 우와아악!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.soldiers[2],
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s6_30', skip = false, ignore_orthographic_size = true })

	self.group_action(self.soldiers, function(target)
		scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = 'embarrassed' })
		scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, 'damaged')
		local wp = target.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(target,
				wp, nil, duration, self, wp_key, { run = false, locked_dir = 'right' })
	end)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	--친구(left,surprise,idle)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(hela, self, 'surprise')

	character_util.normal_jump_async(hela, true)

	--이 후 병사들 (right,scared,idle)(shake0.03)
	self.group_action(self.soldiers, function(target)
		character_util.remove_anim(target)
		scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, 'scared')
		character_util.shake(target, 0.03, 99999)
	end)

	--파이몬(left,smile,victory_get): 하하하! 오랜만에 아주 푹 쉬었군!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_powergirl, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'victory_get', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s6_31', skip = true, { ignore_orthographic_size = true } })

	--친구(left,scared,idle)(shake0.03): 지, 진짜 그 파이몬이잖아?!
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_shaolin_intro', state = 'event' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.shake(hela, 0.03, 99999)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hela, self, 'left',
			nil,
			{ name = 'scared', keep = true },
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s6_32', skip = true })

	--레이네: $all_pymon_host$ 파, 파이몬?! 일어났어?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_03')
	self.controller:talk_demon_powergirl_host(demon_powergirl)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(demon_powergirl, 'cw_jump_king_s6_33', true)

	self.controller:talk_end_demon_powergirl_host(demon_powergirl)

	--파이몬(left,idle,question): 흠… 그게 무슨 소리지?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_powergirl, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'question' },
			{ name = 'idle' },
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s6_34', skip = true })

	--파이몬(left,idle,release): 네가 온 마력을 다해 날 깨우지 않았는가!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_powergirl, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'idle' },
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s6_35', skip = true })

	--레이네: $all_pymon_host$…아, 아 그래! 파이몬 좋은 소식이 있어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	self.controller:talk_demon_powergirl_host(demon_powergirl)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(demon_powergirl, 'cw_jump_king_s6_36', true)

	--레이네: $all_pymon_host$내가 돛단배를 잘접는 아이를 찾았어! 같이 기지로 돌아가자!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(demon_powergirl, 'cw_jump_king_s6_37', true)

	--파이몬(left,idle,mad)(jump1회): 뭐라고? 돛단배를 잘 접는다고?!
	self.controller:talk_end_demon_powergirl_host(demon_powergirl)
	character_util.normal_jump(demon_powergirl, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_powergirl, self, 'left',
			nil,
			{ name = 'mad' },
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s6_38', skip = true })

	--파이몬(left,smile,victory_get): 하하하! 아주 훌륭한 인재를 찾았구나!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_powergirl, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'victory_get' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s6_39', skip = true })

	--친구(left,tired,idle)(shake 정지): 어… 어?
	character_util.stop_shake(hela)
	scene_util.set_emotion(hela, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hela, 'cw_jump_king_s6_40', true)

	--파이몬이 (right,idle,idle) 0.5칸 이동 후 친구를 holdable로 들어올린다.
	--이때 친구 (left,scared,embarrassed): 우아아아!!
	scene_util.set_emotion(hela, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(hela, self, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(hela,
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s6_41', skip = false })

	local wp = demon_powergirl.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	wp_util.move_async(demon_powergirl, wp, 5, nil, { run = false })
	command_util.publish_holdup(demon_powergirl, hela, demon_powergirl.Position, nil, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--파이몬 친구들고 좌측 표시 위치까지 이동 속도 12 표정(smile)
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_powergirl, self, 'smile')
	self.controller:demon_powergirl_rush_routine_start(demon_powergirl, false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_aircraft_04')
	--이동중에 fx_flame_rush 경로에 fx_flame_area
	local flame_rush = self.fx:flame_rush_loop()
						   :Instantiate(demon_powergirl.Position, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0), demon_powergirl.Transform)

	local flame_area = self.fx:flame_area()
						   :Instantiate(demon_powergirl.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, demon_powergirl.Transform)

	local wp = {
		demon_powergirl.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_reine_escape_pos_10')
	}
	wp_util.move_async(demon_powergirl, wp, 12, nil,
			{ run = false, callback = function(wp_index)
				if wp_index == 0 then
					--오는길에 NPC는 spindead 오브젝트는 fx_obj_smoke와 함께 사라짐
					character_util.air_spin(self.soldiers[1])
					character_util.air_spin(self.soldiers[2])
					character_util.air_spin(self.soldiers[2])
					character_util.air_spin(self.soldiers[4])
				elseif wp_index == 1 then
					flame_rush:Dispose()
					flame_rush = nil

					flame_area:Dispose()
					flame_area = nil

					speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(hela)
				end
			end })
end

function local_class:ending_scene()
	local hela = self.get_hela()
	local demon_powergirl = self.get_demon_powergirl()

	self.controller:demon_powergirl_rush_routine_end()
	self.fx:flame_rush_end()
		:Instantiate(demon_powergirl.Position, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0), demon_powergirl.Transform)

	--파이몬 멈춰서면 들려있는 친구 (left,confused,seat)
	scene_util.set_emotion(hela, self, 'confused')
	scene_util.set_anim(hela, self, { name = 'seat' })

	--파이몬이 친구를 내려놓는다. 왼쪽 1칸 위치에 친구 (left,confused,prostrate)
	command_util.publish_throw(demon_powergirl, hela, vector(-1, 0, 0),
			demon_powergirl.Position, 4, true)

	--파이몬 내려놓자마자 (left,smile,victory_get)
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_powergirl, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_powergirl, self, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, one_shot_sfx = '02_demonpowergirl_throw_01' })

	--친구(left,damaged,prostrate)(shake0.03/0.5초)
	character_util.shake(hela, 0.03, 0.5)
	scene_util.set_emotion(hela, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(hela, self, { name = 'prostrate' })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--친구 (surprise) 표정으로 마리오점프 기상 (left,surprise,idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion(hela, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(hela, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim(hela, self, { name = 'idle' })
	character_util.remove_anim(hela)
	character_util.remove_anim(demon_powergirl)

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--스테이지 클리어 연출

	--카드 보상
	--orb_civilwar_reine
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, true, false, false, false)
	character_util.stop(hela)
	--친구(right,surprise,release): 너, 너 진짜 파이몬 이였다고?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hela, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'surprise' },
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s6_42', skip = true })

	scene_util.set_anim(hela, self, { name = 'release' })
	character_util.remove_anim(hela)

	--레이네: $all_pymon_host$...내가 말했잖아.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	self.controller:talk_demon_powergirl_host(demon_powergirl)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(demon_powergirl, 'cw_jump_king_s6_43', true)

	--친구(right,smile,cast): 이… 강대한 마력…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hela, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'cast' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s6_44', skip = true })

	--친구가 이동속도 8로 해당 경로대로 파이몬 우측으로 이동
	local wp = {
		hela.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
		hela.Position + vector(2, 0, -1),
		hela.Position + vector(2, 0, 0),
	}
	wp_util.move_async(hela, wp, 8, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'left' })

	--친구(left,love,sing): 파… 팔뚝한번만 만져봐도 될까요?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hela, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'sing' },
			{ name = 'love' },
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s6_45', skip = true })

function local_class:create_shoot_helper(target, proj_name)
	local pattern_info = { columns = 1 }
	local proj_data = game_data_service.GetData('ProjectileData')
	local proj_spec = proj_data:GetSpec(proj_name):Clone()
	local proj_shooter = shoot_helper_util.create_projectile_shooter(self, target)

	local shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			proj_shooter,
			proj_spec,
			pattern_info,
			CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset,
			0.5,
			CS.Oak.WeaponType.AssaultRifle
	)

	return shoot_helper
end

function local_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	if label == 0 and lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, self.vfo) then
		self.fx.hit():Instantiate(hit_info.position)
	elseif label == 1 then
		-- 오브젝트 관통 하도록
		return false
	end
end

function local_class:custom_prostrate_jump_move(fos, wp)
	local height = 0.5
	local wp_key = 'wp_key'
	local jump_target_pos = wp
	local duration = 1

	self.group_action(fos, function(target, i)
		scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = 'prostrate', scale = 0.25 })
		scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, 'damaged')
		character_util.jump(target, height, duration)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(target,
				jump_target_pos[i], nil, duration, self, wp_key, { run = false })
	end)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('CivilWarLetterFromMaidenSection1')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.section_state = {
		before_loaded = 1,
		box_hidden = 2,
		before_open = 3,
		after_open = 4,
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_loaded

	self.get_star_piece = function()
		return get_field_object('letter_from_maiden_star_piece')
	end

	self.item = {
		names = {
			letter = 'cw_letter_from_maiden',
			card_key = 'cw_lab_card_key'
		},
		get_id = function(this, key)
			local item_name = this.names[key]

			local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')
			local item_id = item_data:GetSpec(item_name).Id

			return item_id
		end
	}

	---@type CivilWarUtil
	self.cw_util = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_item_get_event()
end

function local_class:enter()
	local main_quest_id = 357
	local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(main_quest_id)

	if main_quest ~= nil and main_quest.IsComplete then
		self.cw_util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/CivilWar/Common/Util')

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_open

		self.controller.chest:get().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	else
		self.controller.chest:get().ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.box_hidden
	end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.cw_util = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_open and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.chest:get()) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_open

		self.cw_util:start_scene(self.open_treasure_box_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:open_treasure_box_scene()
	local chest = self.controller.chest:get()
	local knight = get_party_leader()

	--가디언에게 획득되는 것까지 일반적인 보물상자의 연출과 동일한 스텝으로 진행.
	chest.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	local to_chest_dir = (chest.Bounds.center - knight.Position).normalized

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(knight, to_chest_dir * 0.3, 0.12, 0.15)

	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'bomb_attack', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(0.09)

	field_object_util.shake(chest, 0.03, 10)

	local chest_center = vector_util.get_x0z(chest.Bounds.center, chest.Position.y)

	do
		local duration = 1

		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.75, duration)
		camera_util.move(chest_center, duration)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_treasure_open_01')

	local chest_animator = self.controller.chest:get_animator()

	chest_animator:Play('open')

	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	field_object_util.stop_shake(chest)

	wait_for_sec(0.09)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, {
		look_target = chest.Bounds.center,
		look_mode = 'side',
		sfx = false
	})

	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'victory_extra')

	wait_for_sec(1.0)

	stage.DropManager.HideLooter = true

	local x_offsets = { -0.3, 0.3 }
	local offset_walker = 1
	local drop_end_base_pos = vector_util.get_0yz(chest.Bounds.min, chest.Bounds.center.x) +
			unity_class.vector3.back * 0.2

	for key in pairs(self.item.names) do
		local item_id = self.item:get_id(key)
		local x_offset = x_offsets[offset_walker]

		local item = drop_item_util.create_item({
			itemid = item_id,
			notforinven = true,
			pos = chest_center,
			target = drop_end_base_pos + unity_class.vector3.right * x_offset
		})

		item.ConsumeTarget = knight

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_treasure_item_popup_01')

		camera_util.shake(0.06, 0.2)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		offset_walker = offset_walker + 1
	end

	star_piece_util.appear(self.get_star_piece(), chest_center + unity_class.vector3.up * 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	stage.DropManager.HideLooter = false

	do
		local duration = 0.2

		camera_util.resize_to_default(duration)

		camera_util.return_to_leader(duration)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	--아이템 획득 다 한 후, 1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	do
		local sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
			type_priority = 'event',
			player_priority = 'player'
		})

		--이후, 가디언 right, idle, eat 1초
		scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'eat', remove_after = 1 })

		music_player_util.stop_sfx(sfx)
	end

	--가디언 손에 편지를 든다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_02')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'bow_idle')
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(knight, '[base]weapon1', 'paper_piece')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--내레이션 박스 등장
	do
		--캔터베리의 가디언, $name 에게.

		--오랜만에 뵈었네요.
		--가능하다면 공주님도 함께 뵙고 싶었는데.
		--명색이 기사라면 공주님을 지키는 데에 더 집중해야 했던 거 아닌가요?

		--전쟁 준비로 바쁘게 움직이다 당신이 좋아할만한 물건을 찾았는데…
		--계속 눈에 밟혀서 차라리 당신한테 버리는 게 낫겠더라구요.

		--……어쩐지 요즘은 편지를 쓸 일이 많네요.
		--그냥 아무 것도 하지 않고 넘어가면 편했을텐데… 저도 참.

		--아, 그리고….

		--비네트 님에게 이 카드키도 전달해주세요.
		--다음부터는 정말로 안 챙겨드릴 거라는 말도 전해주세요.

		--그럼…
		--살아남길 바랄게요, 모두.
		local str_keys = {
			'cw_letter_from_maiden_1',
			'cw_letter_from_maiden_2',
			'cw_letter_from_maiden_3',
			'cw_letter_from_maiden_4',
			'cw_letter_from_maiden_5',
			'cw_letter_from_maiden_6',
			'cw_letter_from_maiden_7',
		}

		--이벤트 시작과 동시에 BGM 볼륨 0.5로 조정, 믹스 디폴트 값
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_01')

		for _, str_key in ipairs(str_keys) do
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({
				key = str_key
			})
		end

	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	knight:RefreshWeaponAttachments()

	--가디언 getitemevent
	--떨어뜨리지 않게 주의하세요!
	--연구소 관리자 카드 키
	--연구소 어디든 갈 수 있는 최고등급의 카드 키입니다.
	screen_util.item_get_event(
			self.item.names.card_key,
			'cw_letter_from_maiden_card_key_title',
			'cw_letter_from_maiden_card_key_subtitle',
			'cw_letter_from_maiden_card_key_desc'
	)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0)
end

return local_class

	if quest_util.is_available_section(self.current_section) then
		self.current_section:exit()
	end

	self.current_section = nil

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil

	self.cw_util = nil
end

-- duration만큼 시간이 지나거나 StageEndEvent 발행까지 대기하는 wait_for_sec
function local_class:custom_wait_for_sec(duration)
	local end_time = unity_class.time.time + duration
	while not self.stage_ended and unity_class.time.time < end_time do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	return not self.stage_ended
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
		end,
		glitch = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_glitch_effect')
		end,
		glitch_screen = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_glitch_effect_screen')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}

	--글리치 저장용
	self.fx_glitchs = {}

	-- 상호작용 가능 아이템 데이터 테이블
	self.interactable_item = {
		twinkle_effect = {},
		interactable_fo_key = 's12_market_item_',
		pos_key = 's12_market_item_pos_',
		max_count = 3,
		set = function(this)
			this.twinkle_effect = {}
			for i = 1, this.max_count do
				local fo_key = this.interactable_fo_key .. i
				local interactable_fo = get_field_object(fo_key)
				local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(this.pos_key .. i)

				table.insert(this.twinkle_effect, self.fx:twinkle():Instantiate(pos))
				interactable_fo.Position = pos
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, fo_key, interactable_fo, true)
			end
		end,
		is_interacted_fo = function(this, fo)
			for i = 1, this.max_count do
				local fo_key = this.interactable_fo_key .. i
				local interactable_fo = get_field_object(fo_key)
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, interactable_fo) then
					return true
				end
			end
			return false
		end,
		get_interactable_fo = function(this, idx)
			return get_field_object(this.interactable_fo_key .. idx)
		end,
		remove_all_interacted_item = function(this)
			for i = 1, this.max_count do
				quest_marker_util.remove(this.interactable_fo_key .. i)
				get_field_object(this.interactable_fo_key .. i).Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				this.twinkle_effect[i].transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			end
		end,
		dispose_all_effect = function(this)
			for i = 1, #this.twinkle_effect do
				if this.twinkle_effect[i] ~= nil then
					this.twinkle_effect[i]:Dispose()
					this.twinkle_effect[i] = nil
				end
			end
		end,
	}

	-- 시장 npc 수
	self.market_npc_count = 13

	-- 마커 키
	self.quest_marker_name = 's12_quest_marker'

	-- 케이크 아이템 키
	self.cake_id = 21020

	-- 케이크 박스 아이템 키
	self.cake_box_id = 21021

	--왕실 씬 연출용 유틸
	self.throne_scene_util = nil

	-- 시장을 돌아다니는 NPC 세팅용 글로벌 테이블
	self.princess_world_runner = nil

	self.release_loop_sfx = nil
	self.sleep_loop_sfx = nil
	self.village_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.throne_scene_util = get_or_create_global_table(
			'Quest/Main/CivilWar/Common/ThroneSceneUtil')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self:pre_setting()

	start_coroutine(self.intro_scene, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.throne_scene_util = nil
	self.interactable_item:dispose_all_effect()

	if self.princess_world_runner ~= nil then
		self.princess_world_runner:exit()
		self.princess_world_runner = nil
	end

	if self.release_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.release_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.release_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.sleep_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.sleep_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.sleep_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.village_sfx ~= nil then
		self.village_sfx:Stop()
		self.village_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 출구 인터랙트
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_exit()) then
		self:start_scene(self.block_exit_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	-- 반짝이 아이템 인터렉트
	if self.current_state == self.section_state.interacting_item and
			self.interactable_item:is_interacted_fo(e.Target) then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.before_interact_chef
		self:start_scene(self.interact_item_scene, self, e.Target)
		return true
	end

	-- 빵집 주인 대화
	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_interact_chef and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_chef()) then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.after_interact_chef
		self:start_scene(self.talk_to_chef_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.section_state.after_interact_chef and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_princess(), 's12_princess_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.done
		start_coroutine(self.s12_ending_scene, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event()
	if self.princess_world_runner ~= nil then
		self.princess_world_runner:exit()
	end

	self.princess_world_runner = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--12섹션 공주 왕실 씬
function local_class:intro_scene()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local queen = self.get_queen()
	local throne_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s12_throne_center_pos') + vector(0, 0, 2)

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	self.util:enter_scene(nil)

	--왕실 씬 카메라 조정
	self.throne_scene_util:change_to_throne_view()

	camera_util.move_async(throne_pos, 0)

	--3스테이지 첫 시작
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	--공주(shake 0.3초): 조상님들께...
	scene_util.shake(princess, 0.03, 0.3)
	self.throne_scene_util:show_speech_bubble_async(princess, 'cw_main_s12_1')
	character_util.stop_shake(princess)

	--공주(shake 0.3초): 기도를...
	scene_util.shake(princess, 0.03, 0.3)
	self.throne_scene_util:show_speech_bubble_async(princess, 'cw_main_s12_2')
	character_util.stop_shake(princess)

	--공주(right,idle,seat) : 여긴...?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	self.throne_scene_util:play_speech_action(princess, self, nil, 'seat', 'idle', 'cw_main_s12_3')

	--이때 카밀라는 (right,idle,idle) 상태가 된다.
	character_util.remove_anim(queen)

	--공주 일어나서 카밀라와 거리 1까지 벌어지도록 오른쪽으로 걸어간다.
	wp_util.move_async(princess,
			queen.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 2, nil, { locked_dir = 'left' })
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'left')

	--카밀라(right,smile,idle): 낮잠은 충분히 잤니?
	self.throne_scene_util:play_speech_action(queen, self, nil, nil, 'smile', 'cw_main_s12_4')

	--공주(left,tired,idle) silence 이모티콘

	self.throne_scene_util:show_emoticon_async(princess, 'silence')

	--공주(left,tired,nod2회) : 응…
	self.throne_scene_util:play_speech_action(princess, self, nil, 'nod', { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'cw_main_s12_5')

	--카밀라(right,idle,idle): 안색이 많이 안좋구나…
	self.throne_scene_util:show_speech_bubble_async(queen, 'cw_main_s12_6')

	--카밀라(right,idle,idle): 안좋은 꿈이라도 꾼 거니?
	self.throne_scene_util:show_speech_bubble_async(queen, 'cw_main_s12_7')

	--공주(left,smile,idle)(jump1회): 아, 아니야! 걱정 마 언니.
	character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)
	self.throne_scene_util:play_speech_action(princess, self, nil, nil, 'smile', 'cw_main_s12_8')

	--공주(left,tired,idle)(shake0.03/0.5초): 분명히 꿈을 꿨는데… 기억이 안나서 그래.
	scene_util.shake(princess, 0.03, 0.5)
	self.throne_scene_util:play_speech_action(princess, self, nil, nil, 'tired', 'cw_main_s12_9')
	character_util.stop_shake(princess)

	--공주(left,idle,idle): 뭔가 흐릿해서… 떠올리려고 해도 떠오르지 않아.
	self.throne_scene_util:show_speech_bubble_async(princess, 'cw_main_s12_10')

	--공주(left,tired,idle): 엄청나게 슬픈 기억이였는데… 잊으면 안되는 중요한 기억같았어.
	self.throne_scene_util:play_speech_action(princess, self, nil, nil, 'tired', 'cw_main_s12_11')

	--카밀라(right,smile,idle): 요새 고민이 많았나 보구나. 너무 걱정하지마렴.
	self.throne_scene_util:play_speech_action(queen, self, nil, nil, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'cw_main_s12_12')

	--카밀라(right,smile,idle): 정말 중요한 기억이라면 분명히 기억해낼 수 있을 거야.
	self.throne_scene_util:show_speech_bubble_async(queen, 'cw_main_s12_13')

	--카밀라(right,smile,bomb_idle): 무엇보다도 오늘같은 날에 속상한 표정으로 있기 아깝잖니.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	self.throne_scene_util:play_speech_action(queen, self, nil, 'bomb_idle', 'smile', 'cw_main_s12_14')

	--공주(left,idle,idle) notice 이모티콘 버블
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	self.throne_scene_util:show_emoticon_async(princess, 'notice')

	--공주(smile, sing) : 응, 그렇지 오늘은 언니 생일이잖아.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	self.throne_scene_util:play_speech_action(princess, self, nil, 'sing', 'smile', 'cw_main_s12_15')

	--카밀라 smile, nod 1회
	scene_util.set_emotion(queen, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(queen, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })

	--카밀라(idle, bomb_idle) :그래도 많이 힘들어보이는데 오늘은 성에서 쉬는 게 어때, 내 귀염둥이?
	self.throne_scene_util:play_speech_action(queen, self, nil, 'bomb_idle', nil, 'cw_main_s12_16')

	--공주(attack, idle, jump 2회) : 안 돼!
	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_double_jump(princess, true)
	self.throne_scene_util:play_speech_action(princess, self, nil, nil, nil, 'cw_main_s12_17')

	--공주(smile, victory_get 1회) : 언니 생일 케이크는 꼭 내가 받아올거야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	self.throne_scene_util:play_speech_action(princess, self, nil, 'victory_get', 'smile', 'cw_main_s12_18')

	--카밀라(smile, bomb_idle) : 그래, 혼자 다녀올 수 있겠어?
	self.throne_scene_util:play_speech_action(queen, self, nil, 'bomb_idle', 'smile', 'cw_main_s12_19')

	--공주(smile, nod 1회) : 응! 지금 바로 다녀올게!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	self.throne_scene_util:play_speech_action(princess, self, nil,
			{ name = 'nod', count = 1 }, 'smile', 'cw_main_s12_20')

	--공주(smile, release 2회) : 언니는 걱정말고 기다리고 있어!
	self.throne_scene_util:play_speech_action(princess, self, nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'smile', 'cw_main_s12_21')

	--카밀라도 down으로 전환
	scene_util.set_direction(queen, 'down', false)

	--공주가 아래로 퇴장하면서, 카메라 페이드 아웃.
	do
		local move_key = 'princess_move'

		local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess,
				princess.Position + vector(0, 0, -5), nil, 1.5, self, move_key)
		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		dash_sfx:FadeOut(2)
		dash_sfx = nil

		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
	end

	character_util.set_position(princess, field_util.get_marker_pos('s12_princess_market_start_pos'))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	self.interactable_item:set()
	self.throne_scene_util:change_to_normal_view()

	self.princess_world_runner = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/CivilWar/Common/PrincessWorldRunner')
	self.princess_world_runner:enter()

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	local release_npc = get_character('s12_market_npc_11')
	local sleep_npc = get_character('s12_market_npc_7')

	self.release_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01',
														 repeat_term = 0.2666667, parent = release_npc, volume = 0.6, max_distance = 3 })
	self.sleep_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_sleep_02',
													   loop = true, parent = sleep_npc, volume = 0.6, max_distance = 3 })
	self.village_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(

	--공주가 1초만에 알파 페이드 인 되며 1초간 속도 2로 걸어나온다.
	do
		local move_key = 'fade_in_move'
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(princess,
				princess.Position + vector(0, 0, -2), 2, nil, self, move_key)

		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	self.princess_world_runner:add_dash_sfx()

	self.util:exit_scene({ enable_wind_pot = false }, get_party_leader())

	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_little_princess_03', state = 'event', mix = 0 })

end

-- 아이템 인터랙트
function local_class:interact_item_scene(fo)
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local dir = 'left'

	--아이템 쪽 보는 방향 전환
	if princess.Position.x < fo.Position.x then
		dir = 'right'
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	--tired,question + silence
	scene_util.set_direction(princess, dir, false)
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(princess, self,
			nil, { name = 'question', loop = false }, 'tired', 'silence')

	--공주: 바닥에 떨어진 물건은 함부로 줍지 말라고 했어.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(princess, 'cw_main_s12_23')

	--배치된 반짝이 전부 제거
	self.interactable_item:remove_all_interacted_item()

	self:appear_chef()
end

-- 빵집 주인 등장
function local_class:appear_chef()
	local chef = self.get_chef()
	local chef_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s12_bakery_chef_pos')

	chef.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(chef, 0, 0)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	character_util.set_direction(chef, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(chef, chef_pos)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(chef, 1, 0.5)

	quest_marker_util.show(self, self.quest_marker_name, chef, true)

	chef.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false

	character_util.add_listener(chef, self.controller)
end

-- 빵집 주인 대화

	local chef = self.get_chef()

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(chef, self.controller)

			'cast', { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'cw_main_s12_24')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chef, self, nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 1 }, nil, 'cw_main_s12_25')

	--꼬마공주(smile, sing) : 감사합니다, 아저씨!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(princess, self, nil,
			'sing', 'smile', 'cw_main_s12_26')

	--빵집주인(smile, idle) : 아닙니다, 공주님.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chef, self, nil,
			nil, nil, 'cw_main_s12_27')

	--빵집주인(smile, cast) : 여왕님과 공주님의 우애를 보고 있으면…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chef, self, nil,
			'cast', nil, 'cw_main_s12_28')

	--빵집 주인(sing, sing) : 제 마음까지 따뜻해지는 기분이니까요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chef, self, nil,
			'sing', nil, 'cw_main_s12_29')

	-- 빵집 주인(smile, idle) : 자, 안전히 가져가실 수 있게 제가 포장해 드리죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(chef, self, nil, nil, nil, 'cw_main_s12_30')

	wp_util.move_async(chef, cake_pos + vector(0.4, 0, 0), nil, 0.2)

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })

	scene_util.set_anim(chef, self, 'eat')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_ball_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_box_02')

	self.fx:smoke():Instantiate(cake_pos)
	wait_for_sec(0.05)

	drop_item_util.dispose_item(cake)

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	eat_sfx = nil

		local deceleration_move = function(fo, duration, start_speed, target_speed, dir)
			local dt = 0
			local diff = target_speed - start_speed
			local current_speed = start_speed
			local time_passed = 0

			while time_passed < duration do
				dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
				time_passed = time_passed + dt
				local progress = time_passed / duration

				current_speed = start_speed + (progress * diff)
				fo.Position = fo.Position + dir * current_speed * dt
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	self.princess_world_runner:exit()
	self.princess_world_runner = nil

	--플레이어 기사로 교체
	local demon_knight = self.get_demon_knight()

function local_class:start_scene(func, ...)
	local args = { ... }

	local routine = function()
		-- 이전 리더에 대한 정보를 미리 캐싱해둬야 해제가 가능함
		local cached_leader = get_party_leader()

		self.util:enter_scene({ disable_wind_pot = true })

		yield_return_func(func, table.unpack(args))

		self.util:exit_scene({ enable_wind_pot = false }, cached_leader)
	end

	return start_coroutine(routine)
end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.wood_box:ConsumeComplete()
	self.wood_box = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_get_id and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_broker_table()) then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.before_receipt
		self.util:start_scene(self.id_table_interact_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_gate_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's13_gate_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.before_tesla
		self.util:start_scene(self.gate_enter_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_gate_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's13_gate_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.before_tesla
		self.util:start_scene(self.gate_enter_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_tesla and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's13_kicked_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.before_passage
		self.util:start_scene(self.tesla_puzzle_enter_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_passage and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's13_passage_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.before_broker_base
		self.util:start_scene(self.passage_enter_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_broker_base and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's13_broker_base_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.before_broker_battle
		self.util:start_scene(self.base_enter_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_receipt and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's13_gate_receipt_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.done
		self.util:start_scene(self.gate_receipt_enter_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state < self.section_state.before_receipt and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's13_keeper_enter_zone') then
		self.util:start_scene(self.block_gate_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local require_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Assassinate

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_broker_battle and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, get_party_leader()) and
			e.Info.type & require_damage_type == require_damage_type then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.broker_battle
		start_coroutine(self.broker_base_battle_start, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.section_state.broker_battle and
			e.BattleGroupName == 's13_broker_base' then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.before_get_id
		self.util:start_scene(self.broker_battle_end_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:intro_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local leader_start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('default_start')

	character_util.set_position(leader, leader_start_pos + vector(0, 0, -3))
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	camera_util.move(leader_start_pos, 0, { end_target = leader })

	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.hide_weapon(leader, false)

	wp_util.move_async(leader, leader_start_pos, 2, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')

	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })

	--bgm 첫부분 부터 시작
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress ~= 12 then
		music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })

		music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async(
				{ name = 'ondemand/v2_75_civilwar/audio:bgm_civilwar_saul_01', state = 'field' })
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 0 })

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(stage.Name), 1)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	self.util:exit_scene(nil, leader)

	--시작 시 마커 지정
	local marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s13_gate_marker_pos')
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.quest_marker_name, self.controller.quest_id, true, marker_pos)
end

function local_class:gate_enter_scene()
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 2)

	--스크린플레이 연출
	self:gate_enter_routine()
	self:operator_talk_routine()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	--연출 후 셋팅
	self:gate_enter_npc_setting()

	local marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s13_kicked_marker_pos')
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.quest_marker_name, self.controller.quest_id, true, marker_pos)
end

--게이트 문지기와 npc들이 대화하는 씬
function local_class:gate_enter_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local keeper_1 = self.get_gate_npc(1)
	local keeper_2 = self.get_gate_npc(2)
	local npc_3 = self.get_gate_npc(3)
	local npc_4 = self.get_gate_npc(4)
	local npc_5 = self.get_gate_npc(5)

	local leader_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s13_gate_knight_pos')
	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s13_gate_receipt_marker_pos')

	local crowd_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_01',
		loop = true,
		fade_in_time = 2,
		volume = 0.7,
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'npc'
	})

	--빨간존 진입시 가디언은 위치에 (right,idle,idle)로 정렬
	--동시에 카메라가 이동 후 이벤트가 재생된다.
	do
		local wp_key = 'leader_move'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, leader_pos, 4, nil, self, wp_key,
				{ last_direction = 'right' })

		camera_util.move_async(center_pos, 1.5)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--문지기(1)(down,idle,bomb_idle): 방금 제가 전달드린 그대롭니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(keeper_1, self, nil,
			'bomb_idle', nil, 'cw_main_s13_1')

	--문지기(1)(down,attack,release): 이제부터 통행료와 신분증이 필요합니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(keeper_1, self, nil,
			'release', 'attack', 'cw_main_s13_2')

	--(3)(up,idle,idle)(jump1회): 갑자기 통행료라니 무슨 일이야?
	character_util.normal_jump_async(npc_3, '01_player_jump_01')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_3, self, nil,
			nil, nil, 'cw_main_s13_3')

	--(4)(up,idle,release): 너희들 도대체 누구 허락받고 이러고 있는 거야?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, nil,
			'release', nil, 'cw_main_s13_4')

	--(4)(up,idle,cast2): 내가 여기 몇년을 다녔는데 갑자기 무슨 통행료야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, nil,
			'cast2', nil, 'cw_main_s13_5')

	--문지기(2)가 하단으로 2.5칸 이동하고 (right,idle,idle)이 되고 동시에 (4)는 (left,idle,idle) (3)은 (right,idle,idle)이 된다.
	character_util.remove_anim(keeper_2)
	wp_util.move_async(keeper_2,
			keeper_2.Position + vector(0, 0, -2.0), 4, nil, { last_direction = 'down' })

	scene_util.set_direction(npc_3, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(npc_4, 'left', false)

	--문지기(2)(right,idle,twohand_idle): 모리안 님의 명령입니다.
	--해당 스프라이트가 손위에 올려져있다.
	local print_pos = keeper_2.Position + vector(0.6, 0.9, 0)
	local blueprint = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = print_pos,
		itemid = self.blueprint_item_id,
		notforinven = true,
		sprscale = 1,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		skip_text = true,
		showoncharacter = true
	})
	blueprint.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_paper_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(keeper_2, self, nil,
			{ name = 'twohand_idle', keep = true }, nil, 'cw_main_s13_6')

	--(4)(left,attack,idle): 모, 모리안 님의 칙서?!
	character_util.normal_jump_async(npc_4, '01_player_jump_01')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, nil,
			nil, 'attack', 'cw_main_s13_7')

	--문지기(2)(down,idle,idle) : 지금은 전시 상황입니다!
	--스프라이트 제거
	drop_item_util.dispose_item(blueprint)
	blueprint = nil

	character_util.remove_anim(keeper_2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(keeper_2, 'cw_main_s13_8')

	--문지기(2)(down,attack,idle): 이 곳을 지나는 모두는 사울의 보호를 받는겁니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(keeper_2, self, nil,
			nil, 'attack', 'cw_main_s13_9')


	--문지기(2)(right,attack,idle): 그리고 그 보안을 위해서라도 합당한 금액을 받아야겠죠.
	--해당 대사와 함께 하단 0.5칸 이동
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_walk_04')
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async,
				keeper_2, keeper_2.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5), 1),
		util.cs_generator(scene_util.play_normal_speech_action,
				keeper_2, self, nil, nil, 'attack', 'cw_main_s13_10')
	})

	--문지기(2)(right,idle,idle): 그게 아니라면…
	--해당 대사와 함께 우측으로 0.25칸 이동
	do
		scene_util.set_direction(keeper_2, 'right', false)

		local wp_key = 'keeper_move'
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(keeper_2, keeper_2.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0), 1, nil, self, wp_key)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(keeper_2, self, nil,
				nil, nil, 'cw_main_s13_11')

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--문지기(2)가 시민들을 위협하는 연출
	do
		local jump_npcs = {}
		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(keeper_2, 'attack') / 2

		scene_util.set_anim(keeper_2, self, { name = 'attack', loop = false, sfx_name = '02_normal_slash_01' })

		--attack 모션 끝나기 0.1초 전 (4)(left,damaged,embarrassed)
		--(4) 모션 바뀔 때 화면 shake 0.1 / 0.5초
		wait_for_sec(anim_duration)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc_4, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(npc_4, self, 'embarrassed')

		--동시에 (3)(right,surprise,idle)(jump1회) 나머지 (5)~(10)인원들 (jump1회)
		--(5)~(10)인원들도 (right)보도록
		for i = 5, 10 do
			local gate_npc = self.get_gate_npc(i)

			scene_util.set_direction(gate_npc, 'right')

			table.insert(jump_npcs, gate_npc)
		end
		table.insert(jump_npcs, npc_3)

		crowd_sfx:FadeOut(1)
		crowd_sfx = nil

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_05')
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc_3, self, 'surprise')
		character_util.group_normal_jump(jump_npcs, '01_player_jump_01')

		--1초 후 (3) 표정은 (tired)상태
		wait_for_sec(1)

		for i = 1, #jump_npcs do
			scene_util.set_emotion(jump_npcs[i], self, 'tired')
		end
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc_3, self, 'tired')
	end

	--문지기(2)(right,mad,attack모션 끝에 정지): 모리안 님의 뜻을 거스르려는 겁니까?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(keeper_2, self, 'mad')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(keeper_2, 'cw_main_s13_12')

	--(4)(left,damaged,embarrassed): 자, 잠깐만! 알았다고!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, nil,
			'embarrassed',
			'damaged',
			'cw_main_s13_12_1')

	--문지기(2)(right,idle,idle) 1초 후 원래 자리로 복귀 (좌측0.25칸 위로2.5칸 이동) 문지기
	--동시에 (4) (left,damaged,seat) +fx_hit 피격효과(빨간틴트+눌림)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(keeper_2)
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc_4, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(npc_4, self, 'seat')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
	self.fx.hit():Instantiate(npc_4.Position)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(npc_4)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--원래 자리로 복귀 (좌측0.25칸 위로2.5칸 이동)
	wp_util.move_async(keeper_2, {
		keeper_2.Position + vector(-0.25, 0, 0),
		keeper_2.Position + vector(-0.25, 0, 2.5),
	}, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'down' })

	for i = 5, 10 do
		scene_util.set_direction(self.get_gate_npc(i), 'up')
	end

	--(4)(left,attack,seat) : 젠장, 병정 놀이나 하라고 낸 세금이 아닌데.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc_4, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc_4, 'cw_main_s13_13')

	--(4)(left,tired,eat) 1초 모션 동안
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })
	scene_util.play_wait_action(npc_4, self, nil, 'eat', 'tired', 1)

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	eat_sfx = nil

	--0.5칸 앞에 0.5 크기의 해당 스프라이트가 떨어진다. 끝나면 (left,idle,idle)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	local dollar_pos = npc_4.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
	self.dollar_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = npc_4.Bounds.center + vector(-0.2, 0, 0),
		target = dollar_pos,
		itemid = self.dollar_item_id,
		notforinven = true,
		sprscale = 0.5,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		skip_text = true,
		showoncharacter = true
	})

	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	--문지기(1)(down,idle,release): 잠깐, 모든 통행료는 사울의 화폐로만 받고 있습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(keeper_1, self, nil,
			'release', nil, 'cw_main_s13_14')

	--(5)(jump1회): 뭐라고요? 지금까진 공용 화폐도 허용하고 있었잖아요!
	character_util.normal_jump_async(npc_5, '01_player_jump_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc_5, 'cw_main_s13_15')

	--(6)(release): 현재 환전소도 운영하고 있지 않잖아요!
	local npc_6 = self.get_gate_npc(6)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_6, self, nil,
			'release',
			nil,
			'cw_main_s13_16')

	--문지기(1)(down,attack,idle): 평소 사울에 왕래도 없던 자가 출입하려는 게 문제입니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(keeper_1, self, nil,
			nil, 'attack', 'cw_main_s13_17')

	--문지기(1)(down,idle,idle): 저흰 환전원이 아니라 군인입니다! 명령을 따를 뿐이죠.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(keeper_1, 'cw_main_s13_18')

	--카메라 복귀 후
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

--크로셀, 리리스와 대화하는 씬
function local_class:operator_talk_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--크로셀 UI를 사용하여 대화한다.
	--크로셀: 가디언, 들리십니까? 예상보다 저희쪽에서 연락이 늦었군요.
	self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'cw_main_s13_19')

	--가디언 (right,idle,idle)(jump1회) (!) notice 이모티콘 버블
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(leader, true)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'notice')

	--가디언이 경로대로 오브젝트 뒤로 이동한 후 (right,idle,idle) 상태가 된다.
	wp_util.move_async(leader, {
		leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -3.5),
		leader.Position + vector(-2, 0, -3.5),
	}, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--크로셀: 계산에 따르면 현재 가디언의 위치는 사울 외곽까지 진입했을 거라 예측됩니다.
	self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'cw_main_s13_19_1')

	--리리스: 그렇다는데? 어때 $name 사울 광장엔 무사히 진입했어?
	self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_ceo', 'cw_main_s13_20')

	--선택지
	--입구 막기가 너무 철저한데? (빨강)
	--좀 도와주시면 안될까요? (초록)
	do
		local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'cw_main_s13_choose_1', 'brutal' },
			{ 'cw_main_s13_choose_2', 'mercy' }
		})

		if result == 1 then
			--가디언(right,tired,bomb_idle) 1초
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
			scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self, nil, 'bomb_idle', 'tired', 1)

			--크로셀: 적군들이 어서오세요 하고 환영해줄거라 기대한 건 가요?
			self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'cw_main_s13_21')

		elseif result == 2 then
			--가디언(right,smile,sing) 1초
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
			scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self, nil, 'sing', 'smile', 1)

			--리리스: 무슨일인지 말해, 빠르게 도와줄테니.
			self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_ceo', 'cw_main_s13_22')
		end
	end

	--선택지 - 선택한 선택지는 제거후 복귀 두 선택지 다 보면 진행
	--사울의 화폐에 대해.
	--돌파할 수 있는 방법.
	do
		local choose_table = {
			{ 'cw_main_s13_choose_3', 'normal' },
			{ 'cw_main_s13_choose_4', 'normal' }
		}

		local choose_1_scene = function()
			--가디언(right,tired,bomb_idle) 1초
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self,
					'right',
					'bomb_idle',
					'tired',
					1)

			--리리스: 사울 포인트라는 사울의 고유 화폐야. 보통 줄여서 SP라고 칭하지.
			self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_ceo', 'cw_main_s13_23')

			--리리스: 군사품에 외부 유출을 막기위한 제도라고는 설명했었지.
			self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_ceo', 'cw_main_s13_24')

			--리리스: 아무래도 쿠데타와 독립을 위한 밑거름 이였던 모양이네. 귀여운 전략이야.
			self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_ceo', 'cw_main_s13_25')
		end
		local choose_2_scene = function(this)
			--가디언 (right,attack,release) 1초
			scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self,
					'right',
					'release',
					'attack',
					1)

			--크로셀: 사울의 보안이 강화되면서 이를 통해 이익을 챙기려는 단체에 대한 정보를 입수했습니다.
			self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'cw_main_s13_26')

			--크로셀: 당신의 헤실한 얼굴이라면 가만히 서있어도 브로커들이 접근할 확률이 87.6% 정도 되겠군요.
			self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'cw_main_s13_27')

			--크로셀: 그 브로커들을 통해 광장에 진입하는 게 현재는 가장 효율적인 방법입니다.
			self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'cw_main_s13_28')
		end

		local scene_table = {
			choose_1_scene,
			choose_2_scene,
		}

		while #choose_table > 0 do
			local result = choose_util.play_choose_event(choose_table)

			scene_table[result]()

			table.remove(choose_table, result)
			table.remove(scene_table, result)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	--크로셀: 더 질문할 내용이 있나요?
	self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'cw_main_s13_29')

	--선택지
	--뭐라고 했죠?
	--다른 방법은 없어?
	--까짓거 함 해보죠.
	do
		local talking = true
		local scene_table = {}
		local choose_table = {
			{ 'cw_main_s13_choose_5', 'brutal' },
			{ 'cw_main_s13_choose_6', 'intellect' },
			{ 'cw_main_s13_choose_7', 'mercy' }
		}

		local choose_1_scene = function()
			--크로셀: 사울 포인트 통칭 SP는 사울의 고유 화폐.
			self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'cw_main_s13_30')

			--크로셀: 주변의 브로커들과 접촉하여 내부로 진입.
			self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'cw_main_s13_31')

			--크로셀: 이제 좀 이해가 되십니까?
			self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'cw_main_s13_32')
		end

		local choose_2_scene = function(this)
			--크로셀: 좋습니다. 당신에게 적합한 84가지 방법을 하나씩 설명해드리죠.
			self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'cw_main_s13_33')

			--크로셀: 제1안. 경비병들을 암살 후 복식을 훔쳐 변장하는 방법입니다.
			self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'cw_main_s13_34')

			--크로셀: 경비병의 교대 시간을 노리면 됩니다. 앞으로 8시간을 기다리면…
			self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'cw_main_s13_35')

			--리리스: 그 농담은 질리지도 않나?
			self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_ceo', 'cw_main_s13_36')

			--해당 브랜치 실행 후 목록에서 제거
			for i = 1, #choose_table do
				if choose_table[i][1] == 'cw_main_s13_choose_6' then
					table.remove(choose_table, i)
					table.remove(scene_table, i)
					break
				end
			end
		end

		local choose_3_scene = function(this)
			--가디언 (right,attack,victory_get) 이 후 진행.
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
			scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

			talking = false
		end

		scene_table = {
			choose_1_scene,
			choose_2_scene,
			choose_3_scene,
		}

		while talking do
			local result = choose_util.play_choose_event(choose_table)

			scene_table[result]()

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	--공통 진행
	--크로셀: 현재 긍정적인 상황은 아니지만, 최대한 지원해드리도록 하겠습니다.
	self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'cw_main_s13_37')

	--리리스: 이번 전쟁에 가장 중요한 변수는 너니까…
	self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_ceo', 'cw_main_s13_38')

	--UI shake 0.1 / 1초
	start_coroutine(function()
		local light_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_parvati_light_loop_01', fade_in_time = 0.5,
													   loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'player' })

		self.operator_ui:shake(0.1, 1)

		light_sfx:FadeOut(0.5)
		light_sfx = nil
	end)

	--전화받던 가디언 (surprise)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(leader, false)

	--리리스: 큭…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_light_06')
	self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_ceo', 'cw_main_s13_39')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	--크로셀: 골치 아프군요… 또 그 검은 눈을 가진 병사들입니다.
	self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'cw_main_s13_40')

	--크로셀: 전장에 피어오르는 검은 꽃과 함께 정보 파악이 전혀 안되고 있습니다.
	self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'cw_main_s13_40_1')

	--리리스: 모리안… 그 꼬맹이는 도대체 뭘 준비해 온거야…
	self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_ceo', 'cw_main_s13_40_2')

	--리리스: 그럼 $name, 잠깐 막고 올테니 다음에 보자고.
	self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_ceo', 'cw_main_s13_41')

	--가디언 (right,tired,idle) (annoyed) 이모티콘
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			'tired',
			'annoyed')
end

	local broker_1 = self.get_broker_npc(1)
	local broker_2 = self.get_broker_npc(2)
	local camera_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s13_entrance_marker_pos')

	scene_util.set_direction(broker_2, 'up')

	character_util.convert_to_monster(hulk, 's13_broker_base', 's13_broker_base_battle_zone')

function local_class:broker_battle_end_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local npc = self.get_broker_npc(4)
	local marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s13_broker_base_marker_pos')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.convert_to_npc(npc)

	--npc 부활
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
	heal_info.heal = npc.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.isRevive = true
	heal_info.sender = npc
	heal_info.target = npc
	heal_info.skipEffect = true

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--(2)(right,damaged,idle) 가디언 (left,idle,idle) 상태
	scene_util.set_direction(npc, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'damaged')
	character_util.set_position(npc, marker_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0))

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_position(leader, marker_pos + vector(1, 0, 0))

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--(2)(right,damaged,idle)(shake0.03): 윽…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(npc, 0.03, 99999)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc, 'cw_main_s13_47')
	character_util.stop_shake(npc)

	--(2)(dead모션)(shake 멈춤)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(npc, self, { name = 'dead', loop = false, keep_anim = true })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')

	--(2)의 사울포인트가 350000 (20만)이 보이고 가디언에게 이동된다.
	start_coroutine(function()
		self.rolling_number:show_async(npc, 350000, 0)
	end)
	self.rolling_number:show_async(leader, 0, 350000)

	character_util.remove_rolling_number(npc.Transform)
	character_util.hide_rolling_number(leader.Transform)

	--나렉이션 인터렉트 세팅
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local fo = get_field_object('s13_broker_base_table_' .. i)
		fo.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('s13_broker_base_table_pos_' .. i)
		fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(2, 0, 2))
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(self.quest_marker_name, self.controller.quest_id, true, self.get_broker_table())
end
