--- 마계 전쟁을 바라보는 가디언
function local_class:show_war_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local demon_engineer = self.get_demon_engineer()

	--기사 scared, idle, jump 1회 / 비네트 surprise, idle, jump 1회
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_engineer, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.group_normal_jump({ leader, demon_engineer }, true)

	--샤우트 말풍선, 크기 2배, 화면 중앙 상단 : 반역자 모리안!
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })
	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(leader, 'cw_main_s24_1', true,
			{ viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.75), scale = 2 })

	--기사 right, scared, idle로 전환.
	--0.7초 대기.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--비네트 up, idle로 전환.
	--비네트 : 전장 쪽인가..?
	character_util.remove_emotion(demon_engineer)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self, 'up',
			nil,
			nil,
			'cw_main_s24_2')

	--비네트와 가디언 위 위치로 1초에 걸쳐 정렬한다.
	--카메라 포커스는 가디언과 비네트의 중간 지점으로 동일한 시간동안 이동한다.
	local leader_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s24_knight_pos')
	local demon_engineer_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s24_demon_engineer_pos')
	local camera_pos = {
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s24_knight_camera_pos_1'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s24_knight_camera_pos_2')
	}

	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
	wp_util.move(leader, leader_pos, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'up' })
	wp_util.move(demon_engineer, demon_engineer_pos, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'up' })
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos[1], 1)

	--비네트(up, idle) : 이제… 시작하나 본데.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(demon_engineer, 'cw_main_s24_3')

	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 포커스 위로 3칸 이동.
	--동시에 0.7초만에 검게 페이드 아웃.
	camera_util.move(camera_pos[2], 1)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.7, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self:war_event()

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos[1], 0.5)

	--1초만에 검은색 페이드인.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--비네트(left, tired, idle) : 400년이 지나도 전쟁이 계속될 줄은 몰랐었는데…
	--가디언 right로 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self, nil,
			nil,
			'tired',
			'cw_main_s24_17')

	--가디언 선택지
	--(노랑)전쟁은 결코 변하지 않으니까.
	--(초록)이번 전투로 전쟁이 끝날 거야.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{ { 'cw_main_s24_18', 'intellect' }, { 'cw_main_s24_20', 'mercy' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--가디언 right, sleep_deep, cross_arm 1초
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'sleep_deep')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_ready_01' })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--비네트(tired, cross_arm) : 흐음… 너는 헤실한건지 똑똑한건지 모르겠단 말이지.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self, 'left',
				'cross_arm',
				'tired',
				'cw_main_s24_19')
	else
		--가디언 attack, victory_get 1회
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'victory_get')
		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		--비네트(tired, cross_arm) : 흐음… 그러면 좋겠는데 말이지.
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self, 'left',
				'cross_arm',
				'tired',
				'cw_main_s24_21')
	end

	--비네트(attack, idle) : 움직이자.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self, nil,
			nil,
			'attack',
			'cw_main_s24_22')

	--비네트(idle, bomb_idle) : 뭐, 저쪽은 리리스가 어떻게든 할 거야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self, nil,
			'bomb_idle',
			nil,
			'cw_main_s24_23')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('s24_door_1', false))

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

--- 리리스와 모리안의 전쟁 연출 이벤트
function local_class:war_event()
	local demon_queen = self.get_demon_queen()
	local demon_governor = self.get_demon_governor()
	local legendary_hero_old = self.get_legendary_hero_old()
	local legendary_hero = self.get_legendary_hero()

	local camera_pos = {

	local move_action_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(move_time, 2)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.LinkDoorEvent))

	self.mana_cannon_loop = false

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.default_start and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.battle_group_info[1].battle_zone_name) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.battle_1_start
		self:battle_start(1)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.battle_1_end and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.show_cannon_zone_name) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.show_cannon
		self.util:start_scene(self.show_cannon_event, self)

		return true

	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.show_cannon and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.show_switch_zone_name) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.show_switch
		self.util:start_scene(self.show_pink_switch_event, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.show_switch and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.battle_group_info[2].battle_zone_name) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.battle_2_start
		self:battle_start(2)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.door_switch_clear and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.cannon_shot_zone_name) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.door_switch_clear
		self.util:start_scene(self.shot_mana_cannon_event, self)

		return true
	end

	self:quest_marker_check(e)

	if not self.talk_flower_zone_check and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's25_show_flower_zone') then
		self.talk_flower_zone_check = true
		self.util:start_scene(self.show_flower_zone, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	local battle_group_name = e.BattleGroupName

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.battle_1_start and
			battle_group_name == self.battle_group_info[1].battle_group_name then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.battle_1_end
		self:battle_end(1)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.battle_2_start and
			battle_group_name == self.battle_group_info[2].battle_group_name then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.battle_2_end
		self:battle_end(2)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 퀘스트 마커 처리 및 진행도 처리용
function local_class:on_link_door_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.show_cannon then
		if e.IsOpen then
			if e.LinkDoorTypeName == 'green' then
				self.current_link_door_state = self.current_link_door_state | self.link_door_state.green_open

				quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name .. 'green')

				if self.current_link_door_state == self.link_door_state.all_open then
					quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name,
							self.get_cannon_soldier(), true)
				end
			elseif e.LinkDoorTypeName == 'pink' then
				self.current_link_door_state = self.current_link_door_state | self.link_door_state.pink_open

				quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name .. 'pink')

				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name .. 'saul_tent_1',
						get_field_object('saul_tent_exit_1'), true)

				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name .. 'saul_tent_2',
						get_field_object('saul_tent_exit_2'), true)
			end

			-- 스위치 둘 다 눌렀으면 진행도 넘김
			if self.current_link_door_state == self.link_door_state.all_open then
				self.current_section_state = self.section_state.door_switch_clear
			end
		else
			quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

			if e.LinkDoorTypeName == 'green' then
				local not_open = self.link_door_state.all_open ~ self.link_door_state.green_open

				self.current_link_door_state = self.current_link_door_state & not_open

				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name .. 'green',
						self.get_green_switch(), true)
			elseif e.LinkDoorTypeName == 'pink' then
				local not_open = self.link_door_state.all_open ~ self.link_door_state.pink_open

				self.current_link_door_state = self.current_link_door_state & not_open

				quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name .. 'saul_tent_1')
				quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name .. 'saul_tent_2')

				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name .. 'pink',
						self.get_pink_switch(), true)
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

	return true

--- 해당 섹션 전용 마커 처리
function local_class:quest_marker_check(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'saul_tent_zone') then
		self:remove_quest_marker()

		-- 핑크 스위치를 안눌렀다면
		if 0 == (self.current_link_door_state & self.link_door_state.pink_open) then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name .. 'pink',
					self.get_pink_switch(), true)
		else
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name .. 'saul_tent_1',
					get_field_object('saul_tent_exit_1'), true)

			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name .. 'saul_tent_2',
					get_field_object('saul_tent_exit_2'), true)
		end
	end

	-- 리리스 텐트 존
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'demon_tent_zone') then
		self:remove_quest_marker()

		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name,
				get_field_object('demon_tent_exit_1'), true)
	end

	-- 메인 존
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'main_zone') then
		self:remove_quest_marker()

		if self.current_section_state < self.section_state.show_cannon then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name,
					field_util.get_marker_pos('s25_show_cannon_pos_1'), true)

		elseif self.current_section_state < self.section_state.show_switch then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name .. 'pink',
					get_field_object('saul_tent_entrance_1'), true)

			if 0 == (self.current_link_door_state & self.link_door_state.green_open) then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name .. 'green',
						self.get_green_switch(), true)
			end
		elseif self.current_section_state < self.section_state.door_switch_clear then
			if 0 == (self.current_link_door_state & self.link_door_state.pink_open) then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name .. 'pink',
						get_field_object('saul_tent_entrance_1'), true)
			end

			if 0 == (self.current_link_door_state & self.link_door_state.green_open) then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name .. 'green',
						self.get_green_switch(), true)
			end
		elseif self.current_section_state < self.section_state.assassinate_soldier then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name,
					self.get_cannon_soldier(), true)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:npc_setting()
	local dead_setting = function(target, tint)
		scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false, one_shot_sfx = false })

		if tint then
			character_util.add_color(target, target.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
		end
	end

	-- 사울 병사
	local saul_table = { 8, 8, 8, 7 }
	local saul_dead = { { i = 2, j = 7 }, { i = 2, j = 8 }, { i = 3, j = 8 }, { i = 4, j = 7 } }

	for i = 1, #saul_table do
		for j = 1, saul_table[i] do
			local saul_soldier = self.get_saul_soldier(i, j)
			local marker = self.get_saul_marker(i, j)

			character_util.set_position(saul_soldier, marker.position)
			character_util.set_direction(saul_soldier, marker.direction)
			scene_util.set_emotion(saul_soldier, self, 'attack')
			scene_util.set_anim(saul_soldier, self, { name = 'dagger_idle', one_shot_sfx = false })

			for _, check in pairs(saul_dead) do
				if i == check.i and j == check.j then
					dead_setting(saul_soldier, true)
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end


	-- 마계 병사
	local demon_count = 10
	local demon_dead = { 1, 2, 5, 10 }

	for i = 1, demon_count do
		local demon_soldier = self.get_demon_soldier(i)
		local marker = self.get_demon_marker(i)

		character_util.set_position(demon_soldier, marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(demon_soldier, marker.direction)
		scene_util.set_emotion(demon_soldier, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(demon_soldier, self, { name = 'dagger_idle', one_shot_sfx = false })

		for _, check in pairs(demon_dead) do
			if i == check then
				dead_setting(demon_soldier, false)
				break
			end
		end
	end

	-- 에리나
	local legendary_hero = self.get_legendary_hero()

	character_util.set_position_from_marker(legendary_hero, 's25_legendary_hero_pos_1')
	scene_util.set_emotion(legendary_hero, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(legendary_hero, self, 'sword_idle')

	-- 리리스
	local demon_queen = self.get_demon_queen()

	character_util.set_position_from_marker(demon_queen, 's25_demon_queen_pos_1')
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_queen, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_queen, self, { name = 'sword_attack_stab', loop = false })

	-- 모리안
	local demon_governor = self.get_demon_governor()

	character_util.set_position_from_marker(demon_governor, 's25_demon_governor_pos_1')
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_governor, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_governor, self, { name = 'sword_attack_stab', loop = false })

	self.spark_effect = self.get_fx_spark_effect():Instantiate(demon_queen.Position + vector(0.5, 0.5, 0))

	-- 마나 캐논 조작 병사
	local cannon_npc = self.get_cannon_soldier()

	character_util.convert_to_monster(cannon_npc)
	cannon_npc.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterAssassinateDamagedBehaviour.Create()
	cannon_npc.DamagedBehaviour.ApplyOtherDamage = false
	cannon_npc.DamagedBehaviour.ApplyBombDamage = false
	cannon_npc.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
end

--- 마나 캐논 이송을 보는 가디언
function local_class:show_cannon_event()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local demon_engineer = self.get_demon_engineer()
	local mana_cannon = self.get_mana_cannon()
	local npcs = {}

	for i = 1, self.cannon_move_npc.count do
		table.insert(npcs, self.cannon_move_npc:get(i))
	end

	local markers_pos = {}
	local marker_count = 7

	for i = 1, marker_count do
		table.insert(markers_pos, field_util.get_marker_pos('s25_show_cannon_pos_' .. i))
	end

	local camera_pos = {
		(markers_pos[1] + markers_pos[2]) * 0.5,
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s25_show_cannon_camera_pos')
	}

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	--가디언과 비네트 위 위치로 1초에 걸쳐 정렬.
	local leader_wp_key = 'leader_wp'
	local demon_engineer_wp_key = 'demon_engineer_wp'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, markers_pos[1], nil, 1,
			self, leader_wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(demon_engineer, markers_pos[2], nil, 1,
			self, demon_engineer_wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

	camera_util.move(camera_pos[1], 1)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, leader_wp_key)
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, demon_engineer_wp_key)

	--비네트(left, idle, bomb_idle) : 거의 요새 수준이군.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self, nil,
			'bomb_idle',
			'idle',
			'cw_main_s25_2')

	--비네트(left, sleep_deep, bomb_idle) : 리리스가 기죽을만 해.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self, nil,
			'question',
			'sleep_deep',
			'cw_main_s25_3')

	--비네트(right, tired, cross_arm) : 하지만 이것만으로 에리나와 리리스를 이길 확신을…
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--기사 right, tired, idle로 바꾸고 0.5초 대기.
				scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
				wait_for_sec(0.5)
			end,
			{
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action, demon_engineer, self, nil,
				{ name = 'cross_arm', keep = true },
				{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
				'cw_main_s25_4'
			}
	)

--- 케논 앞 병사 루틴
function local_class:cannon_saul_soldier_routine()
	local soldier = self.get_cannon_soldier()
	local mana_cannon = self.get_mana_cannon()
	local animator = mana_cannon:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	local time_passed = 0
	local time_tick = 0.1
	local time_count = 0

	while self.mana_cannon_loop do

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_tick <= time_passed then
			time_passed = 0
			time_count = time_count + 1
		end

		if time_passed == 0 and time_count == 1 then
			scene_util.set_anim(soldier, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

		elseif time_passed == 0 and time_count == 4 then
			animator:Play('shoot_45')

		elseif time_passed == 0 and time_count == 47 then
			animator:Play('end_45')

		elseif time_passed == 0 and time_count == 52 then
			animator:Play('on_45')

		elseif time_passed == 0 and time_count == 80 then
			time_count = 0
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

--- 붙잡고 싸우는 2대 1 무리
function local_class:battle_push_routine(target, left, right)
	local left_move_offset = -direction_util.to_vector3(left.Direction) * 0.5
	local right_move_offset = direction_util.to_vector3(right.Direction) * 2.5

	local time_passed = 0
	local time_tick = 0.1
	local time_count = 0

	target.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'sword_idle'
	target.CustomRunAnimationName = 'sword_run'

	left.LockedDirection = left.Direction
	left.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'sword_idle'
	left.CustomRunAnimationName = 'sword_run'

	character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'sword_attack', count = 1 })
	wait_for_sec(0.26)

	self:damaged_npc(left)
	wp_util.move_async(left, left.Position + left_move_offset, nil, 0.5)

	scene_util.set_emotion(left, self, 'attack')
	character_util.remove_group_anim({ left, right })
	wp_util.move_async(right, right.Position + right_move_offset, 4, nil, { run = true })

	scene_util.set_anim(right, self, 'push')
	scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })
	scene_util.shake(target, 0.02, 200, false)
	scene_util.shake(right, 0.02, 200, false)

	wp_util.move_async(left, left.Position - left_move_offset, nil, 0.5)

	while self.war_routine do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_tick <= time_passed then
			time_passed = 0
			time_count = time_count + 1
		end

		if time_passed == 0 and time_count == 1 then
			character_util.set_anim(left, { name = 'sword_attack', count = 1 })
		elseif time_passed == 0 and time_count == 3 then
			self:damaged_npc(target)
			scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })
		elseif time_passed == 0 and time_count == 6 then
			time_count = 0
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.stop_shake(target)
	character_util.stop_shake(right)
end

function local_class:dead_npc_attack_routine(target, attack_group)
	local time_passed = 0
	local time_tick = 0.1
	local time_count = 0

	character_util.add_color(target, target.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 3)

		end

	end

--- 모리안 흑화 이벤트
function local_class:war_event_show()
	local demon_queen = self.get_demon_queen()
	local demon_governor = self.get_demon_governor()
	local legendary_hero = self.get_legendary_hero()

	local camera_pos = {
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s25_war_camera_pos_1'),

		field_util.get_marker_pos('s25_war_camera_pos_2') + vector(0, 0, 8)
	}

	local light_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_light_loop_03', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop' })
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(6, 1)
	camera_util.move(camera_pos[1], 1, { ignore_camera_grid = true })

	self.war_routine = true
	self.hit_sfx_check = true

	-- 필요한 루프 우선 재생
	start_coroutine(self.battle_routine, self,
			self.get_demon_soldier(3),
			self.get_saul_soldier(1, 4),
			self.get_saul_soldier(1, 5))

	start_coroutine(self.dead_npc_attack_routine, self,
			self.get_demon_soldier(1),
			{ self.get_saul_soldier(4, 1), self.get_saul_soldier(2, 4) })
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	start_coroutine(self.battle_routine, self,
			self.get_demon_soldier(8),
			self.get_saul_soldier(4, 4),
			self.get_saul_soldier(4, 5), true, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	-- 에리나 루프
	local legendary_hero_loop = true

	start_coroutine(function()
		local damaged_npc = function(target, distance)
			scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, 'damaged')
			scene_util.set_anim(target, self, 'damaged')

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hero_sword_01')

			character_util.spine_pulse_color(target,
					CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)

			wp_util.move(target, target.Position + distance, 4, nil,
					{ locked_dir = target.Direction,
					  end_callback = function()
						  scene_util.set_anim(target, self, 'dead')
					  end })
		end

		scene_util.set_direction(legendary_hero, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(legendary_hero, self,
				{ name = 'sword_attack', count = 1, next_anim = 'sword_idle', one_shot_sfx = false })
		wait_for_sec(0.26)

		damaged_npc(self.get_saul_soldier(1, 1), vector(0, 0, 0))
		damaged_npc(self.get_saul_soldier(1, 2), vector(-1, 0, 0))
		damaged_npc(self.get_saul_soldier(1, 3), vector(-1, 0, 0))
		wait_for_sec(0.24)

		scene_util.set_direction(legendary_hero, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(legendary_hero, self,
				{ name = 'sword_attack', count = 1, next_anim = 'sword_idle', one_shot_sfx = false })
		wait_for_sec(0.26)

		damaged_npc(self.get_saul_soldier(2, 1), vector(0, 0, 0))
		damaged_npc(self.get_saul_soldier(2, 2), vector(1, 0, 0))
		damaged_npc(self.get_saul_soldier(2, 3), vector(1, 0, 0))
		wait_for_sec(0.24)

		local saul_soldier_1 = self.get_saul_soldier(3, 1)
		local saul_soldier_2 = self.get_saul_soldier(3, 2)
		local saul_soldier_3 = self.get_saul_soldier(3, 3)

		wp_util.move(saul_soldier_1,
				legendary_hero.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0.4), nil, 1)
		wp_util.move(saul_soldier_2,
				legendary_hero.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5), nil, 1)
		wp_util.move(saul_soldier_3,
				legendary_hero.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0.4), nil, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.shake(legendary_hero, 0.02, 999)
		character_util.shake(saul_soldier_1, 0.02, 999)
		character_util.shake(saul_soldier_2, 0.02, 999)
		character_util.shake(saul_soldier_3, 0.02, 999)
		character_util.set_locked_dir(legendary_hero, 'up')
		character_util.set_locked_dir(saul_soldier_1, 'down')
		character_util.set_locked_dir(saul_soldier_2, 'down')
		character_util.set_locked_dir(saul_soldier_3, 'down')

		character_util.set_group_direction({ saul_soldier_1, saul_soldier_2, saul_soldier_3 }, 'down')
		scene_util.set_direction(legendary_hero, 'up', false)
		scene_util.set_group_anim(
				{ legendary_hero, saul_soldier_1, saul_soldier_2, saul_soldier_3 }, self, 'push')

		local time_passed = 0
		local time_tick = 1.5
		local time_count = 0

		while self.war_routine and legendary_hero_loop do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if time_tick <= time_passed then
				time_passed = 0
				time_count = time_count + 1
			end

			if time_passed == 0 and time_count == 1 then
				wp_util.move(legendary_hero, legendary_hero.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5),
						nil, 0.5)
				wp_util.move(saul_soldier_1, saul_soldier_1.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5),
						nil, 0.5)
				wp_util.move(saul_soldier_2, saul_soldier_2.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5),
						nil, 0.5)
				wp_util.move(saul_soldier_3, saul_soldier_3.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5),
						nil, 0.5)

			elseif time_passed == 0 and time_count == 2 then
				wp_util.move(legendary_hero, legendary_hero.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
						nil, 0.5)
				wp_util.move(saul_soldier_1, saul_soldier_1.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
						nil, 0.5)
				wp_util.move(saul_soldier_2, saul_soldier_2.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
						nil, 0.5)
				wp_util.move(saul_soldier_3, saul_soldier_3.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
						nil, 0.5)

				time_count = 0
			end

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		character_util.stop_shake(legendary_hero)
		character_util.stop_shake(saul_soldier_1)
		character_util.stop_shake(saul_soldier_2)
		character_util.stop_shake(saul_soldier_3)
		character_util.stop(legendary_hero)
		character_util.stop(saul_soldier_1)
		character_util.stop(saul_soldier_2)
		character_util.stop(saul_soldier_3)

		scene_util.set_anim(legendary_hero, self, { name = 'sword_attack', count = 1 })
		wait_for_sec(0.26)

		character_util.air_spin(saul_soldier_1, { offset = vector(-1, 0, 0), play_deathsfx = false })
		character_util.air_spin(saul_soldier_2, { offset = vector(0, 0, 1), play_deathsfx = false })
		character_util.air_spin(saul_soldier_3, { offset = vector(1, 0, 0), play_deathsfx = false })

		character_util.reset_locked_dir(legendary_hero)
	end)

	camera_util.move(camera_pos[2], 3, { ignore_camera_grid = true })

	-- 추가 루틴 재생
	start_coroutine(self.dead_npc_attack_routine, self,
			self.get_demon_soldier(2),
			{ self.get_saul_soldier(3, 4) })

	start_coroutine(self.battle_push_routine, self,
			self.get_demon_soldier(4),
			self.get_saul_soldier(1, 6),
			self.get_saul_soldier(4, 2))
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	start_coroutine(self.dead_npc_attack_routine, self,
			self.get_demon_soldier(5),
			{ self.get_saul_soldier(1, 7), self.get_saul_soldier(2, 5) })

	start_coroutine(self.battle_push_routine, self,
			self.get_demon_soldier(6),
			self.get_saul_soldier(1, 8),
			self.get_saul_soldier(4, 3))
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	start_coroutine(self.dead_npc_attack_routine, self,
			self.get_demon_soldier(10),
			{ self.get_saul_soldier(3, 7) })

	start_coroutine(self.battle_push_routine, self,
			self.get_demon_soldier(7),
			self.get_saul_soldier(3, 5),
			self.get_saul_soldier(2, 6))
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

function local_class:damaged_npc(damaged_target, use_lasthit)
	scene_util.set_emotion(damaged_target, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(damaged_target, self, 'damaged')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	end

function local_class:enter()
	self:npc_setting()
	self:boss_zone_setting()

	self.util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/CivilWar/Common/Util')

	start_coroutine(function()
		music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async(
				{ name = 'ondemand/v2_75_civilwar/audio:bgm_civilwar_morian', state = 'field' })
	end)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	-- 위쪽 라인 루프 재생
	self.war_routine = true

	start_coroutine(self.dead_npc_attack_routine, self,
			self.get_demon_soldier(1),
			{ self.get_saul_soldier(4, 1), self.get_saul_soldier(2, 4) })

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name,
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s26_demon_governor_pos_1'), true)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	self.war_routine = false
	self.util = nil
	self.dissolver = nil

	if self.aura_effect ~= nil then
		self.aura_effect:Dispose()
		self.aura_effect = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.dissolver = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.default_start and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's26_boss_battle_event_zone') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.battle_start
		start_coroutine(self.boss_battle_start, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's26_war_out_zone') then
		self.util:start_scene(self.out_line_zone_event, self, e.Zone)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	-- 모리안의 hp가 50% 이하로 떨어지면
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.battle_start and
		lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.get_demon_governor_boss()) then
		local current_hp_percentage = e.Info.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HpRatio * 100
		local hp_percentage = 50

		if current_hp_percentage <= hp_percentage then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.battle_end
			start_coroutine(self.battle_end_event, self)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
	self.war_routine = false

	return true
end
--endregion on event

function local_class:npc_setting()
	local dead_setting = function(target)
		scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false, one_shot_sfx = false })
		character_util.add_color(target, target.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
	end

	-- 사울 병사
	local saul_table = { 8, 8, 8, 7 }
	local saul_dead = {
		{ i = 1, j = 1 },
		{ i = 1, j = 2 },
		{ i = 1, j = 3 },
		{ i = 2, j = 1 },
		{ i = 2, j = 2 },
		{ i = 2, j = 3 },
		{ i = 2, j = 7 },
		{ i = 2, j = 8 },
		{ i = 3, j = 8 },
		{ i = 4, j = 7 }
	}
	local saul_air_spin = {
		{ i = 3, j = 1 },
		{ i = 3, j = 2 },
		{ i = 3, j = 3 }
	}

	for i = 1, #saul_table do
		for j = 1, saul_table[i] do
			local saul_soldier = self.get_saul_soldier(i, j)
			local marker = self.get_saul_marker(i, j)

			character_util.set_position(saul_soldier, marker.position)
			character_util.set_direction(saul_soldier, marker.direction)
			scene_util.set_emotion(saul_soldier, self, 'attack')
			scene_util.set_anim(saul_soldier, self, { name = 'dagger_idle', one_shot_sfx = false })

			for _, check in pairs(saul_dead) do
				if i == check.i and j == check.j then
					dead_setting(saul_soldier)
					break
				end
			end

			for _, check in pairs(saul_air_spin) do
				if i == check.i and j == check.j then
					character_util.set_active_state(saul_soldier, 'disabled')
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- 마계 병사
	local demon_count = 10
	local demon_dead = { 1, 2, 5, 10 }

	for i = 1, demon_count do
		local demon_soldier = self.get_demon_soldier(i)
		local marker = self.get_demon_marker(i)

		character_util.set_position(demon_soldier, marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(demon_soldier, marker.direction)
		scene_util.set_emotion(demon_soldier, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(demon_soldier, self, { name = 'dagger_idle', one_shot_sfx = false })

		for _, check in pairs(demon_dead) do
			if i == check then
				dead_setting(demon_soldier)
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 틴트 npc 둘러싸고 있는 무리
function local_class:dead_npc_attack_routine(target, attack_group)
	local time_passed = 0
	local time_tick = 0.1
	local time_count = 0
	local group_index = 0

	while self.war_routine do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_tick <= time_passed then
			time_passed = 0
			time_count = time_count + 1
		end

		if time_passed == 0 and time_count == 1 then
			scene_util.set_anim(attack_group[(group_index % #attack_group) + 1], self,
					{ name = 'attack', count = 1, one_shot_sfx = false })
		elseif time_passed == 0 and time_count == 3 then
			local effect_pos = attack_group[(group_index % #attack_group) + 1].Position +
					direction_util.to_vector3(attack_group[(group_index % #attack_group) + 1].Direction) * 0.3 +
					vector(0, 0.2, 0)

			self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(effect_pos)
			character_util.shake(target, 0.02, 0.3)
		elseif time_passed == 0 and time_count == 6 then
			group_index = (group_index % #attack_group) + 1
			time_count = 0
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:boss_battle_start()
	self.util:enter_scene({ disable_wind_pot = true })

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local demon_engineer = self.get_demon_engineer()
	local demon_queen = self.get_demon_queen()
	local legendary_hero = self.get_legendary_hero()
	local demon_governor = self.get_demon_governor()
	local entangle = self.get_boss_entangle()

	scene_util.set_anim(entangle, self, { name = 'entangle_off', loop = false })
	entangle.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)

	local demon_governor_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s26_demon_governor_pos_1')

	self.war_routine = false

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	camera_util.move(demon_governor_pos, 1)

	local align_key = 'leader_wp'
	local leader_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s26_knight_pos_2')
	local demon_engineer_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s26_demon_engineer_pos_2')

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, leader_pos, nil, 1,
			self, align_key, { last_direction = 'up' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(demon_engineer, demon_engineer_pos, nil, 1,
			self, align_key, { last_direction = 'up' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, align_key)

	--리리스, 에리나 up으로 전환 1초 대기.
	scene_util.set_group_direction({ demon_queen, legendary_hero }, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--리리스 right, attack, idle / 에리나 left, attack, idle 1초 대기.
	scene_util.set_direction(demon_queen, 'right')
	scene_util.set_direction(legendary_hero, 'left', false)

	--카메라 포커스 0.5초만에 빨간색 마름모로 이동.
	camera_util.move(demon_governor_pos + vector(0, 0, -2), 0.5)

	--리리스, 에리나 down, attack, idle로 전환.
	--리리스 attack, idle, jump 1회, 느낌표 이모티콘
	scene_util.set_group_direction({ demon_queen, legendary_hero }, 'down')
	character_util.normal_jump(demon_queen, true)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(demon_queen, nil, 'notice')

	--리리스(down, attack, bomb_idle) :  $name, 비네트! 신호는 봤어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self, nil,
			'bomb_idle',
			nil,
			'cw_main_s26_3')

	--리리스(down, attack, release 2회) :  부유성은 아직이야?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self, nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			nil,
			'cw_main_s26_4')


	--비네트(up, bomb_idle) : 아직이야, 리리스.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_engineer, self, nil,
			'bomb_idle',
			nil,
			'cw_main_s26_5')

	--리리스(left, attack, bow_idle) : 그렇다면 모리안과 승부를 낼 수밖에 없는…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self, 'left',
			'bow_idle',
			nil,
			'cw_main_s26_6')

	--모리안이 위에서 수직으로 떨어지며 등장한다.
	--스파인 틴트된 상태 유지 + FX_Blockaura_Char_black 1.5배로 배치도 유지.
	local aura_effect_size = 1.5
	local black_aura = self.get_fx_blockaura_char_black():Instantiate(
			demon_governor.Position + vector(0, 0.35, 0),
			unity_class.quaternion.identity,
			demon_governor.transform)

	black_aura.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * aura_effect_size

	character_util.set_position(demon_governor, demon_governor_pos + vector(0, 10, 0))
	character_util.move_to_async(demon_governor, demon_governor_pos, 0.3)

	--착지할 때
	--FX_slime_buttbounce 착지 지점에 배치.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')
	self.get_fx_slime_buttbounce():Instantiate(demon_governor_pos)
	--애니메이션 right, attack, walk4legs 프레임 멈춘 채로.
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_governor, self, { name = 'walk4legs', one_shot_sfx = '01_land_01', scale = 0 })

	--카메라 쉐이크 0.3초, 세기 0.15
	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.3)

	scene_util.set_direction(demon_queen, 'left', false)
	self:damaged_npc(demon_queen)
	character_util.move_to(demon_queen, demon_queen.Position + vector(1, 0, -1.5), 0.3)

	scene_util.set_direction(legendary_hero, 'right', false)
	self:damaged_npc(legendary_hero)
	character_util.move_to(legendary_hero, legendary_hero.Position + vector(-1, 0, -1.5), 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
	scene_util.set_group_anim({ demon_queen, legendary_hero }, self, 'prostrate')

	--가디언과 비네트가 속도 4로 각각 에리나, 리리스 옆으로 가 선다.
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, legendary_hero.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
			4, nil, self, align_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(demon_engineer, demon_queen.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			4, nil, self, align_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, align_key)

	scene_util.set_direction(demon_governor, 'down')
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_governor, self, { name = 'idle', mix_duration = 0.3 })

	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_engineer, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_group_anim({ leader, demon_engineer }, self, 'eat')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	equipping_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_group_anim({ leader, demon_engineer })

	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.shake_and_wakeup(legendary_hero, 'right', 2, 'idle', true)

		scene_util.set_emotion(legendary_hero, self, 'tired')
	end)

	scene_util.shake(demon_queen, 0.02, 15)
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_queen, self, { name = 'walk4legs', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(3)

	--리리스(left, tired, idle, mixduration 0.3초) : 쳇… 상처가…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self, nil,
			{ name = 'idle', mix_duration = 0.3 },
			'tired',
			'cw_main_s26_7')

	character_util.stop_shake(demon_queen)
	character_util.remove_group_emotion({ leader, demon_engineer, demon_queen, legendary_hero })
	scene_util.set_group_direction({ leader, demon_engineer, demon_queen, legendary_hero }, 'up', false)

	camera_util.move_async(demon_governor.Position, 0.5)

	--기사 일행 전원 up으로 전환.
	--모리안(down, sleep_deep, idle) : 도망가게 두지 않아…
	character_util.set_group_direction({ leader, demon_engineer, demon_queen, legendary_hero }, 'up')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_governor, self, 'down',
			'idle',
			'sleep_deep',
			'cw_main_s26_8')

	--모리안(down, attack, bomb_idle) : 지금의 마계를 쓰러뜨리고!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_governor, self, 'down',
			'bomb_idle',
			'attack',
			'cw_main_s26_9')

	--모리안(down, attack, sword_attack_stab 1회) : 새로운 마계를 만들겠어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_governor, self, 'down',
			{ name = 'sword_attack_stab', loop = false },
			'attack',
			'cw_main_s26_10')

	--모리안(down, doyagao, idle) : 모든 것은 다…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_governor, self, nil,
			'idle',
			'doyagao',
			'cw_main_s26_11')

	--모리안(down, attack, cast2, jump 1회, 샤우트 말풍선) : 이 마계를 지키기 위해서!
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(demon_governor, true)
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(demon_governor, self, nil,
			'cast2',
			'attack',
			'cw_main_s26_12')

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 0.5)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--모리안 위치에 cw_boss_entangle, down, entangle_on 루프없이 실행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_morian_thorns_02')
	character_util.set_position(entangle, demon_governor.Position)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(entangle, false)
	scene_util.set_anim(entangle, self, { name = 'entangle_on', loop = false })

	--동시에 0.3초만에 모리안의 검은 기운 스케일 0으로 줄이면서 제거.
	--동시에 카메라 쉐이크 0.3초, 세기 0.1

	pooled_object_util.scale_async(black_aura, unity_class.vector3.zero, 0.3)

	black_aura:Dispose()
	black_aura = nil
	-- 0.7초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--모리안 스파인 제거한 채로, cw_boss_entangle, down, entangle_off 루프 없이 실행.

function local_class:battle_end_event()

	local demon_governor_boss = self.get_demon_governor_boss()
	local demon_queen = self.get_demon_queen()

	local demon_engineer = self.get_demon_engineer()

	character_util.convert_to_npc(demon_governor_boss)
	stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()

	character_util.add_color(demon_governor, demon_governor.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(demon_governor, 0, 0)
	scene_util.set_direction(demon_governor, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_governor, self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_governor, self, 'prostrate')
	demon_governor.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)

	local loot_at_side_direction = function(fo, target)
		if fo.Position.x <= target.Position.x then
			character_util.set_direction(fo, 'right')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(fo, 'left')
		end

		scene_util.set_emotion(fo, self, 'attack')
	end

	loot_at_side_direction(leader, demon_queen)
	loot_at_side_direction(demon_engineer, demon_queen)

	--물러나, $name!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_governor_boss, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(demon_queen, 'cw_main_s26_17',
			false, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.5), scale = 2 })

	local move_target_side = function(fo, target, offset)
		local move_pos = target.Position + vector(-6, 0, 0) + offset
		local end_direction = 'right'

		if fo.Position.x >= target.Position.x then
			move_pos = target.Position + vector(6, 0, 0) + offset
			end_direction = 'left'
		end

		local wp = {
			vector(move_pos.x, 0, fo.Position.z),
			move_pos
		}

		wp_util.move(fo, wp, 6, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true, last_direction = end_direction })
	end

	move_target_side(leader, demon_governor_boss, vector(0, 0, 0.5))
	move_target_side(demon_engineer, demon_governor_boss, vector(0, 0, -0.5))

	--메라 포커스 0.5초만에 리리스에게로 이동.

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 1.16)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 1.16)
	camera_util.move(demon_governor_boss.Position, 1.16)

	--리리스 twohand_attack4 실행.
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_queen, self, { name = 'twohand_attack4', loop = false, count = 1 })
	wait_for_sec(0.36)

	wp_util.move(demon_queen, demon_queen.Position + vector(0, 0, 3.5), nil, 0.8)
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	--땅 찍는 순간 카메라 쉐이크 0.3초, 세기 0.1
	--카메라 사이즈 0.3초만에 사이즈4로.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_06')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_queen_hand_01')
	local ceo_effect_proj = self.get_fx_cwp_demonceo_proj():Instantiate(demon_governor_boss.Position + vector(-3, 0.5, 3))
	ceo_effect_proj.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2
	ceo_effect_proj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 45, 0)
	pooled_object_util.move_async(ceo_effect_proj,
			ceo_effect_proj.transform.localPosition + vector(2, 0, -2), 0.3)

	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_governor_boss, self, 'scream')
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_governor_boss, self, { name = 'scream', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_queen_squize_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('04_dialogue_morian_10')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)
	local ceo_effect_claw = self.get_fx_cwp_demonceo_claw():Instantiate(demon_governor_boss.Position + vector(3, 0.5, -3))
	ceo_effect_claw.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 45, 0)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_queen_hand_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_queen, self, { name = 'demon_ceo/attack3', loop = false })
	ceo_effect_proj = self.get_fx_cwp_demonceo_proj():Instantiate(demon_governor_boss.Position + vector(3, 0.5, 3))
	ceo_effect_proj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 135, 0)
	ceo_effect_proj.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2
	pooled_object_util.move_async(ceo_effect_proj,
			ceo_effect_proj.transform.localPosition + vector(-2, 0, -2), 0.3)

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_queen_squize_01')
	ceo_effect_claw = self.get_fx_cwp_demonceo_claw():Instantiate(demon_governor_boss.Position + vector(-3, 0.5, -3))
	ceo_effect_claw.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 135, 0)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.move_async(demon_queen.Position, 0.4)

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_queen_hand_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_queen_cast_01')
	local ceo_effect_fire = self.get_fx_m_demonceo_support_fire():Instantiate(demon_governor_boss.Position)
	ceo_effect_fire.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2

	-- 점프
	time_util.mod('action_slow', 0.2)
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_queen, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_queen, self, 'get')
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(demon_queen, 'Top Effects', 100)
	character_util.move_to(demon_queen, demon_queen.Position + vector(0, 3, 0), 0.25)
	camera_util.move(demon_queen.Position + vector(0, 0, 3), 0.25)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4, 0.25)

	local time_passed = 0
	local time_tick = 0.05
	local index = 1
	local dir = { 'right', 'down', 'left', 'up', 'right' }

	while index <= #dir do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= time_tick then
			character_util.set_direction(demon_queen, dir[index])
			index = index + 1
			time_passed = 0
		end

		demon_queen.SpineController.ShadowTransform.position = vector(demon_queen.Position.x, 0, demon_queen.Position.z)
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.05)

	time_util.unmod('action_slow')

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 0.2)
	character_util.move_to(demon_queen, demon_queen.Position + vector(0, -3, 0), 0.2)
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_queen, self, { name = 'walk4legs', loop = false, scale = 999 })
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_queen, self, 'sleep_deep')
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	character_util.set_sorting_layer(demon_queen, 'Default', 0)
	self.get_fx_last_hit():Instantiate(demon_queen.Position)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_queen_squize_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_governor_boss, self, 'groggy')
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_governor_boss, self,
			{ name = 'groggy', loop = false, next_anim = 'groggy_loop', sfx_name = '03_mech_stomp_01' })
	wait_for_sec(1.1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_governor_boss, self, 'groggy2')

	character_util.add_color(demon_governor_boss, demon_governor_boss.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	start_coroutine(function()
		character_util.set_position(demon_governor, demon_governor_boss.Position)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(demon_governor, 1, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_color(demon_governor, demon_governor.Name, 1)
	end)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_grass_slide_01')
	self.dissolver:set_dissolve_material(demon_governor_boss, false)
	coroutine_util.while_each_frame(2, function(progress)
		self.dissolver:set_dissolve_progress(demon_governor_boss, progress)
	end)

	character_util.set_active_state(demon_governor_boss, 'disabled')
	self.dissolver:remove_dissolve_material(demon_governor_boss)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	local battle_gate_count = 5
	for i = 1, battle_gate_count do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('s26_boss_battle_gate_' .. i, false))
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

	local voice_language = '04_dialogue_morian_04'

	if music_player.CurrentVoiceLanguage ~= 'ko' then
		return voice_language .. '_' .. music_player.CurrentVoiceLanguage
	end

	return voice_language
end

return local_class

			[labose_creature_prefix .. 11] = 'cw_labose_creature_npc'
		},
		get = function(this, index)
			return this.container[this.pre_fix .. index]
		end,
		load_async = function(this)
			if this.container ~= nil then
				return
			end

			this.container = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(this.specs)

			this.count = table_util.get_size(this.container)
		end,
		dispose = function(this)
			if this.container == nil then
				return
			end

			load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(this.container)

			this.container = nil
			this.count = 0
		end,
	}


	-- marker
	self.get_saul_marker = function(line, number)
		return field:GetMarker('s25_saul_' .. line .. '_pos_' .. number)
	end

	self.get_demon_marker = function(number)
		return field:GetMarker('s25_demon_' .. number)
	end

	-- fx
	self.get_fx_hit = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	end

	self.get_fx_last_hit = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
	end

	self.get_fx_event_erina_dash = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_erina_dash')
	end

	self.get_fx_event_erina_slash_hit = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_erina_slash_hit')
	end

	self.get_fx_aura_hit_loop = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Aura_Hit_Loop')
	end

	self.get_fx_lilithtower_virus_death_explosion = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lilithtower_virus_death_explosion')
	end

	self.get_fx_cw_black_liquid = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_black_liquid')
	end

	self.get_fx_cw_stage5_blackdust_screen_fx = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_stage5_blackdust_screen_fx')
	end

	self.fx_black_liquids = nil

	self.res_holder = nil

	self.world_map_prefab = nil

	self.world_map_controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_fx_hit()
	self.get_fx_last_hit()
	self.get_fx_event_erina_dash()
	self.get_fx_event_erina_slash_hit()
	self.get_fx_lilithtower_virus_death_explosion()
	self.get_fx_cw_black_liquid()
	self.get_fx_cw_stage5_blackdust_screen_fx()
	self.saul_soldier_npc:load_async()
	self.labose_creature_npc:load_async()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.fx_black_liquids = {}

	self:npc_setting()

	self.util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/CivilWar/Common/Util')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.util:start_scene(self.battle_after_event, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.util = nil

	if self.fx_black_liquids ~= nil then
		for _, effect in pairs(self.fx_black_liquids) do
			effect:Dispose()
			effect = nil
		end

		self.fx_black_liquids = nil
	end

	self.saul_soldier_npc:dispose()
	self.labose_creature_npc:dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.saul_soldier_npc:dispose()
	self.labose_creature_npc:dispose()

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

	return false

function local_class:npc_setting()
	local dead_setting = function(target)
		scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false, one_shot_sfx = false })
		character_util.add_color(target, target.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
	end

	-- 사울 병사
	local saul_table = { 8, 8, 8, 7 }
	local saul_dead = {
		{ i = 1, j = 1 },
		{ i = 1, j = 2 },
		{ i = 1, j = 3 },
		{ i = 2, j = 1 },
		{ i = 2, j = 2 },
		{ i = 2, j = 3 },
		{ i = 2, j = 7 },
		{ i = 2, j = 8 },
		{ i = 3, j = 8 },
		{ i = 4, j = 7 }
	}
	local saul_air_spin = {
		{ i = 3, j = 1 },
		{ i = 3, j = 2 },
		{ i = 3, j = 3 }
	}

	for i = 1, #saul_table do
		for j = 1, saul_table[i] do
			local saul_soldier = self.get_saul_soldier(i, j)
			local marker = self.get_saul_marker(i, j)

			character_util.set_position(saul_soldier, marker.position)
			character_util.set_direction(saul_soldier, marker.direction)
			scene_util.set_emotion(saul_soldier, self, 'attack')
			scene_util.set_anim(saul_soldier, self, { name = 'dagger_idle', one_shot_sfx = false })

			for _, check in pairs(saul_dead) do
				if i == check.i and j == check.j then
					dead_setting(saul_soldier)
					break
				end
			end

			for _, check in pairs(saul_air_spin) do
				if i == check.i and j == check.j then
					character_util.set_active_state(saul_soldier, 'disabled')
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- 마계 병사
	local demon_count = 10
	local demon_dead = { 1, 2, 5, 10 }

	for i = 1, demon_count do
		local demon_soldier = self.get_demon_soldier(i)
		local marker = self.get_demon_marker(i)

		character_util.set_position(demon_soldier, marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(demon_soldier, marker.direction)
		scene_util.set_emotion(demon_soldier, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(demon_soldier, self, { name = 'dagger_idle', one_shot_sfx = false })

		for _, check in pairs(demon_dead) do
			if i == check then
				dead_setting(demon_soldier)
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 모리안과의 전투 끝난 후 연출
function local_class:battle_after_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local demon_engineer = self.get_demon_engineer()
	local demon_governor = self.get_demon_governor()
	local demon_queen = self.get_demon_queen()
	local legendary_hero = self.get_legendary_hero()
	local kaden = get_character('kaden_hero')

	local saul_soldiers = {}

	for i = 1, self.saul_soldier_npc.count do
		table.insert(saul_soldiers, self.saul_soldier_npc:get(i))
	end

	local camera_pos = {
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s27_camera_pos_1'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s27_camera_pos_2'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s27_camera_pos_3'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s27_camera_pos_4'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s27_camera_pos_5')
	}

	character_util.add_color(kaden, kaden.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)

	--비네트, 에리나, 리리스, 가디언 모두 up 바라보고 있는 상태.
	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(
			{ leader, demon_engineer, demon_governor, demon_queen, legendary_hero })

	character_util.set_position_from_marker(leader, 's27_knight_pos_1')
	character_util.set_position_from_marker(demon_engineer, 's27_demon_engineer_pos_1')
	character_util.set_position_from_marker(demon_governor, 's27_demon_governor_pos_1')
	character_util.set_position_from_marker(demon_queen, 's27_demon_queen_pos_1')
	character_util.set_position_from_marker(legendary_hero, 's27_legendary_hero_pos_1')
	--모리안 down, attack, idle
	scene_util.set_direction(demon_governor, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_governor, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_governor, self, 'prostrate')

	--카메라 포커스는 모리안에게.
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos[1], 0)

	local wind_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_04', loop = true })

	--다시 1초에 걸쳐 검게 페이드인이 완전히 끝나면 대사 진행.
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--페이드인과 동시에 1초에 걸쳐 카메라 연두색 마름모 지점으로 이동.
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos[2], 1)

	--리리스(up, cast2) : 모리안, 너는 졌어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self, nil,
			'cast2',
			nil,
			'cw_main_s27_1')

	--리리스(up, release 2회) : 당장 사울의 군세를 멈춰!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self, nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			nil,
			'cw_main_s27_2')

	--모리안 (down, idle, shake 0.3초) : 흐흐흐…
	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 모리안에게로 이동.
	--카메라 이동 + 모리안 대사 다 끝나야 다음 대사 진행.
	wait_all_lua(
			{
				camera_util.move_async, demon_governor.Position, 1
			},
			function()
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
				scene_util.set_direction(demon_queen, 'up')
				scene_util.shake(demon_governor, 0.02, 0.3)
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_governor, self, nil,
						nil,
						{ name = 'doyagao', keep = true },
						'cw_main_s27_4')
			end
	)

	--카메라 쉐이크 0.3초, 세기 0.15
	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.3)
	--모리안(down, smile, bomb_idle, 샤우트 말풍선, 크기 2배) : 흐하하하하하하하!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(demon_governor, self, nil,
			nil,
			'smile',
			{ key = 'cw_main_s27_5', scale = 2, skip = true })

	--모리안(idle, idle) : 그래… 나는 더 싸울 수 없어.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(demon_governor, 'cw_main_s27_9')

	--모리안(attack) : 하지만 그게 무슨 상관이지?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_governor, self, nil,
			nil,
			'attack',
			'cw_main_s27_10')

	--모리안(down, idle) : 리리스의 패배는 마계의 패배겠지만…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_governor, self, nil,
			nil,
			'idle',
			'cw_main_s27_11')

	--0.5초 대기
	--모리안 down, tired, idle로 0.3초 대기
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_governor, self, 'tired')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--모리안 down, sleep_deep, idle로 0.3초 대기.
	scene_util.set_emotion(demon_governor, self, 'sleep_deep')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--모리안(sleep_deep, idle, shake 0.3초) : 나의 패배는 사울의 패배가 아니야.
	--카메라 사이즈 1초에 걸쳐서 0.85배로 줌인.
	--카메라 줌인 + 모리안 대사 다 끝나야 다음 대사 진행.
	wait_all_lua(
			{
				camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async, 3.4, 1
			},
			function()
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
				scene_util.shake(demon_governor, 0.02, 0.3)
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_governor, self, nil,
						{ name = 'walk4legs', loop = false, mix_duration = 0.3, keep = true },
						{ name = 'sleep_deep', keep = true },
						'cw_main_s27_12')
			end
	)

	--모리안(left, sleep_deep) : 사울은 나 없이도 나아갈 거다.
	--카메라 사이즈 1초에 걸쳐서 0.7배로 줌인.
	--카메라 줌인 + 모리안 대사 다 끝나야 다음 대사 진행.
	character_util.shake(demon_governor, 0.02, 0.3)
	wait_all_lua(
			{
				camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async, 2.8, 1
			},
			{
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action, demon_governor, self, nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				'cw_main_s27_13'
			}
	)

	--0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--모리안 right, sleep_deep, idle로 mixduration 0.3초.
	scene_util.set_anim(demon_governor, self, { name = 'idle', mix_duration = 0.3 })
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--모리안 down으로 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(demon_governor, 'down')
	--0.5초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--모리안(down, attack, bomb_idle, jump 2회) : 마계를 지키기 위하여!!
	--카메라 쉐이크 0.3초, 세기 0.1
	--카메라 원래 사이즈로 0.3초만에 복귀.

			'cw_main_s27_14')

	)

	start_coroutine(self.intro_scene, self)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))

	self.background_controller = nil

	if self.player_looping_system ~= nil and self.player_looping_system:is_activated() then
		self.player_looping_system:exit()
	end

	self.throne_scene_util = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.typing_text_obj) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.typing_text_obj)

	end

		self.amb_2_sfx = nil

		play_knight_voice('cw_main_s28_1_3')
		coroutine.yield(self.typing_text:SetTypedText(get_typing_text_param('cw_main_s28_1_3')))

		stop_knight_voice()

		text_typing_end = true

	local end_alpha = 0

			coroutine.yield(nil)

	start_coroutine(function()
		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = 0.2
		while time_passed <= duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

			local rotate_progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(1, progress)
			local rotate_num = 1
			local cur_rotation = rotate_progress * 945 * rotate_num

			drop_item_champion_sword.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
					unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.forward)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end)

	start_coroutine(function()
		-- 챔피언 소드 튀어나오기 시작할 떄 1회 재생

			{
				sfx_name = '01_event_lt_02', loop = false, type_priority = 'default'
			}
	)
	--    카메라 shake(0.15, 3)
	camera_util.shake(0.15, 3)
	--    카메라 줌인(1.8, 3)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(1.8, 3)

	--    챔피언소드 중심에서 0.25초에 한번씩 FX_shockwave 출력
	local shocked_champion_sword = true

	start_coroutine(function()
		local init_delay_time = 0.5

		while shocked_champion_sword do
			self.fx:shockwave():Instantiate(drop_item_champion_sword.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.25))

			wait_for_sec(init_delay_time)

			if init_delay_time > 0.01 then
				init_delay_time = init_delay_time * 0.84
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end)

	-- 카메라 3초간 위로 1칸 이동
	-- ignorecameragrids 해서 제대로 검 중앙을 바라보도록 처리
	camera_util.move(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(0, 0, 1), 3, { ignorecameragrids = true })


	-- 3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(3)

	-- 1프레임만에 화면 검은색으로 페이드 아웃
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if event_lt_sfx ~= nil then
		event_lt_sfx:Stop()
		event_lt_sfx = nil
	end

	self.cw_util:set_directinal_light('main_field_light')

	-- 공주 떨림 멈춤
	character_util.stop_shake(princess)
	shocked_champion_sword = false

	drop_item_champion_sword:ConsumeComplete()

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.1)

	-- 1.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1.5)
end

function local_class:wait_entering_loop()
	self.player_looping_system = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/CivilWar/Common/Stage6/PlayerLoopingSystem')

	local loop_start_x = self.player_looping_system.looping_info.min_x
	local knight = self.get_knight()

	-- 루프 공간 진입 전까지 대기
	while not self.controller.stage_ended and knight.Position.x < loop_start_x do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if self.controller.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	-- 길 앞/뒤 모두 무한루프 처리
	self.player_looping_system:enter()

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.in_loop

	-- 루프 공간 안에 진입 후 대화 이벤트 시작. 컨트롤 빼앗지 않음.
	start_coroutine(self.talk_with_demon_queen, self)
end

	--리리스(sleep_deep): 400년 전 그 사건 때…

				key = 'cw_main_s28_2_2',

	--x좌표는 플레이어 따라감
	--z좌표는 고정 수치
	--줌아웃

	--리리스(attack): …저 꽃을 실제로 보니 이제서야 아귀가 맞는 것 같군.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')

			{
				key = 'cw_main_s28_2_4',
				force_sfx = true,
				skip = false
			})

	if self.controller.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	--리리스(sleep_deep): 케이든… 그렇게 사라져 버려 놓고선…

			{
				key = 'cw_main_s28_2_5',
				force_sfx = true,
				skip = false
			})

	if self.controller.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	--리리스(tired): 이제서야 돌아왔다고? 몇백년만에? 대체 왜?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self, nil, nil, 'tired',
			{
				key = 'cw_main_s28_2_6',
				force_sfx = true,
				skip = false
			})

	if self.controller.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	--리리스(attack): 그가 정말 저 흉측한 걸 만들려고 모리안을 이용해 이 전쟁을 일으킨 거라면…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self, nil, nil, 'attack',
			{
				key = 'cw_main_s28_2_7',

	local road_scene_camera_pos = self.get_road_scene_camera_pos()

	-- 0.5초간 정렬

	-- 가디언
	-- x값 현재 위치 +2
	-- z값 길 중앙

	local move_key = 'last_party_move_pos'
	local last_scene_knight_pos = knight.Position + vector(2, 0, 0)
	last_scene_knight_pos.z = road_scene_camera_pos.z

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight,
			last_scene_knight_pos,
			nil,
			0.5,
			self, move_key,
			{ last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(demon_queen,
			last_scene_knight_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			nil,

function local_class:control_camera_fov(sizes)
	local start_fov = lua_helper.get_value(sizes, 'start', self.original_fov)
	local end_fov = lua_helper.get_value(sizes, 'target', self.original_fov)
	local size_duration = lua_helper.get_value(sizes, 'duration', 0)
	local stage_camera_cam = stage_camera.Transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
	local timer = 0

	while timer < size_duration do
		local progress = timer / size_duration

		stage_camera_cam.fieldOfView = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_fov, end_fov, progress)

		coroutine.yield()

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.cur_fov = end_fov
end

			start_coroutine(self.play_attack_on_labose_event, self)

	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.meet_the_maiden then
