function local_class:set_pre_npc_data(section_state)
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[section_state]

	for i = 1, #pre_npc_data do
		local npc = get_character(pre_npc_data[i].name)

		if pre_npc_data[i].remove_lv_ui ~= nil and pre_npc_data[i].remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')

		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if pre_npc_data[i].pos ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(npc, pre_npc_data[i].pos)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, pre_npc_data[i].dir, false)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].emo ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, pre_npc_data[i].emo)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].anim ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = pre_npc_data[i].anim })
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].keep_shake ~= nil and pre_npc_data[i].keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, pre_npc_data[i].shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', pre_npc_data[i].sorting_layer)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].tint_color then
			character_util.add_fade_color(npc, pre_npc_data[i].tint_color_key,
					pre_npc_data[i].tint_color, 1, 0)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, 'pre_setting', pre_npc_data[i].scale)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_plague_doctor_face_state(face_off)
	local plague_doctor = self.get_plague_doctor()
	local plague_doctor_mask_off = self.get_plague_doctor_maskoff()

	if face_off then
		-- 가면을 벗은 역병의사로 NPC 변경. 역병의사(idle, unique/mask_off)
		-- 현재 NPC 제작중. 임시로 별도 연출 없이 변경 후 1초 대기
		local backup_plague_doctor_pos = plague_doctor.Position
		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(plague_doctor_mask_off, 'unique/mask_off')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_event_cw_03')

		scene_util.set_anim(plague_doctor_mask_off, self, { name = 'unique/mask_off', count = 1 })

		wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.05)

		character_util.set_anim_time_scale(plague_doctor_mask_off, 0)

		plague_doctor_mask_off.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.001)

		character_util.set_position(plague_doctor, vector(999, 0, 999))

		character_util.set_position(plague_doctor_mask_off, backup_plague_doctor_pos)

		character_util.set_anim_time_scale(plague_doctor_mask_off, 1)
	else
		local backup_plague_doctor_mask_off_pos = plague_doctor_mask_off.Position
		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(plague_doctor_mask_off, 'unique/mask_off')

		scene_util.set_direction(plague_doctor, 'left', nil)

		plague_doctor.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.001)

		scene_util.set_anim_async(plague_doctor_mask_off, self, { name = 'unique/mask_on', count = 1 })

		character_util.set_position(plague_doctor_mask_off, vector(999, 0, 999))

		character_util.set_position(plague_doctor, backup_plague_doctor_mask_off_pos)
	end
end

function local_class:play_meet_plague_doctor_event()
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local plague_doctor_mask_off = self.get_plague_doctor_maskoff()
	local plague_doctor = self.get_plague_doctor()
	local demon_queen = self.get_demon_queen()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	local move_key = 'party_align_1'

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.meet_plague_doctor

	-- 가디언(attack, idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')

	-- 리리스(attack, idle, jump 1회): notice 이모티콘 출력
	character_util.normal_jump(demon_queen)
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(demon_queen, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			'notice')

	-- 가디언 파티 1초간 동시에 이미지와 같이 정렬. 카메라 1초간 역병의사와 리리스 가운데 지점으로 이동
	camera_util.move(self.get_between_two_char_pos(), 1)

	local party_align_pos_list = {
		self.get_knight_pos(2, 1),
		self.get_demon_queen_pos(2, 1),
	}

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(user_party[i],
				party_align_pos_list[i+1],
				nil,
				1,
				self, move_key)
	end

	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	-- 이동 직후 파티 (left, attack, idle) (혹시 모를 상황 대비해 연출 방어용)
	scene_util.set_direction(demon_queen, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)

	-- 0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 역병의사(left, idle, idle): …이 앞으론 지나갈 수 없다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(plague_doctor, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_1', dialogue_sfx_name = '03_dialogue_04', skip = true })

	-- 역병의사(left, idle, idle): 지금 당장 이곳을…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(plague_doctor, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_2', dialogue_sfx_name = '03_dialogue_04', skip = true })

	-- 리리스(left, attack, bomb_idle): 이건 또 무슨 재미없는 장난이지?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_3', skip = true })

	-- 리리스(left, attack, release): 그런 가면 따위로 네 정체를 숨길 수 있다고 생각한거야?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_4', skip = true })

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 카메라 줌인 (3, 0.1)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0.1)

	-- 카메라 shake (0.3, 0.2)
	camera_util.shake(0.25, 0.2)

	-- 리리스(left, attack, idle): 케이든.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_5', skip = true })

	--카메라 1초간 역병의사에게로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(plague_doctor.Position, 1)

	--0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 역병의사(left, idle, idle): silence 이모티콘 출력
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(plague_doctor, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'silence')

	-- 역병의사(right, idle, idle) 0.5초 대기
	scene_util.set_direction(plague_doctor, 'right', '01_walk_04')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 역병의사(right, idle, idle): …역시 알아보시는 군요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(plague_doctor, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_6', dialogue_sfx_name = '03_dialogue_04', skip = true })

	-- 가면을 벗은 역병의사로 NPC 변경. 역병의사(idle, unique/mask_off)
	self:change_plague_doctor_face_state(true)

	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(plague_doctor_mask_off, 'unique/mask_off')

	wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.8)

	--    1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 케이든 대사와 함께 bgm 페이드인, 믹스 0초,
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
			{ name = 'ondemand/v2_75_civilwar/audio:bgm_civilwar_doctor', state = 'event', mix = 0 })

	-- 역병의사(right, idle, idle): 오랜만입니다… 리리스.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(plague_doctor_mask_off, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_7', skip = true })

	-- 카메라 줌아웃과 함께 bgm 볼륨 0.5로 조절
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.5, 1)

	-- 카메라 2초간 사이즈 4로 원복. 동시에 2초간 맵 중앙으로 이동.
	camera_util.resize_to_default(2)

	camera_util.move_async(self.get_between_two_char_pos(), 2)

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 리리스(left, attack, idle): 안부 인사 따위는 집어 치워.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_8', skip = true })

	-- 리리스(left, attack, idle, shake 지속): 넌… 대체 뭘 하려는 거야.
	character_util.shake(demon_queen, 0.02, 99999)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_9', skip = true })

	-- 카메라 shake(0.3, 0.2)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)

	-- 리리스(left, attack, shoot, shake 중지, shout, 크기 1.3): 뭘 위해서 이딴 짓을 벌이는 거야!
	character_util.stop_shake(demon_queen)
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(demon_queen, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'shoot', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_negative_01' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_10', scale = 1.3, skip = true })

	-- 리리스(left, attack, bomb_idle): 전쟁을 일으키고… 수많은 사람들의 목숨을 바쳐서 얻은게 고작 저 꽃이야?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_11', skip = true })

	-- 리리스(left, attack, idle)

	-- 역병의사(right, sleep_deep, idle): silence 이모티콘 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(plague_doctor_mask_off, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			'silence')

	-- 역병의사(right, idle, idle)

	-- 카메라 shake(0.2, 0.1)
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)

	-- 리리스(left, attack, shoot, shout, 크기 1.2): 뭐라고 변명이라도 좀 해 봐!
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(demon_queen, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'shoot', one_shot_sfx = '01_count_01' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_12', scale = 1.2, skip = true })

	-- 리리스(left, tired, release): 나는… 나는 그 때의 약속을 위해 계속해서 마계를 지켜 왔는데…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release' },
			{ name = 'tired' },
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_13', skip = true })

	-- 리리스(left, tired, cast): 어째서 네가…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cast' },
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_14', skip = true })

	-- 리리스(left, tired, idle)

	-- 역병의사(right, sleep_deep, idle): …저도 그 때의 약속을 지키고 있는 겁니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(plague_doctor_mask_off, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_15', skip = true })

	-- 역병의사(right, idle, nod 2회): 세계를. 다가올 멸망으로부터. 구하자.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(plague_doctor_mask_off, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2, one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_ready_01' },
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_16', skip = true })

	-- 역병의사(right, idle, idle)

	-- 리리스(left, attack, bomb_idle): …이게? 나랑 모리안을 이용해서 마계의 수많은 사람들을 죽여놓고?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_17', skip = true })

	-- 리리스(left, attack, idle)

	-- 역병의사(right, idle, cross_arm): 이 전쟁은 제가 일으킨 게 아닙니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(plague_doctor_mask_off, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cross_arm' },

function local_class:create_labose_wall()
	local labose_wall = nil

	local effect_pos = unity_class.vector3.one

	-- 맵 중앙에 세로선으로 fx_coop_env_bugs_flying_nontop 생성. 해당 위치에 투명 오브젝트 깔아서 지나가지 못하게 함
	for i = 1, 10 do
		labose_wall = self.get_labose_invisible_wall(i)
		effect_pos = labose_wall.Position

		table.insert(self.labose_wall_fx_list, self.fx.labose_wall():Instantiate(effect_pos))
	end
end

	wp_util.move_async(knight,
			knight.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0),
			nil,
			0.5,
			{ locked_dir = 'left' })

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 가디언(attack, nod 1회)
	scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })

	-- 가디언(attack, run, jump 1회) 1초 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_evolution_01')
	self.dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{
				sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'default'
			}
	)

	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'run' })
	character_util.normal_jump_async(knight)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 카메라 줌인 (3.5, 0.1)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(self.cur_camera_size_in_qte, 0.1)

	-- 가디언 0.1초간 왼쪽으로 1칸 달려감(attack, run)
	character_util.move_to_async(knight,
			knight.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			0.1,
			nil,
			false,
			false)

	-- 카메라 shake(0.03, 지속)
	camera_util.shake(0.03, 99999, true, 'qte_base_shake')

	-- 연타 QTE 이벤트
	-- 터치 1번마다 다음 처리
	-- 가디언 왼쪽으로 0.04 위치 이동
	-- 카메라 줌인 (현재값 -0.02, 0)
	-- 카메라 shake(0.1, 0.1)
	-- 감염도 +2
	-- 터치 횟수가 다음 숫자가 됐을 때 추가로 다음 처리
	-- 공통
	-- 카메라 줌인 (현재값 -0.5)
	-- 카메라 shake(0.3, 0.1)
	-- 15회: 가디언(tired, run)
	-- 30회: 가디언(damaged, run) / 가장자리 붉게 처리
	-- 45회: QTE 이벤트 중지

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	--QTE 클릭 이벤트 45회 / 실패 처리 없음. / 성공하면 다음 진행.
	qte_util.tap(45, nil, false)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	-- 가디언 약하게 shake 지속
	character_util.shake(knight, 0.01, 99999)
	-- 지속되던 카메라 shake 중지
	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	-- 카메라 줌아웃 (4, 0.3)
	-- 카메라 shake(0.3, 0.2)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4, 0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)

	-- 달리기 sfx 중지
	if self.dash_sfx ~= nil then
		self.dash_sfx:Stop()
		self.dash_sfx = nil
	end

	-- 가디언 통과 성공함과 동시에 재생, bgm 뮤트, 믹스 0
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fly_explosion_02')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })

	-- 위와 함께 루프 사운드 전환, 믹스 디폴트
	if self.ambi_1_sfx ~= nil then
		self.ambi_1_sfx:Stop()
		self.ambi_1_sfx = nil
	end

	self.ambi_1_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_bugs_loop_03', loop = true,
		play_pos = self.get_labose_wall_center_pos(), max_distance = 8
	})

	-- 가디언 0.5초간 왼쪽으로 1칸 이동
	-- 가디언(damaged, prostrate, jump 1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.jump(knight, 0.5, 0.3)
	character_util.move_to_async(knight,
			knight.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0),
			0.3,
			nil,
			false,
			false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.passes_through_wall

	if self.passes_through_wall_reset_pos == nil then
		self.passes_through_wall_reset_pos = knight.Position
	end

	self:drone_drop_the_box()

	-- 컨트롤 회복. 가디언 동작이 제한된다
	-- damaged, walk4legs 유지. 애니메이션 scale 0.5
	-- 공격 / 달리기 불가
	-- 이동속도 1(25%)
	-- LilithTowerMainSection4 참고
	buff_manager:AddBuff(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, user_party.Leader, 'speed_down_persistent', 90, false, false)
	scene_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, self, { name = 'walk4legs', scale = 0.5 })

	self:restrict_action_control()

	-- 라보스 벽 이벤트용 투명 오브젝트 상호작용 불가능하게 수정
	for i = 1, 10 do
		local labose_wall = self.get_labose_invisible_wall(i)

		labose_wall.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	self.dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_04', parent = user_party.Leader, type_priority = 'event', loop = true })

	self.is_interacted = false
end

function local_class:restrict_action_control()
	local player_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	player_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super)
	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(player_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	field_ui_manager:Show()

	-- 버튼 비활성화
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton)
end

function local_class:reset_action_control()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:qte_touch_event()
	local knight = self.get_knight()

	if self.qte_tap_cur_count == self.qte_step.emo_tired then
		-- 15회: 가디언(tired, run)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'tired')
		-- 카메라 줌인 (현재값 -0.5)
		self.cur_camera_size_in_qte = self.cur_camera_size_in_qte - 0.5
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(self.cur_camera_size_in_qte, 0)
		-- 카메라 shake(0.3, 0.1)
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.1, true, 'qte_15_shake')

		-- 루프 사운드 전환
		if self.ambi_1_sfx ~= nil then
			self.ambi_1_sfx:Stop()
			self.ambi_1_sfx = nil
		end

		self.ambi_1_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_bugs_loop_01', loop = true,
			play_pos = self.get_labose_wall_center_pos(), max_distance = 5
		})

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_bugs_01')

	elseif self.qte_tap_cur_count == self.qte_step.emo_damage_n_red_color then
		-- 30회: 가디언(damaged, run) / 가장자리 붉게 처리
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'damaged')
		character_util.add_fade_color(knight, knight.Name .. '_red', unity_class.color.red, 0.5, 0.3)
		-- 카메라 줌인 (현재값 -0.5)
		self.cur_camera_size_in_qte = self.cur_camera_size_in_qte - 0.5
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(self.cur_camera_size_in_qte, 0)
		-- 카메라 shake(0.3, 0.1)
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.1, true, 'qte_30_shake')

		-- 루프 사운드 전환
		if self.ambi_1_sfx ~= nil then
			self.ambi_1_sfx:Stop()
			self.ambi_1_sfx = nil
		end

		self.ambi_1_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_bugs_loop_04', loop = true,
			play_pos = self.get_labose_wall_center_pos(), max_distance = 5
		})

		-- 01_hit_bugs_01 + 03_vignette_01
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_bugs_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_vignette_01')

		-- 30회 터치 판정 시 bgm 볼륨 1로 전환
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1, 1)
	else
		-- 카메라 줌인 (현재값 -0.02, 0)
		self.cur_camera_size_in_qte = self.cur_camera_size_in_qte - 0.02
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(self.cur_camera_size_in_qte, 0)
		-- 카메라 shake(0.1, 0.1)
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.1, true, 'qte_common_tap_shake')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fly_hit_01')
	end

	-- 가디언 왼쪽으로 0.02 위치 이동
	character_util.set_position(knight, knight.Position + vector(-0.04, 0, 0))
end

-- 기사, walk4legs애니로 기어가는 연출 중 다음 그리드로 넘어갈 시 재생한 이벤트 후 특정 지점으로 리셋
function local_class:knight_crawl_to_next_area()
	local knight = self.get_knight()

	if self.dash_sfx ~= nil then
		self.dash_sfx:Stop()
		self.dash_sfx = nil
	end
	if self.drone_sfx ~= nil then
		self.drone_sfx:FadeOut(2)
	end

	-- 01_impact_02 + 01_impact_07
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_07')

	-- 가디언(damaged, dead1)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'dead1', sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', loop = false })
	-- 1초간 가디언 몸 검은색 틴트 처리
	character_util.add_fade_color(knight, knight.Name .. '_black', unity_class.color.black, 1, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 1초간 페이드 아웃
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 해당 지점부터 재시작
	character_util.remove_fade_color(knight, knight.Name .. '_black', 0)

	if self.passes_through_wall_reset_pos ~= nil then
		character_util.set_position(knight, self.passes_through_wall_reset_pos)
		scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.1)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'walk4legs', scale = 0.5 })

	-- loop sfx 다시 재생
	self.dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{
				sfx_name = '01_dash_04', loop = true, type_priority = 'default'
			}
	)

	self.drone_sfx = nil
	self.drone_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{
				sfx_name = '01_propeller_03', loop = true, type_priority = 'default'
			}
	)

	-- 1초간 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self:restrict_action_control()

	self.is_interacted = false
end

function local_class:drone_drop_the_box()
	local drone = self.get_drone()
	local demon_queen = self.get_demon_queen()

	character_util.set_active_state(drone, 'enabled')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 드론이 날아와 상자를 떨어뜨려준다
	local box_pos = self.get_drone_box_pos() + vector(0, 3, 4.5)
	local drone_start_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos(
			'right', box_pos,
			2)

	character_util.set_position(drone, drone_start_pos, true)
	scene_util.set_direction(drone, 'left', false)

	local demon_queen_upper_pos = demon_queen.Position + vector(0, 2, 0)

	camera_util.move_async(demon_queen_upper_pos, 1)

	self.drone_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{
				sfx_name = '01_propeller_03', loop = true, type_priority = 'default'
			}
	)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')

	-- 오른쪽에서 드론이 날아와 리리스 위에서 정지
	character_util.move_to_async(drone,
			demon_queen_upper_pos,
			2,
			nil,
			false,
			false)

	-- 드론(right, idle, idle) 대사 출력
	-- 크로셀 UI 사용해서 대사 출력
	-- 포트레이트는 비네트

	camera_util.move_async(drone.Position, 0.01, {end_target = drone})

	-- 비네트: 리리스! 리리스! 정신 차려!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(drone, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_54', skip = true })

	-- 비네트: 이대로 저 꽃이 죽음을 더 집어삼키면 무슨 괴물이 튀어나올지 모른다고!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(drone, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_55', skip = true })

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 비네트: 아, 젠장… 완전 정신을 놨네…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(drone, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_56', skip = true })

	local throw_box_pos = self.get_drone_box_pos() + vector(0, 2, 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')

	scene_util.set_direction(drone, 'left', false)

	character_util.move_to_async(drone,
			throw_box_pos,
			1.5,
			nil,
			false,
			false)

	camera_util.move_async(drone.Position, 0.01)

	scene_util.set_direction(drone, 'right', false)

	character_util.move_to_async(drone,
			drone.Position + vector(0, -1.5, 0),
			0.5,
			nil,
			false,
			false)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	-- 박스 해당 위치에 놓기
	self.fx.appear_smoke():Instantiate(self.get_drone_box_pos())
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')

	local drone_nano_box = self.get_drone_nano_box()

	drone_nano_box.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	drone_nano_box.Position = self.get_drone_box_pos()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.move_to_async(drone,
			drone.Position + vector(0, 1.5, 0),
			0.5,
			nil,
			false,
			false)

	-- 비네트: $name! 이 상자를 먹어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(drone, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_57', skip = true })

	-- 도착 위치는 맵 좌측에서 ¼ 지점(일단 대략적인 위치로 작업 진행)
	-- 상자에 퀘스트 마커
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.get_drone_box_pos() },
	})

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
end

function local_class:interact_drone_box()
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local demon_queen = self.get_demon_queen()
	local drone = self.get_drone()

	if self.dash_sfx ~= nil then
		self.dash_sfx:Stop()
		self.dash_sfx = nil
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_maam_healing_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	character_util.remove_fade_color(knight, knight.Name .. '_red', 1)

	local heal_percent = 15
	local max_hp = knight.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
	heal_info.heal = math.floor(max_hp * heal_percent / 100)
	heal_info.isRevive = false
	heal_info.sender = knight
	heal_info.target = knight

	local cmd = CS.Oak.HealCommand.Create(heal_info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(heal_info.Owner, cmd)

	self.fx.appear_smoke():Instantiate(self.get_drone_box_pos())

	local drone_nano_box = self.get_drone_nano_box()

	drone_nano_box.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	character_util.stop_shake(knight)

	-- 가디언(idle, idle, mario_jump 1회) 끝날때까지 대기
	local look_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(knight)
	character_util.mario_jump_async(knight, look_dir, 0.3, 0.5)

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local knight_align_key = 'knight_align_1'
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, self.get_drone_box_pos() + vector(1, 0, 0), nil, 1,
			self, knight_align_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, knight_align_key)

	-- 드론(right, idle, idle) 대사 출력

	--   크로셀 UI 사용해서 대사 출력
	--   포트레이트는 비네트

	-- 가디언 원상태로 돌아오면 bgm 페이드인, 볼륨 0.5, 믹스 디폴트
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
			{ name = 'ondemand/v2_75_civilwar/audio:bgm_civilwar_doctor', state = 'event', volume = 0.5 })

	-- [demon_engineer]
	-- 비네트: 좋아. 일단 너라도 움직일 수 있어서 다행이야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(drone, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_58', skip = true })

	-- 비네트: 케이든… 그 자식을 상대하려면 아무래도 대비가 필요할 것 같아서 급하게 준비해 봤어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(drone, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_59', skip = true })

	-- 비네트: 이 드론이 녀석의 힘을 억제하는 물질을 배달해 줄거야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(drone, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_60', skip = true })

	-- 비네트: 급하게 만들어서 개수가 얼마 없지만…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(drone, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_61', skip = true })

	-- 비네트: 혼자서라도 조금만 버티고 있어줘. 나도 금방 그쪽으로 갈테니.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(drone, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s30_1_62', skip = true })

	-- 하늘로 날아가는 드론.
	scene_util.set_direction(drone, 'right', false)
	character_util.move_to(drone,
			drone.Position + vector(12, 10, 0),
			1.5,
			nil,
			false,
			false)

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	buff_manager:RemoveBuff(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, user_party.Leader, 'speed_down_persistent')

	character_util.remove_relate_event(demon_queen, self.controller)

	self:reset_action_control()

	self:set_boss_room()

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1, 1)

	if self.drone_sfx ~= nil then
		self.drone_sfx:FadeOut(1)
	end

	self.is_interacted = false
end

function local_class:set_boss_room()
	local plague_doctor = self.get_plague_doctor()

	--이벤트 이전 세팅
	--역병의사 이미지의 위치에 서 있는다. (left, idle, idle)

	-- 역병의사(right, idle, idle): silence 이모티콘 출력

	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(plague_doctor, self,

	-- 역병의사(right, idle, staff_cast): 그래, 그렇게 싸우고 싶다면… 내가 적당한 상대를 붙여주지.

	end

		local resize_impact_duration = 0.1
		local first_resize_duration = 3
		local second_resize_duration = 2
		local third_resize_duration = 2
		local total_duration = first_resize_duration + second_resize_duration + third_resize_duration

		do

			camera_util.shake(0.05, 999, nil, infinite_shake_key)

			--카메라 줌인 (3.7, 0.1) -> (3.2, 2.9)
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(4.3, resize_impact_duration)
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(4.4, first_resize_duration - resize_impact_duration)

			camera_util.cancel_shake()
		end

		--지점 2: 시작 3초 후
		do
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_harpy_explosion_02')

			--카메라 shake (0.25, 0.15) + (0.1, 2)
			camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.15)
			camera_util.shake(0.12, 999, nil, infinite_shake_key)

			--카메라 줌인 (3, 0.1) -> (2.7, 1.9)
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(4.8, resize_impact_duration)
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(5, second_resize_duration - resize_impact_duration)

			camera_util.cancel_shake()
		end

		--지점 3: 시작 5초 후
		do
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_harpy_explosion_02')

			--카메라 shake (0.3, 0.2) + (0.15, 2)
			camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.2)
			camera_util.shake(0.2, 999, nil, infinite_shake_key)

			--카메라 줌인 (2.5, 0.1) -> (2, 1.9)
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(5.7, resize_impact_duration)
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(6, third_resize_duration - resize_impact_duration)

			camera_util.cancel_shake()
		end
	end

	-- fx_cw_labose_energyball_charging가 흩어져 사라질 때
	--다음 동작 수행

	--카메라 shake(0.3, 0.2)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(boss, 0, 0)
	boss.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)

	character_util.set_active_state(boss, 'enabled')

	--boss_symptom(이하 1페이즈 보스) 해당 위치로 이동.
	character_util.set_direction(boss, 'right')
	character_util.set_position(boss, boss_appear_pos, true)

	local appear_aura_effect = self.fx.appear_aura():Instantiate(

			unity_class.quaternion.identity,
			boss.Transform
	)

	scene_util.set_anim(boss, self, 'birth_loop')

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(boss, 1, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	local camera_offset = unity_class.vector3.forward * 2

	do
		local zoom_delay = 0.3
		local stamp_delay = 0.5

		character_util.remove_anim(boss)
		scene_util.set_anim(boss, self, {
			name = 'birth',
			count = 1
		})

		camera_util.move(boss_appear_camera_pos, zoom_delay)
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, zoom_delay)

		local move_duration = stamp_delay - zoom_delay
		local target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(boss.Position)
		local start_pos = boss.Position

		camera_util.move(target_pos + camera_offset, move_duration)
		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(move_duration, function(progress)
			local cur_pos = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress

			character_util.set_position(boss, cur_pos, true)
		end)
	end

	do
		local duration = 0.1

		camera_util.move(boss.Position + camera_offset, duration)
		camera_util.resize_to(5, duration)
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)

	appear_aura_effect:Dispose()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_01')

	do
		local effect = self.fx.tail_smash():Instantiate(boss.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 1.7)

		effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 1.5
	end

	do
		local start_pos = knight.Position
		local move_diff = unity_class.vector3.right * 2

		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'dualsword_idle')

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(0.5, function(progress)
			local move_progress = math.sin(math.pi / 2 * progress)
			local cur_move_diff = move_progress * move_diff

			character_util.set_position(knight, start_pos + cur_move_diff)
		end)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.remove_anim(knight)
	end

	-- blizzard sfx 종료
	if self.ambi_2_sfx ~= nil then
		self.ambi_2_sfx:Stop()
		self.ambi_2_sfx = nil
	end

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
end

return local_class

local section_progress = 30
local local_class = newclass('CivilWarMainSection' .. (section_progress + 1))

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = CivilWarMain @
		Comment = 보스전 페이즈 1 @
		Index = 30 @
		NextSections = 31 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.available_stage_name = 'civilwar_6'

	self.section_state = {
		before_loaded = 1,
		before_battle = 2,
		before_arrow = 3,
		in_arrow = 4,
		before_sword = 5,
		in_sword = 6,
		after_sword = 7,
		done = 8,
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_loaded

	self.get_knight = function()
		return user_util.get_knight_character('knight_female', 'knight_male')
	end

	self.get_plague_doctor = function()
		return get_character('plague_doctor')
	end

	self.get_boss_symptom = function()
		return get_character('boss_symptom')
	end

	self.get_boss_symptom_enhanced = function()
		return get_character('boss_symptom_enhanced')
	end

	---@type CivilWarUtil
	self.cw_util = nil

	---@type CivilWarBossBattleCommon
	self.common = nil

	---@type SpineCharacterDissolver
	self.dissolver = nil

	self.fx = {
		black_smoke_screen = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_event_blacksmoke_create_screen_fx')
		end,
		black_smoke_consume_boss = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_event_blacksmoke_consume_boss')
		end,
		black_smoke_consume_boss_screen = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_event_blacksmoke_consume_boss_screen_fx')
		end,
		ghost_explosion = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_event_boss_symptom_ghost_explosion')
		end,
		boss_roar = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_event_boss_blackflower_thorns_ready_roar')
		end,
		create_all = function(this)
			for key, creator in pairs(this) do
				if key ~= 'create_all' then
					creator()
				end
			end
		end
	}

	self.floor_fighting_effect_offset = unity_class.vector3.up * 0.01
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
	screen_util.preload_boss_title()

	self.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.common = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/CivilWar/Main/BossBattle/Common')
	self.cw_util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/CivilWar/Common/Util')
	self.dissolver = get_or_create_global_table('utils/SpineCharacterDissolver')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_battle

	local start_on_this = self.controller.starting_inner_progress == section_progress

	start_coroutine(function()
		self.cw_util:enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

		self:start_battle_scene(start_on_this)

		self.cw_util:exit_scene({ enable_wind_pot = false }, get_party_leader())

		if start_on_this then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
		end

		--self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_arrow
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_sword
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.cw_util = nil
	self.common = nil
	self.dissolver = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.current_state ~= self.section_state.done and e.BattleGroupName == self.common.battle.group then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.done

		start_coroutine(function()
			self:deactivate_battle()

			self.cw_util:enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

			self:end_battle_scene()
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

local section_progress = 31

	self.common = nil

	self.dissolver = nil

	end

		end,
		create_all = function(this)
			for key, creator in pairs(this) do

			end
		end

	screen_util.preload_boss_title()

	self.fx:create_all()

	self.cw_util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/CivilWar/Common/Util')
	self.common = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/CivilWar/Main/BossBattle/Common')
	self.dissolver = get_or_create_global_table('utils/SpineCharacterDissolver')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	local start_on_this = self.controller.starting_inner_progress == section_progress

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_battle

	start_coroutine(function()
		self.cw_util:enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

		self:battle_start_scene(start_on_this)

		self.cw_util:exit_scene({ enable_wind_pot = false }, get_party_leader())

		if start_on_this then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
		end

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.in_battle
	end)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))

	self.dissolver = nil
	self.common = nil
	self.cw_util = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	return false

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.in_battle and e.BattleGroupName == self.common.battle.group then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_battle

		start_coroutine(function()
			self.cw_util:enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

			message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

			self:end_scene()
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false

function local_class:set_pre_npc_data(section_state)
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[section_state]

	for i = 1, #pre_npc_data do
		local npc = get_character(pre_npc_data[i].name)

		if npc == nil and pre_npc_data[i].name == 'knight' then
			-- 스테이지6 시작 섹션이 33이 아니면 기사의 시작 데이터 셋팅 건너뛰기
			if pre_npc_data[i].no_setting_in_other_section ~= nil and
					pre_npc_data[i].no_setting_in_other_section == true and
					self.controller.starting_inner_progress ~= 32 then
				goto continue
			end

			npc = self.get_knight()
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].remove_lv_ui ~= nil and pre_npc_data[i].remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')

		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if pre_npc_data[i].pos ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(npc, pre_npc_data[i].pos)
		end
		--if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_exit()) then
		if pre_npc_data[i].dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, pre_npc_data[i].dir, false)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].emo ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, pre_npc_data[i].emo)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].anim ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = pre_npc_data[i].anim })
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].keep_shake ~= nil and pre_npc_data[i].keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, pre_npc_data[i].shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', pre_npc_data[i].sorting_layer)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].tint_color then
			character_util.add_fade_color(npc, pre_npc_data[i].tint_color_key,
					pre_npc_data[i].tint_color, 1, 0)
		end

		if pre_npc_data[i].scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, 'pre_setting', pre_npc_data[i].scale)
		end

		:: continue ::
	end

			  auto_layout = true,

			  dialogue_sfx_name = '03_dialogue_04',

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.controller.cw_util:start_scene(self.start_section, self, self.controller.starting_inner_progress >= 5)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	if self.attack_ranges then
		for idx = 1, #self.attack_ranges do
			local attack_range = self.attack_ranges[idx]
			if attack_range then
				attack_range_util.destroy(attack_range)
			end
		end
	end

	self.is_start_bombing = false
	self.is_action_grid = false
	self.shoot_helpers = nil

	if self.war_loop_sfx then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.war_loop_sfx)
		self.war_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.hit_bullet_event ~= nil then
		self.hit_bullet_event:dispose()
		self.hit_bullet_event = nil
	end

	if self.pooled_bullet_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.pooled_bullet_list do
			self.pooled_bullet_list[i]:Dispose()
		end

		self.pooled_bullet_list = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	if self.optimized_npc_list then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.optimized_npc_list)
		self.optimized_npc_list = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.optimized_npc_list == nil then
		return false
	end

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.show_auto_speech_event and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('auto_speech_npc_1')) then

		self.controller.cw_util:start_scene(self.interact_soldier, self)
	end

	for i = 1, self.shoot_npc_count do
		local npc = self.optimized_npc_list[self.shoot_npc_name .. i]

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, npc) then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(npc, { key = 'cw_main_s6_interact_' .. i, bubble_type = 'shout' })

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 's6_fierce_battleground_grid') then
		self:enter_fierce_battleground_grid_3()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 's6_fierce_battleground_grid') then
		self.is_action_grid = false

		self.shoot_npc_state:exit()
		self.hit_bullet_event:exit()

		character_util.stop_shake(self.optimized_npc_list['first_aid_npc_2'])

		--1 ~ 0.4으로 조절
		start_coroutine(function()
			coroutine_util.while_each_frame(3, function(progress)
				local cur_volume = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(1, 0.4, progress)

				if self.war_loop_sfx then
					self.war_loop_sfx.Volume = cur_volume
				end
			end)
		end)

		return true
	end

	--0.4 ~ 0.2으로 조절
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 's6_bombing_grid') then
		start_coroutine(function()
			coroutine_util.while_each_frame(3, function(progress)
				local cur_volume = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0.4, 0.2, progress)

				if self.war_loop_sfx then
					self.war_loop_sfx.Volume = cur_volume
				end
			end)
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_section_state > self.section_state.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's6_leave_event_zone') then
		self.controller.cw_util:start_scene(self.leave_event_zone, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state < self.section_state.show_auto_speech_event and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's6_guide_event_zone') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.show_auto_speech_event

		local npc = self.optimized_npc_list['auto_speech_npc_1']

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(npc, { key = 'cw_main_s6_2', skip = false })

		npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		character_util.add_listener(npc, self.controller)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state < self.section_state.show_champions_event and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's6_champion_event_zone') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.show_champions_event

		self.controller.cw_util:start_scene(self.show_champions_scene, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state < self.section_state.ending and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's6_ending_zone') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.ending

		self.controller.cw_util:start_scene(self.ending_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.is_action_grid = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:set_bullet_sprite()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local custom_atlas
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
				custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)

	self.pooled_bullet_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.pooled_bullet_count do
		local bullet = self.get_custom_sprite():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)
		local bullet_sprite = bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999

		local rotate_y = i > 3 and -90 or 90
		bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, rotate_y, 0)
		bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
		bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
		bullet_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas
		bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'small_shot_normal.png'
		bullet_sprite:Rebuild()

		table.insert(self.pooled_bullet_list, bullet)
	end
end

function local_class:start_section(is_starting_from_this_section)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local demon_queen = self.get_demon_queen()

	self:remove_fo_weapon(leader)
	self:remove_fo_weapon(demon_queen)

	character_util.remove_group_emotion({ leader, demon_queen })

	if is_starting_from_this_section then
		screen_util.fade_out(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
	end

	local start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_start_pos')

	character_util.set_position(leader, start_pos)
	character_util.set_position(demon_queen, start_pos - vector(0, 0, 0.75))

	if not is_starting_from_this_section then
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
		camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
		character_util.convert_to_following_npc(demon_queen, user_party, false)
	end

	self.run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

	wp_util.move(leader, leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 5)
	, nil, 1, { run = true })
	wp_util.move(demon_queen, demon_queen.Position + vector(0, 0, 5)
	, nil, 1, { run = true, end_callback = function()
				music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.run_sfx)
				self.run_sfx = nil
			end })

	--기존 내용 + 볼륨 1에서 볼륨 0.7로 수정 부탁드립니다.
	self.war_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_war_loop_03',
		volume = 0.1,
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'player',
		loop = true })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.05, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.section_start

	if is_starting_from_this_section then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
	end

	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(
			self.quest_marker_name,
			self.quest_id,
			true,
			get_character('auto_speech_npc_1')
	)
end

		self.is_action_grid = true
		self:set_grid_action_request_id()

		local cur_grid_action_request_id = self.grid_action_request_id
		while self.is_action_grid and
				cur_grid_action_request_id == self.grid_action_request_id do
			local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

			-- 막는 용도 연출 npc update
			self.shoot_npc_state:update_frame(dt)

			-- 총알 날라오는 연출 update
			self.hit_bullet_event:update_frame(dt)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end)

end

function local_class:set_grid_action_request_id()
	self.grid_action_request_id = self.grid_action_request_id + 1
	if self.grid_action_request_id >= self.max_grid_action_request_id then
		self.grid_action_request_id = 1
	end
end

		scene_util.set_direction(champion, 'right', false)

	-- 소히 (right, attack , idle) : 무슨 회의 같은거 하고 있는거 아녔어? 갑자기 이게 무슨 난리야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(champions.ghost_buster, self, 'right'
	, nil, 'attack', 'cw_main_s6_10')

	-- 리리스 (left, attack, release) : 모두! 지금은 설명할 시간이 없어!

	start_coroutine(function()
		local range_duration = 2

		--어택 레인지 발생과 함께 한번 재생

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--소히 (right, surprise, jump 1회)

			wait_for_sec(drop_term)

			start_coroutine(self.bomb_drop_attack_range, self, bombing_pos + vector(0, 0, 2), drop_height, drop_duration)

			wait_for_sec(drop_term)

			start_coroutine(self.bomb_drop_attack_range, self, bombing_pos + vector(0, 0, 4), drop_height, drop_duration)

			wait_for_sec(drop_term)

			wait_for_sec(drop_term)

		util.cs_generator(function()
			wait_for_sec(1)

			--첫 어택레인지가 1초 차올랐을 때, 가디언 (left, surprise, jump 1회)

			character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, '01_player_jump_01')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self, nil, nil
	, 'attack', 'cw_main_s6_12_7')

	--리리스 (left, attack, idle) : 우린 반대편쪽으로 이동해서 $name과 합류하도록 한다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self, 'left', nil
	, 'attack', 'cw_main_s6_13')

	--리리스 (left, attack, idle) : 서둘러서 이동해야 해!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_queen, self, nil, nil

		-- 메이 (down, idle, idle) : 다들! 우선 여왕님이 말씀한대로 하자!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(champions.china_hero, self, 'down', 'idle'
		, 'idle', 'cw_main_s6_16')
	end

	-- 마빈 (up, idle, idle) : 서둘러! 이러다간 우리도 휘말린다!

	-- 크레이그 (right, idle, release) : 좋아! 내가 앞장서지, 다들 따라와!

	, nil, 'cw_main_s6_18')

	-- 코코 (right, attack, release) : $name! 무사해야 돼!
	character_util.normal_jump_async(champions.innuit, '01_small_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(champions.innuit, self, 'right', nil
	, 'attack', 'cw_main_s6_19')

	--파티 제외

	-- 소히,페이/메이,코코,크레이그,마리안,마빈이 왼쪽 방향으로 run 자세로 달려가며 (이동속도값 : 4) 화면에서 사라짐.

	local champion_move_key = 'champion_move_key_'

	local queen_move_key = 'queen_move_key'

	local move_count = 1

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')

	for _, champion in pairs(champions) do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(champion)

	end

	for _, champion in pairs(champions) do
		character_util.set_active_state(champion, 'disabled')
	end

	character_util.set_active_state(demon_queen, 'disabled')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	-- 카메라 원래대로 복귀.

function local_class:bomb_drop(end_pos, height, duration, mod_value, qte_wait_duration)
	local start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(end_pos, height)
	local mod_duration = duration / mod_value

	local missile_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_missile_loop_01', loop = true })

	self.fx_bombing_proj = self.get_fx_bomb_proj():Instantiate(start_pos)
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < mod_duration do
		local progress = time_passed / mod_duration
		local change_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

		if self.is_qte_stop then
			break
		end

		self.fx_bombing_proj.transform.position = change_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(missile_loop_sfx)

	while self.is_qte_stop do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	missile_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_missile_loop_01', loop = true })

	local continue_start_pos = self.fx_bombing_proj.transform.position
	local duration = duration - qte_wait_duration

	coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, function(progress)
		local change_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(continue_start_pos, end_pos, progress)

		self.fx_bombing_proj.transform.position = change_pos
	end)

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(missile_loop_sfx)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_explosion_03')

	local explosion = self.get_fx_bomb_proj_explosion():Instantiate(end_pos)

	explosion.transform.localScale = explosion.transform.localScale * 2

	--fx_cw_mana_canon_red_missile_proj_explosion 이펙트 출력될 때 화면 0.04값 shake 1초
	camera_util.shake(0.05, 1)

	self.fx_bombing_proj:Dispose()
	self.fx_bombing_proj = nil
end

function local_class:bomb_drop_attack_range(end_pos, height, duration)
	local start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(end_pos, height)
	local range_duration = 2
	local attack_range = attack_range_util.create_circle(end_pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0),
			2, nil, nil, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	--어택 레인지 발생과 함께 한번 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bombard_range_01')

function local_class:mini_game_ending()
	if self.mini_game_instance == nil then
		return
	end

	self.mini_game_instance.virtual_cop_ui:set_main_active_state(false)
	self.mini_game_instance.navigation_ui:set_active(true)

	-- 카메라
	local camera = self.mini_game_instance.camera_comp
	local camera_transform = camera.transform
	
	-- 카메라 회전한다.
	self:rotate_camera(camera_transform, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(-45, -180, 0), 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	self:mini_game_ending_qte_scene()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self:shake_camera(camera, 0.4, 0.3)

	-- 연출용 총알
	local bullet = get_field_object('moneyshot_bullet')
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(bullet.Transform, 'SpecialEvents')
	
	local bullet_initial_scale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
	local bullet_pre_setting_pos = vector(-132.365, 2.718, -151.358)
	bullet.Transform.localScale = bullet_initial_scale
	bullet.Position = bullet_pre_setting_pos
	
	-- 헬리콥터 1회성이고 연출 박바지니 이걸로 찾음.
	local helicopter = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Find('helicopter_1')
	local helicopter_animator = helicopter.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	-- 총알, 헬리콥터를 향해 날라간다.
	local bullet_move_duration = 1
	local time_passed = 0
	
	local bullet_target_pos = vector(-132.5, 8.8, -157)
	bullet.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(-4, -100, -45)

	local cam_original_parent = camera_transform.parent
	local time_scale_key = 'minigame_ending'
	local time_scale_value_1 = 0.07
	local time_scale_value_2 = 2

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_event_cw_06')
	loop_sound_controller:change_volume('01_helicopter_03', 0.4, 0)
	self.mini_game_instance.virtual_cop_ui:play_fps_hand_anim('shoot', false)

	local bullet_target_scale = vector(1, 1, 1)
	
	local cam_move_points = {
		camera_transform.position,
		vector(-132.5, 4.5, -153)
	}
	
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1 })
	loop_sound_controller:change_volume('01_helicopter_03', 0.4, 0)
	start_coroutine(self.move_camera_bezier_curve, self, camera, cam_move_points, bullet_move_duration)

	local cam_zoom_in_fov = 50
	local cam_zoom_out_fov = 70
	while time_passed < bullet_move_duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time_passed = time_passed + dt
		
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / bullet_move_duration)
		if progress > 0.2  and progress < 0.5 then
			self.mini_game_instance:set_ui_active_state(false)
		elseif progress > 0.5 and progress < 0.6 then
			loop_sound_controller:stop_sfx('01_helicopter_03')
			time_util.mod(time_scale_key, time_scale_value_1, false)

		elseif progress > 0.6 then
			time_util.unmod(time_scale_key)
			time_util.mod(time_scale_key, time_scale_value_2, false)
		end
		
		camera.fieldOfView = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(cam_zoom_out_fov, cam_zoom_in_fov, progress)

		bullet.Position = vector_util.lerp(bullet_pre_setting_pos, bullet_target_pos, progress)
		bullet.Transform.localScale = vector_util.lerp(bullet_initial_scale, bullet_target_scale, progress)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	
	bullet.Position = vector(-999, 0, -999)

	time_util.unmod(time_scale_key)
	self:shake_camera(camera, 0.3, 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_event_cw_08')

	leader.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Top Effects', 1000)
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(leader.Transform, 'SpecialEvents')

	camera_transform.parent = cam_original_parent
	
	helicopter_animator:Play('boss_damaged')
	helicopter_mesh = helicopter.transform:Find('demonworld_boss')

	local heli_dest_pos = helicopter.transform.position + vector(0, -2.5, 0)

	local cam_move_waypoints = {
		cam_start_pos,

		cam_dest_pos
	}

	local cam_current_rotation = camera_transform.localRotation

	while time_passed < cam_zoom_out_duration do

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / cam_zoom_out_duration)
		camera.fieldOfView = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(cam_zoom_in_fov, cam_zoom_out_fov, progress)
		camera_transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Lerp(cam_current_rotation, cam_target_rotation, progress)

		helicopter.transform.position = vector_util.lerp(heli_start_pos, heli_dest_pos, progress)

function local_class:show_bullet_effect(shooter, target_pos)
	character_util.hide_weapon(shooter, true, 'intro')
	scene_util.set_anim(shooter, self, { name = 'unique/fps_shoot', loop = true, scale = 7 })
	self.bullet_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_05', loop = true })
	
	-- self.bullet_effect_time 동안 탄 발사 이팩트를 보여준다.
	local time_passed = 0
	local attack_range_value = 0.5
	local random_range = attack_range_value * 0.9
	local bullet_effect_time = 0.3

	while time_passed < bullet_effect_time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local rad = math.pi * CS.UnityEngine.Random.value * 2
		local x = math.cos(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.1, random_range)
		local z = math.sin(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.1, random_range)
		local effect_spawn_pos = target_pos + vector(x, 0, z)
		local effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.bullet_effect_name):Instantiate(effect_spawn_pos)
		CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(effect.transform, self.mini_game_layer_name)
		wait_for_sec(0.02)
	end

	scene_util.set_anim(shooter, self, 'unique/fps_shoot_idle')

	self:stop_bullet_sfx(0.5)
end

function local_class:rotate_camera(camera, target_rotation, duration)
	local start_rotation = camera.localRotation
	
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local cur_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Lerp(start_rotation, target_rotation, progress)

		camera.localRotation = cur_rotation

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	camera.localRotation = target_rotation
end

function local_class:move_camera_bezier_curve(camera, spline_waypoints, cycle)
	local calculator = CS.Oak.BezierCurveCalculator()

	local bezier_curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Linear

	if (#spline_waypoints == 3) then
		bezier_curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Quadratic
	elseif (#spline_waypoints == 4) then
		bezier_curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Cubic
	end

	local list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	for i = 1, #spline_waypoints do
		list:Add(spline_waypoints[i])
	end

	calculator:Add(list, cycle, bezier_curve_type)

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < cycle do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local cur_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)

		calculator:UpdateFrame(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		cur_pos = calculator.CurrentPosition

		camera.transform.localPosition = cur_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:stop_bullet_sfx(duration)
	if self.bullet_sfx == nil then
		return
	end

	if duration == nil then
		self.bullet_sfx:Stop()
	else
		self.bullet_sfx:FadeOut(duration)
	end

	self.bullet_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:shake_camera_async(camera, magnitude, duration)
	self:stop_camera_shake()
	local req_id = self.camera_shake_req_id

	local shake_calculator = CS.Oak.ShakeCalculator()
	local shake_info = CS.Oak.ShakeInfo()

	shake_info.magnitude = magnitude
	shake_info.duration = duration
	shake_info.useUnscaledTime = true

	shake_calculator:Shake(shake_info)

	local cam_original_pos = camera.transform.localPosition
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	while req_id == self.camera_shake_req_id and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		if shake_calculator.IsActive then
			shake_calculator:UpdateFrame(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
			camera.transform.localPosition = cam_original_pos + shake_calculator.ShakeOffset
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	camera.transform.localPosition = cam_original_pos
end

function local_class:shake_camera(camera, magnitude, duration)
	start_coroutine(self.shake_camera_async, self, camera, magnitude, duration)
end

function local_class:stop_camera_shake()
	self.camera_shake_req_id = self.camera_shake_req_id + 1
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

-- 아이템 인터랙트
function local_class:interact_item_scene(idx)
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local interact_fo_pos = self.interactable_item:get_interactable_fo(idx).Position

	self.controller.cw_util:enter_scene(nil)

	self.interactable_item:remove_interacted_item(idx)

	self.interactable_item.interacted_count = self.interactable_item.interacted_count + 1
	local item_data = self.interactable_item.item_table[self.interactable_item.interacted_count]

	if princess.Position.x > interact_fo_pos.x then
		character_util.set_direction(princess, 'left')
	else
		character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
	end

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

	scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, 'eat')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	eat_sfx = nil

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)

	character_util.remove_anim(princess)

	if self.interactable_item.interacted_count == self.interactable_item:max_count() then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_treasure_item_popup_01')
	end

	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = interact_fo_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.2),
		                                         target = interact_fo_pos,
		                                         itemid = item_data.item_id, notforinven = true,
												 sprscale = item_data.scale,
												 lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true })
	wait_for_sec(0.7)
	item.ConsumeTarget = princess
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	item_data.cb(self)

	if self.interactable_item.interacted_count == self.interactable_item:max_count() then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_interact_chef
		self:appear_chef()
	end

	if self.interactable_item.interacted_count == 2 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_event_illusion_03', delayed_time = 2 })
	end

	self.controller.cw_util:exit_scene({ enable_wind_pot = false }, get_party_leader())
end

-- 병사 그룹1 돌진 and 전투 연출
function local_class:soldier_group_1_fight_scene()
	local dw_soldiers = {
		self.get_dw_soldier(1, 1),
		self.get_dw_soldier(1, 2),
		self.get_dw_soldier(1, 6),
	}
	local saul_soldiers = {
		self.get_saul_soldier(1, 1),
		self.get_saul_soldier(1, 2),
		self.get_saul_soldier(1, 6),
	}

	local move_key = 'group_2_soldier_move'
	local soldiers_move_distance = unity_class.vector3.Distance(
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_dw_soldier_wp_1_2'),
		field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_dw_soldier_wp_1_3'))
	for i = 1, #dw_soldiers do
		character_util.remove_anim(dw_soldiers[i])
		character_util.set_emotion(dw_soldiers[i], { name = 'attack' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dw_soldiers[i], dw_soldiers[i].Position
				+ vector(soldiers_move_distance, 0, 0),
				6, nil, self, move_key, { run = true, play_sfx = true })
	end
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	local soldier_fight_routine = function (key)
			local time_passed = 0
			local progress = 0
			local duration = 0.3
			local dw_soldier_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_dw_soldier_1_' .. key .. '_pos')
			local dw_soldier_knockback_pos = dw_soldier_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5)
			local dw_soldier = dw_soldiers[key]
			local saul_soldier = saul_soldiers[key]
			local speed = 6
			local move_duration = unity_class.vector3.Distance(dw_soldier.Position, dw_soldier_pos) / speed
			local saul_move_duration = 0.3
			local soldier_move_key = dw_soldier.Name
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dw_soldier, dw_soldier_pos,
					nil, move_duration, self, soldier_move_key, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

			wait_for_sec(move_duration - saul_move_duration)

			wp_util.move_async(saul_soldier,
					field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_saul_soldier_1_' .. key .. '_pos'),
					nil, saul_move_duration, { run = true })
			character_util.remove_anim(saul_soldier)

			wp_util.wait_move_end(self, soldier_move_key)

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', parent = dw_soldier })

			character_util.set_direction(dw_soldier, 'up')
			self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(dw_soldier.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0.2))
			self.fx:hit():Instantiate(dw_soldier.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0.2))
			character_util.spine_damage_squish(dw_soldier, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)
			character_util.spine_pulse_color(dw_soldier,
						CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)

			while time_passed <= duration and not self.stage_ended do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCirc(
						time_passed, 0, 1, duration))

				dw_soldier.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(dw_soldier_pos, dw_soldier_knockback_pos, progress)
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			wp_util.move_async(dw_soldier, dw_soldier_pos, 4, nil, { run = true })

			self.battlefield_controller:set_fight_routine_1(1, dw_soldier, saul_soldier, false)
	end

	-- 리더가 이미 전장 그리드에 있으면 달려가 전투하는 연출 보여줌
	if self.current_grid == 'battlefield_grid' then
		local knockback_duration = 0.3
		wait_all({
			util.cs_generator(function ()
				soldier_fight_routine(1)
			end),
			util.cs_generator(function ()
				soldier_fight_routine(2)
			end),
			util.cs_generator(function ()
				local dw_soldier = dw_soldiers[3]
				local saul_soldier = saul_soldiers[3]
				local dw_soldier_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_dw_soldier_1_6_pos')
				local saul_soldier_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_saul_soldier_1_6_pos')
				wp_util.move_async(dw_soldier, { vector(dw_soldier_pos.x, 0, dw_soldier.Position.z),
						dw_soldier_pos }, 6, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'right' })
				character_util.set_anim(dw_soldier, { name = 'rifle_shoot' })
				character_util.set_direction(saul_soldier, 'left')
				character_util.normal_jump(saul_soldier, '01_jump_01')

				wait_for_sec(0.6)

				wp_util.move_async(saul_soldier, saul_soldier_pos, nil, 0.6, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_monster_01', parent = saul_soldier })

				self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(dw_soldier.Position + vector(0.2, 0, 0))
				self.fx:hit():Instantiate(dw_soldier.Position + vector(0.2, 0, 0))
				character_util.spine_damage_squish(dw_soldier, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)
				character_util.spine_pulse_color(dw_soldier,
						CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)
				character_util.spine_damage_squish(saul_soldier, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)
				character_util.spine_pulse_color(saul_soldier,
						CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)

				self.battlefield_controller:set_fight_routine_3(1, dw_soldier, saul_soldier)
			end)
		})
	else
		character_util.set_position(dw_soldiers[1],
				field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_dw_soldier_1_1_pos'))
		character_util.set_position(dw_soldiers[2],
				field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_dw_soldier_1_2_pos'))
		character_util.set_position(dw_soldiers[3],
				field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_dw_soldier_1_6_pos'))
		character_util.set_position(saul_soldiers[1],
				field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_saul_soldier_1_1_pos'))
		character_util.set_position(saul_soldiers[2],
				field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_saul_soldier_1_2_pos'))
		character_util.set_position(saul_soldiers[3],
				field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_saul_soldier_1_6_pos'))
		self.battlefield_controller:set_fight_routine_1(1, dw_soldiers[1],
				saul_soldiers[1], false)
		self.battlefield_controller:set_fight_routine_1(1, dw_soldiers[2],
				saul_soldiers[2], false)
		self.battlefield_controller:set_fight_routine_3(1, dw_soldiers[3],
				saul_soldiers[3])
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('CivilWarMindReadingGirlController')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = controller @
		QuestName = CivilWarMindReadingGirl @
		Comment = CivilWarMindReadingGirl 퀘스트/이벤트 @
]]

function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	--17섹션 체크용
	self.is_in_section_17 = false

	self.main_quest_id = 357

	--region Character
	--소녀
	self.get_kid_girl = function()
		return get_character('mind_reading_kid_girl')
	end

	--개
	self.get_dog = function()
		return get_character('mind_reading_dog')
	end

	--불법 상인
	self.get_black_merchant = function()
		return get_character('mind_reading_black_merchant')
	end

	--상인
	self.get_merchant = function()
		return get_character('mind_reading_merchant')
	end

	--시민
	self.get_civilian = function()
		return get_character('mind_reading_civilian')
	end
	--endregion Character

	self.starting_inner_progress = -1
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))

	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	if quest_util.is_available_section(self.current_section) then
		self.current_section:exit()
	end

	self.current_section = nil

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')

	local main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)

	if main_quest_progress.InnerProgress == 16 then
		self.is_in_section_17 = true
	end

	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

-- pre story section 설정
function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
end

-- main section 설정
function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section1')
	}

	--self.post_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'PostSection')
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:on_progress_section()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	-- 섹션 17으로 넘어왔을 때
	if e.QuestId == self.main_quest_id and e.CurrentProgress == 16 then
		self:disable_mind_reading_event()
	end

end
--endregion

--region Custom
function local_class:disable_mind_reading_event()
	self.is_in_section_17 = true

	--비활성화
	local disable_npcs = {
		self.get_kid_girl(),
		self.get_dog(),
		self.get_black_merchant(),
		self.get_merchant(),
		self.get_civilian()
	}

	local wait_pos = vector(999, 0, 999)

	for idx = 1, #disable_npcs do
		character_util.set_position(disable_npcs[idx], wait_pos)
		character_util.set_active_state(disable_npcs[idx], 'disabled')
	end

end
--endregion Custom

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

function local_class:on_pre_load()

end

function local_class:enter()
	if self.controller.is_in_section_17 then
		return true
	end

	self:pre_setting()

	self.util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/CivilWar/Common/Util')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	if self.peanut_box then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.peanut_box)
	end
	self.util = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.controller.is_in_section_17 then
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.controller.is_in_section_17 then
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.market_scene and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_kid_girl()) then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.black_market_scene

		self.util:start_scene(self.kid_girl_talk_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.peanut_interact_scene and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_peanut_box_interact_wall_invisible()) then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.ending_scene

		self.util:start_scene(self.peanut_box_interact_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.ending_scene and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_kid_girl()) then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.done

		self.util:start_scene(self.kid_girl_ending_scene, self)

		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.controller.is_in_section_17 then
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.start and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'mind_reading_market_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.market_scene

		self.util:start_scene(self.market_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.black_market_scene and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'mind_reading_black_market_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.peanut_interact_scene

		self.util:start_scene(self.black_market_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:show_mind_reading_async(fo, duration)

function local_class:market_scene()

	local merchant = self.get_merchant()
	local black_merchant = self.get_black_merchant()
	local kid_girl = self.get_kid_girl()
	local dog = self.get_dog()

	local leader_pos = self.get_leader_marker_pos(1)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	--컨트롤 뺏고 가디언 파란원 위치에 정렬 카메라가 상인을 포커스하고 이벤트가 재생된다.
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, leader, leader_pos, 2, nil, { last_direction = 'right' }),
		util.cs_generator(camera_util.move_async, merchant.Position, 1),
	})

	--상인(left,tired,idle): 땅콩을 이렇게 많이요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(merchant, self,
			'left',
			nil,
			'tired',
			'cw_mind_reading_s1_1')

	--불법상인(right,idle,release): 잔말말고 빨리 물건이나 팔라고!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(black_merchant, self,
			nil,
			'release',
			nil,
			'cw_mind_reading_s1_2')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_02')
	--상인(left,idle,bow_idle)상태로 손에 peanut_box 을 들고 0.5칸 좌측 이동 후 불법상인한테 해당 peanut_box가 획득된다.
	--이 후 다시 0.5칸 뒷걸음질로 우측 이동
	self.peanut_box = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = merchant.Bounds.center + vector(-0.3, 0, 0),
			  itemid = self.item_id.peanut_box, notforinven = true, showoncharacter = true,
			  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.5 })

	--넣어주는 시간
	local push_half_duration = 0.3

	scene_util.set_anim(merchant, self, { name = 'bow_idle' })
	drop_item_util.move_item(self.peanut_box, merchant.Bounds.center + vector(-0.8, 0, 0),
			{ duration = push_half_duration })

	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(push_half_duration)

		self.peanut_box.ConsumeTarget = black_merchant
		self.peanut_box.ShowFloatingText = false
		self.peanut_box:Fly()
		self.peanut_box = nil
	end)

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(merchant, vector(-0.5, 0, 0), push_half_duration, push_half_duration)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--상인은(left,idle,idle) 상태
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(merchant)

	--불법상인 이동속도 6로 (run)모션 경로따라 그리드밖으로 사라짐

		self.get_black_merchant_marker_pos(2),
		self.get_black_merchant_marker_pos(3),
		screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', self.get_black_merchant_marker_pos(3), -1),
	}

	local black_merchant_move_key = 'black_merchant_move_key'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(black_merchant, black_merchant_move_pos, 6, nil, self, black_merchant_move_key, {
		end_callback = function()
			character_util.set_position(black_merchant, self.wait_pos)
		end,
		run = true
	})

	do
		--이때 동시에 좌측에서 (소녀)(개)가 (run)애니메이션 속도 8로 달려옴
		--소녀 표정은 (smile) 개(idle)
		scene_util.set_emotion(kid_girl, self, 'smile')

		local move_key = 'move_key'

		local kid_girl_move_pos = self.get_kid_girl_marker_pos(2)
		local dog_move_pos = self.get_dog_marker_pos(2)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(kid_girl, kid_girl_move_pos, 8, nil, self, move_key, {
			run = true
		})

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dog, dog_move_pos, 8, nil, self, move_key, { run = true })

		--소녀 도착 후
		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
	end

	--소녀(left,smile,idle): 오늘은 땅콩 먹는 날이야!
	character_util.normal_jump_async(kid_girl, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid_girl, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			'smile',
			'cw_mind_reading_s1_3')

	--소녀(left,idle,idle)(shake0.03/1초)
	--fx_object_twinkle 1초 커졌다 꺼짐
	self:show_mind_reading_async(kid_girl, 1)

	--소녀(left,surprsie,idle)(jump1회)(notice) 이모티콘 버블
	character_util.normal_jump_async(kid_girl, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(kid_girl, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			'surprise',
			'notice')

	--상인(right,idle,idle): 꼬마야 무슨 일이니?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(merchant, self,
			'right',
			nil,
			nil,
			'cw_mind_reading_s1_4')

	--소녀(left,tired,cast): 땅콩… 다 팔렸어?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid_girl, self,
			nil,
			'cast',
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
			'cw_mind_reading_s1_5')

	--상인(right,idle,bomb_idle): 음…? 그렇단다 꼬마야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(merchant, self,
			nil,
			'bomb_idle',
			nil,
			'cw_mind_reading_s1_6')

	--개(left,tired,saet) (annoyed) 이모티콘 버블
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(dog, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'seat', keep = true },
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
			'annoyed')

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, black_merchant_move_key)

	character_util.add_listener(kid_girl, self.controller)

	--상인(down,idle,idle):갑자기 땅콩을 한 무더기 사가다니….
	scene_util.set_direction(merchant, 'down', false)
	merchant.Interactable.Talk = 'cw_mind_reading_oneline_1'

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	--카메라 반환
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--소녀(right,tired,idle) 개(left,tired,seat) 상태 (위에서 keep)

function local_class:kid_girl_ending_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local kid_girl = self.get_kid_girl()
	local dog = self.get_dog()

	local leader_pos = self.get_leader_marker_pos(2)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	--소녀에게 인터랙트시 가디언 좌측에 정렬 이벤트 재생
	wp_util.move_async(leader, leader_pos, 2, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

	if self.is_first_interact then
		self.is_first_interact = false
		--소녀에게 인터랙트 시 가디언 좌측에 정렬 이벤트 재생
		--소녀(left,smile,idle)(jump1회)
		character_util.normal_jump_async(kid_girl, '01_player_jump_01')

		--소녀(left,smile,release): 덕분에 땅콩 먹을 수 있게 됐어!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid_girl, self,
				'left',
				'release',
				'smile',
				'cw_mind_reading_s1_20')

		--소녀(left,idle,idle)(shake0.03/1초)
		--fx_object_twinkle 1초 커졌다 꺼짐
		self:show_mind_reading_async(kid_girl, 1)

		--소녀(left,surprsie,idle)(jump1회)(notice) 이모티콘 버블
		character_util.normal_jump_async(kid_girl, true)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(kid_girl, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				'surprise',
				'notice')

		--소녀(left,smile,release): 나중에 나 꼭 보답 하고 싶어!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid_girl, self,
				nil,
				'release',
				'smile',
				'cw_mind_reading_s1_22')
	end

	--소녀(left,smile,sing): 혹시 연락처 줄 수 있어?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid_girl, self,
			'left',
			'sing',
			'smile',
			'cw_mind_reading_s1_23')

	do
		--선택지
		local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'cw_mind_reading_s1_choose_1', 'normal' },
			{ 'cw_mind_reading_s1_choose_2', 'normal' }
		})

		if result == 1 then
			--네 (무색)

		elseif result == 2 then
			--아니요 (무색)
			--소녀(left,tired,idle): 알았어…
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid_girl, self,
					nil,
					'idle',
					'tired',
					'cw_mind_reading_s1_24')

			--이 후 (right,idle,idle) 상태 재 인터랙트 가능
			scene_util.set_direction(kid_girl, 'right', false)

			--재인터랙트 시 혹시 연락처 줄 수 있어 부터 시작.

			--재 인터렉트시 스테이트 초기화
			self.current_state = self.section_state.ending_scene

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

			return
		end
	end

	character_util.remove_relate_event(kid_girl, self.controller)

	--네 선택시 SNS 등록 (독심술 소녀)
	sns_util.add_sns(self.follow_id)

	--소녀(left,smile,idle)(jump1회): 진짜?! 고마워!
	character_util.normal_jump_async(kid_girl, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid_girl, self,
			'left',
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			'cw_mind_reading_s1_23_1')

	--소녀(left,smile,get)상태로 스타피스를 해당 위치에 떨군다.
	--상단 1칸 좌측 0.5칸 위치
	scene_util.set_anim(kid_girl, self, 'get')

	local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)

	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, kid_girl.Position, kid_girl.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 1))
