	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid_girl, self,
			nil,
			'release',
			'smile',
			'cw_mind_reading_s1_21')

	--소녀(left,smile,cast): 정말 대단해…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid_girl, self,
			nil,
			'cast',
			'smile',
			'cw_mind_reading_s1_25')

	--카메라 3으로 줌 카메라 줌 끝나면 다음 대사 (줌시간 0.5초)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 0.5)

	--이때 가디언 (right,scared,idle)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'scared')
	character_util.normal_jump(leader)

	--소녀(left,smile2,sing): 리리스 진영에서 적진 한 가운데로 잠입한 용사 님…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid_girl, self,
			nil,
			'sing',
			'smile2',
			'cw_mind_reading_s1_26')

	--카메라 4로 복귀 복귀 끝나면 다음 대사
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)

	--소녀(left,smile2,success): 나 완전 두근두근해! 멋져!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid_girl, self,
			nil,
			'success',
			'smile2',
			'cw_mind_reading_s1_27')

	--이때 개(left,smile,victory)
	scene_util.set_emotion(dog, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(dog, self, 'victory')

	--소녀(left,smile2,sing): 그럼 다음에 봐!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid_girl, self,
			nil,
			'sing',
			'smile2',
			'cw_mind_reading_s1_28')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dog)

	--소녀와 강아지 오른쪽으로 8속도 (run) 그리드 밖에서 사라짐
	local dog_exit_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', dog.Position, 1)
	local kid_girl_exit_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', kid_girl.Position, 1)

	local move_key = 'exit_move_key'
	local exit_move_speed = 8

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_pet_bark_01')
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(dog, dog_exit_pos, exit_move_speed, nil, self, move_key, {
		run = true,
		end_callback = function()
			character_util.set_position(dog, self.wait_pos)
			character_util.set_active_state(dog, 'disabled')
		end })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(kid_girl, kid_girl_exit_pos, exit_move_speed, nil, self, move_key, {
		run = true,
		end_callback = function()
			character_util.set_position(kid_girl, self.wait_pos)
			character_util.set_active_state(kid_girl, 'disabled')
		end })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

local local_class = newclass('CivilWarNanoMachineSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = CivilWarNanoMachine @
		Comment = CivilWarNanoMachine 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @

]]

	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.cw_util = self.controller.cw_util

	self.zone_enter_npc_info = {
		sub_nm_online_zone_1 = {
			npc_name = 'sub_nm_soldier',
			talk = 'cw_passage_nanomachine_1',
			active = true
		},
		sub_nm_online_zone_2 = {
			npc_name = 'sub_nm_soldier_2',
			talk = 'cw_passage_nanomachine_2',
			active = true
		}
	}

	self.get_congress_man = function()
		return get_character('sub_nm_congress_man')
	end

	self.get_congress_man_2 = function()
		return get_character('sub_nm_congress_man_2')
	end

	self.get_star_piece = self.controller.get_star_piece

	self.get_death_explosion = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lilithtower_virus_death_explosion')
	end

	self.get_punch_proj_loop = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_punch_proj_loop')
	end

	self.get_punch_hit_loop = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_punch_hit_loop')
	end

	self.get_smoke_bomb = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_smokebomb')
	end

	self.congress_man_tint_key = 'congress_man_color'

	self.is_first_interact_event = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_death_explosion()
	self.get_punch_proj_loop()
	self.get_smoke_bomb()
	self.get_punch_hit_loop()

	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
	screen_util.preload_boss_title()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')


	self:npc_setting()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_congress_man()) then
		self.is_first_interact_event = true

		self:npc_interact_event()
		return
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	--플레이어 아래와 같은 존에 진입 시 플레이어 컨트롤 뺏지 않은 채  NPC 특정 연출 진행
	local name = e.Zone.Name
	if self.zone_enter_npc_info[name] ~= nil and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), name)
			and self.zone_enter_npc_info[name].active == true then
		self.zone_enter_npc_info[name].active = false
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.online_npc_event, self, name))
		return
	end

	if self.is_first_interact_event == false and self.is_in_grid == false and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(),self.event_zone_name) then
		self.is_in_grid = true

		--하원 의원 NPC 아래와 같은 대사 2초 간격으로 출력
		--하원 의원 (left, idle, idle) : 이제 이 세상은 내 차지가 될 것이다!
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(function()
					local congress_man = self.get_congress_man()
					while self.is_in_grid == true do
						scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(congress_man, 'cw_passage_nanomachine_2_1', false)
						self:wait_for_sec(3)
					end
				end))
		return
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if self.is_first_interact_event == false and type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.event_grid_name) then
		self.is_in_grid = false

		local npc = self.get_congress_man()
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(npc)
		return
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 'sub_nm_battle_zone' then
		self.cw_util:start_scene(self.after_battle_scene, self)
		return
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:npc_setting()
	local congress_man = self.get_congress_man()
	local congress_man_2 = self.get_congress_man_2()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(congress_man)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(congress_man_2)
	character_util.remove_color(congress_man_2, self.congress_man_tint_key)

	character_util.set_position(congress_man, congress_man_2.Position)
	character_util.set_position(congress_man_2, vector(999,0,999))

	local soldier = get_character('sub_nm_soldier')
	local soldier_2 = get_character('sub_nm_soldier_2')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier_2)
end

function local_class:online_npc_event(zone_name)
	local info = self.zone_enter_npc_info[zone_name]
	local npc = get_character(info.npc_name)

	--B(cw_soldier#cw_saul_soldier) NPC (left, idle, idle) : 동쪽으로는… 절대 가지 마….
	-- B(cw_saul_soldier) NPC (left, idle, idle) : 동쪽은 가면 안돼….
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc, info.talk, false)

	--대사 출력 0.5초 후
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--dead 출력 이후 wall 상태
	scene_util.set_anim(npc, self,'dead')
end

		self.cw_util:enter_scene({ disable_wind_pot = true })

		local party_align_pos = congress_man.Position + vector(-2,0,0)

		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(congress_man, 'cw_passage_nanomachine_4')

		--하원 의원 (left, idle, idle) :나는 새로운 힘을 얻었다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(congress_man, 'cw_passage_nanomachine_5')

		--하원 의원 (left, idle, victroy_get ) :내가 리리스를 쓰러 트리고 마계의 지배자가 되겠다!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(congress_man, self, nil,

		choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{'cw_passage_nanomachine_choose_1', 'brutal'},

		--헛소리 집어치워!! (빨간색)
		--플레이어 (right, attack, release 3회)
		--제대로 미쳤군! (초록색)
		--플레이어 (right, attack, release 3회)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, {name = 'release', count = 3})

		--하원 의원 (left, idle, attack) : 세상은 썩었다! 어느 것 하나 제대로 된 게 없어!
		local sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_normal_slash_01', loop = true,
												 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		scene_util.set_anim(congress_man, self,{ name = 'attack', loop = true })
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(congress_man, self, nil,
				nil,nil, 'cw_passage_nanomachine_6')
		character_util.remove_anim(congress_man)
		sfx:Stop()
		sfx = nil

		--하원 의원 (left, idle, idle) : 내가 마왕이 돼서 제대로 된 자유를 만들겠다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(congress_man, 'cw_passage_nanomachine_7')

		--플레이어 (right, attack, release 3회)
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, {name = 'release', count = 3})

		--하원 의원 (left, idle, idle) : 날 막겠다고? 어디 한 번 해보시지.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(congress_man, 'cw_passage_nanomachine_8')

		--플레이어 아래와 같은 위치로 (dualgun_run) 동작으로 속도 8로 이동되며 카메라 3 크기으로 확대
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'dualgun_run')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_03')

		--

		--shake 0.1 세기로 출력
		-- 1초 뒤 Qte 연타 출력.
		-- 게임패드 연결중 일 경우 게임패드 이벤트도 구독

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_earth_01')
		time_util.unmod(time_key)
		camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.3)
		self.get_smoke_bomb():Instantiate(leader.Position)

		--하원 의원은 (cw_nano_armstrong)로 변경되며 플레이어는 (sweet) 버블 출력
		local congress_man_2 = self.get_congress_man_2()
		character_util.set_position(congress_man_2, congress_man.Position)
		character_util.set_position(congress_man, vector(999,0,999))

function local_class:after_battle_scene()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('sub_nm_battlegate_1', true))

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	local congress_man = self.get_congress_man_2()

	character_util.convert_to_npc(congress_man)

	--	--배틀 후 아래와 같이 정렬된 후 대사 진행
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(congress_man)
	scene_util.set_direction(congress_man, 'left')

	--	--하원 의원 (left, idle, cast) : 대… 대단하군… 웰 던….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_evil_laugh_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(congress_man, self, nil,
			'dualgun_idle', nil, 'cw_passage_nanomachine_13')

	--	--이후 하원 의원 (left, idle, dead) 출력 후 스타피스 전달
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(congress_man, self, 'dead')

	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	character_util.add_color(congress_man, self.congress_man_tint_key, unity_class.color.black, 0.7, 0)
	congress_man.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	local star_piece_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_nm_star_piece_pos')

	star_piece_util.appear(self.get_star_piece(), congress_man.Position, star_piece_pos)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

function local_class:wait_for_sec(delay)
	local s = CS.UnityEngine.Time.time
	while CS.UnityEngine.Time.time - s < delay and self.is_in_grid == true do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:tap(count, duration, time_mod, is_wait_duration, tap_sfx_name)
	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 99999)
	is_wait_duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_wait_duration, false)
	tap_sfx_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(tap_sfx_name, nil)

	local tap_count = 0
	local event_listener = {}

	-- TouchEvent EventListener 생성
	event_listener.on_touch_event = function(_, e)
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
			if tap_sfx_name then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(tap_sfx_name)
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_energy_fist_01')
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

			tap_count = tap_count + 1
			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	event_listener.on_stage_end_event = function(_, _)
		message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

		if time_mod then
			time_util.unmod('qte_mod')
		end

		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:SubscribeOnce(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	-- 탭 횟수가 1회인 경우, turbo_tap이 아니라 일반 tap으로 띄움
	screen_util.show_turbo_tap()

	-- 맞는 부분 FX_punch_Hit_new 출력
	--shake 0.1 세기로 출력
	--self.get_punch_hit():Instantiate(leader.Position + vector(0.5,0,0))

	if time_mod then
		time_util.mod('qte_mod', time_mod)

	local time_passed = 0

	while is_wait_duration and time_passed < duration do

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	if time_mod then

local local_class = newclass('CivilWarOniGirlSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = CivilWarOniGirl @
		Comment = CivilWarOniGirl 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.available_stage_name = 'civilwar_substage_lana'

	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		all_rescue = 2,
		ending_rescue = 3
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	self.get_oni_girl = function()
		return get_character('onigirl')
	end

	self.get_oni_girl_mother = function()
		return get_character('onigirl_mother')
	end

	self.get_left_rescuer = function(index)
		return get_character('left_rescuer_' .. index)
	end

	self.get_right_rescuer = function(index)
		return get_character('right_rescuer_' .. index)
	end

	self.get_up_rescuer = function(index)
		return get_character('up_rescuer_' .. index)
	end

	self.get_ending_rescuer = function(index)
		return get_character('ending_rescuer_' .. index)
	end

	self.get_trailer = function()
		return get_field_object('s1_trailer')
	end

	self.get_up_rescue_pos = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_up_rescue_center')
	end

	self.get_ending_pos = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_ending_rescue_pos')
	end

	self.rescue_count = 0

	self.speech_shout_rescue_routine_request_id = 0

	self.play_shout_rescue_routine = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.rescue_data = {
		{
			zone_name = 's1_left_rescue_zone',
			enter_zone_func = self.enter_left_rescue,
			interact_func = self.interact_left_rescue,
			interact_target = self.get_left_rescuer(1),
			in_rescue = false,
			is_rescued = false,
			return_direction = 'right'
		},
		{
			zone_name = 's1_right_rescue_zone',
			enter_zone_func = self.enter_right_rescue,
			interact_func = self.interact_right_rescue,
			interact_target = self.get_right_rescuer(1),
			in_rescue = false,
			is_rescued = false,
			return_direction = 'left'
		},
		{
			zone_name = 's1_up_rescue_zone',
			enter_zone_func = self.enter_up_rescue,
			interact_func = self.interact_up_rescue,
			interact_target = self.get_up_rescuer(1),
			in_rescue = false,
			is_rescued = false,
			return_direction = 'down'
		}
	}

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent), 'on_tesla_coil_on_off_event')

	local trailer = self.get_trailer()
	trailer.Position = trailer.Position + vector(0, 0, -2)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	sp_util.start_scene(self.opening, self)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('up_rescue_door_1', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('up_rescue_door_2', false))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent))

	for i = 1, #self.rescue_data do
		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.rescue_data[i].interact_target, self.controller)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.rescue_data do
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.rescue_data[i].interact_target) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_rescue, self, self.rescue_data[i])
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.rescue_data do
		local data = self.rescue_data[i]

		if not data.in_rescue and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), data.zone_name) then
			data.in_rescue = true
			sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_rescue_zone, self, data)
			return true
		end
	end

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.all_rescue and not self.play_shout_rescue_routine and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's1_ending_rescue_zone') then
		start_coroutine(self.speech_shout_rescue_routine, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- ZoneLeaveEvent
function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.all_rescue and self.play_shout_rescue_routine and
		type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), 's1_ending_rescue_zone') then

		self.play_shout_rescue_routine = false
		return true
	end

	-- 구출하지 않고 존 나가면 발생
	for i = 1, #self.rescue_data do
		local data = self.rescue_data[i]

		if data.in_rescue and not data.is_rescued and not self.return_action and
			type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), data.zone_name) then

			self.return_action = true

			sp_util.start_scene(function()
				local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()

				-- 라나(idle, release): 아직 구해줘야 할 사람이 있어.
				character_util.look_at(oni_girl, get_party_leader())
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl, self, nil,
					'release', nil, 'cw_onigirl_s1_20')

				-- 파티원 전원 1초간 뒷걸음질로 왼쪽으로 1칸 이동
				local align_pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_leave(data.zone_name, get_party_leader(), 2)
				party_util.align_party(align_pos, data.return_direction, 1, 'linear')

				self.return_action = false
			end)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

--- InteractEvent
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.all_rescue and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_trailer()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_trailer, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- TeslaCoilOnOffEvent
function local_class:on_tesla_coil_on_off_event(e)
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local target_coil = get_field_object('up_rescue_tesla_' .. i)
		local other_coil = get_field_object('up_rescue_tesla_' .. i % 2 + 1)

		-- 한쪽 전기가 들어왔을 때 다른쪽 전기도 켜져있으면 문 열림
		if e.IsTurningOn and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.CoilObject, target_coil) and other_coil.Electrocutable.IsPoweredOn then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('up_rescue_door_1'))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('up_rescue_door_2'))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

	-- 라나(smile, victory_get): 절대 다른 마음 있어서 그런건 아니고!

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl, self, nil,
		nil, 'smile', 'cw_onigirl_s1_18')

	-- 엄마(smile, victory_get): 좋았어! 다 같이 힘차게 가보자고!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, nil,
		'victory_get', nil, 'cw_onigirl_s1_18_1')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl)
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(oni_girl, user_party, true)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl_mother)
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(oni_girl_mother, user_party, true)

	-- 카메라 1초간 가디언에게로 이동
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	-- 시작 연출
	music_player:PlayStageIntroMusic()

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(stage.Name), 1)

	party_util.set_direction('right')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'victory_get')

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	-- 퀘스트 마커 추가
	for i = 1, #self.rescue_data do
		local target = self.rescue_data[i].interact_target
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(target.Name, self.quest_spec.QuestId, true, target)
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

--- 구조자한테 상호작용 했을 때
function local_class:interact_rescue(rescue_data)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	local oni_girl_mother = self.get_oni_girl_mother()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(rescue_data.interact_target, self.controller)
	quest_marker_util.remove(rescue_data.interact_target.Name)

	oni_girl_mother.Interactable.Talk = nil

	rescue_data.interact_func(self)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl_mother)
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(oni_girl_mother, user_party, true)

	rescue_data.is_rescued = true

	self.rescue_count = self.rescue_count + 1

	-- 전부 구했을 때 세팅
	if self.rescue_count > 2 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.all_rescue

		local ending_pos = self.get_ending_pos()

		-- 구조자1(left, scared, embarrassed)
		local ending_rescuer_1 = self.get_ending_rescuer(1)
		ending_rescuer_1.Position = ending_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5)
		scene_util.set_direction(ending_rescuer_1, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(ending_rescuer_1, self, 'scared')
		scene_util.set_anim(ending_rescuer_1, self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })

		-- 구조자2(left, damaged, cast2)
		local ending_rescuer_2 = self.get_ending_rescuer(2)
		ending_rescuer_2.Position = ending_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5)
		scene_util.set_direction(ending_rescuer_2, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(ending_rescuer_2, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(ending_rescuer_2, self, 'cast2')

		local trailer = self.get_trailer()
		trailer.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(trailer.Name, self.quest_spec.QuestId, true, trailer)
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

--- 왼쪽 구출 상호작용
function local_class:interact_left_rescue()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()
	local oni_girl_mother = self.get_oni_girl_mother()
	local rescuer_1 = self.get_left_rescuer(1)
	local rescuer_2 = self.get_left_rescuer(2)

	local rescuer_2_move_key = 'rescuer_2_move'
	local oni_girl_mother_move_key = 'oni_girl_mother_move'

	-- 라나 엄마가 구출하는 연출
	local rescue_scene = function()
		local block = get_field_object('left_rescue_push_block')

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(oni_girl_mother, oni_girl_mother.Position + vector(2, 0, 0),
			nil, 2, self, oni_girl_mother_move_key, { locked_dir = 'left' })

		-- 블럭 옮기는 라나 엄마
		coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(2, block.Position, block.Position + vector(2, 0, 0),
			function(_, cur_value)
				block.Position = cur_value
			end)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, oni_girl_mother_move_key)

		-- 구조자2 탈출
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(rescuer_2)

		local rescuer_2_waypoint = wp_util.get_turn_twice_wp(rescuer_2,
			rescuer_2.Position + vector(8, 0, -2), { x = rescuer_2.Position.x + 2 })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(rescuer_2, rescuer_2_waypoint, 4, nil, self, rescuer_2_move_key)

		-- 라나 엄마 이동
		character_util.remove_anim(oni_girl_mother, true)
		character_util.remove_emotion(oni_girl_mother)

		local oni_girl_mother_waypoint = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(oni_girl_mother,
			oni_girl_mother.Position + vector(-4.5, 0, -4))

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(oni_girl_mother, oni_girl_mother_waypoint,
			4, nil, self, oni_girl_mother_move_key, { last_direction = 'left' })
	end

	party_util.align_to_target(rescuer_1, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	-- 라나(idle, release): 이쪽으로 나오세요. 이제 괜찮…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl, self, 'left',
		'release', nil, 'cw_onigirl_s1_21')

	-- 가디언&라나(surprise, idle, jump 1회)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, self, 'surprise')
	party_util.jump(0.5, 0.3)

	start_coroutine(rescue_scene)

	-- 구조자1(attack, release): 야, 임마! 뭐 하다가 이제야 오는거야?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rescuer_1, self, 'right',
		'release', { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'cw_onigirl_s1_22')

	-- 라나(tired, idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, self, 'tired')

	-- 구조자1(attack, cross_arm): 내가 내는 세금이 얼만데… 나랏돈 받아먹는 놈들이 굼떠가지고는…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rescuer_1, self, 'right',
		'cross_arm', nil, 'cw_onigirl_s1_23')

	-- 다음 동작들 동시에 실행
	-- 가디언&라나 0.1초간 위로 0.3칸 올라간 뒤 (down, surprise, idle)
	local move_key = 'up_move'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.3),
		nil, 0.1, self, move_key, { locked_dir = 'down' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(oni_girl, oni_girl.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.3),
		nil, 0.1, self, move_key, { locked_dir = 'down' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	-- 구조자1 3초간 카메라 오른쪽 바깥으로 이동
	local rescuer_1_waypoint = {
		rescuer_1.Position + vector(5, 0, 0),
		screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', rescuer_1.Position, 1.5)
	}

	local rescuer_1_speed = 5

	wp_util.move_async(rescuer_1, rescuer_1_waypoint, rescuer_1_speed, nil, { callback = function(waypoint_index)
		if waypoint_index == 0 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
			character_util.jump(rescuer_1, 1.5, 3 / rescuer_1_speed)
		end
	end })

	character_util.set_active_state(rescuer_1, 'disabled')

	-- 가디언(right, idle, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')

	-- 라나(left, tired, sing): $name, 괜찮아?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl, self, 'left',
		'sing', { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'cw_onigirl_s1_23_1')

	-- 라나(tired, release): 저런 사람들이 종종 있더라. 나도 엄마 따라다니면서 몇 번 봤었어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl, self, nil,
		'release', nil, 'cw_onigirl_s1_24')

	-- 라나(tired, bomb_idle): 해봤자 좋은 소리도 못 듣는걸 왜 엄마는 찾아다니면서 하는걸까?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl, self, nil,
		'bomb_idle', nil, 'cw_onigirl_s1_25')

	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl, 'right')

	-- 카메라 오른쪽으로 3칸 이동
	camera_util.move_async(leader.Position + vector(3, 0, 0), 1)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, oni_girl_mother_move_key)

	-- 엄마(left, doyagao, bomb_idle): 그런걸 바라고 하는게 아니니까.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, 'left',
		'bomb_idle', 'doyagao', 'cw_onigirl_s1_26')

	-- 엄마(smile, release): 난 그냥 사람들이 안전하게 가족들 품으로 돌아가는걸 보면…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, 'left',
		'release', { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'cw_onigirl_s1_27')

	-- 엄마(smile, cast2): 마음 속에 뭔가 채워지는 기분이 들거든.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, nil,
		'cast2', nil, 'cw_onigirl_s1_28')

	-- 엄마(idle, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl_mother)

	-- 라나(left, tired, bomb_idle): 그 기분 나도 좀 느껴보고 싶네…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl, self, 'left',
		'bomb_idle', { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'cw_onigirl_s1_28_1')

	-- 라나(tired, release): 그럼 이 재미없는 구호 활동도 좀 즐기게 되지 않을까?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl, self, nil,
		'release', nil, 'cw_onigirl_s1_29')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl_mother)

	-- 카메라 1초간 가디언에게 이동
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, rescuer_2_move_key)

	character_util.set_active_state(rescuer_2, 'disabled')
end

--- 오른쪽 구출 상호작용
function local_class:interact_right_rescue()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()
	local oni_girl_mother = self.get_oni_girl_mother()
	local rescuer_1 = self.get_right_rescuer(1)
	local rescuer_2 = self.get_right_rescuer(2)

	local rescuer_2_move_key = 'rescuer_2_move'

	-- 라나 엄마가 구출하는 연출
	local rescue_scene = function()
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl_mother)

		-- 구조자2 탈출
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(rescuer_2)
		character_util.mario_jump_async(rescuer_2, 'left')

		local oni_girl_mother_waypoint = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(oni_girl_mother,
			oni_girl_mother.Position + vector(-1, 0, 1), true)

		wp_util.move_async(oni_girl_mother, oni_girl_mother_waypoint, 4)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl_mother)
		character_util.set_direction(oni_girl_mother, 'right')

		local rescuer_2_waypoint = wp_util.get_turn_twice_wp(rescuer_2,
			rescuer_2.Position + vector(-12, 0, 2), { x = rescuer_2.Position.x - 6 })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(rescuer_2, rescuer_2_waypoint,
			4, nil, self, rescuer_2_move_key)
	end

	local move_key = 'start_move'
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, rescuer_1.Position + vector(-0.75, 0, 0),
		nil, 1, self, move_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(oni_girl, rescuer_1.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, 0),
		nil, 1, self, move_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	-- 가디언(right, attack, push) 0.3초 대기
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'push', upper = true })
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 가디언&구조자1 shake 지속
	character_util.shake(leader, 0.02, 9999)
	character_util.shake(rescuer_1, 0.02, 9999)

	-- 가디언&구조자1 1초간 왼쪽으로 0.5칸 이동. 0.5초 대기. 2회 반복.
	local move_rescue = function()
		move_key = 'rescue_move'

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, leader.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
			nil, 1, self, move_key, { locked_dir = 'right' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(rescuer_1, rescuer_1.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
			nil, 1, self, move_key, { locked_dir = 'left' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
	end

	move_rescue()

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	move_rescue()

	rescue_scene()

	-- 가디언(idle, idle)&구조자1 shake 중지
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader, true)
	character_util.stop_shake(leader)

	character_util.stop_shake(rescuer_1)

	-- 구조자1(idle, idle, mario_jump) 0.5초 대기
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(rescuer_1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(rescuer_1,'left')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 구조자1(idle, sing): 아이고, 감사합니다…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rescuer_1, self, nil,
		'sing', nil, 'cw_onigirl_s1_31')

	-- 구조자1(idle, release): 갑자기 위에서 돌무더기가 떨어지는 바람에…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rescuer_1, self, nil,
		'release', nil, 'cw_onigirl_s1_32')

	-- 구조자1(surprise, cast)
	scene_util.set_emotion(rescuer_1, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(rescuer_1, self, 'cast')

	-- 엄마(surprise, idle, jump 1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_mother, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(oni_girl_mother)

	-- 라나(right, attack, release): 그러게 평소에 달리기 연습을 열심히 했어야죠!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl, self, nil,
		'release', 'attack', 'cw_onigirl_s1_33')

	-- 구조자1(tired, idle)

--- 위쪽 구출 지역에 입장
function local_class:enter_up_rescue()
	local oni_girl_mother = self.get_oni_girl_mother()
	local rescuer_1 = self.get_up_rescuer(1)

	-- 엄마가 파티에서 이탈
	local up_rescue_center = self.get_up_rescue_pos()

	local oni_girl_mother_origin_pos = oni_girl_mother.Position

	local waypoint_1 = wp_util.get_turn_twice_wp(oni_girl_mother, up_rescue_center, { z = up_rescue_center.z - 3 })

	-- 아래 유틸을 사용하기 위해 임시로 위치 이동
	oni_girl_mother.Position = up_rescue_center

	local waypoint_2 = wp_util.get_turn_twice_wp(oni_girl_mother,
		up_rescue_center + vector(-2.5, 0, 4.5), { z = up_rescue_center.z + 3.5 })

	for i = 1, #waypoint_2 do
		table.insert(waypoint_1, waypoint_2[i])
	end

	oni_girl_mother.Position = oni_girl_mother_origin_pos

	wp_util.move(oni_girl_mother, waypoint_1, 9, nil, {
		run = true,
		end_callback = function()
			-- right, attack, eat
			character_util.set_direction(oni_girl_mother, 'right')
			scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_mother, self, 'attack')
			scene_util.set_anim(oni_girl_mother, self, 'eat')

			-- 원라인: 금방 열어드릴게요!
			oni_girl_mother.Interactable.Talk = 'cw_onigirl_s1_46'
			oni_girl_mother.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_equipping_01'

			character_util.set_active_state(oni_girl_mother, 'enabled')
		end
	})

	-- 구조해야 할 대상 보여줌
	-- 카메라 1초간 구조자 1에게 이동
	camera_util.move_async(rescuer_1.Position, 1)

	-- 구조자1(left, tired, hurt): 이대로 갇혀서 죽는건가…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rescuer_1, self, 'left',
		{ name = 'hurt', keep = true },
		{ name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'cw_onigirl_s1_46_1')

	-- 카메라 1초간 가디언에게 돌아옴
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

--- 트레일러 상호작용 시
function local_class:interact_trailer()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	self.play_shout_rescue_routine = false

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()
	local oni_girl_mother = self.get_oni_girl_mother()
	local rescuer_1 = self.get_ending_rescuer(1)
	local rescuer_2 = self.get_ending_rescuer(2)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(rescuer_1)

	local trailer = self.get_trailer()
	quest_marker_util.remove(trailer.Name)
	trailer.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	local ending_pos = self.get_ending_pos()

	-- 구조자1(scared, cast)
	scene_util.set_emotion(rescuer_1, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(rescuer_1, self, 'cast')

	-- 구조자2(damaged, cast)
	scene_util.set_emotion(rescuer_2, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(rescuer_2, self, 'cast')

	-- 다음 동작들 1.5초간 동시에 실행

	-- 모든 파티원들 이미지와 같이 트레일러 아래에 정렬 (up, push)
	local leader_waypoint
	local leader_push_pos = ending_pos + vector(-2, 0, -3)

	local oni_girl_waypoint
	local oni_girl_push_pos = leader_push_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -0.5)

	local oni_girl_mother_waypoint
	local oni_girl_mother_push_pos = leader_push_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5)

	local move_key = 'push_align'
	local move_duration = 1.5

	if leader.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		leader_waypoint = leader_push_pos
		oni_girl_waypoint = oni_girl_push_pos
		oni_girl_mother_waypoint = oni_girl_mother_push_pos

	else
		local target_pos = leader_push_pos + vector(-2, 0, 0)

		leader_waypoint = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(leader, target_pos, true)
		table.insert(leader_waypoint, leader_push_pos)

		oni_girl_waypoint = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(oni_girl, target_pos, true)
		table.insert(oni_girl_waypoint, oni_girl_push_pos)

		oni_girl_mother_waypoint = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(oni_girl_mother, target_pos, true)
		table.insert(oni_girl_mother_waypoint, oni_girl_mother_push_pos)
	end

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, leader_waypoint, nil, move_duration, self, move_key,
		{ run = true, last_direction = 'up' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(oni_girl, oni_girl_waypoint, nil, move_duration, self, move_key,
		{ run = true, last_direction = 'up' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(oni_girl_mother, oni_girl_mother_waypoint, nil, move_duration, self, move_key,
		{ run = true, last_direction = 'up' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'push', upper = true })
	scene_util.set_anim(oni_girl, self, { name = 'push', upper = true })
	scene_util.set_anim(oni_girl_mother, self, { name = 'push', upper = true })

	-- 트레일러와 파티원 전원 1초간 위로 1칸 이동. 사람들 shake
	-- 트레일러 미는 액션
	local move_trailer = function()
		move_key = 'trailer_move'
		local trailer_move_duration = 1

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_push_rock_unit_01')

		-- 리더
		character_util.shake(leader, 0.04, trailer_move_duration)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader,
			leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), nil, trailer_move_duration, self, move_key)

		-- 라나
		character_util.shake(oni_girl, 0.04, trailer_move_duration)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(oni_girl,
			oni_girl.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), nil, trailer_move_duration, self, move_key)

		-- 라나 엄마
		character_util.shake(oni_girl_mother, 0.04, trailer_move_duration)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(oni_girl_mother,
			oni_girl_mother.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), nil, trailer_move_duration, self, move_key)

		-- 트레일러
		coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(trailer_move_duration, trailer.Position,
			trailer.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
			function(_, cur_value)
				trailer.Position = cur_value
			end)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')

	qte_util.swipe('up')

	move_trailer()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')

	qte_util.swipe('up')

	move_trailer()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl_mother, true)

	-- 모든 파티원들 1초간 길 왼쪽으로 일렬로 정렬
	party_util.align_party(leader.Position, 'left', 1, 'linear')

	-- 엄마(right, idle, release): 이제 됐어요. 이쪽으로 나오세…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, nil,
		'release', nil, 'cw_onigirl_s1_59')

	-- 구조자 1(down, scared, embarrassed, jump 2회): 길이 났다! 이제 살았어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rescuer_1, self, 'down',
		'embarrassed', { name = 'scared', keep = true }, 'cw_onigirl_s1_60')

	-- 구조자 1(down, scared, cast)
	scene_util.set_anim(rescuer_1, self, 'cast')

	-- 구조자 2(damaged, release): 어서 도망쳐!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rescuer_2, self, nil,
		'release', 'damaged', 'cw_onigirl_s1_61')

	-- 다음 동작들 동시에 실행

	-- 모든 파티원들(surprise, idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_mother, self, 'surprise')

	-- 구조자 1 / 2 3초간 카메라 바깥으로 달려서 이동
	local end_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', ending_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, 0), -3.5)
	local move_speed = 7

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_start_opening_zone') then

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.rescue_start

		sp_util.start_scene(self.opening, self)
		return true
	end

	if not self.is_game_over and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.rescue_start and e.FullEnter and
		self.rescuer_data[e.FieldObject] and self.rescuer_data[e.FieldObject].zone_name == e.Zone.Name then

		self.rescuer_data[e.FieldObject].in_rescue_zone = true

		attack_range_util.hide(self.rescue_zone_attack_range[e.Zone.Name])

		start_coroutine(self.enter_rescue_zone, self, e.FieldObject)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.rescue_start and not self.rock_zone_data.in_zone and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.rock_zone_data.name) then

		self.rock_zone_data.in_zone = true

		start_coroutine(self.check_crash_rock_routine, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- ZoneLeaveEvent
function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.rescue_start and self.rock_zone_data.in_zone and
		type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), self.rock_zone_data.name) then

		self.rock_zone_data.in_zone = false

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- InteractEvent
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local left_jumping_interactable = self.get_left_jumping_interactable()

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, left_jumping_interactable) then
		start_coroutine(self.jump_action_scene, self, left_jumping_interactable)
		return true
	end

	local right_jumping_interactable = self.get_right_jumping_interactable()

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, right_jumping_interactable) then
		start_coroutine(self.jump_action_scene, self, right_jumping_interactable)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- HoldUpEvent
function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	if self.rescuer_data[e.Target] then

		local target = e.Target
		local zone_name = self.rescuer_data[e.Target].zone_name
		local marker_pos = field_util.get_zone(zone_name).Bounds.center

		character_util.spine_rotate(target, 0, 0)
		target.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, 0, 0)

		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(target.Name, self.controller.quest_id, true, marker_pos)

		attack_range_util.show(self.rescue_zone_attack_range[zone_name])

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- SwitchOnOffEvent
function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	if e.IsTurningOn then
		for i = 1, #self.switch_and_door_name[e.SwitchObject] do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.switch_and_door_name[e.SwitchObject][i]))
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:opening()

	local oni_girl_mother = self.get_oni_girl_mother()

	-- 스크린 이펙트 생성
	local screen_effect = self.fx.spark_screen():Instantiate(leader.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, stage_camera.Transform)
	local screen_effect_particle_systems = screen_effect:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem))

	self.screen_effect_data = {
		effect = screen_effect,
		particle_systems = screen_effect_particle_systems
	}

	for index = 0, self.screen_effect_data.particle_systems.Length - 1 do
		local effect_particle_system = self.screen_effect_data.particle_systems[index]
		self.screen_effect_data[effect_particle_system] = {
			origin_speed = effect_particle_system.main.simulationSpeed
		}
	end

	-- 정렬
	local opening_pos = self.get_opening_pos()

	local move_key = 'align_move'
	local move_duration = 1

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, opening_pos + vector(-1, 0, -1),
		nil, move_duration, self, move_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(oni_girl, opening_pos + vector(-1, 0, 1),
		nil, move_duration, self, move_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(oni_girl_mother, opening_pos,
		nil, move_duration, self, move_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

		citizen = 'cw_demon_noble_male',
		evacuee_1 = 'cw_demon_oldman',
		evacuee_2 = 'cw_civilian_business_male'
	})

	local citizen = dynamic_npc.citizen
	citizen.Position = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', opening_pos, 8)

	local evacuee_1 = dynamic_npc.evacuee_1
	evacuee_1.Position = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right',
		opening_pos + vector(0, 0, 3), 8)

	local evacuee_2 = dynamic_npc.evacuee_2
	evacuee_2.Position = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right',
		opening_pos + vector(0, 0, -3), 8)

	-- 도망 경로 생성
	local get_runaway_waypoint = function(target)
		return wp_util.get_turn_twice_wp(target, opening_pos + vector(-14.5, 0, -1),
			{ x = opening_pos.x - 6.5 })
	end

	local runaway_speed = 7
	scene_util.set_emotion(evacuee_1, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(evacuee_1, self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })
	wp_util.move(evacuee_1, get_runaway_waypoint(evacuee_1), runaway_speed, nil)

	camera_util.move(opening_pos, move_duration)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	scene_util.set_emotion(evacuee_2, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(evacuee_2, self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })
	wp_util.move(evacuee_2, get_runaway_waypoint(evacuee_2), runaway_speed, nil)

	-- 엄마(tired, question): 다들 도망가고 있잖아…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, nil,
		'question', { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'cw_onigirl_s2_1')

	-- 엄마(tired, release): 안쪽에 무슨 일 있나?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, nil,

	-- 시민 2초간 엄마 오른쪽 1칸 옆으로 이동

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(citizen, self, nil,

	local truck_pos = self.get_explosion_truck().Position

	local truck_gray_smoke_effect = self.fx.gray_smoke():Instantiate(truck_pos + vector(1, 0.5, 0.5))
	local truck_fire_smoke_effect = self.fx.fire_smoke():Instantiate(truck_pos + vector(1, 0.5, 0.5))

	-- 트럭 빨갛게 깜빡 거림
	local mpb = CS.UnityEngine.MaterialPropertyBlock()
	local mesh_renderer = truck.Transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))

	local is_play_truck_red_pulse = true

	start_coroutine(function()
		local time_passed = 0

		while is_play_truck_red_pulse do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local x = math.abs(math.sin(time_passed))

			mpb:SetColor('_Color', unity_color({ 1, x, x, 1 }))
			mesh_renderer:SetPropertyBlock(mpb)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		mpb:Clear()

--- 자동차 위로 뛰는 액션 연출
function local_class:jump_action_scene(jumping_interactable)
	sp_util.enter_scene()

	self.is_play_action = true

	local oni_girl_mother = self.get_oni_girl_mother()

	-- 점프 연출
	local jump_action = function(duration, target_pos, height)
		local jump_height = lua_helper.get_or_default(height, 3)

		scene_util.set_anim(oni_girl_mother, self, 'get')
		scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_mother, self, 'attack')

		coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(duration, oni_girl_mother.Position, target_pos,
			function(progress, cur_value)

				local h = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * jump_height
				local cur_pos = cur_value + h * unity_class.vector3.up

				character_util.set_position(oni_girl_mother, cur_pos, true)
			end
		)

		character_util.remove_anim(oni_girl_mother)
	end

	wp_util.move_async(oni_girl_mother, jumping_interactable.Position, 4)

	local jumping_end_pos

	-- 자동차 기준으로 플레이어 위치 판단
	if jumping_interactable.Position.x < self.jumping_pos[2].x then
		character_util.set_direction(oni_girl_mother, 'right')

		jumping_end_pos = {
			self.jumping_pos[2],
			self.jumping_pos[3],
			self.jumping_pos[4]
		}

	else
		character_util.set_direction(oni_girl_mother, 'left')

		jumping_end_pos = {
			self.jumping_pos[3],
			self.jumping_pos[2],
			self.jumping_pos[1]
		}
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	jump_action(0.4, jumping_end_pos[1])

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	jump_action(0.4, jumping_end_pos[2])

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lights_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(oni_girl_mother, self, 'boong_attack_ready_loop')
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(2.5, 0.7)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 슬로우 연출
	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.05)

		time_util.mod('slow', 0.05)
		camera_util.resize_to_default(0.03)
		wait_for_sec(0.04)

		time_util.unmod('slow')
	end)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_raincoat_light_01')
	jump_action(0.6, jumping_end_pos[3], 4)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl_mother)

	self.is_play_action = false

	-- 게임 오버면 컨트롤 풀리지 않도록
	if self.is_game_over then
		return
	end

	self:disable_throw_control()

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

--- 구출 시작
function local_class:start_rescue()
	-- 타이머 세팅
	local timer_duration = 180
	timer_util.start_timer({
		duration = timer_duration,
		alarm = { timer_duration - 10 },
		handler = self,
		callback = 'game_over'
	})

	timer_util.set_position_based_on_anchor(vector(0, -100))

	self:slow_effect_setting()

	self.is_game_over = false
	self.is_play_action = false

	self:disable_throw_control()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		name = 'ondemand/v2_75_civilwar/audio:bgm_civilwar_onigirl',
		state = 'event',
		mix = 0
	})
end

--- 구출 실패 시
function local_class:game_over(e)
	if not e.IsComplete then
		self.ticking_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gimmick_ticking_loop_01', loop = true })
		return
	end

	timer_util.end_timer(self)

	start_coroutine(function()
		sp_util.enter_scene()

		self.is_game_over = true

		while self.is_play_action do

			if self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.rescue_start then
				return
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if self.ticking_loop_sfx then
			music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.ticking_loop_sfx)
			self.ticking_loop_sfx = nil
		end

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })

		local oni_girl_mother = self.get_oni_girl_mother()

		-- 엄마(down, surprise, embarrassed)
		-- NPC 들고 있는 경우 embarrassed 무시
		scene_util.set_direction(oni_girl_mother, 'down')
		scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_mother, self, 'surprise')
		scene_util.set_anim(oni_girl_mother, self, 'embarrassed')

		-- 카메라 shake (0.3, 1.5)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_building_explosion_01')
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 1.5)

		-- 0.5초 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		-- 카메라 줌인(3, 1) + 1초간 화면 페이드 아웃

		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		-- 슬로우 이펙트 클리어
		for effect, _ in pairs(self.slow_effects) do
			self:dispose_slow_effect(effect)
		end

		self.slow_effects = {}

		-- 구출 세팅
		self:rescue_setting()

		-- 구출한 수 초기화
		self.rescue_count = 0

		self:close_battle_gate()

		for _, attack_range in pairs(self.rescue_zone_attack_range) do
			attack_range_util.hide(attack_range)
		end

		oni_girl_mother.Position = self.oni_girl_mother_origin_pos
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl_mother)
		character_util.set_direction(oni_girl_mother, 'right')
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		local amb_sun_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_amb_sun_01',
			fade_in_time = 1,
			loop = true,
			volume = 0.7
		})

		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(amb_sun_loop_sfx, 1)

		self:start_rescue()

		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, oni_girl_mother)
	end)
end

--- 구출 지역에 도착했을 때
function local_class:enter_rescue_zone(target)
	sp_util.enter_scene({ release_hold = false })

	self.is_play_action = true

	local oni_girl_mother = self.get_oni_girl_mother()

	quest_marker_util.remove(target.Name)

	local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_' .. target.Name .. '_pos')
	character_util.clear_holdup_state(oni_girl_mother, target)

	character_util.set_active_state(target, 'visible')

	self.rescue_count = self.rescue_count + 1

	if #self.rescuers <= self.rescue_count then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.all_rescue
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_02')
	scene_util.set_anim(oni_girl_mother, self, { name = 'throw', keep = true, loop = false })

	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.remove_anim(oni_girl_mother)

		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.rescue_start and not self.is_game_over then
			self:disable_throw_control()
			sp_util.exit_scene(nil, oni_girl_mother)
		end
	end)

	local start_xz_speed = 15
	local xz_speed = start_xz_speed

	local start_y_speed = -0.5
	local y_speed = start_y_speed

	local start_rotate_speed = 360 * 2
	local rotate_speed = start_rotate_speed
	local rotate_dir = 1

	-- 위치에 따른 회전 방향 변경
	if target.Position.x < target_pos.x then
		rotate_dir = -1
	end

	local start_pos_xz = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position)
	local end_pos_xz = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos)
	local move_dir = (end_pos_xz - start_pos_xz).normalized

	local cur_angle = target.SpineController.RotateAngle

	local ratio = 15
	local time_passed = 0

	-- 던져지는 연출
	while xz_speed > 0 do
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		-- 스파인 회전
		cur_angle = cur_angle + rotate_speed * rotate_dir * unity_class.time.deltaTime
		character_util.spine_rotate(target, cur_angle, 0)

		-- 이동
		local cur_xz = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position) + xz_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime * move_dir
		local cur_y = target.Position.y + y_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime

		character_util.set_position(target, vector_util.get_x0z(cur_xz, cur_y), true)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 감속
		xz_speed = (start_xz_speed - 10 * time_passed) / (ratio * time_passed + 1)
		y_speed = (start_y_speed - 0.1 * time_passed) / (ratio * time_passed + 1)
		rotate_speed = (start_rotate_speed - 90 * time_passed) / (ratio * time_passed + 1)
	end

	self.is_play_action = false

	-- 전부 구출 여부
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.all_rescue then
		self:success_rescue()
	end
end

--- 구출 성공 연출
function local_class:success_rescue()
	if self.ticking_loop_sfx then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.ticking_loop_sfx)
		self.ticking_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	timer_util.end_timer(self)

	-- 엄마(left, attack, idle) 0.5초 대기
	scene_util.set_direction(oni_girl_mother, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_mother, self, 'attack')

	-- 엄마(right, attack, idle) 0.7초 대기

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_shadow_beast_rush_01')
	self.thunder_effect:Dispose()

	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_mother, self, 'damaged')

	-- 2초 대기

	-- 카메라 shake (0.2, 0.1)

	-- 엄마(side, attack, frustration) 1초 대기

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 다음 동작 동시에 진행
	-- 카메라 줌인 (2, 3)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2, 3)

	-- 카메라 shake(0.1, 999)
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 9999)

	-- 엄마 몸에 전기 이펙트 다시 생성
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lights_01')
	self.thunder_effect = self.fx.cloud_thunder_player():Instantiate(oni_girl_mother.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.3),

	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 카메라 줌인 시작 2초 후 1초간 흰색으로 페이드 아웃. 이후 페이드 인

	-- 전기 궤적과 함께 화면 왼쪽 밖으로 빠르게 사라지는 라나와 가디언
	-- 0.5초간 카메라 이동. 라나와 가디언 어리둥절하게 앉아 있음

	for effect, _ in pairs(self.slow_effects) do
		self:dispose_slow_effect(effect)
	end

	self.slow_effects = nil

	-- 스크린 이펙트 스피드 원복
	for index = 0, self.screen_effect_data.particle_systems.Length - 1 do
		local effect_particle_system = self.screen_effect_data.particle_systems[index]
		local main = effect_particle_system.main

		main.simulationSpeed = self.screen_effect_data[effect_particle_system].origin_speed
	end

	-- 이동 시키면 꼬리 이펙트가 갑자기 생겨서 제거 후 다시 생성

	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.move_async(self.opening_scene_pos_data.camera, 0)

	oni_girl.Position = self.opening_scene_pos_data.oni_girl
	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(oni_girl, self, 'embarrassed')

	knight.Position = self.opening_scene_pos_data.knight
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'embarrassed')

	local first_fragments_target_pos = oni_girl.Position + vector(3, 0, -1)
	self:fall_fragments(first_fragments_target_pos)

	screen_util.fade_in(0.5, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	-- 라나에게 화면 전환
	-- 주위에 폭발 일어나던 시간대
	-- 전기 궤적과 함께 화면 왼쪽 밖으로 빠르게 사라지는 라나와 가디언
	-- 0.5초간 카메라 이동. 라나와 가디언 어리둥절하게 앉아 있음

	-- 카메라 shake (0.4, 0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)

	-- 1 위치에 FX_Explosion_Bomb_new
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')

	-- 라나&가디언(right, surprise, embarrassed, jump)

	character_util.normal_jump(knight)

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	local second_fragments_target_pos = oni_girl.Position + vector(-5, 0, -1)
	self:fall_fragments(second_fragments_target_pos)

	-- 라나&가디언(left, surprise, embarrassed, jump)
	scene_util.set_direction(oni_girl, 'left')
	character_util.normal_jump(oni_girl)

	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left')
	character_util.normal_jump(knight)

	-- 카메라 shake (0.4, 0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)

	-- 2 위치에 FX_Obj_Car_Explosion_small
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	local car_explosion_effect = self.fx.car_explosion():Instantiate(second_fragments_target_pos)
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	self:fall_fragments(stage_camera.LookAtPosition)

	-- 라나(right, damaged, prostrate, jump)
	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(oni_girl, self, 'prostrate')

	-- 가디언(left, scared, prostrate, jump)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'prostrate')

	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)

	-- 3 위치에 fx_applebomb_explosion
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_02')
	local applebomb_explosion_effect = self.fx.applebomb_explosion():Instantiate(stage_camera.LookAtPosition)

	local oni_girl_trail_effect = self.fx.onigirl_trail():Instantiate(oni_girl.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
		unity_class.quaternion.identity, oni_girl.Transform)

	local knight_trail_effect = self.fx.onigirl_trail():Instantiate(knight.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
		unity_class.quaternion.identity, knight.Transform)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_aircraft_11')
	wp_util.move_async(knight, self.current_target_pos_data.knight, self.oni_girl_mother_speed)

	knight.Position = self.current_target_pos_data.knight + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'seat', mix_duration = 0 })
	wait_for_sec(0.05)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_aircraft_11')
	wp_util.move_async(oni_girl, self.current_target_pos_data.oni_girl, self.oni_girl_mother_speed)

	-- 라나는 반시계 방향으로 돌아가고 있음
	oni_girl.Position = self.current_target_pos_data.oni_girl + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(oni_girl, self, { name = 'seat', mix_duration = 0 })
	wait_for_sec(1.2)

	camera_util.move_async(oni_girl.Position + vector(3, 0, 0), 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	oni_girl_trail_effect:Dispose()
	knight_trail_effect:Dispose()

	-- 액티비티에서 구한 NPC들 사용. 회전 초기화 / 동작 유지
	-- 지정된 위치에서 오른쪽으로 10칸 옆에 세팅
	-- NPC 200의 속도로 지정된 위치로 이동
	-- 모든 NPC가 이동할 때 까지 반복
	local rescuers_pos_center = oni_girl.Position + vector(6, 0, -0.5)

	-- 구조자 최종 위치
	local rescuers_target_pos = {
		rescuers_pos_center + vector(-2, 0, 1),
		rescuers_pos_center + vector(-1.5, 0, 2.5),
		rescuers_pos_center + vector(0.5, 0, 2),
		rescuers_pos_center + vector(2, 0, 1),
		rescuers_pos_center + vector(-2.5, 0, 0),
		rescuers_pos_center + vector(0, 0, 0),
		rescuers_pos_center + vector(1.5, 0, -1.5),
		rescuers_pos_center + vector(-1.5, 0, -2),
		rescuers_pos_center + vector(1, 0, -1.5),
		rescuers_pos_center + vector(0.5, 0, -2),
	}

	for rescuer in pairs(self.rescuers) do
		-- 구조자 세팅
		character_util.spine_rotate(rescuer, 0, 0)
		character_util.set_direction(rescuer, direction_util.to_side_dir(rescuer.Direction))
		scene_util.set_anim(rescuer, self, 'prostrate')
		scene_util.set_emotion(rescuer, self, 'damaged')

		-- 정해진 최종 위치에서 랜덤 선택
		local index = random_util.get_random_int(1, #rescuers_target_pos)
		local target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(rescuers_target_pos[index], rescuer.Position.y)

		-- 꼬리 이펙트가 너무 멀면 안 보여서 최종 위치 근처로 이동 시킴
		character_util.set_position(rescuer,
			target_pos + (vector_util.get_x0z(rescuer.Position) - target_pos).normalized * 7, true)

		local trail = self.fx.onigirl_trail():Instantiate(rescuer.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, rescuer.Transform)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_huntress_roll_02')
		character_util.move_to_async(rescuer,
			vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos, rescuer.Position.y), 0.08)

		trail:Dispose()

		table.remove(rescuers_target_pos, index)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 엄마 0.1초간 카메라 오른쪽 밖에서 라나 오른쪽 1칸 위치로 이동
	-- 엄마(left, attack, jingak 마지막 프레임)

	local oni_girl_mother_trail_effect = self.fx.onigirl_trail():Instantiate(oni_girl_mother.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),

	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_mother, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(oni_girl_mother, self, { name = 'jingak', scale = 99 })

	local end_pos = oni_girl.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)

	local time_passed = 0

	local start_speed = 90 + (stage_camera.HalfWidth - 7) * 8
	local speed = start_speed

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_aircraft_10')

	while true do
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 이동
		local cur_pos = oni_girl_mother.Position + speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime * unity_class.vector3.left

		if cur_pos.x < end_pos.x then
			break
		else
			oni_girl_mother.Position = cur_pos
		end

		-- 감속
		speed = math.max((start_speed - 50 * time_passed) / (25 * time_passed + 1), 2)
	end

	oni_girl_mother.Position = end_pos

	-- 공중에 나타난 NPC들 동시에 떨어짐. 1.5초 대기
	-- 자유낙하
	-- 바닥에 닿을 때 FX_hit 출력
	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		while #self.rescuers > 0 do
			local move_dist = unity_class.time.deltaTime * 3.5 * unity_class.vector3.down

			for rescuer in pairs(self.rescuers) do
				local target_pos = rescuer.Position + move_dist

				if target_pos.y < 0 then
					-- 땅에 착지
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')

					character_util.set_position(rescuer, vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos), true)

					self.fx.hit():Instantiate(rescuer.Position + vector(0, 0.05, -0.05))
					self.rescuers:remove(rescuer)

				else
					character_util.set_position(rescuer, target_pos, false)
				end
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end)

	-- 0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	oni_girl_mother_trail_effect:Dispose()
	self.thunder_effect:Dispose()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_building_explosion_01')

	local fire_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_fire_01',
		fade_in_time = 1,
		loop = true,
		volume = 0.7
	})

	-- 1초간 카메라 라나와 엄마 사이로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(oni_girl_mother.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 1)

	-- 엄마: 허억… 허억…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_02')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl_mother, self, nil,
		nil, nil, 'cw_onigirl_s2_24')

	-- 엄마(damaged, seat, shake 중지) 0.5초 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
	character_util.stop_shake(oni_girl_mother)
	scene_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_mother, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(oni_girl_mother, self, 'seat')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	character_util.mario_jump_new(knight, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(oni_girl, 'right')

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	-- 라나: 엄마?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(oni_girl, self, nil,
		nil, nil, 'cw_onigirl_s2_25')

	-- 기사를 리더로 변경
	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	param.HidePreviousParty = false
	param.MoveCamera = false
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(knight, param, true)

	-- 가디언 선택지
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- (mercy) 너희 어머니 진짜 빠르시다!
		{ 'cw_onigirl_s2_26', 'mercy' },
		-- (brutal) 뭐지? 버근가?
		{ 'cw_onigirl_s2_27', 'brutal' }
	})

function local_class:check_crash_rock_routine()
	while self.rock_zone_data.in_zone do
		for i = 1, #self.rocks_data do
			local data = self.rocks_data[i]

			if data.active and bounds_util.is_overlapping_xz(data.rock.Bounds, get_party_leader().Bounds) then
				camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)

				music_player_util.play_sfx({
					sfx_name = '02_explosion_05',
					play_pos = data.rock.Position,
					type_priority = 'event',
					player_priority = 'npc'
				})

				self:instantiate_slow_effect(self.fx.rock_destroy(), data.rock.Position, 15, { life_duration = 30 })

				data.rock.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				data.active = false
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

--- 슬로우 이펙트 생성
function local_class:instantiate_slow_effect(effect_pool, pos, slow_ratio, arg)
	local effect = effect_pool:Instantiate(pos)
	local life_duration = lua_helper.get_value(arg, 'life_duration', 9999999)
	local apply_time = lua_helper.get_value(arg, 'apply_time', 0.2)

	local effect_data = {
		instantiate_time = unity_class.time.time,
		slow_ratio = slow_ratio,
		is_slow = false,
		life_duration = life_duration,
		apply_time = apply_time,
		--- 파티클 시스템 접근
		particle_systems = effect:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem))
	}

	self.slow_effects[effect] = effect_data
end

--- 이펙트 슬로우 매니저
function local_class:slow_effect_manager()
	while self.current_section_state == self.section_state.rescue_start do
		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

		for effect, effect_data in pairs(self.slow_effects) do

			-- 0.1초 뒤에 슬로우
			if not effect_data.is_slow and cur_time - effect_data.instantiate_time > effect_data.apply_time then

				effect_data.is_slow = true

				self:change_effect_speed(effect)
			end

			-- life_duration 지나면 이펙트 제거
			if cur_time - effect_data.instantiate_time > effect_data.life_duration then
				self:dispose_slow_effect(effect)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

--- 이펙트 속도 변경
function local_class:change_effect_speed(effect, reset)
	local effect_data = self.slow_effects[effect]

	for i = 0, effect_data.particle_systems.Length - 1 do
		local effect_particle_system = effect_data.particle_systems[i]
		local main = effect_particle_system.main

		if not effect_data[effect_particle_system] then
			effect_data[effect_particle_system] = {
				origin_speed = main.simulationSpeed
			}
		end

		if reset then
			-- dispose 할 때 원복
			main.simulationSpeed = effect_data[effect_particle_system].origin_speed
		else
			main.simulationSpeed = main.simulationSpeed / effect_data.slow_ratio
		end
	end
end

--- 이펙트 제거
function local_class:dispose_slow_effect(effect)
	self:change_effect_speed(effect, true)
	effect:Dispose()
	self.slow_effects[effect] = nil
end

		self.rescue:Dispose()
		self.rescue = nil
	end

	if self.engineer_aura ~= nil then
		self.engineer_aura:Dispose()
		self.engineer_aura = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if not self.is_already_enter_rescue_zone and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'rescue_zone') then
		self.is_already_enter_rescue_zone = true
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_rescue_zone, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local rescue_npc = self.get_female(1)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, rescue_npc) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_rescue_npc, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

	quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0, false,

end

function local_class:shake_female()
	local female = self.get_female(1)
	local time_passed = 0
	local shake_duration = 1
	local duration = 1.5
	local magnitude = 0.03

	while self.is_shake_female do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= duration then
			time_passed = 0
			character_util.shake(female, magnitude, shake_duration)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

return local_class

end

	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if self.current_state <= self.section_state.puzzle_start and
			event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.PlayerDetectedEvent) and self.is_detected == false then

		self.is_detected = true
		self.cw_util:start_scene(self.detected_event, self, e.Detector.Name)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state < self.section_state.puzzle_start and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_android()) then

		self.cw_util:start_scene(self.interact_android, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.ending and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_mystery()) then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.none

		self.cw_util:start_scene(self.interact_message_system, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_tesla_coil_on_off_event(e)
	if self.current_state <= self.section_state.tutorial and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.CoilObject, self.get_android()) and e.IsTurningOn then

		self.charging_util:start_charge(self.get_android(), 1)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.section_state.puzzle_start and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then

		if e.Zone.Name == self.puzzle_leave_zone_name then
			self.current_state = self.section_state.charge_android

			self.cw_util:start_scene(self.leave_android_event, self)
			return true
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.puzzle_end_zone_name then
			self.current_state = self.section_state.ending

			self.cw_util:start_scene(self.enter_message_system_event, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.start and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) and
			e.Zone.Name == self.online_event_zone_name then

		self.current_state = self.section_state.tutorial
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.pre_android_event, self))
			return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'charging_complete' and e:GetParamAt(1) == self.get_android().Name then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.charge_android

		local routine = function()
			-- 이전 리더에 대한 정보를 미리 캐싱해둬야 해제가 가능함
			local cached_leader = get_party_leader()

			self.cw_util:enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false, disable_wind_pot = false })

			self:charge_android()

			self.cw_util:exit_scene(nil, cached_leader)
		end

		return start_coroutine(routine)
	end
end
--endregion
function local_class:temple_setting()
	local android = self.get_android()

	android.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1, 1, 2))

	local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()
	star_piece.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsHidden = true

	local box = self.get_mystery()
	box.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	local animator = box:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	animator:Play('open', -1, 0)
	animator.speed = 0

	if quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.quest_key) == 1 then
		self.is_followed_android = true
		self.current_state = self.section_state.charge_android
		return
	end

	character_util.add_color(android, self.android_tint_key, unity_class.color.black, 0.7, 0.1)

	scene_util.set_anim(android, self, 'prostrate')
	scene_util.set_emotion(android, self, 'empty')
end

function local_class:pre_android_event()
	local androids = {}
	local android_count = 3

	for number = 1, android_count do
		local android = self.get_online_android(number)
		android.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		table.insert(androids, android)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(androids[3])

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	--안드로이드1 (right, idle, idle) : 이 안드로이드는 상태가 왜 이런 것입니까?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(androids[1], 'cw_sm_pre_1', false)

	--안드로이드3 (left, idle, bomb_idle) : 안쪽에 있는 함정을 밟고 그만 방전된 것으로 보입니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(androids[3], self, nil,
			{name = 'bomb_idle', keep = true},
			nil, { key = 'cw_sm_pre_2', skip = false })

	--안드로이드3 (left, idle, bomb_idle) : 함부로 들어가지 않는 것이 좋겠습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(androids[3], self, nil,
			nil, nil, { key = 'cw_sm_pre_3', skip = false })

	for number = 1, android_count do
		androids[number].Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	end
	--이후 각 NPC 인터렉트 시 하단의 원라인 대사 출력
	--안드로이드1 (right, idle, idle) : 이 안드로이드는 왜 방전되어 있는 겁니까?
	androids[1].Interactable.Talk = 'cw_sm_pre_4'
	--안드로이드3 (left, idle, bomb_idle) : 함부로 들어가지 않는 것이 좋겠습니다.
	androids[3].Interactable.Talk = 'cw_sm_pre_5'
end

function local_class:detected_event(detector_laser_name)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if self.reset_table[detector_laser_name] == nil then
		return
	end

	--플레이어 레이저에 닿을 시 1회 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_light_04')

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, self.reset_table[detector_laser_name].dir, false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, {name ='dead', keep_anim = true})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1,'linear')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	character_util.set_position(leader, field_util.get_marker_pos(self.reset_table[detector_laser_name].reset_maker_name))

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.puzzle_start then
		character_util.set_position(self.get_android(), leader.Position + vector(0,0,0.5))
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	self.is_detected = false
end

function local_class:charge_android()
	local android = self.get_android()

	--플레이어 컨트롤 뺏은 후, 1초동안 로봇 NPC 중심으로 카메라 패닝.
	camera_util.move_async(android.Position, 1)

	--로봇 NPC 1초동안 검은색 틴트 사라지며 원래 색으로 돌아옴.
	character_util.remove_color(android, self.android_tint_key, 1)

	--로봇 NPC shake 1회, 이후 0.5초 뒤 shake 1회. 이후 get 자세로 jump 하며 일어남
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.shake(android, 0.03, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_glitch_02')
	scene_util.shake_and_wakeup(android, 'right', 1, 'idle', true)

	--로봇 (right, idle, idle) : 시스템 가동. 준비 완료.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(android, 'cw_sm_s1_2')

	--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 다시 플레이어에게로 복귀.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
end

function local_class:interact_android()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	local android = self.get_android()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_state <= self.section_state.tutorial and self.is_followed_android == false then
		--플레이어가 로봇 인터렉트 시, 하단의 나레이션 박스 출력.
		--『전원이 다한 것 같다.』
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_sm_s1_1' })
		return
	end

	--플레이어 ■타일에 left 방향으로 정렬.
	wp_util.move_async(leader, self.get_leader_pos(1),
			4, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	if self.is_followed_android then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.puzzle_start

		--이후 다시 로봇 인터렉트 시, 아래의 대화 진행하여 재진입 가능.
		--로봇 (right, idle, idle) : 동행자, 복귀 확인.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(android, 'cw_sm_s1_14')

		--로봇 (right, idle, idle) : 재진입 실행.
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(android, 'cw_sm_s1_15')

		--로봇 NPC와 가디언 캐릭터 왼쪽으로 2칸 이동.
		local move_offset = vector(-2, 0, 0)
		wp_util.move(android, android.Position + move_offset, 4, nil)
		wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + move_offset, 4, nil)

		--로봇 NPC가 가디언의 팔로워로 따라붙는다. (파티원이 아닌 팔로워로만 따라붙게 처리)
		character_util.convert_to_following_npc(android, user_party, false)

		--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
		return
	end

	if self.is_first_interact == false then
		self.is_first_interact = true

		--로봇 (right, idle, attack) : 침입자 발견.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bombard_range_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'right',
				nil, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'cw_sm_s1_3')

		--로봇 (right, idle, attack) : 안면 인식 진행.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'right',
				nil, nil, 'cw_sm_s1_4')

		--로봇 스파인 1초동안 0.03값으로 shake.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_broadcast_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(android, self, 'vr')
		scene_util.shake(android, 0.03, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--이후 로봇 캐릭터 shake 멈추며 (notice) 이모티콘 표시.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(android, self, nil, nil, nil,
				'notice')

		--로봇 (right, idle, release) : 헤실헤실한 얼굴. 인식.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'right',
				'release', 'idle', 'cw_sm_s1_5')

	--로봇 (right, idle, release) : 명령 수행을 위해, 도움 필요.

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, 'right',
			'release', 'idle', 'cw_sm_s1_9')

		{ 'cw_sm_s1_choose_2', 'brutal' }
	})

	if result == 1 then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.puzzle_start
		self.is_followed_android = true

		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.quest_key, 1)

		--(mercy) 역시 내가 없으면 안되는건가?
		--가디언 (left, doyagao, bomb_idle 1초)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self, 'left',
				'bomb_idle', 'doyagao', 1)
		--이후 가디언 idle 표정 전환.

		--로봇 (right, idle, nod 1회) : 수락 확인. 안쪽으로 동행 시작.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil,
				{ name = 'nod', count = 1 }, nil, 'cw_sm_s1_10')

		--로봇 NPC와 가디언 캐릭터 왼쪽으로 2칸 이동.
		local move_offset = vector(-2, 0, 0)
		wp_util.move(android, android.Position + move_offset, 4, nil)
		wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + move_offset, 4, nil)

		--로봇 NPC가 가디언의 팔로워로 따라붙는다. (파티원이 아닌 팔로워로만 따라붙게 처리)
		character_util.convert_to_following_npc(android, user_party, false)
	else
		--(brutal) 난 나보다 약한 녀석의 말 따윈 듣지 않는다.
		--가디언 (left, attack, cross_arm 1초)

		scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self, 'left',
				'cross_arm', 'attack', 1)
		--이후 가디언 idle 표정 전환.

		--로봇 (right, idle, idle) : 용무 없음 확인.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android, self, nil,
				nil, nil, 'cw_sm_s1_11')
	end

	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
