--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = controller @
		QuestName = CivilWarWindPot @
		Comment = 바람의 항아리 데이터 저장용 퀘스트 @
]]

function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	self.craft_key = 'windpot_craft_flag'
	self.current_craft_state = 0
	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WindPotCraftResultEvent))
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	if quest_util.is_available_section(self.current_section) then
		self.current_section:exit()
	end

	self.current_section = nil

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

-- pre story section 설정
function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
end

-- main section 설정
function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section1')
	}
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WindPotCraftResultEvent), 'on_windpot_craft_result_event')

	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:on_progress_section()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	local craft_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.craft_key)
	self.current_craft_state = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(craft_state ~= -1, craft_state, 0)
end

function local_class:on_windpot_craft_result_event(e)
	local craft_id = e.CraftResultId

	if craft_id == -1 then
		return
	end

	self:save_craft_result(craft_id)
end
--endregion

-- 조합 결과를 저장하는 함수
function local_class:save_craft_result(craft_id)
	-- 이미 해금된 조합이면 무조건 리턴.
	if self:is_unlock_craft(craft_id) then
		return
	end

	self.current_craft_state = self.current_craft_state | (1 << craft_id)

	start_coroutine(self.save_current_craft_state_routine, self)
end

-- 현재 조합 결과를 저장하는 루틴
function local_class:save_current_craft_state_routine()
	-- 커스텀 스테이트가 저장되는 동안 강제로 lock.
	CS.Oak.WindPotManager.Lock(1)

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress,
			self.craft_key,
			self.current_craft_state)

	CS.Oak.WindPotManager.Unlock(1)
end

-- 해당 조합법이 이미 해금되어 있는지?
function local_class:is_unlock_craft(craft_id)
	local bit = 1 << craft_id
	return (self.current_craft_state & bit) == bit
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

---@class CivilWarPlagueDoctorSceneManager
local local_class = newclass('CivilWarPlagueDoctorSceneManager')

function local_class:init()
	local sorting_layer = 'Under Effects'
	local bg_pivot = field_util.get_marker_pos('s33_plague_doctor_scene_bg_pivot')

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	self.background_width = 17

	local function preset_bg(fo, order)
		fo.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(45, 0, 0)

		fo.ActiveState = active_state_type.visible

		local sorting_group = fo.gameObject:AddComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Rendering.SortingGroup))

		sorting_group.sortingOrder = order
		sorting_group.sortingLayerName = sorting_layer
	end

	local function create_normal_bg_info(name, order, offset, z_move_scale)
		local fo = get_field_object(name)

		preset_bg(fo, order)

		fo.Position = bg_pivot + offset

		return {
			fo = fo,
			z_move_scale = z_move_scale,
			z_move = function(this, camera_z_diff)
				local diff = unity_class.vector3.forward * camera_z_diff * this.z_move_scale

				this.fo.Position = this.fo.Position + diff
			end,
		}
	end

	local function create_fog_bg_info(name, count, order, offset, z_move_scale, x_scroll_speed)
		local fos = {}

		for i = 1, count do
			local fo = get_field_object(name .. i)

			preset_bg(fo, order)

			fo.Position = bg_pivot + offset + (i - 1) * self.background_width * unity_class.vector3.right

			fos[i] = fo
		end

		return {
			fos = fos,
			x_scroll_speed = x_scroll_speed,
			z_move_scale = z_move_scale,
			z_move = function(this, camera_z_diff)
				local diff = unity_class.vector3.forward * camera_z_diff * this.z_move_scale

				for i, fo in ipairs(this.fos) do
					fo.Position = fo.Position + diff
				end
			end,
			x_move = function(this, x_diff)
				local diff = unity_class.vector3.right * x_diff

				for i, fo in ipairs(this.fos) do
					fo.Position = fo.Position + diff
				end
			end,
		}
	end

	local function create_flower_bg_info(name, order, offset, z_move_scale)
		local fo = get_character(name)

		character_util.set_sorting_layer(fo, sorting_layer, order)
		scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, { name = 'open', loop = false })
		character_util.set_active_state(fo, 'visible')
		character_util.set_active_shadow(fo, false)
		character_util.spine_scale(fo, 0.4 * unity_class.vector3.one, 0)

		fo.Position = bg_pivot + offset

		return {
			fo = get_character(name),
			z_move_scale = z_move_scale,
			z_move = function(this, camera_z_diff)
				local diff = unity_class.vector3.forward * camera_z_diff * this.z_move_scale

				this.fo.Position = this.fo.Position + diff
			end,
		}
	end

	local grid_bounds = field_util.get_zone('s33_plague_doctor_scene_grid').Bounds

	self.grid_info = {
		min_x = grid_bounds.min.x,
		max_x = grid_bounds.max.x,
		width = grid_bounds.size.x,

		min_z = grid_bounds.min.z,
	}

	self.backgrounds = {
		sky = create_normal_bg_info(
				's33_plague_doctor_scene_bg_sky',
				-7,
				vector(0, -1, 8.5),
				0.3
		),
		flower = create_flower_bg_info(
				's33_plague_doctor_scene_bg_flower',
				-6,
				vector(0, -1, 2.5),
				0.29
		),
		floor = create_normal_bg_info(
				's33_plague_doctor_scene_bg_floor',
				-5,
				vector(0, -1, 7),
				0.27
		),
		building_back = create_normal_bg_info(
				's33_plague_doctor_scene_bg_building_back',
				-4,
				vector(0, -1, 6.8),
				0.23
		),
		building_middle = create_normal_bg_info(
				's33_plague_doctor_scene_bg_building_middle',
				-3,
				vector(0, -1, 7.1),
				0.18
		),
		building_front = create_normal_bg_info(
				's33_plague_doctor_scene_bg_building_front',
				-2,
				vector(0, -1, 0.7),
				0.11
		),
		fog = create_fog_bg_info(
				's33_plague_doctor_scene_bg_fog_',
				2,
				-1,
				vector(0, -1, 1),
				0.03,
				-1
		),
	}

	self.camera_move = {
		is_moving = false,
		start_pos = nil,
		target_pos = nil,
		duration = 0,
		time_passed = 0,
	}

	self.camera_resize = {
		is_resizing = false,
		start_scale = nil,
		target_scale = nil,
		duration = 0,
		time_passed = 0,
	}

	self.camera_pivot = stage_camera.Transform.parent

	local free_width_space = 0.2

	self.max_camera_scale = (self.grid_info.width * 0.5 - free_width_space) / stage_camera.Camera.aspect
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.backgrounds = nil
	self.camera_pivot = nil
end

function local_class:update(dt)
	local prev_cam_z = self.camera_pivot.position.z

	if self.camera_move.is_moving then
		self.camera_move.time_passed = self.camera_move.time_passed + dt

		if self.camera_move.time_passed >= self.camera_move.duration then
			self.camera_move.is_moving = false

			self.camera_pivot.position = self.camera_move.target_pos

			self.camera_move.start_pos = nil
			self.camera_move.target_pos = nil
			self.camera_move.duration = 0
			self.camera_move.time_passed = 0
		else
			local progress = self.camera_move.time_passed / self.camera_move.duration
			local cur_pos = self.camera_move.start_pos * (1 - progress) + self.camera_move.target_pos * progress

			self.camera_pivot.position = cur_pos
		end
	end

	if self.camera_resize.is_resizing then
		self.camera_resize.time_passed = self.camera_resize.time_passed + dt

		if self.camera_resize.time_passed >= self.camera_resize.duration then
			self.camera_resize.is_resizing = false

			camera_util.resize_to(self.camera_resize.target_scale, 0)

			self.camera_resize.start_scale = nil
			self.camera_resize.target_scale = nil
			self.camera_resize.duration = 0
			self.camera_resize.time_passed = 0
		else
			local progress = self.camera_resize.time_passed / self.camera_resize.duration
			local cur_scale = self.camera_resize.start_scale * (1 - progress) + self.camera_resize.target_scale * progress

			camera_util.resize_to(cur_scale, 0)
		end
	end

	do
		local info = self.backgrounds.fog
		local auto_scroll_x_diff = info.x_scroll_speed * dt

		info:x_move(auto_scroll_x_diff)

		if info.x_scroll_speed < 0 and self.grid_info.min_x > info.fos[1].Bounds.max.x then
			info:x_move(self.background_width)
		elseif info.x_scroll_speed > 0 and self.grid_info.max_x < info.fos[#info.fos].Bounds.min.x then
			info:x_move(-self.background_width)
		end
	end

	do
		local camera_z_diff = self.camera_pivot.position.z - prev_cam_z

		-- 배경 z축 이동. 조금씩 펼쳐지도록 함
		for _, info in pairs(self.backgrounds) do
			info:z_move(camera_z_diff)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:move_camera(target, duration)
	self.camera_move.is_moving = true

	self.camera_move.start_pos = self.camera_pivot.position
	self.camera_move.target_pos = target
	self.camera_move.duration = duration
	self.camera_move.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:resize_camera(target, duration, max_ratio)
	self.camera_resize.is_resizing = true

	self.camera_resize.start_scale = stage_camera.Camera.orthographicSize
	self.camera_resize.target_scale = math.min(target * stage_camera:GetDefaultSize() / 4, self.max_camera_scale * max_ratio)
	self.camera_resize.duration = duration
	self.camera_resize.time_passed = 0
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

---@class CivilWarStage6PlayerLoopingSystem
local local_class = newclass('CivilWarStage6PlayerLoopingSystem')

function local_class:init()
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		in_loop = 2,
		to_target_z = 3,
		fixed_z = 4,
		to_leader_z = 5,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.camera_pivot_tf = stage_camera.Transform.parent

	self.looping_info = {
		min_x = field_util.get_marker_pos('loop_start').x,
		max_x = field_util.get_marker_pos('loop_end').x,
		dist = nil
	}

	self.looping_info.dist = self.looping_info.max_x - self.looping_info.min_x

	self.move_camera_z_duration = nil

	self.move_z_info = {
		target_z = nil,
		duration = nil,
		time_passed = nil,
		progress = nil
	}

	local loop_camera_grid

	for i = 1, field.CameraGrids.Count do
		local grid = field.CameraGrids[i - 1]

		if grid.name == 's28_loop' then
			loop_camera_grid = grid

			break
		end
	end

	self.camera_grid = {
		min_z = loop_camera_grid.bounds.min.z,
		max_z = loop_camera_grid.bounds.max.z
	}

	self.prev_cycling_move_x_diff = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.current_state = self.states.none
	self.camera_pivot_tf = nil
	self.prev_cycling_move_x_diff = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.current_state = self.states.in_loop
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.prev_cycling_move_x_diff = nil
end

function local_class:update_loop(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none then
		return
	end

	local leader = user_party.Leader

	-- X 계산
	do
		local move_diff

		if leader.Position.x < self.looping_info.min_x then
			move_diff = self.looping_info.dist * unity_class.vector3.right
		elseif leader.Position.x > self.looping_info.max_x then
			move_diff = self.looping_info.dist * unity_class.vector3.left
		end

		if move_diff ~= nil then
			for i = 1, user_party.Count do
				local member = user_party[i - 1]

				member.Position = member.Position + move_diff
			end

			self.camera_pivot_tf.position = self.camera_pivot_tf.position + move_diff

			self.prev_cycling_move_x_diff = move_diff.x
		else
			self.prev_cycling_move_x_diff = nil
		end
	end

	-- Z 계산
	do
		if self.move_z_info.time_passed ~= nil then
			self.move_z_info.time_passed = self.move_z_info.time_passed + dt
			self.move_z_info.progress = self.move_z_info.time_passed / self.move_z_info.duration
		end

		local next_camera_z

		if self.current_state == self.states.to_target_z then
			if self.move_z_info.progress < 1 then
				next_camera_z = leader.Position.z * (1 - self.move_z_info.progress) +
						self.move_z_info.target_z * self.move_z_info.progress
			else
				next_camera_z = self.move_z_info.target_z

				self.move_z_info.time_passed = nil
				self.move_z_info.progress = nil
				self.move_z_info.duration = nil

				self.current_state = self.states.fixed_z
			end

		elseif self.current_state == self.states.to_leader_z then
			if self.move_z_info.progress < 1 then
				next_camera_z = self.move_z_info.target_z * (1 - self.move_z_info.progress) +
						leader.Position.z * self.move_z_info.progress
			else
				self.current_state = self.states.in_loop

				self.move_z_info.target_z = nil
				self.move_z_info.time_passed = nil
				self.move_z_info.progress = nil
				self.move_z_info.duration = nil
			end

		elseif self.current_state == self.states.fixed_z then
			next_camera_z = self.move_z_info.target_z
		end

		if next_camera_z ~= nil then
			local half_height = stage_camera.Camera.orthographicSize

			if next_camera_z + half_height > self.camera_grid.max_z then
				next_camera_z = self.camera_grid.max_z - half_height
			elseif next_camera_z - half_height < self.camera_grid.min_z then
				next_camera_z = self.camera_grid.min.z + half_height
			end

			self.camera_pivot_tf.position = vector_util.get_xy0(self.camera_pivot_tf.position, next_camera_z)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:move_camera_z(target_z, duration)
	self.move_z_info.target_z = target_z
	self.move_z_info.duration = duration
	self.move_z_info.time_passed = 0
	self.move_z_info.progress = 0

	self.current_state = self.states.to_target_z
end

function local_class:return_camera_z(duration)
	self.move_z_info.duration = duration
	self.move_z_info.time_passed = 0
	self.move_z_info.progress = 0

	self.current_state = self.states.to_leader_z
end

function local_class:is_camera_moving()
	return self.current_state == self.states.to_leader_z or self.current_state == self.states.to_target_z
end

function local_class:is_activated()
	return self.current_state ~= self.states.none
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('JumpKingGimmickController')

function local_class:init()
	self.empty_battle_action_name = 'cw_jump_king_manual'

	-- 이펙트
	self.fx = {
		jump_king_buff = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_jump_king_buff')
		end,
		jump_king_buff_end = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_jump_king_buff_end')
		end,
		jump_king_cast = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_jump_king_cast')
		end,
		jump_king_jump = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_jump_king_jump')
		end,
		jump_king_smash = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_jump_king_smash')
		end,
		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,
		smokescreen = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_smokescreen')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}

	--region 감시 발각 이벤트
	-- 감시병
	self.soldiers = {}

	-- 감시병 발각 커스텀 이벤트 키
	self.progress_detected_event_key = 'cw_jump_king_progress_detected_key'

	-- 감시병 발각 플래그
	self.is_detected = false

	-- 플레이어를 발각한 감시병 캐싱
	self.sender_detecting_soldier = nil

	-- 감시존 들어가기 전 점프 시작 위치
	self.detected_reset_pos = nil

	-- 감시 리셋 마커 가져오기

	---@param pos vector3 리셋 위치
	---@param dir string 리셋 후 리더가 바라볼 방향
	---@param dir string 리셋 후 팔로우 캐릭터가 리더기준 4방향중 리셋될 위치
	self.get_reset = {
		{
			pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('game_over_reset_pos_1'),
			dir = 'left',
			hela_pos = 'right'
		},
		{
			pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('game_over_reset_pos_3'),
			dir = 'down',
			hela_pos = 'right'
		},
		{
			pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('game_over_reset_pos_5'),
			dir = 'down',
			hela_pos = 'right'
		},
		{
			pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('game_over_reset_pos_6'),
			dir = 'left',
			hela_pos = 'right'
		},
		{
			pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('game_over_reset_pos_9'),
			dir = 'right',
			hela_pos = 'left'
		},
	}

	---@param flag boolean 게임오버 존에 들어 왔는지
	---@param not_jump boolean 존에 들어왔을 당지 점프중이 아닐때
	---@param idx number 들어온 존의 번호
	self.is_in_game_over_zone = {
		flag = false,
		not_jump = true,
		idx = 0,
	}

	-- 게임오버 존의 총 갯수
	self.game_over_zone_count = 10

	-- 감시병
	self.get_detecting_soldier = function(idx)
		return get_character('detecting_soldier_' .. idx)
	end

	-- 추가 감시병
	self.get_detecting_soldier_1 = function(idx)
		return get_character('detecting_soldier_1_' .. idx)
	end

	-- 길막는 병사들
	self.get_blocking_soldier = function(idx)
		return get_character('blocking_soldier_' .. idx)
	end

	-- 특정 시점동안 감시 하는 병사들
	self.get_progress_soldier = function(idx)
		return get_character('progress_detecting_soldier_' .. idx)
	end
	self.contains_game_over_zone = false
	--endregion

	-- 레이네
	self.get_reine = function()
		return get_character('reine')
	end

	-- 헬라
	self.get_hela = function()
		return get_character('hela')
	end

	---@param charge_time_passed number 점프 차지 중 타임 dt 용도
	---@param charging boolean 점프 차지 중인지
	---@param button_up boolean 버튼 up 이 됐을 때 점프
	---@param distance number 점프 할 거리
	---@param speed number 점프 스피드
	---@param height number 점프 높이
	self.jump = {
		charge_time_passed = 0,
		charging = false,
		button_up = false,
		distance = 0,
		speed = 7,
		height = 3
	}

	-- 점프할 거리
	self.jump_distance = {
		level_1 = 4,
		level_2 = 5,
		level_3 = 6.25
	}

	-- 점프 차지 연출용 스테이트
	self.jump_charge_state = {
		ready = 0,
		level_1 = 1,
		level_2 = 2,
		level_3 = 3,
		over = 4,
		done = 5
	}
	self.current_charge_state = self.jump_charge_state.ready

	-- 플레이어 스테이트
	self.player_state = {
		idle = 0,
		jump_charge = 1,
		jump = 2,
		-- 점프가 끝난 시점
		jump_end = 3,
		-- 비정상 적인 위치에서 리셋
		reset = 4
	}
	self.current_player_state = self.player_state.idle

	self.fx_buff_loop_pool = nil

	-- 튜토리얼 인지
	self.is_long_jump_tutorial = false
	self.tutorial_long_jump_success = false
	self.s4_tutorial_start = false

	-- 점프 기믹을 사용 가능 한지
	self.is_available_gimmick = false

	-- 퀘스트가 클리어된 상태 인지
	self.is_quest_clear = false

	self.stage_ended = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	if self.sender_detecting_soldier ~= nil then
		self.sender_detecting_soldier = nil
	end
end

function local_class:load_async()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	self.fx:load_all()

	self.reine = self.get_reine()
	self.hela = self.get_hela()

	self:quest_clear_check()

	self:set_empty_battle_action()
	self.current_player_state = self.player_state.idle
end

function local_class:quest_clear_check()
	local main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(366)

	-- 퀘스트 클리어 이후 특정 감시병 세팅 하지 않음
	if main_quest_progress ~= nil and main_quest_progress.Grade == 0 then
		self.is_quest_clear = true
		-- 해당 감시병 발각 존이 9, 10 이므로 8까지만 체크하도록
		self.game_over_zone_count = 8
	else
		self:progress_detecting_soldier_setting()
	end
end

function local_class:progress_detecting_soldier_setting()
	local progress_soldier_count = 8

	for idx = 1, progress_soldier_count do
		local soldier = self.get_progress_soldier(idx)
		local soldier_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('progress_game_over_soldier_pos_' .. idx)
		soldier.Position = soldier_pos
	end
end

-- 빈 배틀 액션 세팅 해주기
function local_class:set_empty_battle_action()
	yield_return_func(get_party_leader().CharacterBehaviour.RefreshBattleActionsWithClass,
			get_party_leader().CharacterBehaviour, self.empty_battle_action_name)
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
	self.stage_ended = true

	return true
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	-- 버튼 down 됐을 때 점프 차지 시작
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action3TouchDown then
		if self.current_charge_state ~= self.jump_charge_state.done
				and self.current_player_state == self.player_state.idle then

			local current_state = leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
			if current_state ~= nil then
				if not lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState)
						or lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterJumpState)
						or lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterForcedDashState) then
					return
				end
			end

			-- 파티멤버가 1.2칸 이내에 왔을때 부터 들 수 있도록
			local dist_to_party_member = (leader.Position - self.hela.Position).sqrMagnitude
			local max_dist = 1.2 ^ 2
			if dist_to_party_member < max_dist then
				self.jump.charging = true
				self.jump.button_up = false

				-- 컨트롤 입력을 막음
				leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:RequestDisableControl(leader, CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
				start_coroutine(self.gimmick_loop, self)
			end
		end
	end

	-- 버튼이 up 됐을 때 점프
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action3TouchUp then
		local current_state = leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
		if current_state ~= nil then
			if not lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState)
					or lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterJumpState)
					or lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterForcedDashState) then
				return
			end
		end

		self.jump.button_up = true
	end

	-- 점프 캔슬
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown then
		if self.jump.charging then
			if self.current_player_state == self.player_state.jump_charge
					and self.current_charge_state ~= self.jump_charge_state.ready then

				-- 리더가 팔로우 캐릭터를 holdup 하고 있고, 던지지 않았을 경우에만 점프 캔슬
				if lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)
						and not lua_helper.type_compare(self.hela.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState) then
					self:jump_cancel(leader)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	-- 게임 오버 감시병 존
	if not self.is_in_game_over_zone.flag then
		for idx = 1, self.game_over_zone_count do
			if e.Zone.Name == 'game_over_zone_' .. idx and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.reine) then
				self.is_in_game_over_zone.flag = true
				self.is_in_game_over_zone.idx = idx

				if not self.is_detected and self.is_in_game_over_zone.not_jump then
					self.is_detected = true
					start_coroutine(self.game_over_zone_enter, self, idx)
				end

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	-- 튜토리얼 성공 후 거리가 긴 장애물 넘기 이벤트 용 예외처리
	if self.s4_tutorial_start and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.reine, 's4_jump_king_tutorial_reset_zone') then
		self.is_long_jump_tutorial = true
	elseif self.s4_tutorial_start and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.reine, 's4_jump_king_tutorial_check_zone') then
		self.is_long_jump_tutorial = false
		self.tutorial_long_jump_success = true
	elseif self.s4_tutorial_start and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.reine, 's4_jump_king_tutorial') then
		self.is_long_jump_tutorial = false
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	-- 점프가 끝나기 전에 존에 들어왔다가 나가는 경우가 있어 예외 처리
	local zone_enter_check_flag = false
	if self.is_in_game_over_zone.flag then
		for idx = 1, self.game_over_zone_count do
			if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, self.reine, 'game_over_zone_' .. idx) then
				for num = 1, self.game_over_zone_count do
					self.contains_game_over_zone = zone_util.contains_fo('game_over_zone_' .. num, self.reine, false)
					if self.contains_game_over_zone then
						zone_enter_check_flag = true
					else
						self.is_in_game_over_zone.flag = false
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if zone_enter_check_flag then
			self.is_in_game_over_zone.flag = zone_enter_check_flag
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:gimmick_loop()
	self.jump.charge_time_passed = 0
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	-- 버튼 down 중 경과되는 시간에 따라 연출 및 점프 거리 세팅
	while not self.stage_ended and self.jump.charging do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		self.jump.charge_time_passed = self.jump.charge_time_passed + dt

		local time = {
			ready = 0.5,
			level_1 = 1.25,
			level_2 = 2,
			level_3 = 4,
		}

		self.jump_charge_time = {
			ready = self.jump.charge_time_passed < time.ready,
			level_1 = self.jump.charge_time_passed > time.ready and self.jump.charge_time_passed <= time.level_1,
			level_2 = self.jump.charge_time_passed > time.level_1 and self.jump.charge_time_passed <= time.level_2,
			level_3 = self.jump.charge_time_passed > time.level_2 and self.jump.charge_time_passed <= time.level_3,
			over = self.jump.charge_time_passed > time.level_3
		}

		if self.jump_charge_time.ready then
			if self.current_charge_state == self.jump_charge_state.ready then
				self.current_charge_state = self.jump_charge_state.level_1
				self.current_player_state = self.player_state.jump_charge
				self:jump_charge_action(leader, self.jump_charge_state.ready)
			end
		elseif self.jump_charge_time.level_1 then
			if self.current_charge_state == self.jump_charge_state.level_1 then
				self.current_charge_state = self.jump_charge_state.level_2
				self:holdup(leader)
				self:jump_charge_action(leader, self.jump_charge_state.level_1)
				self.jump.distance = self.jump_distance.level_1
			end
		elseif self.jump_charge_time.level_2 then
			if self.current_charge_state == self.jump_charge_state.level_2 then
				self.current_charge_state = self.jump_charge_state.level_3
				self:holdup(leader)
				self:jump_charge_action(leader, self.jump_charge_state.level_2)
				self.jump.distance = self.jump_distance.level_2
			end
		elseif self.jump_charge_time.level_3 then
			if self.current_charge_state == self.jump_charge_state.level_3 then
				self.current_charge_state = self.jump_charge_state.over
				self:holdup(leader)
				self:jump_charge_action(leader, self.jump_charge_state.level_3)
				self.jump.distance = self.jump_distance.level_3
			end
		elseif self.jump_charge_time.over then
			if self.current_charge_state == self.jump_charge_state.over then
				self.current_charge_state = self.jump_charge_state.done
				self:throw(leader)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_light_turn_off_01')
				self:buff_dispose()

				self:jump_charge_action(leader, self.jump_charge_state.over)

				self:reset_disable_control(leader)

				self.jump.charging = false

				return
			end
		end

		-- 버튼 up 이 되면 점프 루틴을 탐
		if self.jump.button_up then
			if self.jump_charge_time.ready then
				self.current_charge_state = self.jump_charge_state.ready

				self.current_player_state = self.player_state.idle

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				self:reset_disable_control(leader)
			else
				self:custom_jump(leader)
			end

			return
		end

		if self.stage_ended then
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

-- 점프 모으는 중 연출
function local_class:jump_charge_action(fo, level)
	if self.jump_charge_state.ready == level then
		--0초~0.5초 미만
		--캐릭터의 표정이 (attack) 액션이 (boong_attack_ready_loop)상태가 된다.
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(fo,
				{ name = 'boong_attack_ready_loop', loop = true }, { name = 'attack' })
	elseif self.jump_charge_state.level_1 == level then
		--0.5초~1.25초 미만 (1단계)
		--캐릭터의 표정 (damaged)로 변경 액션은 유지 상태로 (shake0.03/0.3초) 적용
		--fx_lasthit 재생
		self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(fo.Position)

		character_util.set_emotion(fo, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.shake(fo, 0.03, 0.3)

	elseif self.jump_charge_state.level_2 == level then
		--1.25초~2초 미만 (2단계)
		--캐릭터의 표정 (attack)으로 변경 나머지 액션과 이펙트는 유지 (shake0.03/0.3초) 적용
		character_util.set_emotion(fo, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.stop_shake(fo)
		character_util.shake(fo, 0.03, 0.3)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_catch_fire_01')

		self.fx:jump_king_cast():Instantiate(fo.Position)
	elseif self.jump_charge_state.level_3 == level then
		--2초 미만~ 4초 (3단계)
		--나머지는 유지 상태로 표정 (mad)로 변경 (shake0.03)과 동시에 fx_m_plitvice_buff가 활성화 된다.
		--취소되거나 점프를 뛰면 해당 이펙트는 fx_m_plitvice_buff_end 재생되며 사라진다.
		local side_dir = direction_util.is_side_ver2(fo.Direction)
		local fx_offset = unity_class.vector3.zero

		if side_dir then
			local dir = direction_util.to_vector3(direction_util.get_opposite_ver2(fo.Direction))
			fx_offset = dir * 0.1
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_demonpowergirl_cwp_03')
		self.fx_buff_loop_pool = self.fx:jump_king_buff():Instantiate(fo.Position + fx_offset)
		self.fx_buff_loop_pool.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7

		character_util.set_emotion(fo, { name = 'mad' })
		character_util.stop_shake(fo)
		character_util.shake(fo, 0.03, 9999)

	elseif self.jump_charge_state.over == level then
		--5초 초과 (타임 오버)
		--캐릭터 보던 방향으로 (confused,dead)재생 쓰러지고 1초 후 마리오점프하면서 기상하고 원래 상태로 복귀한다.
		--쓰러질때 팔로워 캐릭터는 (surprise)표정 (jump1회) 재생 원래상태로 복귀될때까지 (tired)표정 상태가 된다.

		character_util.stop_shake(fo)

		local anim_dur = spine_util.get_animation_duration(fo, 'dead')

		local trip_sound_sec = 1.2
		wait_for_sec(anim_dur - trip_sound_sec)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')

		wait_for_sec(trip_sound_sec)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		local look_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(fo)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
		character_util.mario_jump_async(fo, look_dir)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)
		self.current_charge_state = self.jump_charge_state.ready
		self.current_player_state = self.player_state.idle
	end
end

function local_class:holdup(fo)
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(fo.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local leader_look_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(fo)
		character_util.set_locked_dir(self.hela, leader_look_dir)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.hela,
				{ name = 'seat', loop = true }, { name = 'attack' })
		command_util.publish_holdup(fo, self.hela, fo.Position, nil, true)
	end
end

function local_class:custom_jump(fo)
	self.is_in_game_over_zone.not_jump = false

	character_util.stop_shake(fo)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.hela, { name = 'damaged' })

	self:buff_dispose()

	self.fx:jump_king_jump():Instantiate(fo.Position)

	local reset_pos = fo.Position

	self.detected_reset_pos = reset_pos

	local jump_sound

	if self.jump.distance == self.jump_distance.level_1 then
		jump_sound = '02_fire_harpy_dash_01'
	elseif self.jump.distance == self.jump_distance.level_2 then
		jump_sound = '02_fire_harpy_kick_03'
	elseif self.jump.distance == self.jump_distance.level_3 then
		jump_sound = '02_clara_boss_jump_01'
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(jump_sound)

	self:custom_jump_logic(fo, self.jump.distance, self.jump.speed, self.jump.height)

	self.current_charge_state = self.jump_charge_state.ready

	self.fx:jump_king_smash():Instantiate(fo.Position)

	-- 이동 불가능 할 경우
	if not self.is_available_gimmick and not field:IsThereFloorAt(fo.Position)
			or not self.is_available_gimmick and field:IsAnythingBlockingWithoutBounds(fo.Bounds, CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, unity_class.vector3.zero) then

		self.is_detected = false

		self.current_player_state = self.player_state.reset
		self:reset_wrong_position(fo, reset_pos, fo.Direction)
	elseif field:IsThereFloorAt(fo.Position) and self.is_detected then
		if self.sender_detecting_soldier ~= nil then
			self.current_player_state = self.player_state.reset
			self:on_detected(self.sender_detecting_soldier)
		end
	elseif self.is_in_game_over_zone.flag and field:IsThereFloorAt(fo.Position) and not self.is_detected then
		for idx = 1, self.game_over_zone_count do
			if zone_util.contains_fo('game_over_zone_' .. idx, fo, false) then
				self.is_detected = true
				self.current_player_state = self.player_state.reset
				self:game_over_zone_enter(self.is_in_game_over_zone.idx)
			end
		end
	else
		-- 점프 이후 연달아서 점프 타일 혹은 가속 타일을 밟았을 때를 대비해서 스테이트 변환 되기 까지 두프레임 쉬어줌
		coroutine.yield()
		coroutine.yield()
		while lua_helper.type_compare(fo.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterJumpState) do
			while lua_helper.type_compare(fo.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterForcedDashState) do
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		self:throw(fo)
	end

	self:reset_disable_control(fo)
	self.is_available_gimmick = false
	self.is_in_game_over_zone.not_jump = true
	self.current_player_state = self.player_state.idle
end

function local_class:custom_jump_logic(target, distance, speed, height)
	self.current_player_state = self.player_state.jump

	local time_passed = 0

	-- 바라 보는 방향으로 점프
	local dir = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(target))
	local start_pos = target.Position
	local end_pos = start_pos + distance * dir
	end_pos = field:GetGroundPositionAt(end_pos)
	local duration = distance / speed

	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local lerp_pos = vector_util.lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		local cur_y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height + lerp_pos.y
		local cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(lerp_pos, cur_y)

		target.Position = cur_pos

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 특정 조건에서 바운드 체크시 캐릭터 탈출로 간주해서 크래시가 안되서 임의로 기믹을 읽어와서 기믹 발동 처리
	local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(target.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
		local obj = obj_list[i]
		if field:IsThereFloorAt(target.Position)
				or not field:IsAnythingBlockingWithoutBounds(target.Bounds, CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, unity_class.vector3.zero) then
			if lua_helper.type_compare(obj.CrashBehaviour, typeof(CS.Oak.AccelerateCrashBehaviour)) then
				-- accel tile 일때 해당 타일 정보대로 커맨드 날림
				local tile_behaviour = obj.CrashBehaviour
				local cmd = CS.Oak.StartAccelTileEffectCommand.Create(
						target, obj, tile_behaviour.SpeedMultiplier, tile_behaviour.AccelerateDuration, target.Position)

				self.is_available_gimmick = true

				command_util.publish_cmd(target.Owner, cmd)

			elseif lua_helper.type_compare(obj.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.JumpTileBehaviour) then
				-- 점프 타일 일때 캐릭터가 뛰는 속도로 간주하여 점프타일 작동 시킴
				local jump_tile_data = obj.FieldObjectBehaviour
				local jump_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(obj.Direction)
				local jump_speed = target.CharacterStatsBehaviour.DashSpeed

				self.is_available_gimmick = true

				message_system:SendSync(jump_tile_data, CS.Oak.JumpTileSpringEvent.Create(target, obj, jump_dir, jump_speed))
			end
		end
	end

	target.Position = end_pos

	obj_list:Dispose()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_demonpowergirl_throw_03')

	self.current_player_state = self.player_state.jump_end
end

-- 4방향 검사
function local_class:throw(fo)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.hela, user_party, true)

	local current_state = fo.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local hold_target = current_state.HoldTarget
		if hold_target ~= nil then
			-- 기본적으로 바라보는 방향 앞으로 내려놓음
			local throw_pos = fo.Position + direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			local throw_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)

			-- 주변 충돌 검색 크기 축소
			local new_bounds = fo.Bounds
			new_bounds.size = new_bounds.size * 0.9

			local success_throw = false

			-- 바라보는 방향을 마지막으로 4방향 검사해서 내려 놓음
			local count = 4
			for i = 1, count do
				throw_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(direction_util.get_cw_turn(fo.Direction, i - 1))
				throw_pos = fo.Position + throw_dir
				new_bounds.center = throw_pos

				if not success_throw and field:IsThereFloorAt(throw_pos) and
						not field:IsAnythingBlockingWithoutBounds(new_bounds, CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, unity_class.vector3.zero) then
					if self.current_player_state == self.player_state.reset then
						-- 4방향 모두 내려놓을 곳이 없으면 리더 자리에 바로 내려 놓음
						character_util.release_hold_object(fo, hold_target)
					else
						command_util.publish_throw(fo, hold_target, throw_dir,
								fo.Position, 4, false)
						success_throw = true
					end
				end
			end

			if not success_throw then
				character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'release', loop = false })
				character_util.release_hold_object(fo, hold_target)
			end
			if self.current_charge_state == self.jump_charge_state.done then
				character_util.set_emotion(fo, { name = 'confused' })
				character_util.set_side_direction(fo)
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(fo,
						{ name = 'dead', loop = false }, { name = 'confused' })
			else
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)
			end
		end
	end
	coroutine.yield()

	while lua_helper.type_compare(self.hela.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.reset_locked_dir(self.hela, self.hela.Direction)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.hela)
	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(self.hela, user_party, true)
end

-- 점프가 정상적으로 종료될때까지 기다려주는 함수
function local_class:jump_end_wait(callback)
	while self.current_player_state ~= self.player_state.idle do
		-- 점프가 종료되었는데 리셋 상태라면 존 엔터 이벤트가 꼬일 수 있어서 따로 처리를 위한 콜백
		if self.current_player_state == self.player_state.reset then
			if callback then
				callback()
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:reset_wrong_position(fo, reset_pos)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	--팔로워와 플레이어 캐릭터가 표정(scared) 모션(embarrassed) 상태가 되고 서큘러 페이드 인 페이드 아웃하여 점프를 뛴 지점 혹은 지정된 지점에 복귀한다.
	--화면 shake0.1/ 0.5초와 함께 fx_Common_SmokeScreen 재생 0.5초간 서큘러 페이드 아웃 0.5초간 서큘려 페이드 인으로 복귀
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)
	self.fx:smokescreen():Instantiate(fo.Position)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_02')

	party_util.set_animation('embarrassed', true)
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'surprise' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.75, 'linear')

	fo.Position = reset_pos

	-- 위치가 이동 완료 된 후 에 던지도록 한프레임 쉬어줌
	coroutine.yield()

	self:throw(fo)

	self.hela.Position = reset_pos + direction_util.to_vector3(direction_util.get_opposite_ver2(fo.Direction))
	character_util.set_direction(self.hela, fo.Direction)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.75, 'linear')

	if self.is_long_jump_tutorial and not self.tutorial_long_jump_success then
		self:long_jump_fail_event()
	end

	self.current_player_state = self.player_state.idle

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

function local_class:reset_pos_setting(zone_num)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local hela = self.get_hela()

	-- 플레이어로부터 가장 가까운 리셋 위치를 찾음
	local shortest_dist = 99999
	local reset_marker
	local reset_dir
	local hela_reset_marker
	for i = 1, #self.get_reset do
		local dist_to_player = (leader.Position - self.get_reset[i].pos).sqrMagnitude
		if shortest_dist > dist_to_player then
			shortest_dist = dist_to_player
			reset_marker = self.get_reset[i].pos
			reset_dir = self.get_reset[i].dir
			hela_reset_marker = reset_marker + direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(self.get_reset[i].hela_pos)
		end
	end

	-- 7번 존에서만 예외로 리셋 위치 고정 시켜줌
	if zone_num == 7 then
		reset_marker = self.get_reset[3].pos
		reset_dir = self.get_reset[3].dir
		hela_reset_marker = reset_marker + direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(self.get_reset[3].hela_pos)
	end

	leader.Position = reset_marker
	character_util.set_direction(leader, reset_dir)

	hela.Position = hela_reset_marker
	character_util.set_direction(hela, reset_dir)
	self.current_player_state = self.player_state.idle
end

function local_class:jump_cancel(fo)
	start_coroutine(self.throw, self, fo)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	self.jump.charging = false

	if self.fx_buff_loop_pool ~= nil then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_light_turn_off_01')
		self:buff_dispose()
	end

	character_util.stop_shake(fo)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)

	self:run_cancel_command(fo)
	self:reset_disable_control(fo)
	self.current_player_state = self.player_state.idle
	self.current_charge_state = self.jump_charge_state.ready
end

-- run cancel 커맨드를 날려줌
function local_class:run_cancel_command(fo)
	local look_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(fo)
	local move_dir = direction_util.get_opposite_ver2(look_dir)

	local cmd = CS.Oak.RunCancelCommand.Create(fo, move_dir, look_dir)
	command_util.publish_cmd(fo.Owner, cmd)
end

-- 상호작용 키 원래대로 리셋
function local_class:reset_disable_control(fo)
	local manual_touch_state = fo.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
	if manual_touch_state ~= nil and
			lua_helper.type_compare(manual_touch_state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
		manual_touch_state:RemoveDisableControl(fo)
	end
end

function local_class:buff_dispose()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.fx_buff_loop_pool ~= nil then
		local buff_end = self.fx:jump_king_buff_end()
							 :Instantiate(leader.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, leader.Transform)
		buff_end.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7
		self.fx_buff_loop_pool:Dispose()
		self.fx_buff_loop_pool = nil
	end
end

-- 게임 오버 존에 들어갔을 시 연출
function local_class:game_over_zone_enter(zone_num)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	local party_reaction = function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.hela,
				{ name = 'embarrassed', loop = true }, { name = 'scared' })

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.reine,
				{ name = 'embarrassed', loop = true }, { name = 'scared' })
	end

	local soldier_reaction = function(fo)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(fo,
				{ name = 'release', loop = true }, { name = 'mad' })
	end

	local soldier_speech = function(key, ...)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
		local args = { ... }
		self.soldiers = table.unpack(args)

		for idx = 1, #self.soldiers do
			local soldier = self.soldiers[idx]
			self.soldiers[idx] = {
				fo = soldier,
				dir = soldier.Direction
			}
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.soldiers[idx].fo,
					{ key = key, skip = false })
		end
	end

	-- 위에서 내려와서 발각 하는 병사 세팅
	local soldiers_count = 4
	local soldiers_setting = function()
		for idx = 1, soldiers_count do
			local soldier = self.get_blocking_soldier(idx)
			character_util.set_active_state(soldier, 'enabled')
			soldier.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('game_over_soldier_pos_' .. idx)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
		end
	end

	--게임 오버 존 (해당 존은 섹션 관계없이 유지)
	local soldiers_move = function(soldier_num)
		--이때 레이나 친구 (up,embarrassed)상태 서큘러 페이드 아웃 하단에 표시한 위치에서 재시작
		party_reaction()

		local camera_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('game_over_soldier_pos_' .. soldier_num) + vector(0, 0, -1.5)
		camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0.5)

		soldiers_setting()

		local wp_key = 'wp_key'

		for idx = 1, soldiers_count do
			local soldier = self.get_blocking_soldier(idx)
			local wp = soldier.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5)

			--각 존 그리드 밖에서 사울병사 둘이 내려오고 둘다 (down,mad,release)
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(soldier,
					wp, 7, nil, self, wp_key,
					{ run = true, end_callback = function()
						soldier_reaction(soldier)
					end })
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')

		local soldier = self.get_blocking_soldier(soldier_num)
		soldier_speech('cw_jump_king_detecting_soldier_1', { soldier })

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	--상단 빨간존 올라갈 시
	--레이나 친구 (up,idle,idle) 상태
	--카메라 윗쪽 그리드 끝까지 이동
	--왼쪽 존이면 왼쪽에서만 오른쪽 존이면 오른쪽에서만
	--(1): 녀석들을 붙잡았다!
	if zone_num == 1 then
		soldiers_move(2)
	elseif zone_num == 2 then
		soldiers_move(4)
	elseif zone_num == 3 or zone_num == 4 or zone_num == 5 then
		--플레이어가 해당 그리드의 2층으로 올라왔을 때
		--2층의 NPC들이 플레이어를 바라보며 표정(mad) (jump1회)

		--이때 레이네와 친구 (scared)표정 (embarrassed) 애니메이션
		party_reaction()

		local soldiers = {}
		local soldier_start_count = 1
		local soldier_end_count = 8

		for idx = soldier_start_count, soldier_end_count do
			local soldier = self.get_detecting_soldier(idx)
			table.insert(soldiers, soldier)
		end

		soldier_speech('cw_jump_king_detecting_soldier_3', soldiers)

		for i = 1, #self.soldiers do
			local soldier = self.soldiers[i].fo
			character_util.set_emotion(soldier, { name = 'mad' })
			character_util.look_at(soldier, self.reine)
			character_util.normal_jump(soldier, true)
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	elseif zone_num == 6 or zone_num == 7 then
		--해당 표시된 지형에 있는 2NPC 플레이어 바라보면서 표정 (mad) 애니메이션 (release) 대사: 꼬마애를 찾았다!
		local soldiers = {
			zone_6 = {
				self.get_detecting_soldier_1(1),
				self.get_detecting_soldier_1(2),
			},
			zone_7 = {
				self.get_detecting_soldier_1(3),
				self.get_detecting_soldier_1(4),
			},
		}

		--레이네/친구 표정 (scared) 애니메이션(embarrassed)상태 서큘러 페이드인 페이드 아웃 상단에 레이네/친구 표시한 곳에서 재시작
		party_reaction()

		soldier_speech('cw_jump_king_detecting_soldier_3',
				{ soldiers['zone_' .. zone_num][1], soldiers['zone_' .. zone_num][2] })

		for idx = 1, 2 do
			local soldier = soldiers['zone_' .. zone_num][idx]
			character_util.look_at(soldier, self.reine)
			soldier_reaction(soldier)
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)
	elseif zone_num == 8 then
		--파란존 진입시

		--레이네/친구 표정 (scared) 애니메이션(embarrassed)상태 서큘러 페이드인 페이드 아웃 상단에 레이네/친구 표시한 곳에서 재시작
		party_reaction()

		--해당 파란존에 NPC들이 플레이어블 캐릭터 바라보며 표정 (mad) 애니메이션 (release) 대사: 꼬마애를 찾았다!
		local soldiers = {}

		local soldier_start_count = 9
		local soldier_end_count = 12

		for idx = soldier_start_count, soldier_end_count do
			local soldier = self.get_detecting_soldier(idx)
			table.insert(soldiers, soldier)
		end

		soldier_speech('cw_jump_king_detecting_soldier_3', soldiers)

		for idx = 1, #self.soldiers do
			local soldier = self.soldiers[idx].fo
			character_util.look_at(soldier, self.reine)
			soldier_reaction(soldier)
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)
	elseif zone_num == 9 or zone_num == 10 then
		--레이네 / 친구 (scared)표정 (embarrassed)모션 후 위치 초기화
		party_reaction()

		--해당 존 안에 캐릭터들이 플레이어를 바라보며 표정(mad) 애니메이션(release) 대사: 그 꼬마를 찾았다!!
		local soldiers = {}
		local soldier_count = 8

		for idx = 1, soldier_count do
			local soldier = self.get_progress_soldier(idx)
			table.insert(soldiers, soldier)
		end

		soldier_speech('cw_jump_king_jump_block_2', soldiers)

		--각 초기화 위치는 감시시야 앞에 빨간원(레이네) 노란원(친구)
		for idx = 1, #self.soldiers do
			local soldier = self.soldiers[idx].fo
			character_util.look_at(soldier, self.reine)
			soldier_reaction(soldier)
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	--서큘러 페이드 인 초기화
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	soldiers_setting()

	self:throw(self.reine)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.reine)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.hela)

	if self.soldiers ~= nil then
		for idx = 1, #self.soldiers do
			local soldier = self.soldiers[idx].fo
			soldier.Direction = self.soldiers[idx].dir
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(soldier)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
		end
		self.soldiers = nil
	end

	self:reset_pos_setting(zone_num)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	if self.is_long_jump_tutorial and not self.tutorial_long_jump_success then
		self:long_jump_fail_event()
	end

	self.is_in_game_over_zone.flag = false
	self.is_detected = false

	self.current_player_state = self.player_state.idle

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

function local_class:long_jump_fail_event()
	--친구(left,tired,release): 빠, 빨리 움직이자!
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.hela,
			{ name = 'release', loop = true }, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.hela,
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s4_10', skip = true })

	--친구(left,attack,cast): 저 앞을 넘으려면 좀 더 힘을 줘서 뛰어야 할 것 같아!
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.hela,
			{ name = 'cast', loop = true }, { name = 'attack' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.hela,
			{ key = 'cw_jump_king_s4_10_1', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.hela)
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

---@class CivilWarBattleFieldBase
local battlefield_base = newclass('BattleFieldBase')

---@class CivilWarCenterBattleField : CivilWarBattleFieldBase
local center_battlefield = newclass('CenterBattleField', battlefield_base)
---@class CivilWarTopBattleField : CivilWarBattleFieldBase
local top_battlefield = newclass('TopBattleField', battlefield_base)
---@class CivilWarBottomBattleField : CivilWarBattleFieldBase
local bottom_battlefield = newclass('BottomBattleField', battlefield_base)

--region battlefield_base
function battlefield_base:init(controller, child)
	---@type CivilWarBattleFieldEventController
	self.controller = controller
	self.child = child
	self.fx = self.controller.fx
	self.cw_util = self.controller.cw_util
	self.stage_ended = false

	self.time_passed = 0

	-- 최대 포인트
	self.max_point = 100

	-- 기본 포인트
	self.default_point = 50

	-- 현재 전장 포인트
	self.battlefield_point = self.default_point

	-- 포인트 차감 주기
	self.deduction_period = 1.5

	-- 배틀 클리어 시 얻는 포인트
	self.battle_clear_point_amount = 25

	-- 배틀존 이름
	self.battle_zone_name = ''

	-- 전장 초기화가 끝났는지
	self.ended_reset_battlefield = true

	-- 각 전장 npc 전투 연출 데이터 테이블
	self.fight_pattern_1_npcs = {}
	self.fight_pattern_2_npcs = {}
	self.fight_pattern_3_npcs = {}
	self.stand_npcs = {}

	-- 각 전장 고유 인덱스
	self.battlefield_idx = 0

	-- 마계 병사 수
	self.dw_soldiers_count = 0

	-- 사울 병사 수
	self.saul_soldiers_count = 0

	-- 마계 지원병 수 
	self.dw_extra_soldiers_count = 4

	-- 사울 지원병 수
	self.saul_extra_soldiers_count = 4

	-- 영웅들
	self.heroes = {}

	-- 전투 루틴 강제 종료시키기 위한 해시셋
	self.fight_routine_flag_hashset = create_lua_hashset()

	-- 전투 종료 후 end_callback 스킵하도록
	self.is_skip_battle_end_cb = false

	-- 배틀게이트 숫자
	self.battle_gate_count = 0

	self.sfx_sqr_distance = 100
end

function battlefield_base:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not self.ended_reset_battlefield then
		return
	end
	if self.time_passed >= self.deduction_period then
		self.time_passed = 0
		self:add_point(-1)

		if self.battlefield_point <= 0 then
			self.child:game_over()
		end
	end
end

function battlefield_base:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.child = nil
end

function battlefield_base:on_stage_end_event()
	self.stage_ended = true

	-- 전투 연출중인 루틴 모두 정지
	self:stop_all_fight_routine()
end

function battlefield_base:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.battle_zone_name) and
			self.ended_reset_battlefield then
		self.ended_reset_battlefield = false
		start_coroutine(self.start_battle, self)
		return true
	end
end

-- 배틀 그룹 전멸 이벤트
function battlefield_base:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_zone_name then
		start_coroutine(self.clear_battle, self)
	end
end

-- 배틀 시작 이벤트
function battlefield_base:on_start_battle_event(battle_zone_name)
	-- 자기 배틀이면 무시
	if battle_zone_name == self.battle_zone_name then
		return
	end

	self:reset_battlefield()
end

-- 전장 이벤트 클리어
function battlefield_base:on_clear_battlefield_event()
	self:stop_all_fight_routine()

	for i = 1, self.dw_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_dw_soldier(i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
		character_util.set_active_state(soldier, 'disabled')
	end

	for i = 1, self.saul_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_saul_soldier(i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
		character_util.set_active_state(soldier, 'disabled')
	end

	for i = 1, self.dw_extra_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_dw_extra_soldier(i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
		character_util.set_active_state(soldier, 'disabled')
	end

	for i = 1, self.saul_extra_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_saul_extra_soldier(i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
		character_util.set_active_state(soldier, 'disabled')
	end

	for i = 1, #self.heroes do
		local hero = self:get_hero(self.heroes[i].name)
		character_util.set_position(hero, vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero)
		hero.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

		if lua_helper.type_compare(hero.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
			hero.Interactable.Talk = ''
		else
			hero.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		end
	end
end


--region get character
function battlefield_base:get_dw_soldier(soldier_idx)
	return get_character('bf_dw_soldier_' .. self.battlefield_idx
			.. '_' .. soldier_idx)
end

function battlefield_base:get_saul_soldier(soldier_idx)
	return get_character('bf_saul_soldier_' .. self.battlefield_idx
			.. '_' .. soldier_idx)
end

function battlefield_base:get_dw_extra_soldier(soldier_idx)
	return get_character('bf_dw_extra_soldier_' .. self.battlefield_idx
			.. '_' .. soldier_idx)
end

function battlefield_base:get_saul_extra_soldier(soldier_idx)
	return get_character('bf_saul_extra_soldier_' .. self.battlefield_idx
			.. '_' .. soldier_idx)
end

function battlefield_base:get_hero(name)
	if name == 'china_hero' then
		return user_util.get_china_hero_character('china_hero_boy', 'china_hero_girl')
	else
		return get_character(name)
	end
end
--endregion get character

--region get marker pos
function battlefield_base:get_dw_soldier_pos(soldier_idx)
	return field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_dw_soldier_' ..
			self.battlefield_idx .. '_' .. soldier_idx .. '_pos')
end

function battlefield_base:get_saul_soldier_pos(soldier_idx)
	return field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_saul_soldier_' ..
			self.battlefield_idx .. '_' .. soldier_idx .. '_pos')
end

function battlefield_base:get_dw_extra_soldier_pos(soldier_idx)
	return field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_extra_dw_soldier_' ..
			self.battlefield_idx) + vector(0, 0, soldier_idx)
end

function battlefield_base:get_dw_extra_soldier_end_pos(soldier_idx)
	return field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_extra_dw_soldier_' ..
			self.battlefield_idx .. '_end') + vector(0, 0, soldier_idx)
end

function battlefield_base:get_saul_extra_soldier_pos(soldier_idx)
	return field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_extra_saul_soldier_' ..
			self.battlefield_idx .. '_' .. soldier_idx)
end

function battlefield_base:get_hero_pos(name)
	return field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_' .. name)
end
--endregion get marker pos

-- 병사 세팅
function battlefield_base:set_soldiers()
	for i = 1, self.dw_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_dw_soldier(i)
		character_util.set_active_state(soldier, 'enabled')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
		character_util.set_position(soldier,
				self:get_dw_soldier_pos(i))
		character_util.set_immortal(soldier, true)
	end

	for i = 1, self.saul_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_saul_soldier(i)
		character_util.set_active_state(soldier, 'visible')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
		character_util.set_position(soldier,
				self:get_saul_soldier_pos(i))
	end

	for i = 1, self.dw_extra_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_dw_extra_soldier(i)
		character_util.set_active_state(soldier, 'enabled')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
		character_util.set_immortal(soldier, true)
	end

	for i = 1, self.saul_extra_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_saul_extra_soldier(i)
		character_util.set_active_state(soldier, 'visible')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
	end
end

-- 영웅 세팅
function battlefield_base:set_heroes()
	for i = 1, #self.heroes do
		local hero = self:get_hero(self.heroes[i].name)
		character_util.set_position(hero, self:get_hero_pos(self.heroes[i].name))
		character_util.set_emotion(hero, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.remove_anim(hero)
		character_util.set_direction(hero, 'right')
		character_util.set_immortal(hero, true)
	end
end

-- 전장 세팅
function battlefield_base:set_battlefield()
	self:set_heroes()
	self:set_soldiers()

	for i = 1, #self.fight_pattern_1_npcs do
		self:set_fight_routine_1(self.fight_pattern_1_npcs[i].dw_soldier,
					self.fight_pattern_1_npcs[i].saul_soldier,
					self.fight_pattern_1_npcs[i].is_side)
	end

	for i = 1, #self.fight_pattern_2_npcs do
		self:set_fight_routine_2(self.fight_pattern_2_npcs[i].dw_soldier,
					self.fight_pattern_2_npcs[i].saul_soldier,
					self.fight_pattern_2_npcs[i].is_side)
	end

	for i = 1, #self.fight_pattern_3_npcs do
		self:set_fight_routine_3(self.fight_pattern_3_npcs[i].dw_soldier,
					self.fight_pattern_3_npcs[i].saul_soldier)
	end

	for i = 1, #self.stand_npcs do
		self:set_stand_soldier(self.stand_npcs[i].soldier, self.stand_npcs[i].dir)
	end
end

-- 전장 초기화
function battlefield_base:reset_battlefield()
	if self.ended_reset_battlefield then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, self.saul_soldiers_count do
		self:revive_soldier(self:get_saul_soldier(i))
	end

	for i = 1, self.saul_extra_soldiers_count do
		self:revive_soldier(self:get_saul_extra_soldier(i))
	end

	for i = 1, self.dw_extra_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_dw_extra_soldier(i)
		character_util.set_position(soldier, vector(999, 0, 999))
	end

	self.child:set_battlefield()

	self.ended_reset_battlefield = true
	self.time_passed = 0
end

-- 재시작 전용 하드리셋
function battlefield_base:hard_reset()
	-- 게임오버 연출한 섹션이거나 아직 리셋 안된 전장이면 리셋
	self:reset_battlefield()

	self.time_passed = 0

	-- 기본 포인트로 세팅
	self:set_point(self.default_point)
end

-- 전장 이벤트 시작
function battlefield_base:start_battlefield_event()
	self:set_point(self.default_point)
end

-- 전장 포인트 추가
function battlefield_base:add_point(value)
	local result_value = self.battlefield_point + value
	if result_value > self.max_point then
		result_value = self.max_point
	end

	if result_value < 0 then
		result_value = 0
	end

	self.battlefield_point = result_value
	self.controller.battle_ui:set_situation_value(self.battlefield_idx, result_value)
end

-- 전장 포인트 세팅
function battlefield_base:set_point(value)
	self.battlefield_point = value
	self.controller.battle_ui:set_situation_value(self.battlefield_idx, value)
end

-- 전장 포인트 얻어오기
function battlefield_base:get_point()
	return self.battlefield_point
end

-- 배틀 시작
function battlefield_base:start_battle()
	self.controller:publish_start_battle_event(self.battle_zone_name)
	self.controller.pause_bf_timer_hashset:add(self.battle_zone_name)

	self.child:close_battle_gate()

	self:stop_all_fight_routine()
	for i = 1, self.saul_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_saul_soldier(i)
		character_util.set_active_state(soldier, 'enabled')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
		character_util.convert_to_monster(soldier, self.battle_zone_name)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	for i = 1, self.saul_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_saul_soldier(i)
		command_util.publish_monster_notice(soldier, get_party_leader(), 'battle')
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	for i= 1, self.dw_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_dw_soldier(i)
		soldier.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
		CS.Oak.StageUtil.NpcToAllyInBattle(soldier)
	end

	for i= 1, #self.heroes do
		local hero = self:get_hero(self.heroes[i].name)

		if lua_helper.type_compare(hero.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
			hero.Interactable.Talk = ''
		end
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero)
		hero.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
		CS.Oak.StageUtil.NpcToAllyInBattle(hero)
	end

	self:add_extra_soldier()
end

-- 배틀 완료
function battlefield_base:clear_battle()
	self.child:open_battle_gate()
	self.controller:set_war_sfx_volume(0.3)

	local dw_extra_soldier_count = self:get_dw_extra_soldier_num()
	self.controller.pause_bf_timer_hashset:remove(self.battle_zone_name)
	for i = 1, dw_extra_soldier_count do
		local soldier = self:get_dw_extra_soldier(i)
		local end_pos = self:get_dw_extra_soldier_end_pos(i)

		character_util.convert_to_npc(soldier)
		soldier.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(soldier, end_pos,
				4, nil, self, nil, {
			end_callback = function()
				character_util.set_direction(soldier, 'left')
			end
		})
	end

	for i = 1, self.dw_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_dw_soldier(i)
		local end_pos = self:get_dw_soldier_pos(i)

		character_util.convert_to_npc(soldier)
		soldier.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		if not self.is_skip_battle_end_cb then
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(soldier, end_pos,
					4, nil, self, nil, {
				end_callback = function()
					character_util.set_side_direction(soldier)
					character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(soldier, { name = 'victory_extra' }, { name = 'smile' })
				end
			})
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #self.heroes do
		local hero = self:get_hero(self.heroes[i].name)
		local hero_pos = self:get_hero_pos(self.heroes[i].name)
		character_util.convert_to_npc(hero)
		hero.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		if not self.is_skip_battle_end_cb then
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hero, hero_pos,
					4, nil, self, nil, {
				end_callback = function()
					if self.heroes[i].sfx ~= nil then
						music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.heroes[i].sfx, parent = hero })
					end
					character_util.set_direction(hero, self.heroes[i].dir)
					character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(hero, { name = self.heroes[i].anim },
							{ name = self.heroes[i].emotion })

					if lua_helper.type_compare(hero.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
						if self.heroes[i].name == 'china_hero' then
							if user_util.has_fei() then
								hero.Interactable.Talk = self.heroes[i].talk.boy
							else
								hero.Interactable.Talk = self.heroes[i].talk.girl
							end
						else
							hero.Interactable.Talk = self.heroes[i].talk
						end
					end
				end
			})
		end
	end

	self:add_point(self.battle_clear_point_amount)
end

-- npc들 전투 완료 후 배치로 재배치
function battlefield_base:replace_npcs()
	for i = 1, self.dw_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_dw_soldier(i)
		local end_pos = self:get_dw_soldier_pos(i)

		character_util.convert_to_npc(soldier)
		soldier.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(soldier, end_pos,
				4, nil, self, nil, {
			end_callback = function()
				character_util.set_side_direction(soldier)
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(soldier, { name = 'victory_extra' }, { name = 'smile' })
			end
		})
	end

	for i = 1, #self.heroes do
		local hero = self:get_hero(self.heroes[i].name)
		local hero_pos = self:get_hero_pos(self.heroes[i].name)
		character_util.convert_to_npc(hero)
		hero.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hero, hero_pos,
				4, nil, self, nil, {
			end_callback = function()
				if self.heroes[i].sfx ~= nil then
					music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.heroes[i].sfx, parent = hero })
				end

				character_util.set_direction(hero, self.heroes[i].dir)
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(hero, { name = self.heroes[i].anim },
						{ name = self.heroes[i].emotion })

				if lua_helper.type_compare(hero.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
					if self.heroes[i].name == 'china_hero' then
						if user_util.has_fei() then
							hero.Interactable.Talk = self.heroes[i].talk.boy
						else
							hero.Interactable.Talk = self.heroes[i].talk.girl
						end
					else
						hero.Interactable.Talk = self.heroes[i].talk
					end
				end
			end
		})
	end
end

-- 추가 병력 투입
function battlefield_base:add_extra_soldier()
	self:add_extra_dw_soldier(self:get_dw_extra_soldier_num())
	self:add_extra_saul_soldier(self:get_saul_extra_soldier_num())
end

-- 추가 투입 해야할 마계 병사 숫자 가져오기
function battlefield_base:get_dw_extra_soldier_num()
	local count = self.battlefield_point
	if count >= 90 then
		return 4
	elseif count >= 80 then
		return 3
	elseif count >= 70 then
		return 2
	elseif count >= 60 then
		return 1
	end

	return 0
end

-- 추가 투입 해야할 사울 병사 숫자 가져오기
function battlefield_base:get_saul_extra_soldier_num()
	local count = self.battlefield_point

	if count >= 40 then
		return 0
	elseif count >= 30 then
		return 1
	elseif count >= 20 then
		return 2
	elseif count >= 10 then
		return 3
	elseif count < 10 then
		return 4
	end
end

-- 추가 마계 병사 투입
function battlefield_base:add_extra_dw_soldier(num)
	local move_key = 'dw_soldier_move'

	if num == 0 then return end

	for i = 1, num do
		local soldier = self:get_dw_extra_soldier(i)

				7, nil, self, move_key, { run = true })

-- 움직이는 힘 싸움 전투 연출 루틴
function battlefield_base:set_fight_routine_1(dw_soldier, saul_soldier, is_side)
	start_coroutine(function()
		local continue = true
		local hash_key = dw_soldier.Name
		local move_dir = (is_side and unity_class.vector3.right
				or unity_class.vector3.forward) * 0.5
			self.fight_routine_flag_hashset:add(hash_key)

		character_util.stop(dw_soldier)
		character_util.stop(saul_soldier)

		character_util.shake(dw_soldier, 0.03, 99999)
		character_util.shake(saul_soldier, 0.03, 99999)

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(dw_soldier,
				{ name = 'push', upper = true }, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(saul_soldier,
				{ name = 'push', upper = true }, { name = 'attack' })

		character_util.look_at(dw_soldier, saul_soldier)
		character_util.look_at(saul_soldier, dw_soldier)

		dw_soldier.LockedDirection = dw_soldier.Direction
		saul_soldier.LockedDirection = saul_soldier.Direction

		while self.fight_routine_flag_hashset:contains(hash_key) do
			wp_util.move(dw_soldier, dw_soldier.Position + move_dir, nil, 0.5)
			wp_util.move(saul_soldier, saul_soldier.Position + move_dir, nil, 0.5)

			continue = self:fight_wait_for_sec(hash_key, 1.5)
			if not continue then
				break
			end

			wp_util.move(dw_soldier, dw_soldier.Position - move_dir, nil, 0.5)
			wp_util.move(saul_soldier, saul_soldier.Position - move_dir, nil, 0.5)
			self:fight_wait_for_sec(hash_key, 1.5)
		end
		character_util.stop(dw_soldier)
		character_util.stop(saul_soldier)
		character_util.stop_shake(dw_soldier)
		character_util.stop_shake(saul_soldier)

		character_util.reset_locked_dir(dw_soldier)
		character_util.reset_locked_dir(saul_soldier)
		character_util.look_at(dw_soldier, saul_soldier)
		character_util.look_at(saul_soldier, dw_soldier)

		character_util.remove_anim(dw_soldier, true)
		character_util.remove_emotion(dw_soldier)
		character_util.remove_anim(saul_soldier, true)
		character_util.remove_emotion(saul_soldier)
	end, self)
end

-- 넉백 전투 연출 루틴
function battlefield_base:set_fight_routine_2(dw_soldier, saul_soldier, is_side)
	start_coroutine(function()
		local continue = true
		local hash_key = dw_soldier.Name

		local dw_soldier_move_pos = nil
		local saul_soldier_move_pos = nil
		local dw_soldier_original_pos = dw_soldier.Position
		local saul_soldier_original_pos = saul_soldier.Position

		character_util.stop(dw_soldier)
		character_util.stop(saul_soldier)

		if is_side then
			if dw_soldier.Position.x > saul_soldier.Position.x then
				dw_soldier_move_pos = dw_soldier.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)
				saul_soldier_move_pos = saul_soldier.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)
			else
				dw_soldier_move_pos = dw_soldier.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)
				saul_soldier_move_pos = saul_soldier.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)
			end
		else
			if dw_soldier.Position.z > saul_soldier.Position.z then
				dw_soldier_move_pos = dw_soldier.Position + vector(0, 0, 1)
				saul_soldier_move_pos = saul_soldier.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)
			else
				dw_soldier_move_pos = dw_soldier.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)
				saul_soldier_move_pos = saul_soldier.Position + vector(0, 0, 1)
			end
		end

		self.fight_routine_flag_hashset:add(hash_key)

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(dw_soldier,
				{ name = 'sword_idle' }, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(saul_soldier,
				{ name = 'sword_idle' }, { name = 'attack' })

		character_util.look_at(dw_soldier, saul_soldier)
		character_util.look_at(saul_soldier, dw_soldier)

		dw_soldier.LockedDirection = dw_soldier.Direction
		saul_soldier.LockedDirection = saul_soldier.Direction

		while self.fight_routine_flag_hashset:contains(hash_key) do
			scene_util.set_anim(dw_soldier, self, { name = 'sword_attack', count = 1 })

			continue = self:fight_wait_for_sec(hash_key, 0.26)
			if not continue then
				break
			end

			self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(saul_soldier.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
			self.fx:hit():Instantiate(saul_soldier.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

			if (stage_camera.LookAtPosition - dw_soldier.Position).sqrMagnitude < self.sfx_sqr_distance then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_normal_slash_01', volume = 0.5, parent = dw_soldier })
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', volume = 0.5, parent = saul_soldier })
			end

			character_util.spine_damage_squish(saul_soldier, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)
			character_util.spine_pulse_color(saul_soldier,
						CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)

			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(saul_soldier,
				{ name = 'damaged' }, { name = 'damaged' })

			continue = self:knockback(hash_key, saul_soldier, saul_soldier_move_pos, 0.5)
			if not continue then
				break
			end

			character_util.remove_anim(saul_soldier)
			character_util.set_emotion(saul_soldier, { name = 'attack' })

			continue = self:fight_wait_for_sec(hash_key, 0.3)
			if not continue then
				break
			end

			wp_util.move(saul_soldier, saul_soldier_original_pos, nil, 0.3, { run = true })

			continue = self:fight_wait_for_sec(hash_key, 0.3)
			if not continue then
				break
			end

			scene_util.set_anim(saul_soldier, self, { name = 'sword_attack', count = 1 })

			continue = self:fight_wait_for_sec(hash_key, 0.26)
			if not continue then
				break
			end

			if (stage_camera.LookAtPosition - dw_soldier.Position).sqrMagnitude < self.sfx_sqr_distance then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_onehand_slash_01', volume = 0.5, parent = saul_soldier })
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_slash_01', volume = 0.5, parent = dw_soldier })
			end

			self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(dw_soldier.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
			self.fx:hit():Instantiate(dw_soldier.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

			character_util.spine_damage_squish(dw_soldier, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)
			character_util.spine_pulse_color(dw_soldier,
						CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)

			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(dw_soldier,
					{ name = 'damaged' }, { name = 'damaged' })

			continue = self:knockback(hash_key, dw_soldier, dw_soldier_move_pos, 0.5)
			if not continue then
				break
			end

			character_util.remove_anim(dw_soldier)
			character_util.set_emotion(dw_soldier, { name = 'attack' })

			continue = self:fight_wait_for_sec(hash_key, 0.3)
			if not continue then
				break
			end

			wp_util.move(dw_soldier, dw_soldier_original_pos, nil, 0.3, { run = true })
			continue = self:fight_wait_for_sec(hash_key, 0.3)
		end
		character_util.stop(dw_soldier)
		character_util.stop(saul_soldier)

		character_util.reset_locked_dir(dw_soldier)
		character_util.reset_locked_dir(saul_soldier)
		character_util.look_at(dw_soldier, saul_soldier)
		character_util.look_at(saul_soldier, dw_soldier)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dw_soldier)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(saul_soldier)

	end, self)
end

-- 전투 연출 전용 커스텀 wait_for_sec 무사히 종료했으면 true else flase
function battlefield_base:fight_wait_for_sec(hash_key, duration)
	local end_time = unity_class.time.time + duration
	while self.fight_routine_flag_hashset:contains(hash_key)
			and unity_class.time.time < end_time do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	return (not self.stage_ended and
			self.fight_routine_flag_hashset:contains(hash_key))
end

-- EaseOutCirc 넉백
function battlefield_base:knockback(hash_key, fo, end_pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = fo.Position
	local progress = 0

	while time_passed <= duration and self.fight_routine_flag_hashset:contains(hash_key) do

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCirc(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))
		fo.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	return self.fight_routine_flag_hashset:contains(hash_key)
end

-- 모든 전투 연출 종료
function battlefield_base:stop_all_fight_routine()

function battlefield_base:stop_fight_routine(fo)

-- 게임 오버
function bottom_battlefield:game_over()
	-- 이미 다른 전장에서 게임오버가 된 상태면 무시
	if self.controller.game_over then
		return
	end

	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local erina = get_character('legendary_hero_old')
	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_game_over_1')
	local reset_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_game_over_reset_pos')

	self.super:game_over()

	self.cw_util:enter_scene(nil)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_capture_enemy_01')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(knight,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s10_bottom_game_over', bubble_type = 'shout',
			viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.25), type_speed = 0, scale = 2 })
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	character_util.set_side_direction(knight)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(knight, '01_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.6)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(1)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 3 })

	self.controller:stop_war_sfx(3)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self:stop_all_fight_routine()
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	camera_util.move_async(center_pos, 0)
	character_util.set_position(erina, center_pos)

	for i = 1, self.dw_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_dw_soldier(i)
		character_util.set_side_direction(soldier)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(soldier, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false }, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.add_color(soldier, soldier.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.6, 0)
	end

	for i = 1, self.saul_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_saul_soldier(i)
		local soldier_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_game_over_saul_soldier_1_' .. i)
		character_util.set_anim(soldier, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_emotion(soldier, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_position(soldier, soldier_pos)
		character_util.look_at(soldier, erina)

		wait_for_sec(0.2)
	end

	character_util.set_anim(erina, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_emotion(erina, { name = 'damaged' })

	local hit_routine = true
	local stop_sfx = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		local count = 1
		while hit_routine do
			if count % 3 == 0 then
				if not stop_sfx then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_slash_01')
				end
				self.fx:hit():Instantiate(erina.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
				self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(erina.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
			end
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.1)
			character_util.shake(erina, 0.1, 0.1)
			wait_for_sec(0.1)
			count = count + 1
		end
	end)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_09')

	local hit_loop = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_loop_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 1 })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_emotion(erina)
	character_util.set_anim(erina, { name = 'dead1', loop = false })
	character_util.add_color(erina, erina.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 1.8)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 1.8)

	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.set_emotion(erina, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_vignette_01')

	hit_loop:FadeOut(1)
	hit_loop = nil

	stop_sfx = true

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.3, unity_class.color.red, 'linear')

	hit_routine = false

	character_util.remove_color(erina, erina.Name, 0)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(erina)

	for i = 1, self.dw_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_dw_soldier(i)
		character_util.remove_color(soldier, soldier.Name, 0)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
	end

	for i = 1, self.saul_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_saul_soldier(i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
	end

	character_util.set_position(knight, reset_pos)
	character_util.remove_emotion(knight)
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')

	-- 전장 초기화
	self.controller:publish_hard_reset()

	camera_util.move_async(vector(400, 0, 400), 0)
