-- 게임 오버
function center_battlefield:game_over()
	-- 이미 다른 전장에서 게임오버가 된 상태면 무시
	if self.controller.game_over then
		return
	end

	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local lilith = get_character('demon_queen')
	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_game_over_2')
	local reset_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_game_over_reset_pos')
	local soldiers = {
		self:get_saul_soldier(1), self:get_saul_soldier(2), self:get_saul_soldier(3),
		self:get_saul_soldier(4), self:get_saul_soldier(5), self:get_saul_soldier(7),
		self:get_saul_soldier(8),
	}
	local sfx = {
		'02_onehand_slash_02', '02_onehand_slash_02', '02_onehand_slash_02',
		'02_onehand_back_slash_02', '02_onehand_back_slash_02',
		'02_onehand_back_slash_02', '02_onehand_back_slash_02'
	}

	self.super:game_over()

	self.cw_util:enter_scene(nil)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_capture_enemy_01')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(knight,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s10_center_game_over', bubble_type = 'shout',
			viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.25), type_speed = 0, scale = 2 })
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	character_util.set_side_direction(knight)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(knight, '01_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.6)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(1)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 3 })

	self.controller:stop_war_sfx(3)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self:stop_all_fight_routine()
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	camera_util.move_async(center_pos, 0)
	character_util.set_position(lilith, center_pos)

	for i = 1, self.dw_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_dw_soldier(i)
		character_util.set_side_direction(soldier)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(soldier, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false }, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.add_color(soldier, soldier.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.6, 0)
	end

	for i = 1, self.saul_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_saul_soldier(i)
		local soldier_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_game_over_saul_soldier_2_' .. i)
		character_util.set_anim(soldier, { name = 'dagger_idle' })
		character_util.set_emotion(soldier, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_position(soldier, soldier_pos)
		character_util.look_at(soldier, lilith)
	end

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	scene_util.set_anim(lilith, self, { name = 'demon_ceo/attack2', count = 1 })
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_demon_claw_01')

	local air_spin_soldier = self:get_saul_soldier(6)
	self.fx:demon_queen_slash():Instantiate(lilith.Position)
	self.fx:demon_queen_claw():Instantiate(air_spin_soldier.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.2))
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	character_util.air_spin(air_spin_soldier)

	character_util.remove_anim(soldiers[3])
	wp_util.move_async(soldiers[3], lilith.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), nil, 0.3, { run = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(soldiers[5])
	wp_util.move(soldiers[5], lilith.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0), nil, 0.3, { run = true, last_direction = 'left' })

	scene_util.set_anim(soldiers[3], self, { name = 'attack', count = 1, sfx_name = sfx[3] })
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_slash_01')

	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.2)
	self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(lilith.Position + vector(-0.2, 0.1, 0))
	self.fx:hit():Instantiate(lilith.Position + vector(-0.2, 0.1, 0))
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(lilith, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(lilith,
				CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.3)
	character_util.set_anim(lilith, { name = 'damaged' })

	local lilith_knockback = function(end_pos, duration)
		local time_passed = 0
		local start_pos = lilith.Position
		local progress = 0

		while time_passed <= duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCirc(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))
			lilith.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		lilith.Position = end_pos
	end

	lilith_knockback(lilith.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.5)

	scene_util.set_anim(soldiers[5], self, { name = 'attack', count = 1, sfx_name = sfx[5] })
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_slash_01')

	self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(lilith.Position + vector(0.2, 0.1, 0))
	self.fx:hit():Instantiate(lilith.Position + vector(0.2, 0.1, 0))
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(lilith, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(lilith,
				CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.set_anim(lilith, { name = 'damaged2' })
	lilith_knockback(lilith.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 0.3)

	local move_key = 'game_over_soldier_move'

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_09')

	for i = 1, #soldiers do
		if i ~= 3 then
			local dir_vec = (lilith.Position - soldiers[i].Position).normalized
			local distance = vector_util.distance(lilith.Position, soldiers[i].Position) - 1
			character_util.remove_anim(soldiers[i])
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(soldiers[i], soldiers[i].Position + (dir_vec * distance),
					nil, 0.3, self, move_key, { run = true })
		end
	end
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	local stop_sfx = false
	local attack_lilith = function(soldier, anim, play_fx, hit_sfx_name)
		scene_util.set_anim(soldier, self, { name = 'attack', count =  1, sfx_name = hit_sfx_name })
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		if play_fx then
			if not stop_sfx then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_slash_01')
			end

			self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(lilith.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
			self.fx:hit():Instantiate(lilith.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
		end
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(lilith, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(lilith,
				CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)

		character_util.look_at(lilith, soldier)
		character_util.set_anim(lilith, { name = anim })
	end

	local anim = { 'damaged2', 'damaged', 'damaged', 'damaged', 'damaged2', 'damaged2', 'damaged2' }
	for i = 1, #soldiers do
		local play_fx = i % 2 == 0 and true or false
		attack_lilith(soldiers[i], anim[i], play_fx, sfx[i])
	end
	scene_util.set_emotion(lilith, self, 'damaged')
	character_util.add_color(lilith, lilith.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 4)

	for i = 1, #soldiers do
		local play_fx = i % 2 == 0 and true or false
		attack_lilith(soldiers[i], anim[i], play_fx, sfx[i])
	end

	character_util.set_direction(lilith, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim(lilith, self, { name = 'dead1', loop = false })
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 1.8)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.set_emotion(lilith, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	wait_for_sec(0.33)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.17)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_vignette_01')

	stop_sfx = true

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.3, unity_class.color.red, 'linear')

	character_util.remove_color(lilith, lilith.Name, 0)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lilith)

	self:revive_soldier(air_spin_soldier)
	for i = 1, self.dw_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_dw_soldier(i)
		character_util.remove_color(soldier, soldier.Name, 0)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
	end

	for i = 1, self.saul_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_saul_soldier(i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
	end

	character_util.set_position(knight, reset_pos)
	character_util.remove_emotion(knight)
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')

	-- 전장 초기화
	self.controller:publish_hard_reset()

	camera_util.move_async(vector(400, 0, 400), 0)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.7, unity_class.color.red, 'linear')

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_main_s10_game_over' })

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	self.controller:reset_camera_zoom()
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.controller:play_war_sfx(0.3)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 3 })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.controller.game_over = false
	self.controller.pause_event_hashset:remove(self.battlefield_idx)

	self.cw_util:exit_scene(nil, knight)
end

function top_battlefield:game_over()

	if self.controller.game_over then
		return
	end

	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local sohee_name = 'ghost_buster'
	local sohee = self:get_hero(sohee_name)
	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_game_over_3')
	local reset_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_game_over_reset_pos')

	self.super:game_over()

	self.cw_util:enter_scene(nil)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_capture_enemy_01')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(knight,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s10_top_game_over', bubble_type = 'shout',
			viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.25), type_speed = 0, scale = 2 })
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	character_util.set_side_direction(knight)
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(knight, '01_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.6)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(1)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 3 })

	self.controller:stop_war_sfx(3)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self:stop_all_fight_routine()
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 0)
	camera_util.move_async(center_pos, 0)

	for i = 1, self.dw_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_dw_soldier(i)
		character_util.set_side_direction(soldier)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(soldier, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false }, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.set_side_direction(soldier)
		character_util.add_color(soldier, soldier.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.6, 0)
	end

	local soldiers = {}
	for i = 1, self.saul_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_saul_soldier(i)
		local soldier_pos = self:get_saul_soldier_pos(i)
		character_util.set_emotion(soldier, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_position(soldier, soldier_pos)
		table.insert(soldiers, soldier)
	end

	for i = 1, #self.heroes do
		if self.heroes[i].name ~= sohee_name then
			local hero = self:get_hero(self.heroes[i].name)
			local hero_pos = self:get_hero_pos(self.heroes[i].name)
			character_util.set_direction(hero, 'right')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(hero, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
			character_util.set_position(hero, hero_pos)
		end
	end

	character_util.set_anim(soldiers[8], { name = 'boong_attack_ready_loop' })

	local play_attack_routine = true
	local stop_sfx = false
	local attack_routine = function(soldier, target, sfx, hit_sfx)
		start_coroutine(function()
			local count = 1
			character_util.look_at(soldier, target)

			while play_attack_routine do
				if not stop_sfx then
					scene_util.set_anim(soldier, self, { name = 'attack', count =  1, sfx_name = sfx })
				else
					scene_util.set_anim(soldier, self, { name = 'attack', count =  1, sfx_name = false })
				end

				wait_for_sec(0.3)

				if count % 2 == 0 then
					if hit_sfx ~= nil and not stop_sfx then
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(hit_sfx)
					end
					self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
					self.fx:hit():Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
				end
				count = count + 1
				character_util.shake(target, 0.03, 0.3)
				wait_for_sec(0.2)
			end
		end)
	end

	character_util.set_position(soldiers[1], soldiers[1].Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5))

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridMoveEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WindPotPullStartEvent))

	self.contain_bottom_zone = nil
	self.contain_center_zone = nil
	self.contain_top_zone = nil

	if self.war_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.war_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.war_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	self.res_holder = nil
	self.battle_ui = nil
	if not is_unity_null(self.ui_prefab) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.ui_prefab)
	end
	self.ui_prefab = nil

	if self.battlefields ~= nil then
		for _,battlefield in pairs(self.battlefields) do
			battlefield:dispose()
		end
		self.battlefields = nil
	end
	if self.support_soldiers ~= nil then
		self.support_soldiers:dispose()
		self.support_soldiers = nil
	end

	if self.cannon_soldiers ~= nil then
		self.cannon_soldiers:dispose()
		self.cannon_soldiers = nil
	end

	self.pause_bf_timer_hashset:clear()
	self.pause_event_hashset:clear()
end

			self.battle_ui:ui_visible(false)
	      end)

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	self.support_soldiers:on_interact_event(e)
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
	self.stage_ended = true

	self.battle_ui:end_battle_ui()

	if self.battlefields ~= nil then
		for _,battlefield in pairs(self.battlefields) do
			battlefield:on_stage_end_event()
		end
	end

	if self.support_soldiers ~= nil then
		self.support_soldiers:on_stage_end_event()
	end

	if self.cannon_soldiers ~= nil then
		self.cannon_soldiers:on_stage_end_event()
	end

	return true
end

	for _,battlefield in pairs(self.battlefields) do

	end
	self.cannon_soldiers:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	self.support_soldiers:on_zone_enter_event(e)
end

	self.cannon_soldiers:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	self.support_soldiers:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)

	for _,battlefield in pairs(self.battlefields) do

end

	if e.To.name == 'battlefield_grid' then
		self:set_war_sfx_volume_by_battlefield()

-- 전장 세팅
function local_class:set_battlefield()
	if self.finished_setting_battlefield then
		return
	end

	for _,battlefield in pairs(self.battlefields) do
		battlefield:set_battlefield()
	end
	self.finished_setting_battlefield = true
end

-- 전장 이벤트 시작
function local_class:start_battlefield_event()
	if self.started_battlefield_event then
		return
	end

	get_field_object('tent_inner').ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	self.battle_ui:init_battle_ui()

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(self.camera_zoom_value, 0.5)
	self.is_camera_zoom_out = true

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridMoveEndEvent), 'on_camera_grid_move_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent), 'on_hold_up_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WindPotPullStartEvent), 'on_wind_pot_pull_start_event')

	if not self.finished_setting_battlefield then
		self:set_battlefield()
	end

	self.started_battlefield_event = true

	for _,battlefield in pairs(self.battlefields) do
		battlefield:start_battlefield_event()
	end
	self.cannon_soldiers:start_battlefield_event()
	self.support_soldiers:start_battlefield_event()

	self:show_battlefield_quest_marker()

	start_coroutine(self.battlefield_event_loop, self)
end

-- 전장 이벤트 업데이트 루프
function local_class:battlefield_event_loop()
	local knight = get_party_leader()

	while not self.stage_ended and
			not self.cleared_battlefield_event do

		if #self.pause_event_hashset == 0 and
				not knight.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
			if #self.pause_bf_timer_hashset == 0 then
				self.battlefields.center:update(dt)
				self.battlefields.bottom:update(dt)
				self.battlefields.top:update(dt)
			end

			self.cannon_soldiers:update(dt)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 배틀 시작 이벤트 publish
function local_class:publish_start_battle_event(battle_zone_name)
	for _,battlefield in pairs(self.battlefields) do
		battlefield:on_start_battle_event(battle_zone_name)
	end

	self.cannon_soldiers:on_start_battle_event(battle_zone_name)
end

	self.cannon_soldiers:on_clear_battlefield_event()
	for _,battlefield in pairs(self.battlefields) do
		battlefield:on_clear_battlefield_event()
	end

	self:on_clear_battlefield_event()
end

function local_class:on_clear_battlefield_event()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridMoveEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WindPotPullStartEvent))

	self.battle_ui:end_battle_ui()

	get_field_object('tent_inner').ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

	self.cleared_battlefield_event = true
end

		self.main_quest_id, true, center_pos)

		self.main_quest_id, true, get_field_object('bf_cannon'))

	end
end

function local_class:reset_camera_zoom()
	if self.is_camera_zoom_out then
		self.is_camera_zoom_out = false
		camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	end
end

-- 루프 sfx 실행

	if self.war_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		return
	end

	self.war_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '01_war_loop_02', loop = true,
			  type_priority = 'loop', volume = volume_value })
end

-- 루프 sfx 정지
function local_class:stop_war_sfx(duration)
	if self.war_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.war_loop_sfx:FadeOut(duration)
		self.war_loop_sfx = nil
	end
end

-- 루프 sfx 볼륨 조정
function local_class:set_war_sfx_volume(value)
	if self.war_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.war_loop_sfx.Volume = value
	end
end

-- 전장 상태를 기반하여 루프 sfx 볼륨 세팅
function local_class:set_war_sfx_volume_by_battlefield()
	local knight = get_party_leader()

	if zone_util.contains_fo(self.contain_bottom_zone, knight, false) and
			self.battlefields.bottom.ended_reset_battlefield then
		self:set_war_sfx_volume(0.6)
	elseif zone_util.contains_fo(self.contain_center_zone, knight, false) and
			self.battlefields.center.ended_reset_battlefield then
		self:set_war_sfx_volume(0.6)
	elseif zone_util.contains_fo(self.contain_top_zone, knight, false) and
			self.battlefields.top.ended_reset_battlefield then
		self:set_war_sfx_volume(0.6)
	else
		self:set_war_sfx_volume(0.3)
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

				this.container = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(this.specs)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this)
			if this.container ~= nil then
				load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(this.container)
				this.container = nil
			end
		end,
	}

	-- 전투 이벤트 시작 여부
	self.started_battle = false

	-- 스테이지 종료 여부
	self.stage_ended = false

	-- 경고 연출 실행 플래그
	self.play_warning_scene = false

	-- 대기 시간
	self.wait_time_passed = 0

	-- 대포 이벤트 등장 시 점수 세팅 값
	self.cannon_event_point_value = 30

	-- 대포 이벤트 프로그레스 키
	self.progress_key = 0
	self.progress = stage_progress_util.get_custom_data_int(self.progress_key, 1)

	-- 대포 이벤트 전투 병사 수
	self.cannon_soldiers_count = 8

	-- 퍼즐 그리드 이름
	self.puzzle_grid_name = 'battlefield_puzzle_grid'

	-- 대포 이벤트 실행 시 이벤트 정지 key
	self.cannon_event_pause_key = 'cannon_event'

	-- 전투 루틴 모두 종료되었는지 확인용 해시셋
	self.playing_fight_routine_hashset = create_lua_hashset()

	-- 이탈 방지 씬 실행 여부
	self.play_block_scene = false

	-- 크레이그 실드 이펙트
	self.tanker_shield_fx = nil

	-- 사이렌 소리
	self.siren_sfx = nil

	--- 대포 발사 소리
	self.cannon_loop_sfx = nil

	-- 대포 이벤트 루프 sfx
	self.cannon_war_sfx = nil

	-- 대포 컨트롤러
	local path = 'Quest/Main/CivilWar/Common/CivilWarManaCannon'
	self.cannon_controller = get_or_create_global_variable(path).mana_cannon(self)

end

function cannon_soldiers:load_async()
	self.dynamic_npc:load_async()

	self:set_object_by_progress()
end

function cannon_soldiers:update(dt)
	local data = self.cannon_event_data[self.progress]

	if self.controller.game_over then
		return
	end

	-- 대포 이벤트 대기
	if data.state == self.cannon_event_state.wait then
		self.wait_time_passed = self.wait_time_passed + dt
		-- 등장 조건 체크
		if self.wait_time_passed >= data.wait_time and not self.started_battle and
				self.controller:check_ended_reset_battlefield(data.battlefield_idx) then
			self.cannon_event_data[self.progress].state = self.cannon_event_state.spawn
			self.wait_time_passed = 0
			-- 등장 이벤트
			self.cw_util:start_scene(self.start_cannon_event, self)
		end
	end
end

function cannon_soldiers:dispose()
	self.dynamic_npc:dispose()

	if self.siren_sfx ~= nil then
		self.siren_sfx:Stop()
		self.siren_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.cannon_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.cannon_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.cannon_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.cannon_war_sfx ~= nil then
		self.cannon_war_sfx:Stop()
		self.cannon_war_sfx = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cannon_controller = nil
	self.playing_fight_routine_hashset:clear()
end

function cannon_soldiers:on_stage_end_event()
	self.stage_ended = true

	if self.tanker_shield_fx ~= nil then
		self.tanker_shield_fx:Dispose()
		self.tanker_shield_fx = nil
	end
end

-- 배틀 시작 이벤트
function cannon_soldiers:on_start_battle_event(battle_zone_name)
	self.started_battle = true

	-- 포격 이벤트
	if self.cannon_event_data[self.progress].state == self.cannon_event_state.appeared_cannon and
			battle_zone_name == self.cannon_event_data[self.progress].battlefield_zone then
		self.cannon_event_data[self.progress].state = self.cannon_event_state.activated_cannon
		-- 대포 활성화
		self.cannon_controller:activate(self:get_cannon(),
				{ shooter = self:get_cannon_driver(), damage_type = 'true_damage' })
	end

	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
end

function cannon_soldiers:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local data = self.cannon_event_data[self.progress]
	-- 이벤트 전투 존
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, knight, data.zone) and
			data.state == self.cannon_event_state.deactivated_cannon then
		self.cannon_event_data[self.progress].state = self.cannon_event_state.cannon_event_battle
		-- 이벤트 전투 시작
		start_coroutine(self.start_battle, self)
		return true
	end

	-- 이탈 방지 존 이벤트
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, knight, data.block_zone) and not self.play_block_scene and
			(data.state == self.cannon_event_state.deactivated_cannon or
			data.state == self.cannon_event_state.cannon_event_battle or
			data.state == self.cannon_event_state.break_cannon) then
		self.play_block_scene = true
		self.cw_util:start_scene(data.block_cb, self, e.Zone)
		return true
	end
end

-- 배틀 그룹 전멸 이벤트
function cannon_soldiers:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	self.started_battle = false

	--이벤트 전투 클리어
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.cannon_event_data[self.progress].zone then
		self.cannon_event_data[self.progress].state = self.cannon_event_state.break_cannon
		self:clear_event_battle()

	-- 전장 일반 전투 클리어
	elseif self.cannon_event_data[self.progress].state == self.cannon_event_state.activated_cannon and
			e.BattleGroupName == self.cannon_event_data[self.progress].battlefield_zone then
		self.cannon_event_data[self.progress].state = self.cannon_event_state.deactivated_cannon
		-- 대포 비활성화
		self.cannon_controller:deactivate()
		-- 타이머 정지
		self.controller.pause_bf_timer_hashset:add(self.cannon_event_pause_key)
		-- 전장 일반 전투 클리어 콜백 호출
		self.cw_util:start_scene(self.cannon_event_data[self.progress].clear_battle_cb, self)
	end
end

function cannon_soldiers:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	local cannon = self:get_cannon()
	-- 대포 파괴
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self:get_cannon()) and
			self.cannon_event_data[self.progress].state == self.cannon_event_state.break_cannon then
		self.cannon_event_data[self.progress].state = self.cannon_event_state.clear

		character_util.air_spin(self:get_cannon_driver())

		local broken_cannon = get_field_object(self.cannon_event_data[self.progress].broken_cannon)
		broken_cannon.Position = cannon.Position

		-- 대포 이벤트 클리어
		start_coroutine(self.clear_cannon_event, self)
	end
end

-- 전장 이벤트 시작
function cannon_soldiers:start_battlefield_event()
	local cannon = self:get_cannon()
	cannon.DamagedBehaviour.DamageType =
			CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick | CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
end

-- 전장 이벤트 클리어 처리
function cannon_soldiers:on_clear_battlefield_event()
	self:disabled_broken_cannon()
end

-- 게임 오버 하드 리셋
function cannon_soldiers:hard_reset()
	self.wait_time_passed = 0
end

end

-- 배틀 시작
function cannon_soldiers:start_battle()
	local data = self.cannon_event_data[self.progress]
	self.started_battle = true

	self:close_battle_gate()

	for i = 1, self.cannon_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_soldiers(i)
		character_util.set_active_state(soldier, 'enabled')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
		character_util.convert_to_monster(soldier, data.zone)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	for i = 1, self.cannon_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_soldiers(i)
		command_util.publish_monster_notice(soldier, get_party_leader(), 'battle')
	end
end

-- 배틀 클리어
function cannon_soldiers:clear_event_battle()
	self:open_battle_gate()
end

-- 대포 이벤트 시작
function cannon_soldiers:start_cannon_event()
	local data = self.cannon_event_data[self.progress]
	local knight = get_party_leader()

	-- 타이머 정지
	self.controller.pause_bf_timer_hashset:add(self.cannon_event_pause_key)

	-- 배틀 종료 시 연출 콜백 호출 안되도록 정지
	self.controller:skip_battle_end_cb(data.battlefield_idx)

	self:play_siren_sfx(1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(knight,
			{ key = data.text_key, bubble_type = 'shout',
			viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.75), type_speed = 0, scale = 2 })

	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump(knight, '01_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(1.6)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.7, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 0)

	-- 대포 이벤트 시작 콜백
	data.start_event_cb(self)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.7, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	if not self.controller.is_camera_zoom_out then
		camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	self.controller:set_war_sfx_volume_by_battlefield()
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.remove_emotion(knight)

	-- 대포 이벤트 경고 연출 실행
	self:cannon_event_warning_scene()

	-- 대포 이벤트 시작 시 해당 전장 포인트를 낮춘다
	if self.controller:get_point(data.battlefield_idx) > self.cannon_event_point_value then
		self.controller:set_point(data.battlefield_idx, self.cannon_event_point_value)
	end

	self.cannon_event_data[self.progress].state = self.cannon_event_state.appeared_cannon

	self.controller:show_cannon_quest_marker()

	-- 타이머 다시 진행
	self.controller.pause_bf_timer_hashset:remove(self.cannon_event_pause_key)
end

-- 대포 이벤트 완료 공용 처리
function cannon_soldiers:clear_cannon_event()
	local cannon = self:get_cannon()
	local data = self.cannon_event_data[self.progress]

	-- 대포 마커 제거
	self.controller:remove_cannon_quest_marker()

	cannon.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.sender = cannon
	heal_info.target = cannon
	heal_info.target = cannon
	heal_info.heal = 1
	heal_info.isRevive = true
	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

	-- 위기 연출 플래그 해제
	self.play_warning_scene = false

	self:stop_cannon_war_sfx(3)

	-- 배틀 완료 연출 스킵하도록 막아놓은거 해제
	self.controller:play_battle_end_cb(data.battlefield_idx)

	-- 대포 파괴 콜백 호출
	data.destroyed_cannon_cb(self)

	-- 타이머 정지 해시셋 제거
	self.controller.pause_bf_timer_hashset:remove(self.cannon_event_pause_key)

	-- 아직 진행할 대포 이벤트가 있다면 progress 증가 + 저장 후 계속 진행, 없다면 전장 이벤트 클리어 처리
	if self.progress < #self.cannon_event_data then
		self.controller:show_battlefield_quest_marker()
		self.progress = self.progress + 1
		stage_progress_util.set_custom_data_async(self.progress_key, self.progress)
	else
		self.controller:publish_clear_battlefield_event()
	end
end

-- 대포 이벤트 경고 연출
function cannon_soldiers:cannon_event_warning_scene()
	if self.play_warning_scene then
		return
	end
	self.play_warning_scene = true

	start_coroutine(self.field_tint_routine, self)
	start_coroutine(self.shake_routine, self)
end

-- 대포 이벤트 경고 틴트 연출
function cannon_soldiers:field_tint_routine()
	local tint_color = unity_color({ 1, 0, 0, 1 })
	local tint_key = 'battlefield_cannon_tint'
	local time_passed = 0

	self:play_cannon_war_sfx(0.8)
	while self.play_warning_scene and not self.stage_ended do
		field:Tint(tint_key, tint_color, 0.5)

		time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < 1 and self.play_warning_scene and not self.stage_ended do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		if self.stage_ended then
			return
		end

		field:RemoveTint(tint_key, 0.5)

		time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < 2 and self.play_warning_scene and not self.stage_ended do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 대포 이벤트 경고 틴트 연출
function cannon_soldiers:shake_routine()
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 2
	while self.play_warning_scene and not self.stage_ended do
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

		time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < duration and self.play_warning_scene and not self.stage_ended do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 병사 부활
function cannon_soldiers:revive_soldier(soldier)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(soldier)
	character_util.reset_all_state(soldier)
	soldier.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.sender = soldier
	heal_info.target = soldier
	heal_info.target = soldier
	heal_info.heal = soldier.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.isRevive = true
	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

	soldier.SpineController:Rotate(0, 0)
	character_util.set_active_state(soldier, 'visible')
end

-- 대포 등장 루틴
function cannon_soldiers:cannon_appear_routine(start_pos, end_pos, battle_zone_center)
	local cannon = self:get_cannon()
	local time_passed = 0
	local progress = 0
	local duration = 2.5
	local offset = { vector(3, 0, 0), vector(3.5, 0, 0), vector(3, 0, 1), vector(3.5, 0, 1) }
	local cannon_driver = self:get_cannon_driver()
	local soldiers = { self:get_soldiers(1), self:get_soldiers(2), self:get_soldiers(3), cannon_driver }
	local battle_zone_offset = { vector(-3, 0, 0), vector(-1, 0, 0), vector(1, 0, 0), vector(3, 0, 0),
							  vector(-3, 0, 1.5), vector(-1, 0, 1.5), vector(1, 0, 1.5), vector(3, 0, 1.5)}
	local move_key = 'cannon_soldiers_move'
	local move_key_2 = 'cannon_soldiers_return'

	-- 재활용 병사 부활 처리
	self:revive_soldier(cannon_driver)
	for i = 1, self.cannon_soldiers_count do
		self:revive_soldier(self:get_soldiers(i))
	end

	-- 병사와 함께 등장
	for i = 1, #soldiers do
		character_util.set_position(soldiers[i], start_pos + offset[i])
		character_util.set_active_shadow(soldiers[i], false)
		character_util.set_anim(soldiers[i], { name = 'push', upper = true })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(soldiers[i], end_pos + offset[i],
				nil, duration, self, move_key)
	end

	local wagon_loop = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_wagon_loop_01', loop = true })

	cannon.Position = start_pos
	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		progress = time_passed / duration
		cannon.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	cannon.Position = end_pos
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	self:stop_siren_sfx(4)

	wagon_loop:Stop()
	wagon_loop = nil

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_dendrobium_ready_03')

	-- 조종수 제외 병사는 퇴장 + 배틀존에 전투용으로 배치
	for i = 1, #soldiers - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim(soldiers[i], true)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(soldiers[i], soldiers[i].Position + vector(10, 0, 0),
				4, nil, self, move_key_2)
	end
	character_util.remove_anim(cannon_driver, true)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key_2)

	character_util.set_active_state(cannon_driver, 'enabled')

	for i = 1, self.cannon_soldiers_count do
		local soldier = self:get_soldiers(i)
		character_util.set_position(soldier, battle_zone_center + battle_zone_offset[i])
		character_util.set_direction(soldier, 'down')
	end

	for i = 1, #soldiers do
		character_util.set_active_shadow(soldiers[i], true)
	end
end

-- 첫번째 대포 이벤트 시작 연출
function cannon_soldiers:start_cannon_event_scene_1()
	local ghost_buster = get_character('ghost_buster')
	local camera_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_top_center')
	local extra_npc_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_cannon_extra_npc_pos_1')
	local start_center_pos = self:get_cannon_start_pos(self.cannon_event_data[self.progress].battlefield_idx)
	local end_center_pos = self:get_cannon_end_pos(self.cannon_event_data[self.progress].battlefield_idx)
	local play_ghost_buster_routine = true
	local saul_soldier = get_character('bf_saul_soldier_3_8')

	local ghost_buster_attack_routine = function()
		start_coroutine(function()
			while play_ghost_buster_routine do
				local magiton = self.fx:ghost_buster_magiton():Instantiate(ghost_buster.Position + vector(0.6, 0.2, 0.1))
				scene_util.set_anim(ghost_buster, self, { name = 'rifle_shoot2' })

				scene_util.set_anim(saul_soldier, self, { name = 'damaged' })
				scene_util.set_emotion(saul_soldier, self, { name = 'damaged' })

				character_util.spine_damage_squish(saul_soldier, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)
				character_util.spine_pulse_color(saul_soldier,
							CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)
				wait_for_sec(0.3)
				character_util.spine_damage_squish(saul_soldier, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)
				character_util.spine_pulse_color(saul_soldier,
							CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)
				wait_for_sec(0.3)
				character_util.spine_damage_squish(saul_soldier, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)
				character_util.spine_pulse_color(saul_soldier,
							CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)
				wait_for_sec(0.4)

				scene_util.set_emotion(saul_soldier, self, { name = 'attack' })
				character_util.remove_anim(saul_soldier)
				character_util.remove_anim(ghost_buster)
				magiton:Dispose()

				wait_for_sec(1)
			end
		end)
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('bf_cannon_door_3', true))

	camera_util.move(camera_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 1), 0)

	local extra_npc_count = 2
	for i = 1, extra_npc_count do
		local extra_npc = self.dynamic_npc:get(i)
		self:revive_soldier(extra_npc)
		character_util.set_position(extra_npc, extra_npc_pos + vector(-i - 5, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(extra_npc, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(extra_npc, { name = 'dagger_idle' }, { name = 'attack' })
	end

	self.controller:set_war_sfx_volume(0.6)

			dir = 'right'
		},
	}

	local teatan_hero_shoot = function(start_pos, end_pos, duration)
		local dir = (end_pos - start_pos).normalized
		local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.forward, dir)

		local missile = self.fx.teatan_hero_missile():Instantiate(start_pos, rot, nil)
		missile.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(2, 2, 2)
		local trail = self.fx.teatan_hero_trail():Instantiate(start_pos, rot, nil)
		trail.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(2, 2, 2)

		local time_passed = 0
		local progress = 0
		while time_passed < duration do
			progress = time_passed / duration

			missile.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			trail.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end


		self.fx.teatan_hero_explosion():Instantiate(end_pos)

		missile:Dispose()
		trail:TriggeredDispose()
	end

-- 첫번째 대포 파괴 후 처리
function cannon_soldiers:destroyed_cannon_event_scene_1()
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local tanker = get_character('tanker')
	local camera_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_top_center')

	self.cw_util:enter_scene(nil)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('bf_battle_gate_3_3', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('bf_cannon_door_3', false))

	self.controller:set_war_sfx_volume(0.6)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 1)
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 1, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(tanker)
	if self.tanker_shield_fx ~= nil then
		self.tanker_shield_fx:Dispose()
		self.tanker_shield_fx = nil
	end

	-- $name이 대포를 부쉈어!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tanker,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s10_cannon_1_12', life_time = 2, force_sfx = true })

	-- 전투 연출 루틴 종료
	self.cannon_event_data[self.progress].play_fight_routine = false

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_matched_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')

			-- 적들을 몰아내자!!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tanker,
					{ key = 'cw_main_s10_cannon_1_13_1', bubble_type = 'shout',
					viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.6), scale = 2, skip = true, life_time = 2 })
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			-- 모든 전투 연출 루틴이 정상 종료될때까지 대기
			while #self.playing_fight_routine_hashset > 0 do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			self.controller:set_war_sfx_volume(0.3)
		end)
	})

	self.controller:replace_npcs(self.cannon_event_data[self.progress].battlefield_idx)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_mvp_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_clap_02')

	-- 우와아아!! $name 만세!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tanker,
			{ key = 'cw_main_s10_cannon_1_13', bubble_type = 'shout',
			viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.6), scale = 2, life_time = 2 })

	if not self.controller.is_camera_zoom_out then
		camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	end
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	self.cw_util:exit_scene(nil, knight)
end

	self:set_fight_routine_2(dw_soldiers[4], saul_soldiers[4], true)
	self:set_fight_routine_2(dw_soldiers[5], saul_soldiers[5], true)
	self:set_fight_routine_2(dw_soldiers[7], saul_soldiers[7], true)
	self:set_fight_routine_3(dw_soldiers[6], saul_soldiers[6])

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	start_coroutine(self.fire_cannon_scene, self, extra_npc_pos + vector(0, 0, -1.5), self.extra_air_spin_cb)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.7, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 이대로는 아군의 손해만 늘겠군.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(erina, self, 'left', nil, nil, 'cw_main_s10_cannon_2_3')

	character_util.set_direction(erina, 'up')
	-- $name! 저 대포를 파괴하러 가라!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(erina, self, nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'cw_main_s10_cannon_2_4')

	scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })
	-- 길은 내가 뚫어주지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(erina, self, 'down', nil, nil, 'cw_main_s10_cannon_2_5')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.move(erina.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5), 1)
	wp_util.move_async(erina, erina.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5), nil, 1)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.fx:legendaryhero_charge():Instantiate(erina.Position)
	self.fx:legendaryhero_slash():Instantiate(erina.Position)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_event_qs_03')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(erina, self, { name = 'legendary_hero/attack2', count = 1 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hero_sword_02')
	scene_util.set_anim(erina, self, { name = 'legendary_hero/attack1', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	local erina_attack = function(start_pos, end_pos, speed)
		start_coroutine(function()
			local duration = (end_pos - start_pos).magnitude / speed
			local dir = (end_pos - start_pos).normalized
			local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.right, dir)
			local time_passed = 0
			local progress = 0

			local proj = self.fx.legendaryhero_proj():Instantiate(start_pos, rot, nil)
			local trail = self.fx.legendaryhero_trail():Instantiate(start_pos, rot, nil)

			while time_passed < duration do
				progress = time_passed / duration

				proj.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
				trail.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			proj:Dispose()
			trail:TriggeredDispose()
		end)
	end

	local speed = 12
	local start_pos = erina.Position + vector(0, 0.1, -0.2)
	local end_pos = erina.Position + vector(0, 0.1, -12)
	local obstacle_duration = (erina.Position.z - obstacles[1].Position.z) / speed

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_slash_04')
	erina_attack(start_pos, end_pos, speed)

	camera_util.move(vector(erina.Position.x, 0, obstacles[1].Position.z), obstacle_duration)
	wait_for_sec(obstacle_duration)

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_02')
	self.fx:smoke():Instantiate(obstacles[1].Position + vector(1, 0, -0.5))
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	self:disabled_obstacles()

	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_anim(erina)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	wp_util.move_async(erina, erina.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0), 4)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	-- 믿고 있겠다, 가디언.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(erina, self, 'right', nil, nil, 'cw_main_s10_cannon_2_6')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.remove_emotion(knight)

	local erina_fire_cb = function()
		scene_util.set_anim(erina, self,
			{ name =  'legendary_hero/attack2', scale = 0.5, loop = false, remove_after = 1.1 })

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hero_charge_02', parent = erina })
		self.fx:legendaryhero_cast():Instantiate(erina.Position)
	end

	self:fire_cannon_loop(erina.Position, nil, erina_fire_cb, self.progress)
end

-- 세번째 대포 이벤트 전장 전투 클리어 연출
function cannon_soldiers:clear_battle_event_scene_3()
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local lilith = get_character('demon_queen')
	local saul_soldier_count = 6
	local dw_soldier_count = 6
	local saul_soldiers = {}
	local dw_soldiers = {}
	local knight_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_knight_cannon_2')

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self:set_cannon_anim_idle()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('bf_battle_gate_2_3', false))

	character_util.set_position(lilith, field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_demon_queen_cannon'))
	character_util.set_direction(lilith, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(lilith, { name = 'attack' })

	character_util.set_position(knight, knight_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(knight, { name = 'attack' })

	local dynamic_npc_start_count = 15
	for i = 1, saul_soldier_count do
		local npc = self.dynamic_npc:get(i + dynamic_npc_start_count)
		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_saul_soldier_2_' .. i .. '_pos')
		character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
		table.insert(saul_soldiers, npc)
	end
	for i = 1, dw_soldier_count do
		local npc = get_character('bf_dw_soldier_2_' .. i)
		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_dw_soldier_2_' .. i .. '_pos')
		character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
		table.insert(dw_soldiers, npc)
	end
	character_util.set_position(get_character('bf_dw_soldier_2_7'), vector(999, 0, 999))

	self:set_fight_routine_1(dw_soldiers[1], saul_soldiers[1], false)
	self:set_fight_routine_1(dw_soldiers[2], saul_soldiers[2], false)
	self:set_fight_routine_1(dw_soldiers[3], saul_soldiers[3], true)
	self:set_fight_routine_2(dw_soldiers[4], saul_soldiers[4], true)
	self:set_fight_routine_2(dw_soldiers[5], saul_soldiers[5], true)
	self:set_fight_routine_3(dw_soldiers[6], saul_soldiers[6])

	wait_for_sec(1)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.7, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- $name! 곧 있으면 마신들이 올…
	music_player:PlayDialogue('cw_main_s10_cannon_3_3')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(lilith, { key = 'cw_main_s10_cannon_3_3', type_speed = 0, dialogue = false })

	-- qte 대포 연출. 타이밍을 맞추기 위해 따로 분리함
	do
		local charging_duration = 1
		local aiming_duration = 2
		local fire_duration = 0.5
		local qte_duration = 0.2
		local reload_duration = 1
		local time_passed = 0
		local pos = knight.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)

		local attack_range_radius = 1.5
		local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero,
				attack_range_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		attack_range:Hide()

		local start_pos = pos + vector(0, 12.5, 0)

		local cannon = self:get_cannon()
		local animator = cannon:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		scene_util.set_anim(self:get_cannon_driver(), self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })
		animator:Play('on_45')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bombard_range_01')

		attack_range_util.setup_by_position(attack_range, pos, 0)
		attack_range_util.show(attack_range, aiming_duration)

		wait_for_sec(aiming_duration)

		animator:Play('shoot_45')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lockon_01')

		wait_for_sec(aiming_duration - charging_duration - fire_duration)

		self:play_cannon_sfx(1, pos)
		local missile_effect = self.fx.cannon_proj():Instantiate(start_pos)
		missile_effect.transform.localScale = vector(2, 2, 2)

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(lilith)

		local slow_key = 'cannon_slow'

		wait_all({
			util.cs_generator(function ()
				while time_passed < qte_duration do
					time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
					local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / fire_duration)
					missile_effect.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, pos, progress)
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end
			end),
			util.cs_generator(function ()
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
				time_util.mod(slow_key, 0.2)
				camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 0.2)
			end)
		})

		self:stop_cannon_sfx(0)

		qte_util.swipe('left', nil, 0)
		time_util.unmod(slow_key)

		self:play_cannon_sfx(1, pos)

		start_coroutine(function()
			while time_passed < fire_duration do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / fire_duration)
				missile_effect.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, pos, progress)
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			-- 카메라 쉐이크
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

			-- 미사일 비활성화
			missile_effect:Dispose()
			missile_effect = nil

			self:stop_cannon_sfx(0)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_explosion_03')
			-- 폭발 이팩트 재생
			local explosion_effect = self.fx.cannon_explosion():Instantiate(pos)
			explosion_effect.transform.localScale = vector(3, 3, 3)

			attack_range:Hide()
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(attack_range)
			attack_range = nil

			animator:Play('end_45')

			wait_for_sec(reload_duration)
			animator:Play('idle')
		end, self)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(knight, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(knight, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.jump(knight, 0.5, 0.3)
	wp_util.move(knight, knight.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, -1.5), nil, 0.3)

	character_util.set_locked_dir(lilith, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(lilith, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.jump(lilith, 0.5, 0.3)
	wp_util.move(lilith, lilith.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, -1.5), nil, 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	self.fx.hit():Instantiate(knight.Position + vector(0, 0.05, 0))
	self.fx.hit():Instantiate(lilith.Position + vector(0, 0.05, 0))

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	character_util.remove_anim(knight)
	character_util.remove_anim(lilith)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_new(knight, 'left', 0.4, 0.5)
	character_util.mario_jump_new(lilith, 'left', 0.4, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.8)
	character_util.remove_anim(knight)
	character_util.remove_anim(lilith)
	character_util.reset_locked_dir(knight)
	character_util.reset_locked_dir(lilith)
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(lilith, 'left')

	-- 이대로면 녀석들이 올 때까지 버티기도 힘들겠어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lilith, self, 'right', 'dagger_idle', nil, 'cw_main_s10_cannon_3_4')

	-- $name! 대포 쪽으로 보내줄게!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lilith, self, nil, { name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'cw_main_s10_cannon_3_5')

	wp_util.move_async(lilith,
			{ lilith.Position + vector(0, 0, -2.5),
			  vector(knight.Position.x, 0, lilith.Position.z - 2.5)}, 4, nil, { run = true })

	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(lilith, 'up')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	-- 이쪽으로 와!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lilith, self, nil, 'bomb_idle', nil, 'cw_main_s10_cannon_3_6')

	character_util.normal_jump_async(knight, '01_jump_01')
	character_util.set_direction(lilith, 'down')

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.5, 0.5)
	wp_util.move_async(knight, lilith.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5), nil, 0.5, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	character_util.set_active_shadow(knight, false)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(knight, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'get')

	local slow_key = 'lilith_jump'
	time_util.mod(slow_key, 0.2)

	wp_util.move_async(knight, lilith.Position + vector(0, 1.2, -0.05), nil, 0.2)

	time_util.unmod(slow_key)
	time_util.mod(slow_key, 0.1)

	scene_util.set_anim(lilith, self, { name = 'demon_ceo/attack4', count = 1 })

	wp_util.move_async(knight, lilith.Position + vector(0, 0.5, -0.05), nil, 0.2)

	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.2)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_boss_rise_01')

	self.fx.hit():Instantiate(lilith.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(lilith, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)

	time_util.unmod(slow_key)

	character_util.set_active_shadow(knight, true)
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local time_passed = 0
			local duration = 2
			local height = 2
			local progress = 0
			local start_pos = knight.Position
			local end_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(start_pos + vector(0, 0, -5))

    		while time_passed < duration do
    		    time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

    		    progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
    		    local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
    		    local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height + lerp_pos.y
    		    local cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(lerp_pos, cur_y)
    		    knight.Position = cur_pos
    		    knight.SpineController.ShadowTransform.position = vector_util.get_x0z(lerp_pos) + vector(0, 0.05, 0)
    		    coroutine.yield()
    		end
			knight.Position = end_pos

			camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.2)
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.5, 0.2)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
			self.fx.shockwave():Instantiate(knight.Position + vector(0, 0.05, 0))
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local dir = { 'up', 'right', 'down', 'left', 'up', 'right', 'down', 'left' }
			character_util.reset_locked_dir(knight)
			for i = 1, #dir do
				character_util.set_direction(knight, dir[i])
				wait_for_sec(0.25)
			end
			scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'walk4legs', scale = 0.01 })
		end)
	})

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim(knight)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'up')
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(knight.Position + vector(0, 0, 2.5), 0.5)

	-- 저 대포만 없애면 마신들이 올 때까지 버틸 수 있을 거야, $name!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lilith, self, nil, { name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'cw_main_s10_cannon_3_7')
	-- 조금만 더 힘내 줘.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(lilith, self, nil, 'cast', nil, 'cw_main_s10_cannon_3_8')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 0.5)

	character_util.set_direction(lilith, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.remove_emotion(knight)
end

-- 첫번째 대포 이벤트 메이, 페이 연출중 전투 루틴
function cannon_soldiers:china_hero_fight_routine()
	start_coroutine(function()
		local progress = self.progress
		local hash_key = 'china_hero'
		local punch_fx = user_util.has_fei() and self.fx.china_hero_boy_punch or self.fx.china_hero_girl_punch
		local china_hero = user_util.get_china_hero_character('china_hero_boy', 'china_hero_girl')
		local saul_soldier_1 = self.dynamic_npc:get(3)
		local saul_soldier_2 = self.dynamic_npc:get(4)
		local saul_soldier_1_original_pos = saul_soldier_1.Position
		local saul_soldier_2_original_pos = saul_soldier_2.Position

		self.playing_fight_routine_hashset:add(hash_key)

		character_util.look_at(saul_soldier_1, china_hero)
		character_util.look_at(saul_soldier_2, china_hero)

		saul_soldier_1.LockedDirection = saul_soldier_1.Direction
		saul_soldier_2.LockedDirection = saul_soldier_2.Direction

		while self.cannon_event_data[progress].play_fight_routine and
				not self.stage_ended do

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_energy_fist_01', parent = china_hero })
			scene_util.set_anim(china_hero, self, { name = 'gauntlet_combo_attack', count = 1 })

			local punch = punch_fx():Instantiate(china_hero.Position + vector(0.2, 0 , 0.2))

			self:fight_wait_for_sec(0.16)

			self.fx:china_hero_hit():Instantiate(saul_soldier_1.Position)
			self.fx:china_hero_hit():Instantiate(saul_soldier_2.Position)

			character_util.spine_damage_squish(saul_soldier_1, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)
			character_util.spine_pulse_color(saul_soldier_1,
						CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)

			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(saul_soldier_1,
				{ name = 'damaged' }, { name = 'damaged' })

			character_util.spine_damage_squish(saul_soldier_2, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)
			character_util.spine_pulse_color(saul_soldier_2,
						CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)

			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(saul_soldier_2,
				{ name = 'damaged' }, { name = 'damaged' })

			self:knockback({ saul_soldier_1, saul_soldier_2 }, vector(1, 0, 0 ), 0.44)
			punch:Dispose()

function cannon_soldiers:innuit_fight_routine()
	start_coroutine(function()
		local progress = self.progress
		local hash_key = 'innut'
		local innuit = get_character('innuit')
		local saul_soldier_1 = self.dynamic_npc:get(6)
		local saul_soldier_2 = self.dynamic_npc:get(7)
		local saul_soldier_1_original_pos = saul_soldier_1.Position
		local saul_soldier_2_original_pos = saul_soldier_2.Position

		local innuit_shoot = function()
			local start_pos = innuit.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0.1)
			local end_pos = innuit.Position + vector(1.8, 0, 0.1)
			local duration = 0.1
			local dir = (end_pos - start_pos).normalized
			local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.forward, dir)

			local projectile = self.fx.innuit_projectile():Instantiate(start_pos, rot, nil)
			local trail = self.fx.innuit_trail():Instantiate(start_pos, rot, nil)

			local time_passed = 0
			local progress = 0

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_summon_effect_02', parent = innuit })
			while time_passed < duration and not self.stage_ended do
				progress = time_passed / duration

				projectile.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
				trail.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			projectile:Dispose()
			trail:TriggeredDispose()

			if self.stage_ended then
				return
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_ice_01', play_pos = end_pos })

			character_util.remove_anim(saul_soldier_1)

-- 전투 연출 전용 커스텀 wait_for_sec
function cannon_soldiers:fight_wait_for_sec(duration)
	local end_time = unity_class.time.time + duration
	while not self.stage_ended and unity_class.time.time < end_time do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

-- 넉백
function cannon_soldiers:knockback(fo_list, move_vec, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local progress = 0
	local start_pos = {}
	local end_pos = {}

	for i = 1, #fo_list do
		table.insert(start_pos, fo_list[i].Position)
		table.insert(end_pos, fo_list[i].Position + move_vec)
	end

	while not self.stage_ended and time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCirc(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))

		for i = 1, #fo_list do
			fo_list[i].Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos[i], end_pos[i], progress)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 대포 연출 반복
function cannon_soldiers:fire_cannon_loop(pos, end_cb, fire_cb, progress)
	start_coroutine(function()
		local aiming_duration = 2.5
		local fire_duration = 1
		while self.cannon_event_data[progress].state ~= self.cannon_event_state.clear and
				not self.stage_ended do
			self:fire_cannon_scene(pos, end_cb, fire_cb, aiming_duration, fire_duration)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end, self)
end

-- 대포 연출 발사
function cannon_soldiers:fire_cannon_scene(pos, end_cb, fire_cb, aiming_duration, fire_duration)
	aiming_duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(aiming_duration, 2)
	fire_duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(fire_duration, 0.5)

	local progress = self.progress
	local charging_duration = 1
	local reload_duration = 0.75
	local time_passed = 0

	local attack_range_radius = 2
	local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero,
			attack_range_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	attack_range:Hide()

	local start_pos = pos + vector(0, 12.5, 0)

	local cannon = self:get_cannon()
	local animator = cannon:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	scene_util.set_anim(self:get_cannon_driver(), self, { name = 'attack', count = 1, sfx_name = '01_clang_01' })
	animator:Play('on_45')

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_bombard_range_01', loop = false, play_pos = pos })

	attack_range_util.setup_by_position(attack_range, pos, 0)
	attack_range_util.show(attack_range, aiming_duration)

	if self:cannon_wait_for_sec(charging_duration, progress) then
		attack_range_util.hide(attack_range)
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(attack_range)
		return
	end

	animator:Play('shoot_45')

	if self:cannon_wait_for_sec(aiming_duration - charging_duration - fire_duration, progress) then
		attack_range:Hide()
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(attack_range)
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_lockon_01', loop = false, play_pos = pos })
	self:play_cannon_sfx(1, pos)

	local missile_effect = self.fx.cannon_proj():Instantiate(start_pos)
	missile_effect.transform.localScale = vector(2, 2, 2)

	if fire_cb ~= nil then
		fire_cb(self)
	end

	while time_passed < fire_duration and not self.stage_ended do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / fire_duration)
		missile_effect.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, pos, progress)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self:stop_cannon_sfx(0)

	if self.stage_ended then
		missile_effect:Dispose()
		missile_effect = nil
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(attack_range)
		attack_range = nil

		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_fire_explosion_03', loop = false, play_pos = pos })

	-- 카메라 쉐이크
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	-- 미사일 비활성화
	missile_effect:Dispose()
	missile_effect = nil

	-- 폭발 이팩트 재생
	local explosion_effect = self.fx.cannon_explosion():Instantiate(pos)
	explosion_effect.transform.localScale = vector(3, 3, 3)

	attack_range:Hide()
	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(attack_range)
	attack_range = nil

	animator:Play('end_45')

	if end_cb ~= nil then
		end_cb(self)
	end

	wait_for_sec(reload_duration)
	animator:Play('idle')
end

function cannon_soldiers:set_cannon_anim_idle()
	local cannon = self:get_cannon()
	local animator = cannon:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	animator:Play('idle')
end

-- 대포 전용 wait_for_sec
function cannon_soldiers:cannon_wait_for_sec(duration, progress)
	local end_time = unity_class.time.time + duration
	while not self.stage_ended and
			self.cannon_event_data[progress].state ~= self.cannon_event_state.clear and
			unity_class.time.time < end_time do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	return self.stage_ended or
			self.cannon_event_data[progress].state == self.cannon_event_state.clear
end

-- 대포 콜백용 연출
function cannon_soldiers:extra_air_spin_cb()
	local extra_npc_count = 2
	for i = 1, extra_npc_count do
		local extra_npc = self.dynamic_npc:get(i)
		character_util.stop(extra_npc)
		character_util.set_anim(extra_npc, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.set_emotion(extra_npc, { name = 'damaged' })
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_linda_scream_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_03')

	character_util.air_spin(self.dynamic_npc:get(1))
	character_util.air_spin(self.dynamic_npc:get(2), { offset = unity_class.vector3.left * 3})
end

-- 진행 상황에 따라 문 and 장애물 세팅
function cannon_soldiers:set_object_by_progress()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('door_3', true))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('door_4', true))
	if self.progress == 1 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('door_5', true))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('door_6', true))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('door_7', true))
	elseif self.progress == 2 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('door_5', true))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('door_7', true))

		get_field_object('bf_cannon_broken_3').Position = self:get_cannon_end_pos(3)
		self:disabled_rock()
	else
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('door_5', true))

		get_field_object('bf_cannon_broken_2').Position = self:get_cannon_end_pos(1)
		get_field_object('bf_cannon_broken_3').Position = self:get_cannon_end_pos(3)

		self:disabled_rock()
		self:disabled_obstacles()
	end
end
-- 바위 숨기기
function cannon_soldiers:disabled_rock()
	get_field_object('bf_cannon_rock_1').ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	get_field_object('bf_cannon_rock_2').ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
end

-- 장애물 숨기기
function cannon_soldiers:disabled_obstacles()
	get_field_object('bf_cannon_obstacle_1').ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	get_field_object('bf_cannon_obstacle_2').ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	get_field_object('bf_cannon_obstacle_3').ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	get_field_object('bf_cannon_obstacle_4').ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
end

-- 장애물 숨기기
function cannon_soldiers:disabled_broken_cannon()
	get_field_object('bf_cannon_broken_1').ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	get_field_object('bf_cannon_broken_2').ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	get_field_object('bf_cannon_broken_3').ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
end

-- 배틀 게이트 닫기
function cannon_soldiers:close_battle_gate()
	local data = self.cannon_event_data[self.progress]
	for i = 1, data.battle_gate_count do
		local key = 'cannon_battle_gate_' .. data.battlefield_idx ..'_' .. i
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(key, true))
	end
end

-- 배틀 게이트 열기
function cannon_soldiers:open_battle_gate()
	local data = self.cannon_event_data[self.progress]
	for i = 1, data.battle_gate_count do
		local key = 'cannon_battle_gate_' .. data.battlefield_idx ..'_' .. i
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(key, true))
	end
end

-- 루프 sfx 실행
function cannon_soldiers:play_siren_sfx(volume_value)
	if self.siren_sfx ~= nil then
		return
	end

	self.siren_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '01_siren_loop_07', loop = true,

-- 루프 sfx 정지
function cannon_soldiers:stop_siren_sfx(duration)

-- 대포 루프 sfx 실행
function cannon_soldiers:play_cannon_sfx(volume_value, pos)

		return

	self.cannon_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(

-- 대포 루프 sfx 정지
function cannon_soldiers:stop_cannon_sfx(duration)
	if self.cannon_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.cannon_loop_sfx:FadeOut(duration)
		self.cannon_loop_sfx = nil

-- 루프 sfx 실행
function cannon_soldiers:play_cannon_war_sfx(volume_value)

function cannon_soldiers:stop_cannon_war_sfx(duration)
	if self.cannon_war_sfx ~= nil then
		self.cannon_war_sfx:FadeOut(duration)

return {

-- 병사 지원 이벤트

---@class CivilwarSupportSoldiers
local support_soldiers = newclass('SupportSoldiers')

function support_soldiers:init(controller)
	---@type CivilWarBattleFieldEventController
	self.controller = controller

	-- 아이템 state
	self.item_state = {
		medicine = 1,
		ammo = 2
	}

	-- 아이템 테이블
	self.support_item = {
		medicine = {
			state = self.item_state.medicine,
			point = 0,
			support_npc_scene = self.support_medicine_npc_scene,
			items = {},
		},
		ammo = {
			state = self.item_state.ammo,
			point = 0,
			support_npc_scene = self.support_ammo_npc_scene,
			items = {},
		},
	}

	-- 브레이커블 부술 시 체크할 딕셔너리
	self.breakable_dic = {}

	-- 데이터
	self.constants_data = require('Quest/Main/CivilWar/Main/BattleField/SupportSoldiersConstants')

	self.stage_ended = false

	-- 전장 별 리셋 요소들 데이터
	self.ammo_npcs_reset_data = { {}, {}, {} }
	self.medicine_npcs_reset_data = { {}, {}, {} }
	self.ammo_reset_data = { {}, {}, {} }
	self.medicine_reset_data = { {}, {}, {} }

	-- 튜토디얼 관련 데이터
	self.entered_tutorial_zone = false
	self.tutorial_zone_name = 'support_soldiers_tutorial'

	self.eat_sfx = nil
end

function support_soldiers:dispose()
	if self.eat_sfx ~= nil then
		self.eat_sfx:Stop()
		self.eat_sfx = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil

	self.ammo_npcs_reset_data = nil
	self.medicine_npcs_reset_data = nil
	self.ammo_reset_data = nil
	self.medicine_reset_data = nil
end

function support_soldiers:on_stage_end_event()
	self.stage_ended = true
	self:dispose_all_items()
end

function support_soldiers:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 탄약 지원
	for i = 1, #self.constants_data.ammo_soldiers do
		local npc = get_character(self.constants_data.ammo_soldiers[i].name)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, npc) then
			self:support_npc(npc, self.constants_data.ammo_soldiers[i],
					self.support_item.ammo)
			return
		end
	end

	-- 약 지원
	for i = 1, #self.constants_data.medicien_soldiers do
		local npc = get_character(self.constants_data.medicien_soldiers[i].name)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, npc) then
			self:support_npc(npc, self.constants_data.medicien_soldiers[i],
					self.support_item.medicine)
			return
		end
	end

	-- 아이템 습득
	for _,support_item in pairs(self.support_item) do
		for _,item in pairs(support_item.items) do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, item.fo) then
				self:add_item_point(support_item, self.constants_data.public_data.item_gain_point)
				self:consume_item(item)
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

function support_soldiers:on_wind_pot_pull_start_event(e)
	-- 브레이커블 바람의 항아리 pull 처리
	if self.breakable_dic[e.PullTarget.Name] ~= nil then
		self:set_hide_item(self.breakable_dic[e.PullTarget.Name])
		self.breakable_dic[e.PullTarget.Name] = nil
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function support_soldiers:on_hold_up_event(e)
	-- 브레이커블 hold up 처리
	if self.breakable_dic[e.Target.Name] ~= nil then
		self:set_hide_item(self.breakable_dic[e.Target.Name])
		self.breakable_dic[e.Target.Name] = nil
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function support_soldiers:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	-- 브레이커블 파괴 처리
	if self.breakable_dic[e.FieldObject.Name] ~= nil then
		self:set_hide_item(self.breakable_dic[e.FieldObject.Name])
		self.breakable_dic[e.FieldObject.Name] = nil
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function support_soldiers:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	local battlefield_idx = self:convert_to_battlefield_idx(e.BattleGroupName)
	-- 해당 전장에 포함되는 요소들 리셋
	if battlefield_idx ~= nil then
		self:reset(battlefield_idx)
	end
end

function support_soldiers:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	-- 튜토디얼 이벤트 트리거
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, knight, self.tutorial_zone_name) and
			not self.entered_tutorial_zone then
		self.entered_tutorial_zone = true
		start_coroutine(self.tutorial_scene, self)
		return true
	end
end

-- 전장 이벤트 클리어
function support_soldiers:on_clear_battlefield_event()
	self:dispose_all_items()
	self:remove_npcs()
	self.support_item = nil
end

-- 전장 이벤트 시작
function support_soldiers:start_battlefield_event()
	self.controller.battle_ui:set_item_count(self.item_state.ammo, 0)
	self.controller.battle_ui:set_item_count(self.item_state.medicine, 0)
	self:set_support_event()
end

-- 이벤트 세팅
function support_soldiers:set_support_event()
	self:set_all_items()
	self:set_npcs()
	self:set_tutorial()
end

-- 모든 아이템 세팅
function support_soldiers:set_all_items()
	for i = 1, #self.constants_data.ammo do
		local data = self.constants_data.ammo[i]
		local pos = self:convert_table_to_vector(data.position)
		local item_pos = pos
		local fo = get_field_object(data.name)

		fo.Position = pos
		if data.breakable_name ~= nil then
			fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			item_pos = vector(999, 0, 999)
			get_field_object(data.breakable_name).Position = pos
			self.breakable_dic[data.breakable_name] = data.name
		end

		self.support_item.ammo.items[data.name] = {
			item = drop_item_util.create_item({
				itemid = self.constants_data.public_data.ammo_item_id,
				pos = item_pos,
				notforinven = true,
				skip_text = true,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
				sprscale = self.constants_data.public_data.ammo_scale
			}),
			fo = fo
		}

		for i = 1, #data.reset_battlefield_idx do
			table.insert(self.ammo_reset_data[data.reset_battlefield_idx[i]], data)
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #self.constants_data.medicine do
		local data = self.constants_data.medicine[i]
		local pos = self:convert_table_to_vector(data.position)
		local item_pos = pos
		local fo = get_field_object(data.name)

		fo.Position = pos
		if data.breakable_name ~= nil then
			fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			item_pos = vector(999, 0, 999)
			get_field_object(data.breakable_name).Position = pos
			self.breakable_dic[data.breakable_name] = data.name
		end

		self.support_item.medicine.items[data.name] = {
			item = drop_item_util.create_item({
				itemid = self.constants_data.public_data.medicine_item_id,
				pos = item_pos,
				notforinven = true,
				skip_text = true,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
				sprscale = self.constants_data.public_data.medicine_scale
			}),
			fo = fo
		}

		for k = 1, #data.reset_battlefield_idx do
			table.insert(self.medicine_reset_data[data.reset_battlefield_idx[k]], data)
		end
	end
end

-- 모든 아이템 해제
function support_soldiers:dispose_all_items()
	if self.support_item == nil then
		return
	end

	for _,support_item in pairs(self.support_item) do
		for _,item in pairs(support_item.items) do
			item.fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			if item.item ~= nil then
				drop_item_util.dispose_item(item.item)
				item.item = nil
				item.fo = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

-- npc 세팅
function support_soldiers:set_npcs()
	for i = 1, #self.constants_data.ammo_soldiers do
		local data = self.constants_data.ammo_soldiers[i]
		local npc = get_character(data.name)
		local pos = self:convert_table_to_vector(data.position)
		local dir = data.direction

		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
		npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, dir)

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(npc, { name = 'seat' }, { name = 'tired' })

		character_util.add_lua_listener(npc, self.controller)

		for k = 1, #data.reset_battlefield_idx do
			table.insert(self.ammo_npcs_reset_data[data.reset_battlefield_idx[k]], data)
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #self.constants_data.medicien_soldiers do
		local data = self.constants_data.medicien_soldiers[i]
		local npc = get_character(data.name)
		local pos = self:convert_table_to_vector(data.position)
		local dir = data.direction

		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
		npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, dir)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(npc, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })

		character_util.add_lua_listener(npc, self.controller)

		for k = 1, #data.reset_battlefield_idx do
			table.insert(self.medicine_npcs_reset_data[data.reset_battlefield_idx[k]], data)
		end
	end
end

-- 리셋
function support_soldiers:reset(battlefield_idx)
	-- npc들 리셋
	self:reset_npcs(battlefield_idx)
	-- 아이템 리셋
	self:reset_items(battlefield_idx)
end

-- npc들 리셋
function support_soldiers:reset_npcs(battlefield_idx)
	for i = 1, #self.ammo_npcs_reset_data[battlefield_idx] do
		local data = self.ammo_npcs_reset_data[battlefield_idx][i]
		local npc = get_character(data.name)
		local pos = self:convert_table_to_vector(data.position)
		local dir = data.direction

		if npc.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
			character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
			character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 1, 0)
			character_util.set_direction(npc, dir)
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(npc, { name = 'seat' }, { name = 'tired' })
			character_util.add_lua_listener(npc, self.controller)
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #self.medicine_npcs_reset_data[battlefield_idx] do
		local data = self.medicine_npcs_reset_data[battlefield_idx][i]
		local npc = get_character(data.name)
		local pos = self:convert_table_to_vector(data.position)
		local dir = data.direction

		if npc.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
			character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
			character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 1, 0)
			character_util.set_direction(npc, dir)
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(npc, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
			character_util.add_lua_listener(npc, self.controller)
		end
	end
end

-- 아이템들 리셋
function support_soldiers:reset_items(battlefield_idx)
	for i = 1, #self.ammo_reset_data[battlefield_idx] do
		local data = self.ammo_reset_data[battlefield_idx][i]
		local fo = self.support_item.ammo.items[data.name].fo

		if self.support_item.ammo.items[data.name].item == nil
				and data.breakable_name == nil then
			fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
			self.support_item.ammo.items[data.name].item = drop_item_util.create_item({
				itemid = self.constants_data.public_data.ammo_item_id,
				pos = fo.Position,
				notforinven = true,
				skip_text = true,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
				sprscale = self.constants_data.public_data.ammo_scale
			})
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #self.medicine_reset_data[battlefield_idx] do
		local data = self.medicine_reset_data[battlefield_idx][i]
		local fo = self.support_item.medicine.items[data.name].fo

		if self.support_item.medicine.items[data.name].item == nil
				and data.breakable_name == nil then
			fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
			self.support_item.medicine.items[data.name].item = drop_item_util.create_item({
				itemid = self.constants_data.public_data.medicine_item_id,
				pos = fo.Position,
				notforinven = true,
				skip_text = true,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
				sprscale = self.constants_data.public_data.medicine_scale
			})
		end
	end
end

-- 모든 npc 제거
function support_soldiers:remove_npcs()
	for i = 1, #self.constants_data.ammo_soldiers do
		local npc = get_character(self.constants_data.ammo_soldiers[i].name)
		character_util.set_position(npc, vector(999, 0, 999))
	end

	for i = 1, #self.constants_data.medicien_soldiers do
		local npc = get_character(self.constants_data.medicien_soldiers[i].name)
		character_util.set_position(npc, vector(999, 0, 999))
	end

	for i = 1, 4 do
		character_util.set_position(self:get_tutorial_npc(i), vector(999, 0, 999))
	end

end

-- 아이템 획득
function support_soldiers:consume_item(item)
	item.fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	item.item.ConsumeTarget = get_party_leader()
	item.item = nil
end

-- npc 도와주기
function support_soldiers:support_npc(npc, npc_data, item_data)
	if item_data.point < 1 then
		return
	end

	self:add_item_point(item_data, -1)

	if not self.controller.game_over then
		self.controller:add_point(npc_data.battlefield_idx, self.constants_data.public_data.bf_gain_point)
	end

	character_util.remove_lua_listener(npc, self.controller)

	npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	start_coroutine(item_data.support_npc_scene, self, npc, npc_data)
end

-- 탄약 지원 연출
function support_soldiers:support_ammo_npc_scene(npc, npc_data)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_throw_01', parent = npc,
			type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local ammo = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = get_party_leader().Position,
		                                         target = npc.Position,
		                                         itemid = self.constants_data.public_data.ammo_item_id,
												 notforinven = true, showoncharacter = true,
												 lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true,
												 sprscale = self.constants_data.public_data.ammo_scale })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gun_reload_04', parent = npc,
			type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	ammo.ConsumeTarget = npc
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	npc.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = 'attack' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_popup_01', parent = npc,
			type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.mario_jump_async(npc, npc.Direction)

	if get_party_leader().Position.x > npc.Position.x then
		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'right')
	else
		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'left')
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_twohand_stomp_jump_01', parent = npc,
			type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'salute', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_anim(npc)

	local wp = {}
	local recent_pos = npc.Position
	local distance = 0
	for i = 1, #npc_data.exit_wp do
		local pos = npc.Position + self:convert_table_to_vector(npc_data.exit_wp[i])

		distance = distance + vector_util.distance(recent_pos, pos)
		recent_pos = pos
		table.insert(wp, pos)
	end

	local fade_duration = 0.5
	if distance > 0 then
		fade_duration = distance/npc_data.move_speed
	end

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, fade_duration)
	wp_util.move_async(npc, wp, npc_data.move_speed, nil, { run = true })
	npc.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
end

-- 약 지원 연출

	local recent_pos = npc.Position
	local distance = 0
	for i = 1, #npc_data.exit_wp do

	character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
