-- 숨겨져있는 아이템 세팅
function support_soldiers:set_hide_item(key)
	if self.support_item.ammo.items[key] ~= nil then
		local fo = self.support_item.ammo.items[key].fo
		fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		self.support_item.ammo.items[key].item.Position = fo.Position

		return
	end

	if self.support_item.medicine.items[key] ~= nil then
		local fo = self.support_item.medicine.items[key].fo
		fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		self.support_item.medicine.items[key].item.Position = fo.Position
	end
end

-- 아이템 점수 추가
function support_soldiers:add_item_point(item_data, value)
	local result_value = item_data.point + value
	if result_value < 0 then
		result_value = 0
	end
	item_data.point = result_value
	self.controller.battle_ui:set_item_count(item_data.state, result_value)
end

-- 테이블을 벡터로 변환
function support_soldiers:convert_table_to_vector(table)
	return vector(table[1], table[2], table[3])
end

-- 배틀존을 전장 인덱스로 변환
function support_soldiers:convert_to_battlefield_idx(zone_name)
	if zone_name == 'battlefield_bottom' then
		return 1
	elseif zone_name == 'battlefield_center' then
		return 2
	elseif zone_name == 'battlefield_top' then
		return 3
	end

	return nil
end

function support_soldiers:get_tutorial_npc(num)
	return get_character('bf_support_tutorial_npc_' .. num)
end

-- 튜토디얼 세팅
function support_soldiers:set_tutorial()
	local tutorial_npc_data = {
		{
			anim = 'prostrate',
			emotion = 'damaged',
			dir = 'right',
		},
		{
			anim = 'eat',
			emotion = 'attack',
			dir = 'left',
		},
		{
			anim = 'seat',
			emotion = 'tired',
			dir = 'right',
		},
		{
			anim = 'eat',
			emotion = 'attack',
			dir = 'left',
		},
	}
	for i = 1, #tutorial_npc_data do
		local npc = self:get_tutorial_npc(i)
		local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('bf_support_tutorial_' .. i)
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, tutorial_npc_data[i].dir)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(npc,
				{ name = tutorial_npc_data[i].anim }, { name = tutorial_npc_data[i].emotion })
	end

	self.eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', parent = self:get_tutorial_npc(2),
				loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	self:get_tutorial_npc(5).CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self:get_tutorial_npc(6).CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
end

-- 튜토디얼 연출
function support_soldiers:tutorial_scene()
	local soldier_1 = self:get_tutorial_npc(1)
	local soldier_2 = self:get_tutorial_npc(2)
	local soldier_3 = self:get_tutorial_npc(3)
	local soldier_4 = self:get_tutorial_npc(4)

	-- 지금 치료해줄테니 조금만 참아!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(soldier_2, { key = 'cw_main_s10_tutorial_3' })

	wait_for_sec(1)
	if self.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	soldier_1.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	soldier_2.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	character_util.shake_and_wakeup(soldier_1, soldier_1.Direction, 2, 'smile', true)

	if self.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	self.eat_sfx:Stop()
	self.eat_sfx = nil

	character_util.remove_anim(soldier_2)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(soldier_2)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	if self.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_twohand_stomp_jump_01', parent = soldier_1,
			type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	scene_util.set_anim(soldier_2, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1, one_shot_sfx = false })
	character_util.set_anim(soldier_1, { name = 'salute', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	if self.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(soldier_1)

	character_util.set_emotion(soldier_1, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(soldier_1, 0, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(soldier_2, 0, 0.5)
	wp_util.move(soldier_2, soldier_2.Position + vector(3, 0, 0), nil, 0.5, { run = true, play_sfx = true })
	wp_util.move_async(soldier_1, soldier_1.Position + vector(3, 0, 0), nil, 0.5, { run = true })

	if self.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	soldier_1.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	soldier_2.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	character_util.set_active_state(soldier_1, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(soldier_2, 'disabled')

	if self.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	soldier_3.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	soldier_4.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true

	self.eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', parent = soldier_4,
				loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	-- 여기 탄약 받아!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(soldier_4, { key = 'cw_main_s10_tutorial_4' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.eat_sfx:Stop()
	self.eat_sfx = nil

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_air_spin_02', parent = soldier_4,
			type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local ammo = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = soldier_4.Position,
		                                         target = soldier_3.Position,
		                                         itemid = self.constants_data.public_data.ammo_item_id,
												 notforinven = true, showoncharacter = true,
												 lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true,
												 sprscale = self.constants_data.public_data.ammo_scale })
	scene_util.set_anim(soldier_4, self, { name = 'release', count = 1 })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	if self.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gun_reload_04', parent = soldier_4,
			type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(soldier_4)
	ammo.ConsumeTarget = soldier_3

	wait_for_sec(0.8)
	if self.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(soldier_3)
	character_util.set_emotion(soldier_3, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.mario_jump_new(soldier_3, 'right', 0.4, 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_popup_01', parent = soldier_3,
			type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	wait_for_sec(0.8)
	if self.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_twohand_stomp_jump_01', parent = soldier_3,
			type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	scene_util.set_anim(soldier_4, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1, one_shot_sfx = false })
	character_util.set_anim(soldier_3, { name = 'salute', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	if self.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(soldier_3)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(soldier_3, 0, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(soldier_4, 0, 0.5)
	wp_util.move(soldier_3, soldier_3.Position + vector(3, 0, 0), nil, 0.5, { run = true })
	wp_util.move_async(soldier_4, soldier_4.Position + vector(3, 0, 0), nil, 0.5, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

	if self.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	soldier_3.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	soldier_4.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	character_util.set_active_state(soldier_3, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(soldier_4, 'disabled')
end

return {
	support_soldiers = support_soldiers,

---@class CivilWarBossBattleCommon
local local_class = newclass('CivilWarBossBattleCommon')

function local_class:init()
	self.battle = {
		zone = 'boss_battle',
		group = 'boss',
		gate = {
			count = 2,
			prefix_name = 'boss_battle_gate_',
			open = function(this, play_sfx)
				play_sfx = lua_helper.get_or_default(play_sfx, true)

				for i = 1, this.count do
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(this.prefix_name .. i, play_sfx))
				end
			end,
			close = function(this, play_sfx)
				play_sfx = lua_helper.get_or_default(play_sfx, true)

				for i = 1, this.count do
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(this.prefix_name .. i, play_sfx))
				end
			end,
		}
	}

	self.white_out_background = nil
	self.white_out_background_renderer = nil

	self.custom_atlas_path = 'spritesheets/projectiles'
	self.custom_atlas_name = 'projectiles_custom'

	self.res_holder = nil

	self.pool = {
		custom_sprite = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite')
		end,
		load_async = function(this)
			for key, creator in pairs(this) do
				if key ~= 'load_async' then
					creator()
				end
			end

			yield_return_func(unity_object_pool.WaitAll)
		end
	}
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_loaded()
end

function local_class:load_async()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	do
		self.white_out_background = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder,
				'ondemand/v2_22_lilithtower/theatres/ending', 'white_tint_background')

		self.white_out_background_renderer = self.white_out_background:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer))

		self:set_white_background_alpha(0)
		self:set_white_background_active(false)
	end

	do
		stage.StageCustomAtlasManager:Load(self.custom_atlas_path, self.custom_atlas_name)
		yield_return_func(stage.StageCustomAtlasManager.WaitAll, stage.StageCustomAtlasManager)

		self.pool:load_async()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_loaded()
	self.white_out_background_renderer = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.white_out_background) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.white_out_background)
	end

	self.white_out_background = nil

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
	end

	self.res_holder = nil
end

function local_class:slow_temporary_async()
	local key = 'transition'
	--
	--time_util.mod(key, 0.2)
	--wait_for_sec(0.15)
	--time_util.unmod(key)
	--wait_for_sec(0.25)
	--
	wait_for_sec(1)
end

function local_class:set_white_background_alpha(target_alpha)
	self.white_out_background_renderer.color = unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, target_alpha })
end

function local_class:set_white_background_scale(target_scale)
	self.white_out_background.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * target_scale
end

function local_class:set_white_background_active(enabled)
	self.white_out_background:SetActive(enabled)

	if enabled then
		self.white_out_background.transform.position = vector_util.get_x0z(stage_camera.LookAtPosition, 2)
		self.white_out_background.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 40

		self.white_out_background_renderer.sortingLayerName = 'Under Effects'
		self.white_out_background_renderer.sortingOrder = -100
	end
end

function local_class:set_white_background_sorting_order(sorting_order, layer_name)
	self.white_out_background_renderer.sortingLayerName = layer_name
	self.white_out_background_renderer.sortingOrder = sorting_order
end

function local_class:get_or_create_projectile(sprite_name, position, rotation)
	local projectile_obj = self.pool.custom_sprite():Instantiate(position, rotation, nil)
	local custom_sprite = projectile_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

	custom_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
	custom_sprite.Atlas = stage.StageCustomAtlasManager:Get(self.custom_atlas_path, self.custom_atlas_name)
	custom_sprite.SortingLayer = 'Default'
	custom_sprite.SortingOrder = 1
	custom_sprite.SpriteName = sprite_name
	custom_sprite.Alpha = 1

	custom_sprite:Rebuild()

	return projectile_obj
end

function local_class:dispose_projectile(projectile_obj)
	projectile_obj:Dispose()
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller)

	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	self.starting_inner_progress = -1
	self.starting_grade = -1
	self.inter_section_params = {}

	self.get_npc = function(idx)
		return get_character('can_cook_online_npc_' .. idx)
	end

end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	if self.cave_sound ~= nil then
		self.cave_sound:Stop()
		self.cave_sound = nil
	end
	if self.amb_restaurant_sound ~= nil then
		self.amb_restaurant_sound:Stop()
		self.amb_restaurant_sound = nil
	end
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')

	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

-- pre story section 설정

	self.pre_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'PreSection')
end

	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section1'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section2')
	}

	self.post_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'PostSection')
end

end

	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:on_progress_section()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	-- 레스토랑 정문 exit 렌더러 지움
	self:exit_renderer_active_control()
	-- 선택지 결과에 따른 레스토랑 테이블 아이템 셋팅
	self:restaurant_item_setting()
end

	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'main_s9_start_chase' then
		-- 메인 9섹션에서 추격 이벤트 중 레스토랑 관련 npc 제거
		self:main_s9_start_chase()
		return true
	end
	return false

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_restaurant_01')

		self.amb_restaurant_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_amb_restaurant_01', parent = user_party.Leader,
			loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc',
			fade_in_time = 1

	self.chef_event_no_flag = false
	self.restaurant_event_flag = true
	self.oneline_event_1_flag = true
	self.oneline_event_2_flag = true

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.inside_zone_name = 'can_cook_restaurant_inside'
	self.out_zone_name = 'can_cook_restaurant_out'

	self.oneline_event_zone_name = 'can_cook_oneline_event_'

	-- 캐릭터

	end

	self.get_chef = function()
		return get_character('can_cook_chef')
	end

	self.get_npc = function(idx)
		return get_character('can_cook_npc_' .. idx)
	end

	self.get_oneline_npc = function(idx)
		return get_character('can_cook_online_npc_' .. idx)
	end

	-- 아이템
	self.camera_item = 20578
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	-- 주방장 초기 세팅
	local head_chef = self.get_head_chef()
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(head_chef, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = true }, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	character_util.set_emotion(head_chef, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	character_util.set_direction(head_chef, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(head_chef, field:GetMarker('can_cook_head_chef_pos').position)

	local chef = self.get_chef()
	character_util.set_position(chef, field:GetMarker('can_cook_chef_pos').position)
	character_util.set_direction(chef, 'down')

	local npc_14 = self.get_npc(14)

	-- oneline npc 이벤트 용으로 위치 세팅
	character_util.remove_emotion(npc_13)
	character_util.remove_emotion(npc_14)
	character_util.set_position(npc_13, field:GetMarker('can_cook_oneline_pos_1').position)
	character_util.set_position(npc_14, field:GetMarker('can_cook_oneline_pos_2').position)
	character_util.set_direction(npc_13, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(npc_14, 'up')

	npc_14.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	npc_14.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	local oneline_npc_6 = self.get_oneline_npc(6)

	oneline_npc_6.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

end

function local_class:exit()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.chef_event_no_flag = false
	self.restaurant_event_flag = true
	self.oneline_event_1_flag = true
	self.oneline_event_2_flag = true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.inside_zone_name)
			and self.cur_section_state < self.section_state.chef_assistant_event then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.restaurant_inside_zone, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.restaurant_event_zone_name)
			and self.restaurant_event_flag then
		self.restaurant_event_flag = false
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.restaurant_event, self))
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.oneline_event_zone_name .. 1)
			and self.oneline_event_1_flag then
		self.oneline_event_1_flag = false
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.oneline_event_1, self))
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.oneline_event_zone_name .. 2)
			and self.oneline_event_2_flag then
		self.oneline_event_2_flag = false
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.oneline_event_2, self))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local head_chef = self.get_head_chef()
	-- 주방장 이벤트
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, head_chef) and
			self.cur_section_state < self.section_state.chef_assistant_event then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_chef, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'main_s9_start_chase' then
		self.oneline_event_1_flag = false
		self.oneline_event_2_flag = false
		return true
	end
	return false
end
--endregion

-- 레스토랑 입장 전 광장 원라인 이벤트
function local_class:oneline_event_1()
	local npc_13 = self.get_npc(13)
	local npc_14 = self.get_npc(14)

	--뱀파이어 여성 (up, idle, idle) : 어머, 여기 사람이 이렇게 많았나?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(npc_13, { key = self.anyone_can_cook_script .. 79 })

	--뱀파이어 남자 꼬마 (up, idle, idle) : 엄마! 여기서 엄청 맛있는 냄새나!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(npc_14, { key = self.anyone_can_cook_script .. 80 })

	--뱀파이어 여성 (up, idle, idle) : 그래? 오늘 점심은 여기에서 먹을까?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(npc_13, { key = self.anyone_can_cook_script .. 81 })

	npc_14.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

	npc_13.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
	npc_14.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()

	npc_13.Interactable.Talk = 'ds_anyone_can_cook_oneline_32'
	npc_14.Interactable.Talk = 'ds_anyone_can_cook_oneline_33'
	npc_14.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_positive_01'

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oneline_npc_5, { key = 'ds_anyone_can_cook_oneline_30' })

-- 이벤트 전 카운터 안으로 진입 하려 할 시

function local_class:restaurant_event()
	local restaurant_npc = {}
	local chef = self.get_chef()
	local head_chef = self.get_head_chef()
	for i = 9, 12 do
		table.insert(restaurant_npc, self.get_npc(i))
	end

	--뱀파이어 여성 (up, idle, jump 1회) : 레드 볼로냐 파스타 하나요! 오늘 또 먹으러 왔어요!

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	local chef = self.get_chef()
	character_util.set_position(chef, self.get_follow_marker(1).position)
	character_util.set_direction(chef, 'up')
	character_util.set_anim(chef, { name = 'push', loop = true })

	local head_chef = self.get_head_chef()
	character_util.set_position(head_chef, field:GetMarker('can_cook_head_chef_pos').position)
	character_util.set_direction(head_chef, 'right')

	head_chef.Interactable.Talk = self.anyone_can_cook_script .. 32

	-- 선택지에 따른 레스토랑 내부 특정 npc 연출 변경
	local restaurant_npc = {}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		table.insert(restaurant_npc, self.get_npc(i + 8))
		restaurant_npc[i].Interactable.Talk = 'ds_anyone_can_cook_oneline_' .. (i + 16)
	end
	restaurant_npc[2].Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_negative_02'

	local npc_13 = self.get_npc(13)
	npc_13.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_positive_01'

	-- 퀘스트 마커 재 조정
	local inner = self.get_exit_inner()
	local outer = self.get_exit_outer()
	self:changed_exit_interact_fo()

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 0 then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, inner, true)
	else
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, outer, true)
	end
	return true
end

end

function local_class:stage_load_resource()
	quest_util.load_pool_resource(

	)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self:restore_exit_interact_fo()

	if self.attack_range_renderer ~= nil then
		self.attack_range_renderer:Dispose()
		self.attack_range_renderer = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.back_restaurant_zone_name) and self.chef_follow_start_flag then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.target_follow_start, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.exit_interact_fo do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.exit_interact_fo[i]) then
			self:teleport_party_for_marker_routine(i)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:target_follow_start()
	local chef = self.get_chef()
	local pushable = self.get_pushable()
	self.chef_follow_start_flag = false

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)
	local restaurant_back_inner = get_field_object('can_cook_back_inner')
	restaurant_back_inner.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	-- 메인 9섹션 퀘스트 마커 임시 삭제
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { 'can_cook_chasing_start' }))

	--통로 진입하면 가게 우상단의 뒷편에서 나오게 되고, 곧바로 정지 이벤트 진행.
	character_util.set_direction(chef, 'up')
	character_util.set_anim(chef, { name = 'push', upper = true })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	--이후 주방보조 up, push로 2x2 푸셔블을 민다. 이후 액팅 시작과 함께 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀.
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local time_passed = 0
			local start_pos = pushable.Position
			local target_pos = pushable.Position + vector(0, 0, 1)
			local duration = 1

			local rock_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '01_push_rock_01', parent = chef,
				loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc',
			})
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = time_passed / duration
				pushable.Position = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				coroutine.yield()
			end
			pushable.Position = target_pos
			if rock_sound ~= nil then
				rock_sound:Stop()
				rock_sound = nil
			end
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_distance_async(chef, vector(0, 0, 1),
					nil, 1, true, true)
		end)
	})
	character_util.remove_anim(chef, true)

	character_util.set_emotion(chef, { name = 'tired' })
	--주방 보조 left, right 각기 1회씩 바라봄.
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(chef, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(chef, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--주방 보조 (left, tired, idle) : 치, 친구…! 또 어디로 간 거야…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chef, { key = self.anyone_can_cook_script .. 34, skip = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	character_util.set_direction(chef, 'left')
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.target_follow_routine, self))
end

function local_class:target_follow_fail_check()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local chef = self.get_chef()

	self.attack_range_renderer = CS.Oak.GhostGuardAttackRangeRenderer(chef, self.sight_distance, self.sight_angle)
	self.attack_range_renderer.AttackRange:Show(0)

	local detection_dist_min = 1
	local detection_dist_max = 100

	while self.chef_follow and self.chef_follow_end do
		-- 리더와 주방 보조의 거리 계산
		local dist_to_player = (leader.Position - chef.Position).sqrMagnitude
		self.attack_range_renderer:Update(chef)
		-- 주방 보조와 거리가 1만큼 가까워 졌을 때 발각
		if self:is_in_sight(leader, chef) or dist_to_player < detection_dist_min then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.detected_event, self, chef)
			-- 주방 보조와 거리가 10이상 멀어졌을 때 놓침
		elseif dist_to_player > detection_dist_max then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.get_away_event, self, chef)
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

-- 플레이어가 감시에 보이는지 체크용 함수
function local_class:is_in_sight(fo, target)
	if fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		return false
	end

	local full_diff = fo.Bounds.center - target.Bounds.center
	local diff = fo.Bounds.center - target.Bounds.center

	if diff.magnitude > self.sight_distance then
		return false
	end

	diff.y = 0

	if unity_class.vector3.Angle(diff.normalized, direction_util.to_vector3(target.Direction)) > self.sight_angle / 2 then
		return false
	end

	if field:IsAnythingBlocking(CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(target.Bounds.center, vector(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)),
			CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, vector_util.get_x0z(full_diff)) then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

-- ExitInteractable의 Interactable를 원복하는 함수
function local_class:restore_exit_interact_fo()
	if self.exit_interact_fo == nil then
		return
	end

	-- ExitInteractable -> ExitInteractable로 원복
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local exit_fo = self.exit_interact_fo[i]
		exit_fo.Interactable = self.cached_exit[i]
	end

	self.exit_interact_fo = nil
	self.marker_fo_list = nil
	self.cached_exit = nil
end

function local_class:changed_exit_interact_fo()
	self.cached_exit = {}
	self.exit_interact_fo = {}

	local exit_names = { 'can_cook_restaurant_inner',
						 'can_cook_back_inner', 'can_cook_restaurant_outer', 'can_cook_back_outer' }

	self.exit_teleport_names = { 'can_cook_restaurant_inner',
								 'can_cook_back_inner', 'can_cook_restaurant_exit', 'can_cook_back_restaurant' }

	for i = 1, #exit_names do
		local exit_fo = get_field_object(exit_names[i])
		table.insert(self.cached_exit, exit_fo.Interactable)
		exit_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		table.insert(self.exit_interact_fo, exit_fo)
	end

	self.marker_fo_list = { self.exit_interact_fo[4], self.exit_interact_fo[4], self.exit_interact_fo[1] }
end

function local_class:teleport_party_for_marker_routine(index)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.teleport_party_for_marker
	, self, self.exit_teleport_names[index], self.marker_fo_list[index]))
end

function local_class:teleport_party_for_marker(marker_name, quest_marker_fo)
	-- 마커 재 조정

function local_class:camera_fx(pos)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_focus_01')
	local camera_pointer = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_adultery_camera_target'):Instantiate(pos)
	self.picturing_infos.transform.position = pos
	self.picturing_infos:SetActive(true)

	-- 화면 터치 이후 찰칵 하도록
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	self.qte_is_start = true

	while not self.qte_success  do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.qte_is_start = false

	if not is_unity_null(camera_pointer) then
		camera_pointer:Dispose()
		camera_pointer = nil
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.picturing_infos.fx_target) then
		self.picturing_infos:Dispose()
		self.picturing_infos = nil
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_shutter_02')

	time_util.mod('picture', 0)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	self.picturing_infos:SetActive(false)

	field:Tint('picture', unity_color({ 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1 }), 0)

	wait_for_unscaled_sec(0.3)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	wait_for_unscaled_sec(0.3)

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 1.5)

	time_util.unmod('picture')

	field:RemoveTint('picture', 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.get_demon_carpenter = function(num) return get_character('demon_carpenter_' .. num) end
	self.get_vampire_carpenter = function(num) return get_character('vapire_carpenter_' .. num) end
	self.get_star_piece = function() return get_field_object('cactus_pickle_star_piece') end

	self.carpenter_zone_2 = 'cactus_pickle_event_2_zone'
	self.carpenter_zone_3 = 'cactus_pickle_event_3_zone'
	self.carpenter_zone_4 = 'cactus_pickle_event_4_zone'

	self.already_enter_zone_1 = false
	self.already_enter_zone_2 = false
	self.is_interact_carpenter = false
	self.already_played_minigame = false

	self.minigame_name = 'CactusPickleMiniGame'

	self.minigame_key = 'demonshire_1_3'

	self.buzz_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')

	self:pre_setting()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.buzz_sfx ~= nil then
		self.buzz_sfx:Stop()
		self.buzz_sfx = nil
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.carpenter_zone_1 and not self.already_enter_zone_1 then
		self.already_enter_zone_1 = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.enter_carpenter_zone_event_1, self, 1))
	elseif zone_name == self.carpenter_zone_2 and not self.already_enter_zone_1 then
		self.already_enter_zone_1 = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.enter_carpenter_zone_event_1, self, 2))
	elseif (zone_name == self.carpenter_zone_3 or zone_name == self.carpenter_zone_4) and not self.already_enter_zone_2 then
		self.already_enter_zone_2 = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.enter_carpenter_zone_event_2, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_demon_carpenter(1)) then
		self.is_interact_carpenter = true

		if self.already_played_minigame then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.retry_minigame, self))
			return
		end

		if self.seen_event then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.branch_cactus_pickle_minigame, self, true))
		else
			self.seen_event = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_carpenter_event, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.minigame_name then
		self.already_played_minigame = true
		mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.minigame_name)
		if e.Success then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.minigame_success, self, true))
		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.minigame_fail, self, true))
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:branch_cactus_pickle_minigame(align)
	local demon_leader = self.get_demon_carpenter(1)
	local demon_carpenter = {}
	local vampire_carpenter = {}
	local demon_carpenter_num = 7
	local vampire_carpenter_num = 6

	for i = 1, demon_carpenter_num do
		table.insert(demon_carpenter, self.get_demon_carpenter(i))
	end
	for i = 1, vampire_carpenter_num do
		table.insert(vampire_carpenter, self.get_vampire_carpenter(i))
	end

	if align then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		camera_util.move(demon_leader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 2), 1)
		party_util.align_party(demon_leader.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 'right', 1)
	end

	local wait = true
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local pass = true

	--맡겨만 달라고!
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('ds_cactus_pickle_34'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end })

	--지금은 안돼.
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('ds_cactus_pickle_35'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
			pass = false
		end })

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party.Leader, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if pass then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(demon_leader, { name = 'smile' })
		--고맙소!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(demon_leader, { key = 'ds_cactus_pickle_36', skip = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
		character_util.remove_emotion(demon_leader)
		character_util.set_direction(demon_leader, 'up')
		--모두 주목!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(demon_leader, { key = 'ds_cactus_pickle_37', skip = true })

		if self.buzz_sfx ~= nil then
			self.buzz_sfx:Stop()
			self.buzz_sfx = nil
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		for i = 2, #demon_carpenter do
			character_util.set_direction(demon_carpenter[i], 'down')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(demon_carpenter[i])
		end

		for i = 1, #vampire_carpenter do
			character_util.set_direction(vampire_carpenter[i], 'down')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(vampire_carpenter[i])
		end

		--여기 계신 분이 공평하게 배식을 도와주기로 하셨다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(demon_leader, { key = 'ds_cactus_pickle_38', skip = true })

		character_util.set_anim(demon_leader, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		--모두 불만 없겠지?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(demon_leader, { key = 'ds_cactus_pickle_39', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(demon_leader)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.set_direction(demon_carpenter[4], 'right')
		--뱀파이어 놈들만 아니라면 뭐…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(demon_carpenter[4], { key = 'ds_cactus_pickle_40', skip = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.set_direction(vampire_carpenter[1], 'left')
		--마족 놈들만 아니라면 뭐…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vampire_carpenter[1], { key = 'ds_cactus_pickle_41', skip = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.set_direction(demon_leader, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(demon_leader, 'release')
		--오케이! 시간이 없으니, 서두르자고!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(demon_leader, { key = 'ds_cactus_pickle_42', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(demon_leader)

		self:start_minigame()
	else
		--음… 어쩔 수 없지.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(demon_leader, { key = 'ds_cactus_pickle_43', skip = true })
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

		character_util.remove_anim(vampire_carpenter[1])
		character_util.remove_anim(vampire_carpenter[2])
		character_util.set_anim(vampire_carpenter[1], { name = 'jingak', sfx_name = '03_mech_stomp_02' })
		character_util.set_anim(vampire_carpenter[2], { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

		if self.buzz_sfx == nil then
			self.buzz_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_01', loop = true,
			                                             parent = demon_carpenter[4] })
		end

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end
end

function local_class:start_minigame()
	mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.minigame_name)

	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false
	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.minigame_name, self.minigame_key, function()
		is_mini_game_load_complete = true
	end)

	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.minigame_name)
end

	local wait = true
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local pass = true

	--맡겨만 달라고!
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('ds_cactus_pickle_34'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,

		if self.current_progress == self.progress.contest_first_stage then

			return true
		elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.contest_second_stage then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.chef_second_talk, self)
			return true
		elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.contest_third_stage then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.chef_third_talk, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_cooking_contest_box()) then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress.contest_second_stage then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.second_contest, self)
			return true
		elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.contest_third_stage then

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.cooking_contest_routine, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.start_contest_enter_zone) and
			self.current_progress == self.progress.contest_start then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_contest_routine, self))

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.contest_in_enter_zone) and
			not self.inner_check then
		self:contest_zone_sound_setting()

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.contest_out_enter_zone) and
			self.inner_check then
		self:contest_zone_sound_setting()

		return true
	end

	return false

end

function local_class:chef_first_talk()
	local chef = self.get_chef()

	party_util.align_party(chef, 'left', 0.5, 'arc')

	character_util.set_direction(chef,'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(chef, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'idle' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	if self.retry then
		--요리사(left,idle,idle) : 지원자가 적으니 채용이 애매해졌네, 자네 다시 할 마음이 있나?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chef, { key = self.ds_cooking_contest_script .. 15, skip = true })
	else
		--요리사(left,idle,idle) : 자네는 알바생 아닌가? 주방 직원 시험에 관심이 있나?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(chef, { key = self.ds_cooking_contest_script .. 14, skip = true })
	end

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ self.ds_cooking_contest_script..16, 'mercy' },{ self.ds_cooking_contest_script..17, 'brutal' } })

	--네 있습니다
	if choose_result == 1 then
		--재진입 여부

			--요리사(left,attack,cross_arm) : 이러면 인원은 어느정도 채워진 것 같군.

			self.buzz:FadeOut()
			self.buzz = nil

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
			screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

			self:set_active_state_member('disabled')

			quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

--아이템 생성,던지기,생성 시 이펙트 설정 오브젝트 반환 후 야채 저장고에 저장
function local_class:vegetable_throw(name, item_number, start_pos, end_pos, fx_name)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(fx_name):Instantiate(start_pos)

	self[name] = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = start_pos, itemid = item_number, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })

	local ground_offset = 0.125
	local drop_start_offset = 0.5
	local initial_velocity = 11
	local initial_acceleration = 28
	local rotation_num = 3

	start_pos = self[name].Position
	local drop_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall()

	drop_calculator:SetParameters(initial_velocity, initial_acceleration,
			field:GetTileInfoAt(start_pos):GetHeightAt(start_pos) + drop_start_offset, 0)
	drop_calculator:ScaleTime(1.2)

	while not drop_calculator:IsDone() and self[name] ~= nil do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local drop_progress = drop_calculator:GetProgress()
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(1, drop_progress)

		local cur_pos = (start_pos * (1 - progress) + end_pos * progress)

		local floor_height = field:GetTileInfoAt(cur_pos):GetHeightAt(cur_pos) + ground_offset
		drop_calculator:Proceed(dt, floor_height)

		self[name].Position = cur_pos + vector(0, unity_class.mathf.Max(drop_calculator:GetDistance(), floor_height), 0)

		local rotate_progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(1, drop_progress)
		local cur_rotation = rotate_progress * 360 * rotation_num

		self[name].SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.forward)
		self[name].ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.forward)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_vegetable(name)
	if self[name] ~= nil then
		self[name]:ConsumeComplete()
		self[name] = nil
	end
end

return local_class

	end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_simon()) then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress.none then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.simon_start_talk, self)
			return true
		elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.fallen_man_get_pork_chop then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.simon_end_talk, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, user_party.Leader) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.get_tomb_stone(1)) and
				self.tomb_stone_stack[1] < self.tomb_stone_break_count then

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.destroy_tomb_stone, self,1))
			return true

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.get_tomb_stone(2)) and
				self.tomb_stone_stack[2] < self.tomb_stone_break_count then

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.destroy_tomb_stone, self,2))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

--묘비 파괴시 이벤트
function local_class:destroy_tomb_stone(num)

	local tomb_stone = self.get_tomb_stone(num)

	--발톱을 받았을 경우
	--히트카운트 증가
	if self.current_progress == self.progress.fallen_man_start_talk then

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_dummy_02',3)

		self.tomb_stone_stack[num] = self.tomb_stone_stack[num] + 1

		if self.tomb_stone_stack[num] < 3 then
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.15)
			self:shake_obj(self.get_tomb_stone(num),0.1,0.15)
		else
			camera_util.shake(0.16, 0.45)
			self:shake_obj(self.get_tomb_stone(num),0.2,0.45)

		end
	end

	--해당 묘비를 3번 이상 칠 경우 폭발 후 파괴한 묘비 카운트 증가
	if self.tomb_stone_stack[num] == self.tomb_stone_break_count then

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_02')
		self.tomb_stone_break = self.tomb_stone_break + 1

		local tomb_stone_pos = tomb_stone.Position

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Env_SmallRock_lv1_destroy'):Instantiate(tomb_stone.Position)

		tomb_stone.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		local stone_count = 2
		--묘비를 2개 다 파괴했을 경우
		if self.tomb_stone_break == stone_count then

			local pork_pos = tomb_stone_pos

			self.pork_chop_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
				itemid = self.port_chop_id,
				pos = pork_pos,
				notforinven = true,
				showoncharacter = true,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
			})

			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.ds_fallen_man_script .. 16 })

			wait_for_sec(1)

			self:pork_chop_routine()

			party_util.reset_controllers()

		end
	end

end

	self.current_progress = self.progress.fallen_man_get_pork_chop

function local_class:shake_obj(obj, magnitude, duration)
	local obj_pos = obj.Position
	local shake_range = magnitude * 0.5

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local cur_shake_x = unity_class.random.Range(-shake_range, shake_range)
		local cur_shake_z = unity_class.random.Range(-shake_range, shake_range)

		obj.Position = obj_pos + vector(cur_shake_x, 0, cur_shake_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	obj.Position = obj_pos

end
